consideration_type: Stock
cash_consideration: No cash consideration is stated for PAD common stockholders. The merger agreement provides for fractional SPAC shares to be rounded up to the nearest whole share.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each share of PAD common stock, a number of shares of FACT common stock equal to 12,388,291 divided by the number of PAD common shares issued and outstanding immediately before the merger effective time. Fractional shares are rounded up to the nearest whole share.

FACT and Merger Sub’s additional conditions include PAD representation-and-warranty accuracy, material covenant compliance, no continuing uncured PAD material adverse effect, a PAD officer certificate and required ancillary documents. The minimum-cash condition had not been satisfied as of the proxy statement/prospectus and may be waived by PAD.

available_options: No holder election; eligible PAD common shares convert into the stated stock consideration. Treasury and dissenting shares have separate treatment.

acquirer: Precision Aerospace & Defense Group, Inc. (formerly Precision Aerospace Group, Inc.), through its merger subsidiary, Precision Aerospace Aerodyn Merger Sub, Inc.
consideration_type: Mixed cash and stock, including contingent post-closing cash and stock payments based on Aerodyn’s adjusted EBITDA.
cash_consideration: For the sole stockholder’s Aerodyn Engineering Holdings, Inc. common stock, closing cash under the supplied merger agreement equals 50% of $20,698,038 less the $500,000 escrow amount; the agreement also provides for payment of Aerodyn’s closing cash after the working-capital calculation and for working-capital adjustment against a $6,724,177 target. Contingent post-closing cash payments for 2024–2027 equal 50% of the specified annual adjusted-EBITDA increase multiplied by 5.99, payable only if adjusted EBITDA exceeds the applicable high-water mark. The S-4 separately describes a December 2025 agreement under which David Lawrence will receive $34,515,000 cash on the FACT/PAD business-combination closing date and four later payments of $750,000.
stock_exchange_ratio: No fixed number of purchaser shares per Aerodyn Engineering Holdings, Inc. common share is stated. Under the supplied merger agreement, the closing share payment is the number of purchaser common shares equal to 50% of $20,698,038 divided by the Initial Listing Price; contingent annual share payments equal the corresponding annual cash payment divided by the purchaser common stock closing price on the last trading day of the relevant year. The S-4 separately describes approximately 1,125,000 New PAD common shares issuable to David Lawrence under a December 2025 agreement.
closing_conditions: The supplied Aerodyn merger agreement makes closing subject to satisfaction or written waiver of: the purchaser’s IPO and listing of its common stock on the NYSE; necessary governmental approvals and applicable HSR waiting-period expiration or termination; absence of specified prohibitory laws, orders or governmental actions; and merger filings with Delaware and Indiana. Purchaser/Merger Sub also require material accuracy of the sole stockholder’s representations, material covenant performance, no Aerodyn/corporation/business material adverse effect, specified certificates and deliverables, and listed third-party consents. The corporation/sole stockholder also require material accuracy of purchaser representations, material purchaser covenant performance, no purchaser material adverse effect, specified deliverables, approval of David Lawrence’s purchaser-board appointment and evidence of the specified employee incentive allocation.
event_status: Completed; PAD acquired Aerodyn on December 23, 2024. The S-4 describes a subsequent December 2025 agreement concerning consideration payable to David Lawrence.
security_description: All issued and outstanding common stock, without par value, of Aerodyn Engineering Holdings, Inc., held by its sole stockholder, David Lawrence; treasury shares, if any, are canceled without consideration.
available_options: No holder election; the sole stockholder’s shares convert into the applicable merger consideration.

acquirer: SPX Enterprises, LLC (Parent); Project King Acquisition, Inc. is its wholly owned merger subsidiary.
consideration_type: Cash, subject to merger-agreement adjustments, applicable tax withholding, and exceptions for cancelled and dissenting shares.
cash_consideration: USD $84.44 per Crawford United Class A or Class B common share, without interest, subject to reductions for closing-date indebtedness and transaction expenses exceeding Crawford United's cash on hand and to applicable tax withholding. The estimated amount after anticipated indebtedness and expense adjustments is approximately USD $83.42 per share.
stock_exchange_ratio: No stock consideration
shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled Crawford United shareholder special meeting: 2/3/2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time, unless adjourned or postponed.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver where permitted: adoption of the merger agreement by holders of a majority of the voting power of outstanding Crawford United common shares and at least two-thirds of outstanding Class A common shares; expiration or termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period; absence of legal restraints prohibiting the merger; and receipt of governmental approvals specified in the confidential disclosure letter, without specified adverse conditions. Parent's and Merger Sub's obligations also require Crawford United's representations and warranties to meet the agreement's applicable accuracy standards, material compliance with its covenants and obligations, no continuing Company Material Adverse Effect since 12/5/2025, a confirming officer certificate, and dissenters' rights claims covering no more than 6.0% of outstanding common shares. Crawford United's obligation also requires Parent's and Merger Sub's representations and warranties to meet the applicable accuracy standard, material compliance with their covenants and obligations, and a confirming Parent officer certificate. There is no financing condition.
event_status: Pending as described in the proxy statement dated 1/5/2026; the merger agreement was executed on 12/5/2025, and the shareholder vote was scheduled for 2/3/2026.
security_description: Crawford United Corporation Class A common capital stock and Class B common capital stock, each without par value. Both classes receive the same per-share cash consideration, except for cancelled shares and shares subject to valid dissenters' rights. Outstanding restricted share awards vest and convert into a right to receive cash based on the merger consideration.
effective_date: Not specified as a calendar date. The merger will become effective when the certificate of merger is filed with the Ohio Secretary of State, or at a later date and time agreed in writing and specified in that certificate. The filing states an expectation of completion as early as the first quarter of 2026, subject to closing conditions.
available_options: No holder election; eligible shares convert into the right to receive cash. Holders who validly exercise and retain dissenters' rights instead have the statutory right to receive the fair cash value of their shares.

acquirer: Churchill Capital Corp X (CCX), through its wholly owned subsidiaries AH Merger Sub I, Inc. and AH Merger Sub II, LLC. Merger Sub I will merge into ColdQuanta, Inc.; the surviving corporation will then merge into Merger Sub II, which will remain a wholly owned subsidiary of CCX.
consideration_type: Stock; subject to the Merger Agreement, consideration to Infleqtion stockholders and holders of Infleqtion restricted stock awards and options is entirely in Post-Closing Company common stock. Outstanding options are assumed and converted into options to purchase that stock.
cash_consideration: No cash consideration to holders of eligible Infleqtion common stock; the stated aggregate consideration is paid entirely in Post-Closing Company common stock. Fractional shares are rounded to whole shares, rather than paid in cash.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each 1 share of Infleqtion common stock outstanding immediately before the First Effective Time, after conversion of Infleqtion preferred stock and excluding Excluded Shares and Dissenting Shares, the holder receives shares of Post-Closing Company common stock equal to the Exchange Ratio. The Exchange Ratio is the per-share Equity Value divided by $10.00; per-share Equity Value equals ($1,800,000,000 plus the aggregate exercise price of all outstanding Infleqtion options) divided by Infleqtion Total Shares. The filing's illustrative assumed Exchange Ratio is 0.347. Each holder's aggregate fractional share entitlement is rounded to the nearest whole share, with 0.5 or more rounded up.
closing_conditions: Closing is subject to satisfaction or permitted waiver of the following: CCX shareholder approval of the condition precedent proposals and requisite Infleqtion stockholder approval; expiration or termination of the HSR Act waiting period (the filing states the initial waiting period expired on 11/3/2025); the specified UK national-security and Australian foreign-investment clearance or non-objection outcomes; no governmental order or law preventing or materially restraining the transactions; CCX having at least $5,000,001 in net tangible assets after redemptions and net PIPE proceeds (the filing states this threshold cannot be waived under CCX's current articles); completion of the required governance documents and board appointments; listing of Post-Closing Company common stock on Nasdaq or another mutually agreed exchange and eligibility for continued listing; and effectiveness of the registration statement without an SEC stop order or action seeking one. CCX's conditions also include Infleqtion's representations and warranties being accurate under the agreement's materiality standards, material compliance with its covenants, no continuing Infleqtion Material Adverse Effect, expiration of the 20-day appraisal-demand period, and holders of no more than 5% of Infleqtion capital stock beneficially owning Dissenting Shares at closing. Infleqtion's conditions also include the corresponding accuracy of CCX and the merger subsidiaries' representations and warranties and material covenant compliance, at least $100 million of Available Closing SPAC Cash, completion of the Domestication and delivery of its time-stamped Delaware certificate of incorporation, no continuing SPAC Material Adverse Effect, and material compliance by the Sponsor and Insiders with the Sponsor Agreement without the specified threats concerning that agreement. The PIPE financing is included in Available Closing SPAC Cash; the filing does not state a separate condition requiring a particular PIPE amount.
event_status: Pending as of the 1/5/2026 registration statement: the parties signed the Merger Agreement on 9/8/2025, and closing remains subject to stated conditions.
security_description: Infleqtion common stock, par value $0.0001 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the First Effective Time after conversion of Infleqtion preferred stock, including preferred-stock restricted awards. Excluded Shares and Dissenting Shares are excepted; outstanding Infleqtion options and restricted stock awards have separately described treatment.
effective_date: The First Merger takes effect when its certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed by CCX and Infleqtion and specified in that certificate. The Second Merger takes effect immediately afterward, when its certificate of merger is filed, or at a later agreed time specified in that certificate. No calendar effective date or time is stated.
available_options: No holder election for eligible Infleqtion common stock: each share is exchanged for the stock consideration specified by the Exchange Ratio, subject to the stated exceptions.

If the Closing VWAP is below $22.73, the ratio is 0.2015; if it is above $34.76, the ratio is 0.1318. Fractional SNDA shares will be paid in cash instead of issued.

consideration_type: Cash for eligible shares of Brighthouse Financial common stock.
cash_consideration: $70.00 in cash per share of Brighthouse Financial common stock, without interest and less applicable deductions or withholding. Consideration for an outstanding fractional share is the fraction multiplied by $70.00, rounded up to the nearest whole cent.
stock_exchange_ratio: No stock consideration for eligible shares of Brighthouse Financial common stock.
shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled Brighthouse Financial stockholder special meeting: 2/12/2026 at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Standard Time.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where permitted by law, waiver of: approval of the merger agreement by holders of a majority of outstanding Brighthouse Financial common shares; expiration or termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period; specified approvals or prior written non-disapprovals from insurance regulators in Delaware, Massachusetts and New York; FINRA approval of the broker-dealer change-of-control application, unless the agreement’s specified alternative criteria for deeming that condition satisfied are met; and absence of a governmental order or law prohibiting or making the merger illegal. Parent’s and Merger Sub’s additional conditions include Brighthouse Financial’s material covenant compliance, accuracy of its representations and warranties under the applicable materiality standards, absence of a Company Material Adverse Effect since the agreement date, an officer’s certificate and no imposed Burdensome Condition. Brighthouse Financial’s additional conditions include Parent’s material performance, accuracy of Parent’s and Merger Sub’s representations and warranties under the applicable Parent Material Adverse Effect standard, and an officer’s certificate. Obtaining the investment, equity financing and debt financing is not a closing condition.

acquirer: Trailblazer Merger Corporation I, through its wholly owned subsidiary Trailblazer Merger Sub, Ltd.; Trailblazer Holdings, Inc. will be the surviving parent after Trailblazer merges into it.
consideration_type: Stock consideration, with an election for holders of Cyabra Series B Preferred Shares to receive either Holdings common stock or Holdings Series A Preferred Stock. Cyabra securityholders may also receive contingent earnout shares if specified stock-price targets are met.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration is specified. A holder otherwise entitled to a fractional share of Holdings common stock is instead paid cash equal to that fraction multiplied by $10.00, rounded to the nearest cent, without interest.
stock_exchange_ratio: Each eligible Cyabra Ordinary Share converts into the right to receive Holdings Common Stock equal to the Conversion Ratio: 10,600,000 shares of Holdings Common Stock divided by Cyabra’s outstanding shares on a fully diluted basis, rounded down to four decimal places. Each eligible Cyabra Preferred Share, other than the specified Series B Preferred Shares issued upon conversion of the 2024 Convertible Notes, receives Holdings Common Stock equal to the Conversion Ratio multiplied by the number of Cyabra Ordinary Shares issuable upon conversion of that preferred share. For the Series B Preferred Share election, the Holdings Series A Preferred Stock option provides a number of preferred shares equal to the holder’s Series B Preferred Shares multiplied by their original issue price, divided by 1,000. Merger consideration and the Conversion Ratio are subject to adjustment for specified changes to Holdings common stock before issuance; fractional Holdings common shares are paid in cash instead.
shareholder_vote_date: Trailblazer stockholders’ Special Meeting is scheduled for an unspecified date in 2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern time. The date of any Cyabra shareholder vote is not stated.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver of applicable conditions: no law or order restraining or prohibiting the Business Combination; expiration or termination of applicable HSR Act waiting periods and required governmental consents; Cyabra shareholder approval; Trailblazer stockholder approval of the Merger Proposal, Charter Amendment Proposal, First Nasdaq Proposal and Incentive Plan Proposal; conditional Nasdaq listing approval and applicable listing requirements; effectiveness of the registration statement without an outstanding SEC stop order; passage of at least 50 days after filing the Israeli merger proposal and at least 30 days after Cyabra shareholder approval; required tax certificate and IRS notice; specified Cyabra consents; Israeli prospectus exemption; appointment of the post-closing board; consummation of the PIPE Investment and 2024 Convertible Notes financing; and required Israeli tax rulings or interim rulings. Party-specific conditions also address material covenant compliance, accuracy of representations and warranties, specified certificates and agreements, and absence of a continuing material adverse effect. The filing describes a potential waiver or sufficient-trust-funds exception concerning the PIPE Investment.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was amended on 11/11/2024 and 11/6/2025, and completion remains subject to closing conditions.
security_description: Cyabra Strategy Ltd. Ordinary Shares, NIS 0.01 par value, and Cyabra Preferred Shares, including Series B Preferred Shares with a distinct consideration election. Excluded shares are canceled without consideration. Cyabra options, convertible notes and warrants have separately described treatment.
effective_date: The Acquisition Merger becomes effective on the date stated in the certificate issued by the Israeli Registrar of Companies. The parties intend legal effectiveness and issuance of that certificate to occur on, or as soon as practicable before, the Closing Date; no calendar date or time is specified.
available_options: Holders of Cyabra Series B Preferred Shares may elect either Holdings Common Stock or Holdings Series A Preferred Stock as Preferred B Merger Consideration. For the preferred-stock choice, the number of Holdings Series A Preferred Shares equals the holder’s Cyabra Series B Preferred Shares multiplied by their original issue price, divided by 1,000. No consideration election is stated for holders of other Cyabra shares.

consideration_type: Elective consideration: eligible Canadian resident Dolly Varden shareholders may elect exchangeable shares of 1566004 B.C. Ltd. instead of Contango ORE, Inc. common stock; other holders receive Contango common stock. Both choices are stock consideration.
cash_consideration: No cash consideration per Dolly Varden common share is stated. Fractional Contango or exchangeable shares are rounded down without payment or other adjustment. Dissenting shareholders who establish entitlement to fair value are treated separately.
stock_exchange_ratio: Contango-stock choice: 0.1652 shares of Contango ORE, Inc. voting common stock per 1 Dolly Varden Silver Corporation common share. Eligible-holder exchangeable-share choice: 0.1652 exchangeable shares of 1566004 B.C. Ltd. per 1 Dolly Varden common share; each exchangeable share is exchangeable for 1 Contango common share, subject to adjustment. No fractional shares are issued; fractional interests are rounded down without payment or other adjustment.
closing_conditions: Pending satisfaction or applicable waiver of Contango stockholder approval of the Arrangement Proposal and Dolly Varden shareholder approval of the Arrangement; approval of the Contango Share Increase Proposal, which is cross-conditioned with the Arrangement Proposal; required NYSE American and TSXV approvals and key third-party consents; British Columbia Supreme Court interim and final orders; absence of legal restraints or specified governmental proceedings; and specified U.S. and Canadian securities-law exemptions and transferability. Contango and the Acquiror additionally require Dolly Varden’s representations and warranties to meet the agreement’s standards, material compliance with its covenants, no Dolly Varden Material Adverse Effect, and valid dissent elections covering no more than 5% of Dolly Varden shares. Dolly Varden additionally requires corresponding representation, warranty, covenant and no-Contango-Material-Adverse-Effect conditions; evidence of NYSE American listing approval for the consideration shares and shares issuable on exchange; execution of specified exchangeable-share and transition-services agreements; and specified post-closing board and officer appointments. Mutual conditions require mutual consent to waive; party-specific conditions may be waived by the benefiting party.
event_status: Announced and pending; the preliminary proxy statement seeks stockholder approval, and completion remains subject to conditions.
security_description: Common shares of Dolly Varden Silver Corporation, excluding shares held by shareholders who validly exercise dissent rights. Dolly Varden options and restricted share units receive separate treatment.
effective_date: Conditional, exact date not stated. Closing and legal effectiveness are to occur on the fifth Business Day after satisfaction or waiver of the closing conditions, or another date agreed in writing; the Arrangement becomes effective at 12:01 a.m. Vancouver time on the Effective Date, unless the parties agree to another time in writing. The subsequent amalgamation of the Acquiror and Dolly Varden has separate, later timing.
available_options: An eligible Canadian-resident shareholder or qualifying Canadian partnership may elect 0.1652 exchangeable shares per Dolly Varden common share for any or all of its shares and receive 0.1652 Contango common shares per remaining Dolly Varden common share. Other shareholders receive 0.1652 Contango common shares per Dolly Varden common share. An exchangeable-share election requires a duly completed Letter of Transmittal and Election Form and any certificates to be deposited with the depositary before the Election Deadline, or another election method reasonably acceptable to Contango and Dolly Varden before the Effective Time. A deposited form is irrevocable.
default_option: A Dolly Varden shareholder who does not submit a duly completed Letter of Transmittal and Election Form and any certificates before the Election Deadline, otherwise fails the election requirements, or has not made another acceptable exchangeable-share election before the Effective Time is deemed to elect only Contango common shares. Shareholders whose dissent rights are withdrawn or who are determined not to be entitled to fair value also receive Contango common shares.
election_deadline: Date and time not yet stated; Dolly Varden and Contango will agree on an Election Deadline before the Effective Date. Dolly Varden must announce it by news release at least two Business Days in advance. The deadline may be extended to a later date before the Effective Date, with at least one Business Day of advance notice of the rescheduled deadline.

acquirer: Churchill Capital Corp IX (CCIX), through its wholly owned merger subsidiaries AL Merger Sub I, Inc. and AL Merger Sub II, LLC. Merger Sub I will merge into Plus Automation, Inc.; immediately afterward, Plus Automation, Inc. will merge into Merger Sub II, which will survive as a wholly owned subsidiary of CCIX.
consideration_type: Stock, plus a contingent right for eligible pre-closing PlusAI equityholders to receive up to 15,000,000 additional shares of post-closing common stock if specified price targets are met during the five-year earnout period.
cash_consideration: No cash consideration is payable to PlusAI stockholders in the merger; the equity consideration is payable entirely in shares. Fractional stock entitlements are rounded to the nearest whole share rather than paid in cash.
stock_exchange_ratio: The Exchange Ratio is the Per Share Equity Value divided by $10.00, rounded to the nearest 0.001. The filing estimates approximately 0.0700 shares of Post-Closing Company common stock per 1 issued and outstanding share of PlusAI common stock. PlusAI Class A common stock receives Post-Closing Company Class A common stock; PlusAI Class B common stock receives Post-Closing Company Class B common stock. A holder’s aggregate fractional share entitlement is rounded to the nearest whole share, with 0.5 or more rounded up.
shareholder_vote_date: CCIX shareholders: extraordinary general meeting scheduled for 2/3/2026 at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time to vote on approval of the Merger Agreement and business combination. PlusAI stockholder approval is contemplated by written consent, but no consent date is stated.
closing_conditions: Conditions include approval of the condition precedent proposals by CCIX shareholders and approval of the Merger Agreement, Merger and other transactions by the requisite PlusAI stockholders; expiration or early termination of the HSR Act waiting period (the initial waiting period expired on 8/6/2025); absence of governmental orders or laws preventing or materially restraining the transactions; at least $5,000,001 of CCIX net tangible assets after redemptions; adoption or execution of documents needed for the contemplated governance arrangements and constitution of the post-closing board; listing and continued-listing eligibility of the Post-Closing Company Class A common stock, including earnout shares; and effectiveness of the registration statement without an SEC stop order or an action seeking one. Each side’s obligations are also subject to specified accuracy of the other side’s representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, and absence of a continuing applicable material adverse effect. CCIX’s obligations additionally require expiration of the appraisal-demand period and holders beneficially owning no more than 5% of PlusAI capital stock holding dissenting shares. PlusAI’s obligations additionally require completed Domestication, delivery of the time-stamped Delaware certificate of incorporation, and material compliance with the Sponsor Agreement without specified threats to its validity or continuation. The former $100 million Available Closing SPAC Cash condition was removed by Amendment No. 2; the filing states there are no other closing conditions based on available closing cash or the trust-account balance after redemptions. Conditions may be waived in writing by the applicable parties where permitted, but CCIX cannot close with less than $5,000,001 of net tangible assets.
event_status: Pending; the Merger Agreement was amended by Amendment No. 1 dated 9/8/2025 and Amendment No. 2 dated 9/18/2025. The filing describes the shareholder meeting and closing as future events and does not state that the merger has closed.
security_description: Issued and outstanding PlusAI Class A common stock and PlusAI Class B common stock, including common shares resulting from the pre-closing conversion of PlusAI preferred stock and SAFEs. Shares issued from the exercise of PlusAI options granted under the 2021 Plan receive the Class B treatment. Excluded shares and dissenting shares are excepted from the ordinary exchange; outstanding options, unvested RSUs and warrants have separately described treatment.
effective_date: Not stated. The first merger becomes effective when its certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed by CCIX and PlusAI and specified in that certificate. The second merger becomes effective immediately afterward when its certificate is filed, or at a later agreed time specified in that certificate. An assumed closing date of 2/6/2026 is expressly illustrative, not a stated legal effective date.
available_options: No holder election; the applicable class of PlusAI common stock is exchanged for the corresponding class of Post-Closing Company common stock, subject to the stated exceptions and contingent earnout.

acquirer: Volato Group, Inc. (Volato), through its wholly owned merger subsidiary, Volato Merger Subsidiary, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock; M2i Global common stockholders will receive Volato Class A common stock, subject to the Merger Agreement’s adjustments. M2i Global Series A Super Voting Preferred Stock will convert into M2i Global common stock immediately before the merger and then be exchanged for Volato common stock.
cash_consideration: No cash will be paid for fractional shares eliminated by rounding; no cash price per M2i Global share is stated.
stock_exchange_ratio: A variable number of shares of Volato Class A common stock per share of M2i Global common stock, determined so that the shares issued to M2i Global stockholders represent 85% of Volato capital stock on an as-converted, fully diluted basis at closing. Volato shares underlying outstanding warrants are excluded from the calculation; shares underlying outstanding Volato options are included. The amount is subject to adjustments mutually agreed by Volato and M2i Global. A holder’s aggregate fractional entitlement is rounded down if less than 0.50 share and up if at least 0.50 share.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted written waiver: effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement with no outstanding SEC stop order or proceeding seeking one; expiration or termination of any applicable HSR Act waiting period; no effective legal restraint or law making the merger illegal; required board and stockholder approvals of Volato and M2i Global; NYSE American listing approval for the combined company and merger shares, subject to official notice of issuance; and completion of due diligence to the satisfaction of Sichenzia Ross Ference Carmel LLP and Alliance Global Partners. Additional party-specific conditions include accuracy of representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, absence of a continuing material adverse effect, and delivery of specified certificates, documents and any required tax opinions. Volato’s obligations also require M2i Global’s stockholder written consent to remain in effect. M2i Global’s obligations also require termination of specified Volato agreements and rights without post-merger liability and Volato net debt of no more than $10,000,000 at the effective time; M2i Global may waive the net-debt condition. M2i Global stockholder approval is described elsewhere in the filing as having been obtained, while Volato stockholder approval remains required.
event_status: Pending as described in the preliminary proxy statement/prospectus; the merger agreement was executed, M2i Global stockholder approval is described as obtained, and Volato stockholder approval and other closing conditions remain.
security_description: M2i Global, Inc. common stock, $0.001 par value per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the merger. M2i Global Series A Super Voting Preferred Stock is to convert into M2i Global common stock immediately before the effective time.
effective_date: When the articles of merger are filed with the Nevada Secretary of State, or at a later time specified in the merger filing with Volato’s and M2i Global’s consent; no calendar date or clock time is stated.
available_options: No holder election; eligible M2i Global common shares convert into the right to receive stock consideration. Holders who properly exercise Nevada appraisal rights may instead obtain payment of the fair value of their shares.

acquirer: Sword Purchaser, LLC (Parent); Sword Merger Sub, Inc. is its wholly owned merger subsidiary.
consideration_type: Cash, for each outstanding share of Sealed Air common stock other than Cancelled Shares and Dissenting Shares.
cash_consideration: USD $42.15 per share of Sealed Air common stock, without interest and less any applicable withholding taxes; subject to equitable adjustment for specified changes in Sealed Air capital stock before the Effective Time. Cancelled Shares receive no payment, and holders of Dissenting Shares who retain appraisal rights receive treatment under Delaware appraisal law instead.
stock_exchange_ratio: No stock consideration is payable to holders of Sealed Air common stock.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permissible waiver: adoption of the Merger Agreement by holders of at least a majority of the outstanding Sealed Air common shares entitled to vote; expiration or termination of the HSR Act waiting period (early termination was received on 12/23/2025); required clearances, approvals and consents under specified other antitrust, foreign investment and applicable laws, including European Union antitrust clearance and European Commission approval under the Foreign Subsidies Regulation; and no governmental law or order prohibiting the Merger. Parent and Merger Sub also require Sealed Air’s representations and warranties to meet the agreement’s applicable accuracy standards, Sealed Air’s material compliance with its covenants, no Company Material Adverse Effect since the agreement date, and Sealed Air’s closing certificate. Sealed Air also requires Parent’s and Merger Sub’s representations and warranties to meet the applicable accuracy standard, their material covenant compliance, and Parent’s closing certificate. Receipt of financing is not a condition to Parent’s or Merger Sub’s obligation to consummate the Merger.
event_status: Announced and pending as described in the preliminary proxy statement; the go-shop period expired on 12/16/2025 without a Superior Proposal, and the HSR Act waiting period received early termination on 12/23/2025. Stockholder approval and other closing conditions are described as required; completion is not reported.
security_description: Sealed Air Corporation common stock, par value $0.10 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the Effective Time, excluding Cancelled Shares and Dissenting Shares.
effective_date: Conditional timing: when the certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at another time specified in that certificate. Filing is to occur contemporaneously with or as promptly as practicable after Closing; no calendar date or clock time is stated.
available_options: No holder election; eligible shares convert into the right to receive fixed cash consideration. Qualifying holders who do not vote in favor may instead pursue statutory appraisal rights by complying with Delaware law.

stock_exchange_ratio: For each 1 Class B common share of Old Glory Holding Company, the number of OGB Financial Company common shares equals the per-share participating equity value divided by $10.00. closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where permitted by law, waiver of the applicable conditions: required bank regulatory approvals without a condition, limitation or requirement reasonably expected to have a material effect on Old Glory Holding Company or its bank after closing; expiration or termination of applicable HSR Act waiting periods and no applicable voluntary agreement not to close; no governmental legal restraint prohibiting the transaction; an effective registration statement/proxy statement without an operative SEC stop order or pending proceeding seeking one; Old Glory Holding Company shareholder written consent and DAAQ shareholder approvals; closing aggregate cash of at least $50,000,000; execution of the registration rights agreement; Nasdaq approval of PubCo’s initial listing application and the shares to be listed, with applicable listing compliance; specified bank capitalization, regulatory-rating, CRA-plan, enforcement-action and BSA/AML or sanctions-compliance requirements; and the applicable parties’ representation-and-warranty accuracy and material covenant compliance. DAAQ’s obligation is also conditioned on no Company Material Adverse Effect since the agreement date.

cash_consideration: No regular cash merger consideration is stated for SPAC Class B ordinary shares. No cash payment for fractional shares is stated; fractional Pubco shares are rounded down.
stock_exchange_ratio: 1 share of Pubco Class A Stock per 1 SPAC Class B ordinary share that has not been forfeited under the Sponsor Support Agreement. closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or written waiver, where permissible, by the Seller and SPAC: required SPAC shareholder approval; no effective law making the transactions illegal or preventing or prohibiting them; an SEC-effective registration statement that remains effective at Closing; and Pubco Class A Stock approved for DTC clearing and listing on an acceptable exchange, subject only to notice of issuance. The Seller may waive additional conditions concerning SPAC’s representations and warranties, material compliance with its agreements and covenants, absence of a continuing uncured SPAC material adverse effect, and material performance of the Sponsor Support Agreement covenants. The agreement also calls for required governmental consents and applicable antitrust filings and waiting periods; no specific approval is stated as having been obtained.

available_options: No holder election; eligible SPAC Class B ordinary shares convert at the fixed stock ratio.

acquirer: Avalanche Treasury Corporation (Pubco), through its merger subsidiary Avalanche Company Merger Sub LLC
consideration_type: Stock; each Company unit held by a Seller Related Party receives both Pubco Class A Stock and Pubco Class B Stock.
cash_consideration: No cash consideration is stated for Company units held by Seller Related Parties. No cash payment for fractional shares is stated; fractional Pubco shares are rounded down.
stock_exchange_ratio: 1 share of Pubco Class A Stock and 1 share of Pubco Class B Stock per 1 Company unit held by a Seller Related Party immediately before the Company Merger Effective Time. No fractional Pubco shares will be issued; a holder’s aggregate entitlement is rounded down to the nearest whole share. Company units held as treasury interests or by Company subsidiaries are cancelled without consideration.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or written waiver, where permissible, by the Seller and SPAC: required SPAC shareholder approval; no effective law making the transactions illegal or preventing or prohibiting them; an SEC-effective registration statement that remains effective at Closing; and Pubco Class A Stock approved for DTC clearing and listing on an acceptable exchange, subject only to notice of issuance. SPAC may waive additional conditions concerning representations and warranties of the Company, Pubco, its subsidiaries, the Seller Related Parties and Astral; their material compliance with agreements and covenants; absence of a material adverse effect on the Company or Pubco; and completion of the Dragonfly Contribution and Foundation Transaction under their respective agreements. The agreement also calls for required governmental consents and applicable antitrust filings and waiting periods; no specific approval is stated as having been obtained.
event_status: Pending; business combination agreement amended by Amendment No. 1 dated 1/13/2026, effective as of 10/1/2025.
security_description: Units of Avalanche Treasury Company LLC held by Seller Related Parties: Dragonfly Digital Management, LLC; Dragonfly Ventures L.P.; and Dragonfly Ventures II, L.P. The amendment provides that the DVs’ units receive the same Company Merger consideration as the Seller’s units.
effective_date: Conditional: the Company Merger takes effect on the Closing Date when its certificate of merger is accepted for filing by the Delaware Secretary of State, or at another time specified in that certificate. No calendar date or clock time is stated.
available_options: No holder election; each eligible Seller Related Party Company unit receives the fixed combination of one Pubco Class A share and one Pubco Class B share.

The Company’s additional conditions include the specified accuracy of Parent’s and Merger Sub’s representations and warranties, their material compliance with obligations and covenants, and their directors’ closing certificates. Obtaining financing is expressly not a closing condition.
event_status: Pending as described in the January 13, 2026 preliminary proxy statement; the merger remains subject to closing conditions, including Company shareholder approval.

acquirer: Tropic Purchaser LLC (Parent); its wholly owned subsidiary, Tropic Merger Sub LLC, is the merger subsidiary and surviving company.
consideration_type: Cash, for each eligible share of Alexander & Baldwin, Inc. common stock; cancelled shares receive no consideration, and properly dissenting shares are entitled to payment of fair value instead.
cash_consideration: USD $21.20 per share of Alexander & Baldwin, Inc. common stock, without interest, less applicable withholding taxes and the $0.35-per-share January dividend, resulting in a net payment at closing of USD $20.85 per share less applicable withholding taxes. The merger consideration is reduced by the per-share amount of any other dividend declared or paid as permitted to maintain REIT status or avoid entity-level income or excise taxes. Cancelled shares receive no payment; properly dissenting shares instead have a right to payment of fair value under Hawaii law.
stock_exchange_ratio: No stock consideration.
shareholder_vote_date: Alexander & Baldwin, Inc. special shareholder meeting scheduled for 3/9/2026 at 10:00 a.m. Hawaii Standard Time.
closing_conditions: The parties’ obligations to close are subject to satisfaction or, where permitted by law, written waiver of the required approval by holders of a majority of Alexander & Baldwin, Inc. common stock entitled to vote, and the absence of an effective law or governmental order issued after the merger agreement date that restrains, enjoins, renders illegal or otherwise prohibits the merger. Parent’s and Merger Sub’s additional conditions include the specified accuracy of the Company’s representations and warranties, the Company’s material compliance with its covenants, no material adverse effect since the merger agreement date, receipt of the Company’s closing certificate, and receipt of a specified REIT tax opinion. The Company’s additional conditions include the specified accuracy of Parent’s and Merger Sub’s representations and warranties, their material compliance with their covenants, and receipt of Parent’s closing certificate. The merger agreement does not contain a financing condition.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement has been executed and the Company’s board has approved it, but shareholder approval and other closing conditions are required.
security_description: Alexander & Baldwin, Inc. common stock, without par value. Issued and outstanding shares immediately before the effective time are affected, other than cancelled shares and properly dissenting shares. Restricted stock unit and performance stock unit awards have separately described treatment.
effective_date: Not specified. The merger will become effective when the articles of merger are filed with the Hawaii Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs, or at a later date and time agreed in writing by the Company and Parent and specified in those articles. The merger was anticipated to be completed in the first quarter of 2026, subject to shareholder approval and other conditions; that anticipated closing period is not a specified legal effective date.
available_options: No holder election; eligible common shares are converted into a fixed right to cash, subject to the stated adjustments, withholding and exceptions for cancelled and properly dissenting shares.

acquirer: QNB Corp.
consideration_type: Stock; Victory common stockholders receive QNB Corp. common stock, subject to cash in lieu of fractional shares. Properly dissenting shareholders receive cash for the fair value of their shares instead.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration per share of Victory common stock. Cash is paid only in lieu of fractional QNB Corp. common shares, without interest and rounded to the nearest cent: the fraction of a share, rounded to the nearest one-thousandth, multiplied by the average daily closing sale price of QNB Corp. common stock for the five consecutive full trading days ending two trading days before the closing date. Properly dissenting Victory shareholders may instead receive cash for the fair value of their shares.
stock_exchange_ratio: 0.5500 shares of QNB Corp. common stock per 1 share of The Victory Bancorp, Inc. common stock. The ratio is generally fixed, subject to specified adjustments for changes in capitalization. If Victory gives notice of termination following the specified QNB stock-price decline relative to the Nasdaq Bank Index, QNB may elect to increase the ratio under the merger agreement’s formula. Fractional QNB shares will not be issued; cash will be paid instead.
shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled: The Victory Bancorp, Inc. shareholders—2/19/2026 at 11:00 a.m., local time; QNB Corp. shareholders—2/19/2026 at 11:00 a.m., local time. No time zone is stated.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted written waiver: approval of the merger agreement and merger by the requisite votes of both Victory and QNB shareholders; required regulatory approvals or waivers, including Federal Reserve approval or waiver and FDIC and Pennsylvania Department of Banking and Securities approvals, remaining in effect without specified materially adverse or unduly burdensome conditions, and expiration of statutory waiting periods; no governmental legal restraint prohibiting the transaction; authorization for quotation on the OTC of QNB shares to be issued; SEC effectiveness of the registration statement and joint proxy statement/prospectus without a stop order or threatened stop order; Victory’s procurement of the specified directors’ and officers’ insurance tail policy; each party’s representations and warranties meeting the agreement’s applicable standards and performance of its obligations in all material respects; each party’s receipt of a closing-date tax opinion that the parent merger will qualify as a reorganization under Section 368(a) of the Internal Revenue Code; Victory’s obtaining required non-governmental consents, subject to the specified material-adverse-effect exception; and holders of no more than 10.0% of outstanding Victory common stock properly exercising dissenters’ appraisal rights.
event_status: Pending as described in the preliminary registration statement amendment filed 1/14/2026; shareholder meetings are scheduled and closing conditions remain. The provided text does not establish that the merger was completed.
security_description: The Victory Bancorp, Inc. common stock, $1.00 par value per share. Treasury shares and dissenters’ rights shares are excluded from the ordinary stock conversion. Outstanding Victory restricted stock awards vest and convert into the right to receive QNB common stock under separate award provisions; outstanding Victory options vest, if unvested, and are assumed as options to purchase QNB common stock.
effective_date: Expected as early as the first quarter of 2026, conditional on satisfaction or waiver of the closing conditions; no exact legal effective date or time is stated. The parent merger becomes effective upon the later of filing the statement of merger with the Pennsylvania Department of State Bureau of Corporations and Charitable Organizations or the later date and time specified in that statement. The bank merger follows the parent merger.
available_options: No holder election for the merger consideration: eligible Victory common stockholders receive the stated QNB stock consideration, with cash instead of any fractional QNB share. Eligible Victory shareholders may separately exercise statutory dissenters’ rights to seek cash payment of fair value rather than receive the merger consideration.

acquirer: Ryerson Holding Corporation, through Crimson MS Corp., its direct wholly owned merger subsidiary
consideration_type: Stock; cash is payable only in lieu of fractional shares.
cash_consideration: No cash price per share of Olympic Steel common stock. Cash is payable only in lieu of a fractional share of Ryerson common stock: the fractional share, calculated after aggregating the holder’s Olympic Steel shares and rounded to the nearest one-thousandth, multiplied by the volume-weighted average closing sales price of Ryerson common stock on the NYSE for the five consecutive full trading days ending on the day before closing. The cash payment is rounded down to the nearest cent.
stock_exchange_ratio: 1.7105 shares of Ryerson Holding Corporation common stock, par value $0.01 per share, for each eligible share of Olympic Steel, Inc. common stock, without par value. The ratio is fixed and will not be adjusted for stock-price changes before closing, but is subject to equitable adjustment for specified share reclassifications, splits, recapitalizations, distributions or similar events. No fractional Ryerson shares will be issued; cash will be paid in their place.
shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled for 2/12/2026 at 9:30 a.m. Eastern Time: Ryerson stockholders vote on the share issuance, and Olympic Steel shareholders vote on adoption of the merger agreement. Both meetings are virtual.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted waiver at or before closing: Ryerson stockholder approval of the share issuance; Olympic Steel shareholder approval of the merger agreement; approval for NYSE listing of the Ryerson shares issuable to Olympic Steel shareholders, subject to official notice of issuance; no effective law or order from a governmental entity of competent jurisdiction in a jurisdiction where either company and its subsidiaries have material assets or operations that prohibits, restrains or makes the merger illegal; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without a stop order; and expiration or termination of the applicable HSR waiting period, including voluntary extensions. The filing states that the HSR waiting period terminated early on 12/17/2025 and all required antitrust approvals had been obtained as of the proxy statement date. Additional party-specific conditions include the other party’s representations and warranties meeting the agreement’s accuracy standards, covenant compliance, absence of a material adverse effect since signing, an executive-officer certificate confirming those conditions, and receipt of an unwithdrawn and unmodified opinion from qualified counsel concerning the intended tax treatment. Olympic Steel must comply with its indebtedness covenant in all respects. Financing is not a condition to Ryerson’s or Merger Sub’s obligation to complete the merger.
event_status: Pending as of the 1/14/2026 joint proxy statement/prospectus; the merger agreement had been signed and antitrust approvals obtained, but the shareholder votes and closing were still prospective.
security_description: Eligible issued and outstanding shares of Olympic Steel, Inc. common stock, without par value. Shares held as Olympic Steel treasury stock or directly by Ryerson, Merger Sub or specified wholly owned subsidiaries are excluded and canceled without consideration. Olympic Steel equity awards have separate treatment.
effective_date: No calendar effective date is stated. Conditionally, the merger becomes effective when the certificate of merger is filed with the Ohio Secretary of State on the closing date, or at a later time agreed by Ryerson and Olympic Steel and specified in the certificate. Unless the parties agree otherwise, closing is to occur as soon as practicable and within two business days after the applicable conditions are satisfied or waived.
available_options: No holder election for merger consideration; eligible Olympic Steel common shares receive the specified stock consideration, with cash instead of fractional shares.

consideration_type: Stock for eligible Falcon common shareholders; Falcon shareholders subject to sanctions instead receive non-voting exchangeable Class B Shares of Falcon, with cash consideration held in a blocked account for their benefit. stock_exchange_ratio: 0.00687 shares of Tamboran Resources Corporation common stock per 1 Falcon Oil & Gas Ltd. common share for each Falcon shareholder other than dissenting shareholders or shareholders subject to sanctions. Fractional Tamboran shares are rounded down to the next whole share.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver where permitted: Falcon shareholder approval by at least two-thirds of votes cast; Tamboran stockholder approval of the Falcon Parent stock issuance; satisfactory interim and final orders of the Supreme Court of British Columbia; authorization of the Falcon Parent shares for NYSE listing; no law or order prohibiting the transactions; accuracy of the parties’ representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, absence of a material adverse effect for either Falcon or Tamboran, and delivery of officer certificates. Tamboran’s additional conditions include no outstanding dissent rights for more than 5% of Falcon common shares; Falcon Australia minority shareholder approval by 12/30/2025 (reported obtained on that date); regulatory approvals remaining effective; executed Falcon option-cancellation and director/officer support agreements; and engagement of the Blocked Account Agent. Hungarian mining approval was granted on 11/28/2025, Hungarian foreign-direct-investment approval on 12/23/2025, and Falcon applied for required TSXV approval on 1/7/2026. Approval of the issuance of potential Falcon Australia minority stock consideration is not a condition.
event_status: Pending under an arrangement agreement executed on 9/30/2025; Falcon Australia minority shareholder approval and the stated Hungarian regulatory approvals had been obtained, while TSXV approval had been applied for.
security_description: Falcon Oil & Gas Ltd. common shares. Shares held by shareholders subject to sanctions receive distinct Class B Share treatment, and shares of dissenting shareholders are subject to dissent rights.
available_options: No holder election for Falcon common shareholders: eligible holders receive Tamboran common stock at the stated ratio; shareholders subject to sanctions receive non-voting exchangeable Class B Shares of Falcon instead, and dissenting holders are subject to dissent rights rather than receiving the arrangement consideration.

acquirer: FirstSun Capital Bancorp
consideration_type: Stock; eligible holders may elect FirstSun non-voting common stock instead of voting common stock for shares exceeding the 4.99% ownership threshold. Cash is paid only in lieu of fractional shares.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration per share of First Foundation common stock is specified. In lieu of a fractional FirstSun share, cash without interest equals the fractional share, rounded to the nearest one-thousandth, multiplied by the average Nasdaq closing-sale price of FirstSun common stock for the five full trading days ending on the trading day immediately before closing; the payment is rounded to the nearest cent.
stock_exchange_ratio: 0.16083 share of FirstSun common stock per 1 share of First Foundation common stock. An eligible holder may elect an equivalent number of FirstSun non-voting common shares for the portion exceeding the 4.99% ownership threshold. The exchange ratio is subject to proportionate adjustment for specified changes in capitalization, warrant terms or preferred-stock conversion rates. No fractional shares will be issued.
shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled for 2/27/2026: FirstSun Capital Bancorp stockholders at 9:30 a.m. Central Time; First Foundation Inc. stockholders at 8:00 a.m. Pacific Time.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted waiver of applicable conditions: FirstSun stockholder approval of the merger and share issuance, the authorized-common-share increase, and creation of non-voting common stock; First Foundation common-stockholder approval of the merger agreement; Nasdaq listing authorization for the FirstSun shares to be issued; required regulatory approvals, including Federal Reserve and OCC approvals, and expiration or termination of applicable waiting periods, without a materially burdensome regulatory condition; effectiveness of the Form S-4 without an applicable stop order or pending or threatened SEC proceeding; absence of legal restraints prohibiting the merger or bank merger; accuracy of each party’s representations and warranties and material performance of its obligations; and each party’s receipt of a legal opinion that the merger qualifies as a reorganization under Section 368(a). FirstSun’s additional conditions include specified lock-up, warrant exercise and termination, and partial termination agreements remaining effective, and First Foundation meeting the applicable minimum consolidated tangible stockholders’ equity threshold—approximately $890.6 million at 12/31/2025 to $902.9 million at 6/30/2026.
event_status: Pending as described in the joint proxy statement/prospectus; stockholder meetings and closing were prospective.
security_description: First Foundation Inc. common stock, par value $0.001 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the merger, excluding specified shares owned by the merger parties or their wholly owned subsidiaries, subject to stated fiduciary-capacity and previously contracted debt exceptions.
effective_date: No calendar effective date is specified. The merger is to become effective upon filing its certificate of merger with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time specified in that certificate in accordance with Delaware law. The filing may occur on or, if the parties agree, before the closing date.
available_options: An eligible First Foundation stockholder who would otherwise hold more than 4.99% of FirstSun voting common stock immediately after the merger may elect an equivalent number of FirstSun non-voting common shares instead of voting common shares for the excess portion. Otherwise, the holder receives voting common stock at the stated exchange ratio, with cash in lieu of fractional shares.
default_option: A holder who does not make the non-voting-stock election receives FirstSun voting common stock under the stated exchange ratio; the election affects only shares above the 4.99% threshold.
election_deadline: Written notice to FirstSun no later than ten business days after the merger’s effective time. An eligible holder may also make the election on the letter of transmittal or other election form provided by FirstSun.

acquirer: RYVYL Inc. (Ryvyl), through its wholly owned merger subsidiary RYVYL Merger Sub Inc., which will merge into RTB Digital, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock; eligible RTB common stock is converted into the right to receive Ryvyl common stock. Outstanding RTB equity awards and convertible securities have separately described assumption or conversion treatment.
cash_consideration: No cash merger consideration is stated for RTB common stock, and no cash will be paid in lieu of fractional Ryvyl shares.
stock_exchange_ratio: A variable number of shares of Ryvyl common stock per 1 share of RTB common stock, equal to the Exchange Ratio: (Fully Diluted Ryvyl Common Stock × Valuation Ratio) ÷ Fully Diluted RTB Common Stock. The stated illustrative ratio of 13.28 is not identified as the final ratio. The number of shares receivable by each holder is rounded down if the fractional portion is less than 0.5 share and up if it is 0.5 share or greater.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted waiver: approval by Ryvyl stockholders and RTB stockholders; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an effective SEC stop order or pending proceeding seeking one; Nasdaq approval to list the merger shares; required regulatory approvals and expiration or termination of applicable antitrust waiting periods, subject to the stated alternative-compliance provision; and absence of orders or laws preventing or prohibiting the merger. Party-specific conditions include material accuracy of representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, and absence of a continuing material adverse effect. RTB's additional conditions include Ryvyl's continued Nasdaq listing, release agreements, required board appointments and employment agreements, and settlement of specified proceedings. Ryvyl's additional conditions include termination of specified RTB contracts. The filing states that Ryvyl's reverse-stock-split condition has been satisfied. Amendment No. 2 removed the warrant-amendment and RTB-holder lock-up requirements; obtaining lock-up agreements is not a closing condition.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement has been amended, and the filing states that the merger had not been completed.
security_description: RTB Digital, Inc. Class A and Class B common stock outstanding immediately before the merger, including RTB preferred stock converted into common stock before closing; excludes shares subject to separately described treasury-stock or appraisal-rights treatment.
effective_date: Upon the filing of the Certificate of Merger with the Delaware Secretary of State, or a later date or time agreed in writing by Ryvyl and RTB and specified in that certificate; no calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: No holder election; eligible RTB common shares receive the stock consideration. Qualifying holders who properly exercise appraisal rights have separately described statutory treatment rather than a merger-consideration election.

consideration_type: Stock: closing shares of IXAQ Class A Common Stock, plus contingent incentive shares of IXAQ Class D Common Stock if specified milestones are achieved.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration is described. Cash is payable only instead of a fractional share of IXAQ Class A Common Stock, in an amount equal to the fraction multiplied by the Redemption Price.
stock_exchange_ratio: Variable: each outstanding share of AERKOMM Common Stock converts into a number of shares of IXAQ Class A Common Stock equal to the Conversion Ratio, calculated as Closing Merger Consideration shares divided by Adjusted Aggregate Fully Diluted AERKOMM Common Stock. The Closing Merger Consideration equals the Closing Purchase Price divided by $11.50; the Closing Purchase Price is $200,000,000 minus Adjusted Closing Net Debt and unpaid AERKOMM Transaction Expenses, plus the Working Capital Variance from Target. Eligible former AERKOMM stockholders may also earn their pro rata portions of the 17,391,304 incentive shares in three one-third installments upon the stated share-price milestones during the five years after closing. No fractional shares are issued; cash is paid instead.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted waiver: AERKOMM shareholder approval and IXAQ approval of the condition-precedent proposals; no applicable legal restraint or final, nonappealable prohibition; expiration or termination of applicable HSR Act waiting periods, if any, and receipt of required regulatory approvals; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an operative SEC stop order; approval of the merger shares for listing on Nasdaq or another national securities exchange; IXAQ having at least $5,000,001 in net tangible assets after redemptions or otherwise being exempt from Securities Act Rule 419, a condition the parties may waive; consummation of the Domestication at least one business day before closing; consummation of the PIPE Investment with gross proceeds of at least the PIPE Minimum Investment Amount, defined as $45,000,000 minus investment obtained under SAFE Agreements, unless waived by IXAQ; accuracy of specified representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, and absence of a continuing Material Adverse Effect; required certificates, agreements and director arrangements; and entry by substantially all AERKOMM Group employees, including all engineering employees, into the specified proprietary-information and inventions agreements.
event_status: Pending; the March 29, 2024 merger agreement was amended on September 25, 2024, February 12, 2025, April 12, 2025, and January 8, 2026.
security_description: Issued and outstanding common stock of AERKOMM Inc., excluding shares cancelled because they are held by the transaction parties and shares held by dissenting stockholders. AERKOMM options, warrants and convertible notes have separately described treatment and are not the security covered by this record.
effective_date: Conditional: the merger becomes effective when the articles of merger are filed with the Nevada Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed by the parties and specified in those articles. No calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: No holder election; eligible AERKOMM common stockholders receive the stated stock consideration, subject to the contingent incentive milestones. Dissenting shares have separate appraisal-rights treatment.

acquirer: GigCapital7 Corp., through MMR Merger Sub, Inc., its direct wholly owned merger subsidiary
consideration_type: Stock; eligible Hadron Energy common stock is converted into the right to receive Domesticated GigCapital7 common stock. Excluded shares receive no consideration; properly perfected dissenting shares are subject to appraisal rights; restricted share awards and options receive separate treatment.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration is specified for eligible Hadron Energy common stock; the stated merger consideration consists of Domesticated GigCapital7 common stock. Properly perfected dissenting shares are subject to appraisal rights rather than the stated merger consideration.
stock_exchange_ratio: A number of shares of Domesticated GigCapital7 common stock equal to the Exchange Ratio per 1 share of Hadron Energy common stock. Exchange Ratio = Aggregate Merger Consideration divided by Hadron Fully Diluted Capital. Aggregate Merger Consideration = ($1,200,200,000 divided by $10.59) minus 13,333,333 shares, further reduced, if Hadron Energy has indebtedness outstanding at closing, by the indebtedness amount divided by $10.59, rounded down to the nearest whole share. Hadron Fully Diluted Capital includes outstanding Hadron Energy common stock after SAFE conversion, outstanding restricted shares, and shares issuable upon exercise of outstanding Hadron options calculated using the treasury method on a cashless-exercise basis. Fractional shares resulting from conversion of Hadron Energy securities in the merger are rounded up to the nearest whole share of Domesticated GigCapital7 common stock.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver by the applicable parties: approval of the GigCapital7 condition-precedent proposals and Hadron Energy stockholder approval; no effective law or order making the transactions illegal or preventing their consummation; SEC effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement at closing, without an effective stop order or unresolved SEC proceeding; conditional Nasdaq listing approval for the shares issued in the transaction, subject to the stated round-lot-holder requirement and exception concerning market value of publicly held securities; expiration or termination of applicable HSR Act and other antitrust waiting periods and receipt of required antitrust approvals; and no outstanding Hadron Energy indebtedness for borrowed money at closing, except ordinary-course trade payables and accrued expenses or amounts GigCapital7 agrees to in writing. Hadron Energy’s additional conditions include accuracy of GigCapital7’s and Merger Sub’s representations and warranties subject to the material-adverse-effect standard, material covenant compliance, no continuing GigCapital7 material adverse effect, completion of the domestication, availability of trust proceeds after redemptions, at least $5,000,001 of GigCapital7 net tangible assets immediately after the Effective Time, at least $20,000,000 of Available Closing SPAC Cash, and the specified post-closing board composition. GigCapital7’s and Merger Sub’s additional conditions include accuracy of Hadron Energy’s representations and warranties subject to the material-adverse-effect standard, material covenant compliance except for specified financial-statement delivery deadlines, no continuing Hadron Energy material adverse effect, no specified materially adverse formal NRC communication, and amendment and conversion of all outstanding Hadron Energy SAFEs before the Effective Time. The filing states that the HSR filing was made on 10/27/2025 and its waiting period expired on 11/26/2025.
event_status: Pending; the Business Combination Agreement was amended on 12/12/2025 to expand the proposed post-closing board from seven to eight directors. The Form S-4/A filed on 1/20/2026 remains preliminary and describes closing as subject to approvals and other conditions.
security_description: Hadron Energy, Inc. common stock, referred to as Hadron Common Stock; excludes shares held by GigCapital7 or Merger Sub or held by Hadron Energy as treasury stock, properly perfected dissenting shares, and Hadron restricted shares. Hadron SAFEs are to convert into Hadron common stock before the Effective Time, after which those shares receive the common-stock merger consideration.
effective_date: The merger is proposed to become legally effective upon filing the Certificate of Merger with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed in writing by GigCapital7, Hadron Energy and Merger Sub and specified in that certificate. No calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: No holder election for the stated stock merger consideration. Hadron Energy stockholders who properly exercise and preserve Delaware appraisal rights do not receive the stated merger consideration unless they fail to perfect, withdraw or lose those rights.
default_option: An eligible share of Hadron Energy common stock outstanding immediately before the Effective Time is cancelled and converted into the right to receive the Per Share Merger Consideration. The filing does not state a separate default for a missed consideration election.

acquirer: Parataxis Holdings Inc. (Pubco), through its wholly owned merger subsidiary PTX Merger Sub I Inc.
consideration_type: Stock; SilverBox warrants are exchanged for Pubco warrants. Public shareholders may separately elect cash redemption instead of receiving stock for redeemed shares.
cash_consideration: No regular cash merger consideration is stated for unredeemed SilverBox shares. Public shareholders who validly exercise redemption rights receive cash per Public Share equal to its pro rata portion of the Trust Account, calculated two business days before closing, including interest net of taxes paid or payable. The illustrative amount based on September 30, 2025 was approximately $10.56 per Public Share.
stock_exchange_ratio: 1 share of Pubco Class A common stock per 1 SilverBox Class A ordinary share outstanding immediately before the SilverBox merger, excluding validly redeemed shares and treasury shares. SilverBox Class A ordinary shares first convert into SilverBox Class A common shares on a one-for-one basis in the Domestication.
closing_conditions: The business combination requires satisfaction or permissible written waiver of applicable conditions, including approval of the Condition Precedent Proposals by SilverBox shareholders; completion of the Domestication; required governmental consents and expiration or early termination of any applicable HSR Act waiting period without burdensome conditions; absence of a law or order prohibiting the transaction; continued effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement; and approval of Pubco Class A common stock and Pubco public warrants for NYSE or Nasdaq listing. Conditions also include the specified accuracy of representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, absence of an uncured material adverse effect, required ancillary agreements and customary closing deliveries. Parataxis may waive its condition that net cash and cash equivalents delivered to Pubco at closing, after redemptions and transaction expenses and including transaction financing proceeds, equal or exceed $25.0 million.
event_status: Pending as described in the preliminary proxy statement/prospectus filed January 20, 2026; the SilverBox merger had not been reported as completed.
security_description: SilverBox Corp IV Class A ordinary shares, including Public Shares; following Domestication, SilverBox Class A common shares. SilverBox Class B ordinary shares and warrants have separately stated treatment.
effective_date: The SilverBox merger will become effective on the closing date when the SilverBox certificate of merger is accepted for filing by the Delaware Secretary of State, or at another time specified in that certificate. No calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: Public shareholders may retain their Public Shares for the merger exchange or elect to redeem all or a portion for cash, regardless of whether or how they vote. Redemption requires a written request and delivery of the shares and required forms to the transfer agent; holders of shares through units must first separate the units. A public shareholder acting alone or with affiliates or a group cannot redeem more than 15% of the Public Shares sold in the IPO without SilverBox's prior consent.
election_deadline: For the separate Public Share redemption election, holders must complete the required procedures by 5:00 p.m., Eastern Time, two business days before the initially scheduled SilverBox extraordinary general meeting. The calendar date is blank in the filing. No deadline for an election among merger consideration forms is stated.

acquirer: Parataxis Holdings Inc. (Pubco), through its wholly owned merger subsidiary PTX Merger Sub II LLC.
consideration_type: Stock, with up to 7,500,000 additional contingent Pubco Class A common shares available pro rata to Parataxis common securityholders upon specified share-price targets or a qualifying change of control.
cash_consideration: No regular cash merger consideration is stated. Cash may be paid only in lieu of a fractional Pubco share: the fractional amount is valued using the specified 20-trading-day VWAP before payment of the Earnout Shares.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each Parataxis common unit held by Edward Chin or his designated affiliates, Pubco Class C common shares equal to the Exchange Ratio multiplied by 1 Parataxis common unit. Exchange Ratio = Per Unit Price divided by $10.00; Per Unit Price = ($100,000,000 equity value plus Interim Investment Amount) divided by Fully-Diluted Company Units, as defined in the agreement. These common holders may also receive their pro rata portion of up to 7,500,000 contingent Pubco Class A Earnout Shares at the stated $12.50 and $15.00 share-price targets during the five-year Earnout Period, subject to the agreement's adjustments and change-of-control provisions. Fractional Pubco shares are rounded down, subject to the stated cash-in-lieu provision.
shareholder_vote_date: Parataxis manager and members holding a majority in interest approved the business combination by joint written consent on 8/6/2025. The date and time of the SilverBox shareholder meeting are blank in the filing.
closing_conditions: The business combination requires satisfaction or permissible written waiver of applicable conditions, including SilverBox shareholder approval of the Condition Precedent Proposals; completion of the Domestication; required governmental consents and expiration or early termination of any applicable HSR Act waiting period without burdensome conditions; absence of legal restraints; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement; and approval of Pubco Class A common stock and Pubco public warrants for NYSE or Nasdaq listing. Conditions also include specified accuracy of the parties' representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, absence of an uncured material adverse effect, required ancillary agreements and customary closing deliveries. Parataxis may waive its condition requiring at least $25.0 million of net cash and cash equivalents delivered to Pubco at closing after redemptions and transaction expenses and including transaction financing proceeds.

effective_date: The Parataxis company merger will become effective on the closing date when its certificate of merger is accepted for filing by the Delaware Secretary of State, or at another time specified in that certificate. No calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: No holder election.

Approval of the Governance Proposal and Adjournment Proposal may be waived in writing by Signing Day Sports and One Blockchain. The Business Combination is not conditioned on approval of the NYSE American Proposal or issuance of the Additional Termination Shares.
