acquirer: BlockchAIn Digital Infrastructure, Inc., through its wholly-owned subsidiary BCDI Merger Sub II LLC, which will merge into One Blockchain LLC.
target: One Blockchain LLC (formerly known as BV Power Alpha LLC)
consideration_type: Stock, with additional BlockchAIn common shares contingently issuable to the One Blockchain securityholders if 2026 EBITDA equals or exceeds $25 million.
stock_exchange_ratio: The aggregate One Blockchain merger consideration is a variable number of BlockchAIn Digital Infrastructure, Inc. common shares equal to (SGN Outstanding Shares × 1/0.085 × the Signing Day Sports Exchange Ratio) minus (SGN Outstanding Shares × that Exchange Ratio). No fixed number of BlockchAIn shares per One Blockchain membership interest is stated. BlockchAIn may adjust the Exchange Ratio before closing subject to the stated 8.5% minimum ownership for Signing Day Sports stockholders and NYSE American listing qualification. Tiger Cloud LLC and VCV Digital Solutions LLC may each receive up to 5,087,367 additional BlockchAIn common shares, subject to adjustment, if 2026 EBITDA equals or exceeds $25 million; if the Additional Termination Shares are not issued because the NYSE American Proposal is not approved, that maximum would be adjusted to 4,616,533 shares each, subject to further adjustment.
shareholder_vote_date: Signing Day Sports, Inc. stockholder special meeting concerning the Business Combination scheduled for 2/24/2026 at 10:00 a.m., Pacific Time, unless postponed or adjourned. One Blockchain’s manager has approved the Business Combination; its securityholders are expected to approve it before closing, but no date for their approval is stated.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where permissible, waiver of conditions including applicable antitrust waiting periods expiring or terminating and required antitrust consents being obtained; Signing Day Sports stockholder approval of the Business Combination Proposal; absence of a law or order prohibiting the transactions; approval of BlockchAIn common shares, including Earnout Shares, for listing on the NYSE American or another national securities exchange; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an effective SEC stop order or an outstanding proceeding seeking one; and amendment and restatement of BlockchAIn’s certificate of incorporation and bylaws. Additional conditions include applicable accuracy standards for the parties’ representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, and no continuing, uncured material adverse effect on Signing Day Sports or One Blockchain. Conditions concerning Signing Day Sports executives include termination of the employment agreements of Craig Smith, Daniel Nelson and Jeffry Hecklinski without continuing liability, which One Blockchain may waive, and execution of their Executive Consulting Agreements, which Signing Day Sports may waive. Approval of the Governance Proposal and Adjournment Proposal may be waived in writing by Signing Day Sports and One Blockchain. The Business Combination is not conditioned on approval of the NYSE American Proposal or issuance of the Additional Termination Shares.
event_status: Pending; Business Combination Agreement amended on 11/10/2025 and 12/21/2025. The filing states that closing had not occurred.
security_description: Outstanding membership interests of One Blockchain LLC, held by Tiger Cloud LLC and VCV Digital Solutions LLC.
effective_date: The One Blockchain merger will become legally effective when its executed certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed in writing and specified in that certificate. No calendar date or clock time is stated.
available_options: No holder election; outstanding One Blockchain membership interests are automatically canceled in exchange for the right to receive BlockchAIn common shares, subject to the stated contingent stock earnout.

acquirer: Eli Lilly and Company; its wholly owned subsidiary, RYLS Merger Corporation, will merge with and into Ventyx Biosciences, Inc.
consideration_type: Cash, subject to the stated exceptions for excluded and dissenting shares.
cash_consideration: USD $1,400.00 per share of Ventyx Biosciences, Inc. Series A Non-Voting Convertible Preferred Stock, without interest and less applicable tax withholding, subject to adjustment for specified changes to the shares before the merger becomes effective. Shares held by Ventyx, Lilly, Merger Sub or specified wholly owned subsidiaries receive no payment; dissenting shares are subject to appraisal rights.
stock_exchange_ratio: No stock consideration.
closing_conditions: The parties’ obligations to close are subject to Ventyx common stockholder approval; expiration or termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period; and absence of a governmental order or law prohibiting the merger. Lilly’s and Merger Sub’s obligations are also subject to the accuracy of Ventyx’s representations and warranties under the agreement’s applicable standards, Ventyx’s material compliance with its covenants, no continuing Ventyx material adverse effect arising after the agreement date, receipt of Ventyx’s closing certificate, and absence of a specified governmental proceeding concerning the merger. Ventyx’s obligation is also subject to the accuracy of Lilly’s and Merger Sub’s representations and warranties under the applicable standard, their material compliance with their covenants, and receipt of Lilly’s closing certificate. Conditions may be waived as provided in the merger agreement. There is no financing condition.
event_status: Announced and pending; the merger agreement was signed on January 7, 2026, and the preliminary proxy statement seeks Ventyx common stockholder approval.
security_description: Ventyx Biosciences, Inc. Series A Non-Voting Convertible Preferred Stock, par value $0.0001 per share. Preferred shares are not entitled to vote at the special meeting.
effective_date: Conditional: the merger will become effective when the certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later date and time agreed by Merger Sub and Ventyx and specified in that certificate. No calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: No holder election; eligible preferred shares are converted into the right to receive the fixed cash consideration. Eligible holders who properly exercise appraisal rights instead seek payment under Delaware law.

acquirer: Black Hawk Acquisition Corporation, acting through its wholly-owned merger subsidiary, BH Merger Sub, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock; Vesicor stockholders are to receive shares of PubCo common stock, and outstanding unexercised Vesicor warrants are to be assumed and converted into warrants to purchase PubCo common stock.
cash_consideration: No cash merger consideration is payable to Vesicor stockholders. The filing states that no cash will be paid in lieu of fractional shares; fractional shares will instead be rounded to the nearest whole share.
stock_exchange_ratio: The number of shares of PubCo common stock per 1 share of Vesicor common stock is the Consideration Ratio: Aggregate Merger Consideration divided by Aggregate Fully Diluted Company Shares. Aggregate Merger Consideration is $70,000,000 divided by the Redemption Price. The filing’s pro forma presentation uses a consideration exchange ratio of 0.714882 shares of PubCo common stock per 1 share of Vesicor common stock, based on a $10.00 Redemption Price. Fractional shares are stated to be rounded to the nearest whole share.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver of the following stated conditions: no law or order prohibiting the Business Combination; SEC effectiveness of the registration statement, with no effective stop order or SEC proceeding to suspend effectiveness; Black Hawk shareholder approval and Vesicor stockholder approval; the specified size and composition of the PubCo board; approval of PubCo common stock for Nasdaq listing; and Black Hawk’s receipt of a fairness opinion. Black Hawk and Merger Sub also require Vesicor’s material covenant compliance, representations and warranties meeting the applicable bring-down standards, no continuing Material Adverse Effect, specified officer and FIRPTA certificates, termination of specified Vesicor stockholder agreements, required third-party consents, specified non-competition and lock-up agreements, and Vesicor’s procurement of a PPM Investment of at least $10,000,000 before closing. Vesicor also requires Black Hawk’s and Merger Sub’s material covenant compliance and representations and warranties meeting the applicable bring-down standards, a Black Hawk officer certificate, an effective Delaware certificate of incorporation for PubCo, and specified ancillary agreements. The PPM Investment condition may be waived by Black Hawk and Vesicor. The Nasdaq-listing condition may be waived only to the extent permitted by law and with the written waiver of Black Hawk, Vesicor and Merger Sub. The filing states that Black Hawk obtained a fairness opinion dated April 26, 2025, and that no securities had been issued, commitments received or funding received for the PPM Investment as of the proxy statement/prospectus.
event_status: Pending; the Business Combination Agreement was executed, but the merger had not closed as of the filing. The filing states that required extension payments had not been funded and that, unless they are made, waived or cured, Black Hawk may be required to liquidate instead of completing the proposed Business Combination.
security_description: Vesicor Therapeutics, Inc. common stock, no par value per share. Outstanding unexercised warrants to purchase Vesicor common stock have separate treatment: they are to be assumed and converted into warrants to purchase PubCo common stock.
available_options: No holder election; Vesicor stockholders are to receive stock consideration. The filing describes no cash-or-stock consideration choice.

acquirer: Athena Technology Acquisition Corp. II, through its wholly owned merger subsidiary, Project Atlas Merger Sub Inc.
consideration_type: Stock: each eligible share of Ace Green Common Stock converts into the right to receive Athena Class A Common Stock and a pro rata share of any contingent Earnout Shares. Properly dissenting shares and treasury shares are excluded from this treatment.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each 1 share of Ace Green Common Stock, a number of shares of Athena Class A Common Stock equal to the Exchange Ratio, rounded up to the nearest whole share. The Exchange Ratio is ($250,000,000 ÷ $10.10) ÷ the number of Ace Green Fully Diluted Capital Stock shares. Eligible holders also have a pro rata right to up to 10,500,000 contingent Earnout Shares in the aggregate, issuable if specified stock-price triggers are met.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permissible written waiver: Athena shareholder approval of the required proposals and Ace Green shareholder approval; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an effective SEC stop order or pending or threatened stop-order proceeding; expiration or termination of applicable HSR Act waiting periods and receipt of required governmental consents; absence of a legal restraint; conditional Nasdaq listing approval, satisfaction of applicable initial listing requirements immediately after the merger effective time, no notice of noncompliance, and approval of the shares and warrants for listing; and at least $7,500,000 from the PIPE investment together with cash remaining in the trust account after redemptions. Each party’s obligation is also subject to the other side’s specified representations and warranties being sufficiently accurate, material covenant compliance, delivery of an officer certificate and required transaction documents, and no continuing, uncured material adverse effect. Additional conditions include the applicable transaction-expense caps or payment of excess amounts by the responsible shareholders or Sponsor; for Ace Green’s obligation, arrangements for release of trust funds, an opportunity for public-share redemptions, effectiveness of Athena’s amended charter, a written waiver of Citigroup deferred IPO fees, and agreements to convert certain unpaid working-capital loans to equity.
event_status: Pending as described in the preliminary proxy statement/prospectus filed January 23, 2026; the merger remains subject to closing conditions.
security_description: Ace Green Recycling, Inc. common stock, par value $0.0001 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the merger effective time, excluding treasury shares and shares for which appraisal rights are properly exercised. Outstanding Ace Green options and restricted stock units receive separate treatment.
effective_date: Conditional: the merger becomes effective when the Certificate of Merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time specified in that certificate with the required agreement and consent. No calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: No holder election for the merger consideration payable on eligible Ace Green Common Stock. Holders who properly exercise appraisal rights receive the rights provided by Section 262 of the Delaware General Corporation Law instead of merger consideration.

acquirer: Beacon Topco, Inc. (Topco), the acquiring parent; its wholly owned subsidiary Cdog Merger Sub, Inc. will merge with and into Clywedog Therapeutics, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock; cash is payable only in lieu of fractional shares.
cash_consideration: Cash in lieu of any fractional share of Topco common stock; no regular cash price per Clywedog share is stated.
stock_exchange_ratio: 4.358932 shares of Beacon Topco, Inc. common stock per 1 share of Clywedog Therapeutics, Inc. common stock, subject to proportional adjustment to reflect the number of outstanding Topco shares held by former Barinthus Bio shareholders immediately before the merger after giving effect to the self-tender offer, if elected. Shares issued to a holder are rounded down to the nearest whole share, with cash in lieu of fractional shares.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where permitted by law, waiver: effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an outstanding stop order or proceeding; no effective order or law preventing or prohibiting the transactions; Barinthus Bio shareholder approval of the Scheme of Arrangement and Scheme Implementation Proposal and court sanction of the scheme, including the capital reduction; required Clywedog stockholder approval; Nasdaq listing approval for Topco common stock, subject to official notice of issuance; the specified notification under the UK National Security and Investment Act, if the relevant notices have been made; and expiration or termination of applicable antitrust waiting periods or receipt of applicable antitrust consents. Additional conditions include qualified accuracy of the parties’ representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, absence of a material adverse effect, required certificates and documents, continuing effectiveness of applicable lock-up agreements, termination of Clywedog investor agreements, completion of the self-tender offer if applicable, and the specified minimum net cash amounts for Barinthus Bio and Clywedog, subject to their respective collars.
event_status: Pending as of the January 27, 2026 filing; closing was expected in the first half of 2026, subject to approvals and other conditions.
security_description: Clywedog Therapeutics, Inc. common stock, $0.0001 par value per share, excluding treasury shares and shares owned by Topco or Merger Sub immediately before the merger effective time; properly dissenting shares receive separate treatment.
effective_date: Not specified as a calendar date. The merger becomes legally effective when the certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time specified in that certificate with Barinthus Bio’s and Clywedog’s consent. The merger follows the Scheme Transaction and, if elected, the self-tender offer.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Clywedog common shares are converted into the stated stock consideration, with cash only in lieu of fractional shares.

acquirer: Beacon Topco, Inc. (Topco), the acquiring parent; its wholly owned subsidiary Cdog Merger Sub, Inc. will merge with and into Clywedog Therapeutics, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock; cash is payable only in lieu of fractional shares.
cash_consideration: Cash in lieu of any fractional share of Topco common stock; no regular cash price per Clywedog share is stated.
stock_exchange_ratio: 4.358932 shares of Beacon Topco, Inc. common stock per 1 share of Clywedog Therapeutics, Inc. Series Seed Preferred Stock, subject to proportional adjustment to reflect the number of outstanding Topco shares held by former Barinthus Bio shareholders immediately before the merger after giving effect to the self-tender offer, if elected. Shares issued to a holder are rounded down to the nearest whole share, with cash in lieu of fractional shares.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where permitted by law, waiver: effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an outstanding stop order or proceeding; no effective order or law preventing or prohibiting the transactions; Barinthus Bio shareholder approval of the Scheme of Arrangement and Scheme Implementation Proposal and court sanction of the scheme, including the capital reduction; required Clywedog stockholder approval; Nasdaq listing approval for Topco common stock, subject to official notice of issuance; the specified notification under the UK National Security and Investment Act, if the relevant notices have been made; and expiration or termination of applicable antitrust waiting periods or receipt of applicable antitrust consents. Additional conditions include qualified accuracy of the parties’ representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, absence of a material adverse effect, required certificates and documents, continuing effectiveness of applicable lock-up agreements, termination of Clywedog investor agreements, completion of the self-tender offer if applicable, and the specified minimum net cash amounts for Barinthus Bio and Clywedog, subject to their respective collars.
event_status: Pending as of the January 27, 2026 filing; closing was expected in the first half of 2026, subject to approvals and other conditions.
security_description: Clywedog Therapeutics, Inc. Series Seed Preferred Stock, $0.0001 par value per share, excluding treasury shares and shares owned by Topco or Merger Sub immediately before the merger effective time; properly dissenting shares receive separate treatment.
effective_date: Not specified as a calendar date. The merger becomes legally effective when the certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time specified in that certificate with Barinthus Bio’s and Clywedog’s consent. The merger follows the Scheme Transaction and, if elected, the self-tender offer.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Clywedog Series Seed Preferred shares are converted into the stated stock consideration, with cash only in lieu of fractional shares.

closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver where permitted: Black Hills shareholder approval of the share issuance, increase in authorized common shares from 100 million to 300 million, corporate name change, and increase in authorized indebtedness from $8 billion to $20 billion; NorthWestern shareholder approval of the merger agreement; required governmental approvals, including FERC, Montana, Nebraska and South Dakota utility regulators, FCC, and Arkansas if required, plus expiration or termination of the HSR Act waiting period, with approvals becoming final orders and without terms reasonably expected to cause a Regulatory Material Adverse Effect; absence of legal restraints prohibiting the merger or imposing such an effect; approval for listing of the Black Hills shares issuable in the merger; and effectiveness of the Form S-4 without an applicable SEC stop order or proceeding. event_status: Pending as described in the registration statement filed on 1/30/2026; shareholder and certain regulatory approvals had not yet been obtained.

available_options: No holder election; eligible NorthWestern common shares convert into the fixed stock consideration, with cash in lieu of fractional shares.

consideration_type: Stock for TLGY Class A Ordinary Shares not redeemed before the merger. TLGY shareholders may separately request cash redemption of Public Shares before the merger; properly redeemed shares are canceled and are not exchanged for stock.
cash_consideration: No fixed cash amount per share is stated for the merger exchange. Public Shares properly redeemed before the merger receive a cash Redemption Price equal to a pro rata portion of TLGY’s Trust Account, calculated as of two business days before completion of the Business Combination. The filing gives approximately $12.68 per Public Share as an illustrative amount based on Trust Account funds as of September 30, 2025, not as a fixed merger cash price.
stock_exchange_ratio: 1 share of StablecoinX Inc. Class A Common Stock per 1 TLGY Acquisition Corporation Class A Ordinary Share that is not redeemed. Each outstanding TLGY Class B Ordinary Share converts into 1 TLGY Class A Ordinary Share before the merger; founder shares held by TLGY Insiders are then subject to the separate Sponsors Securities Exchange. Each outstanding whole TLGY Public Warrant becomes 1 warrant to acquire 1 share of StablecoinX Class A Common Stock.
shareholder_vote_date: TLGY Acquisition Corporation shareholders: extraordinary general meeting scheduled for [•], 2026, at [•] Eastern Time; the specific date and time are not supplied.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted waiver of the specified conditions: TLGY shareholder approval of both the Business Combination Proposal and SPAC Merger Proposal; no effective law or order making the transactions illegal or preventing or prohibiting them; an effective registration statement remaining effective at closing; conditional approval of StablecoinX Class A Common Stock for listing on Nasdaq or another reasonably acceptable national exchange, subject only to notice of issuance; full funding of the PIPE investments; completion of Ethena’s ENA Contribution and Ethena OpCo’s locked-ENA-token sale, with applicable tokens deposited in custodial accounts; the Collaboration Agreement and Token Purchase Agreements remaining in force without the specified repudiation or changes; expiration of applicable antitrust waiting periods and receipt of other necessary governmental consents. Party-specific conditions include the other parties’ representations and warranties meeting the agreement’s applicable standards, material covenant compliance, and no continuing specified material adverse effect; the obligations of StablecoinX, SC Assets and the merger subsidiaries also require material performance by the sponsors under the Sponsor Support Agreement and that agreement remaining in force. The filing states that certain conditions, including shareholder approval, compliance with applicable law, necessary governmental consents and registration-statement effectiveness, may not be waived.
event_status: Pending; the Business Combination Agreement was amended on January 21, 2026, to extend its outside date to April 21, 2026. The filing describes the merger as proposed and does not state that it has closed.
security_description: TLGY Acquisition Corporation Class A ordinary shares, par value $0.0001 per share, including Public Shares not redeemed and shares resulting from conversion of outstanding TLGY Class B ordinary shares. Public Shares properly redeemed before the merger and dissenting shares receive separate treatment. Outstanding whole TLGY Public Warrants also convert into StablecoinX warrants; founder shares and private placement warrants held by TLGY Insiders are subject to a separate securities exchange.
effective_date: The SPAC Merger is to become effective on the conditional Closing Date when the plan of merger is registered by the Cayman Islands Registrar, or at another time specified in the plan. No calendar effective date or time is stated.
available_options: No election among forms of merger consideration. A Public Shareholder may separately request cash redemption of all or a portion of its Public Shares before the merger, regardless of how it votes. A holder of TLGY Units must separate the units into Public Shares and Public Warrants before exercising redemption rights. A Public Shareholder acting alone or with affiliates or a group cannot redeem more than 15% of the Public Shares without TLGY’s consent.

acquirer: Novartis AG, through Ajax Acquisition Sub, Inc., its indirect wholly owned merger subsidiary
consideration_type: Mixed cash and stock: cash in the merger, plus SpinCo common stock in a pre-merger distribution if that distribution occurs. A permitted third-party sale of SpinCo may occur instead, with net cash proceeds distributed to eligible holders; a sale of assets subject to a right of first negotiation may also produce distributable net cash proceeds.
cash_consideration: USD $72.00 in cash per share of Avidity Biosciences, Inc. common stock in the merger, without interest and subject to applicable withholding taxes. Treasury shares, shares owned by specified transaction parties or their wholly owned subsidiaries, and qualifying appraisal shares are excluded. Any permitted sale proceeds are separate from the $72.00 merger payment and are not specified as a per-share amount.
stock_exchange_ratio: If the pre-merger Distribution occurs: 1 share of Atrium Therapeutics, Inc. (SpinCo) common stock, par value $0.001 per share, for every 10 shares of Avidity Biosciences, Inc. common stock, par value $0.0001 per share, held as of the Distribution Record Date. Cash is paid in lieu of fractional SpinCo shares. The Distribution does not occur if a permitted third-party sale of SpinCo occurs; no acquirer stock is payable in the merger.
shareholder_vote_date: Avidity Biosciences, Inc. stockholders’ special meeting scheduled for 2/23/2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern time, virtually via live webcast, unless adjourned or postponed.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where permitted, waiver: approval of the Merger Agreement and Separation Agreement by holders of a majority of Avidity common stock entitled to vote; no applicable law making the merger illegal or effective governmental judgment preventing it; expiration or termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period and satisfaction of specified potential antitrust conditions in other jurisdictions; unless a permitted third-party sale occurs, effectiveness of the SpinCo registration statement without an unresolved stop order or related proceeding; and completion of the Separation and SpinCo distribution, or consummation of a permitted third-party sale with Novartis’s prior written consent. Additional party-specific conditions include the required accuracy of representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, absence of a Company Material Adverse Effect since 10/25/2025, and delivery of closing certificates. The filing states that the FTC granted early termination of the HSR waiting period on 12/17/2025. It states there is no financing or due-diligence closing condition.
event_status: Pending as described in the 1/30/2026 proxy statement; the merger agreement has been signed, and Avidity stockholder approval is being sought.
security_description: Avidity Biosciences, Inc. common stock, par value $0.0001 per share, including shares issued upon exercise of company warrants before the merger’s effective time; specified treasury, affiliated-owned and qualifying appraisal shares are excluded from conversion into the merger consideration.
effective_date: No calendar date stated. The merger becomes effective when the certificate of merger is duly filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later date or time agreed by Avidity and Novartis and specified in that certificate. The filing anticipates completion in the first half of 2026, subject to required approvals and other closing conditions.
available_options: No holder election. Eligible holders receive the fixed merger cash consideration; a separate pre-merger SpinCo distribution or permitted third-party sale is determined by the transaction terms, not by an individual holder choice.

consideration_type: Stock; target shareholders and beneficial owners receive Bakkt Class A Common Stock, subject to reductions for target indebtedness and excess transaction expenses and potential additional shares tied to exercises of specified Bakkt warrants.
cash_consideration: No cash consideration is payable for the target shares. Bakkt's separate cash reimbursement of specified seller loans is deducted from the stock consideration.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each 1 ordinary share of Distributed Technologies Research Global Ltd., a variable number of shares of Bakkt Class A Common Stock equal to the Exchange Ratio: Consideration Shares divided by the Company Share Number. Consideration Shares equal 31.5% of the Parent Share Number, less the Adjustment Share Number. The Parent Share Number includes Bakkt Class A Common Stock outstanding immediately before closing and shares issuable on exercise or conversion of specified outstanding securities, excluding warrants to purchase Bakkt Class A Common Stock. The Adjustment Share Number equals closing target indebtedness, including seller loans, plus target and seller transaction expenses exceeding $1,500,000, divided by the specified 20-trading-day average Bakkt share price. The Company Share Number includes outstanding target ordinary shares, shares issuable on conversion or exercise of outstanding target securities, and shares subject to unfulfilled issuance commitments. Specified Bakkt warrant exercises can result in additional shares equal to 31.5% of the Bakkt shares issued on exercise. Aggregate shares issued to the seller are rounded to the nearest whole share.
shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled Bakkt, Inc. special meeting on 3/24/2026 at 1:00 p.m. Eastern Time to vote on issuance of the acquisition consideration shares.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted waiver of closing conditions: required Bakkt stockholder approval; expiration or termination of any applicable HSR Act waiting period and receipt of requisite antitrust consents, approvals and clearances; receipt or delivery of specified financial-regulatory authorizations; and no continuing law or governmental order prohibiting, preventing, restraining or impairing the transaction. Each side's obligation also depends on the other side's representations and warranties meeting the agreement's applicable accuracy standards and material compliance with pre-closing covenants, and on no continuing material adverse effect on the other side after signing. Additional stated conditions include the registration rights agreement remaining in force and not repudiated by Bakkt for the target and seller's obligation; the restrictive covenant agreement remaining in force and not repudiated by the applicable party; Bakkt's required closing deliverables, including consideration share certificates or book-entry notifications; NYSE listing authorization for the consideration shares, subject to official notice of issuance; and the target and seller's required closing deliverables, including target-share transfer documentation, target board resolutions, investor questionnaires, beneficial-owner joinders, tax statements and a closing-condition certificate.

Fractional shares will not be issued; cash is paid instead.

Additional conditions for Community West Bancshares include a United Security Bancshares FIRPTA certificate and dissenting United Security Bancshares shares representing less than 10% of its issued and outstanding capital stock. The bank merger requires prior FDIC and California Department of Financial Protection and Innovation approvals and may not be consummated until 15 days after FDIC approval. acquirer: OceanFirst Financial Corp.; its wholly-owned subsidiary, Apollo Merger Sub Corp., will merge into Flushing Financial Corporation in the first-step merger.
consideration_type: Stock; cash is payable only in lieu of fractional shares of OceanFirst Financial Corp. common stock.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration per share of Flushing Financial Corporation common stock. Cash in lieu of a fractional share of OceanFirst Financial Corp. common stock equals the fractional share, rounded to the nearest thousandth after aggregating the holder’s Flushing shares, multiplied by the volume-weighted average trading price of OceanFirst common stock for the 15 consecutive full trading days ending on the last trading day before the merger closing date; the payment is rounded to the nearest cent.
stock_exchange_ratio: 0.85 shares of OceanFirst Financial Corp. common stock, par value $0.01 per share, per 1 share of Flushing Financial Corporation common stock, par value $0.01 per share, subject to specified exceptions. The exchange ratio is subject to an appropriate and proportionate adjustment for specified changes in capitalization or extraordinary dividends or distributions before the first-step merger becomes effective; the Warburg equity financing is excluded from that adjustment. No fractional shares will be issued.
closing_conditions: The first-step merger is subject to satisfaction or, where permitted by law, written waiver of applicable conditions: approval of the OceanFirst share issuance by OceanFirst stockholders and adoption of the merger agreement by Flushing stockholders; authorization for Nasdaq listing of the OceanFirst common shares to be issued; receipt of requisite regulatory approvals, expiration or termination of applicable statutory waiting periods, and absence of a materially burdensome regulatory condition; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an effective stop order or unresolved SEC proceeding; absence of legal restraints or laws prohibiting the transactions; and completion of the $225 million Warburg equity financing before or concurrently with the merger closing. Each party’s obligation is also subject to the other party’s representations and warranties meeting the agreement’s applicable accuracy standards, required covenant compliance, and receipt of a satisfactory legal opinion that the mergers together qualify as a reorganization under Section 368(a) of the Internal Revenue Code.
event_status: Pending as of the February 6, 2026 preliminary joint proxy statement/prospectus; the merger agreement was signed, regulatory applications were pending, and completion remained subject to closing conditions.

acquirer: Titan Holdings Corp. (Pubco), through its wholly owned subsidiary Titan Merger Sub Inc., which merges into Key Mining Corp.
consideration_type: Stock for Key Mining Corp. common stockholders; outstanding Key Mining Corp. options and warrants are assumed and converted into Pubco options and warrants under separate provisions. The amended aggregate consideration for holders of all Key Mining Corp. securities, including in-the-money options and warrants, is $230,000,000.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration is stated for Key Mining Corp. common stockholders; their portion of the merger consideration is paid in Pubco common stock. Fractional Pubco shares are rounded up to the nearest whole share, not paid in cash.
stock_exchange_ratio: Per 1 share of Key Mining Corp. common stock, the number of shares of Titan Holdings Corp. common stock equals the Merger Agreement’s Per Share Price divided by $10.00. The Per Share Price is defined by a formula incorporating $230,000,000, aggregate exercise prices of in-the-money Key Mining Corp. options and warrants, and fully diluted Key Mining Corp. shares. Fractional Pubco shares are aggregated by holder and rounded up to the nearest whole share.
closing_conditions: Conditions include requisite Compass Digital Acquisition Corp. and Key Mining Corp. shareholder approvals; expiration or termination of applicable antitrust waiting periods; required governmental and specified third-party consents; no law or order prohibiting the transactions; appointment of the post-closing Pubco board; an effective Form S-4 without a stop order; at least $5,000,000 in aggregate cash after the specified redemptions, proceeds, expenses and liabilities; effective amended Pubco organizational documents; and approval of Pubco common stock for listing on Nasdaq or NYSE American, subject to the stated qualifications. Party-specific conditions include accuracy of representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, absence of a continuing uncured material adverse effect, and specified ancillary documents and closing deliveries. Conditions may be waived in writing where permissible.
event_status: Pending; merger agreement amended on 2/5/2026 to clarify the aggregate consideration payable to holders of all Key Mining Corp. securities.
security_description: Key Mining Corp. common stock, par value $0.001 per share. Dissenting shares and shares held in treasury or by a Key Mining Corp. subsidiary are excluded from the ordinary common-stock exchange; Key Mining Corp. options and warrants receive separate treatment.
effective_date: Conditionally, the mergers are to become effective simultaneously at 5:00 p.m. New York City time on the Closing Date, or at another date and/or time agreed in writing by Compass Digital Acquisition Corp. and Key Mining Corp. and specified in the merger filings. No calendar date is stated.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Key Mining Corp. common stockholders receive Pubco common stock under the stated formula.

acquirer: CVB Financial Corp. (CVBF); its wholly owned subsidiary Citizens Business Bank, National Association is the surviving bank in the subsequent bank merger.
consideration_type: Stock; Heritage common shareholders receive CVBF common stock at a fixed exchange ratio. Cash is payable only in lieu of fractional shares. Excluded shares receive no consideration.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration per share of Heritage common stock. Cash in lieu of a fractional CVBF common share equals the 20-day volume weighted average closing price of CVBF common stock as quoted on Nasdaq as of the fifth business day before closing, multiplied by the fractional share otherwise receivable, with the fraction rounded to the nearest thousandth and the payment rounded to the nearest cent. Excluded shares receive no consideration.
stock_exchange_ratio: 0.65 shares of CVB Financial Corp. common stock per 1 share of Heritage Commerce Corp common stock, other than excluded shares. The ratio is fixed against stock-price changes but is subject to equitable adjustment for specified stock splits, reclassifications and similar transactions. No fractional CVBF shares will be issued; cash will be paid instead.
shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled CVB Financial Corp. shareholder special meeting: 3/26/2026 at 8:00 a.m., Pacific Time, in person. Scheduled Heritage Commerce Corp shareholder special meeting: 3/26/2026 at 8:00 a.m., Pacific Time, virtually.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or written waiver, where permitted, of both companies’ shareholder approvals; all required Federal Reserve and OCC approvals remaining effective, expiration or termination of related statutory waiting periods, and no materially burdensome regulatory condition; effectiveness of CVBF’s Form S-4 registration statement without an SEC stop order or related proceeding; Nasdaq listing approval for the CVBF shares; and no effective governmental legal restraint prohibiting the merger. Each party’s obligation also depends on the other party’s representations and warranties meeting the agreement’s applicable standards, material compliance with covenants and obligations, an officer’s certificate, absence of the other party’s material adverse effect, applicable director voting agreements, and its closing-date tax opinion that the merger qualifies as a Section 368(a) reorganization. acquirer: Suncrete, Inc. (PubCo), through its wholly owned subsidiary Haymaker Merger Sub I, Inc., which merges into Haymaker Acquisition Corp. 4
consideration_type: Stock
stock_exchange_ratio: 1 share of Suncrete, Inc. Class A common stock per 1 share of Haymaker Acquisition Corp. 4 Class A common stock; 1 share of Suncrete, Inc. Class B common stock per 1 share of Haymaker Acquisition Corp. 4 Class B common stock. The PubCo Class B shares outstanding immediately before the Acquisition Merger subsequently convert one-for-one into PubCo Class A shares, except for the stated treatment of Dothan Founder Shares.
shareholder_vote_date: Haymaker Acquisition Corp. 4 shareholders: scheduled for 3/17/2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time, subject to adjournment.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permissible waiver: delivery of the requisite Suncrete member written consent; approval of the Condition Precedent Proposals by the requisite Haymaker shareholder vote; no effective governmental restraint making the transactions illegal or prohibiting them; completion of required HSR filings and expiration or termination of the applicable waiting period (the filing states that early termination was received on 12/17/2025); effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an effective stop order or SEC proceeding to suspend it; approval of the specified PubCo securities for exchange listing; and completion of the Domestication before the Initial Merger. Additional stated party-specific conditions include applicable representations and warranties being accurate, material compliance with covenants, delivery of specified transaction agreements, certificates, resignations and Sponsor Note cancellation evidence, Available Cash of at least $150,000,000 after the PIPE Offering, and consummation of the Project Thunder Transaction. Conditions may be waived by the party entitled to their benefit where permissible.
event_status: Pending as described in the 2/12/2026 proxy statement/prospectus; the Business Combination Agreement was signed on 10/9/2025, but the proposed merger remained subject to shareholder approval and other closing conditions.
security_description: Haymaker Acquisition Corp. 4 Class A and Class B common stock issued upon the Domestication of its respective Class A and Class B ordinary shares; the two classes receive different classes of PubCo stock in the Initial Merger.
effective_date: Initial Merger Effective Time: the date and time its certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or a later time mutually agreed and specified in that certificate; planned for the Closing Date after the Domestication and before the Acquisition Merger. The filing does not state a fixed calendar date.
available_options: No holder election for the stated share conversions.

cash_consideration: No cash consideration for Auddia common stock; fractional shares are rounded down without payment.

closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver, where permitted, of: effectiveness of the registration statement without a stop order or proceeding seeking one; no effective legal restraint or law making the transactions illegal; Auddia stockholder approval; Auddia net cash of at least $12,000,000; the lock-up agreements remaining effective immediately after the applicable effective time; any Holdco charter amendment the parties determine is necessary; and approval of the combined company's listing. Thramann's obligation also requires specified accuracy of Auddia, Holdco and merger-sub representations and warranties; material covenant compliance; no Auddia material adverse effect; Auddia market capitalization of at least $6,000,000 immediately before closing; and an officer's certificate. Auddia's obligation also requires specified accuracy of Thramann's representations and warranties; material covenant compliance; no Thramann material adverse effect; and a closing certificate.

effective_date: The Auddia merger becomes effective when its certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time specified in that certificate; no calendar date or time is stated.

acquirer: McCarthy Finney, Inc. (Holdco), through its wholly owned subsidiary Thramann Merger Sub LLC.
consideration_type: Holdco Special Preferred Stock and non-convertible Holdco Notes, which holders may exchange for Holdco Special Preferred Stock; no cash merger consideration is specified.
cash_consideration: No cash merger consideration is specified per Thramann membership interest. The $3,500,000 aggregate principal amount of Holdco Notes is debt consideration, not cash paid to holders.
stock_exchange_ratio: A variable number of shares of McCarthy Finney, Inc. Special Preferred Stock per 1 Thramann Holdings, LLC membership interest: the Thramann Preferred Stock Exchange Ratio equals Thramann Preferred Merger Shares divided by Thramann Outstanding Membership Interests, rounded to four decimal places. Thramann Preferred Merger Shares equal Thramann Preferred Share Value divided by $1,000; Thramann Preferred Share Value equals Thramann As-Converted Merger Shares multiplied by the Auddia Closing Market Price, minus $3,500,000 in aggregate Holdco Notes principal. Thramann As-Converted Merger Shares equal Holdco Outstanding Shares divided by the Auddia Adjustment Amount, minus Holdco Outstanding Shares. The Auddia Adjustment Amount starts at 0.20 and changes by 0.50 percentage points per $1,000,000 that Auddia net cash exceeds $20,000,000 or falls below $12,000,000; no adjustment applies between those thresholds. Fractional preferred shares are rounded down without consideration.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver, where permitted, of: effectiveness of the registration statement without a stop order or proceeding seeking one; no effective legal restraint or law making the transactions illegal; Auddia stockholder approval; Auddia net cash of at least $12,000,000; the lock-up agreements remaining effective immediately after the applicable effective time; any Holdco charter amendment the parties determine is necessary; and approval of the combined company's listing. Thramann's obligation also requires specified accuracy of Auddia, Holdco and merger-sub representations and warranties; material covenant compliance; no Auddia material adverse effect; Auddia market capitalization of at least $6,000,000 immediately before closing; and an officer's certificate. Auddia's obligation also requires specified accuracy of Thramann's representations and warranties; material covenant compliance; no Thramann material adverse effect; and a closing certificate, including certification that the Contribution has been completed. The sole Thramann member's approval is described as already obtained.

acquirer: Horizon Quantum Holdings Pte. Ltd. (formerly Rose Holdco Pte. Ltd.; to be renamed Horizon Quantum Holdings Ltd.), through its wholly-owned merger subsidiary Rose Acquisition Pte. Ltd.
consideration_type: Stock; Horizon shareholders receive Holdco Class A ordinary shares, except that the Horizon Founder receives Holdco Class B ordinary shares.
cash_consideration: No cash consideration to Horizon shareholders is described. Fractional Holdco ordinary shares are rounded down, with no cash settlement.
stock_exchange_ratio: Each Horizon ordinary share converts into the right to receive Holdco ordinary shares equal to the Exchange Ratio: Aggregate Amalgamation Consideration divided by Fully-Diluted Horizon Capitalization. Aggregate Amalgamation Consideration is ($503,000,000 plus aggregate Horizon Pre-Closing Financing) divided by the Redemption Price. The estimated ratio is approximately 2.46 Holdco ordinary shares per 1 Horizon ordinary share, assuming 17,576,557 fully diluted Horizon shares and an approximately $11.74 Redemption Price. Horizon ordinary shares held by the Founder receive Holdco Class B ordinary shares; those held by other Horizon shareholders receive Holdco Class A ordinary shares. Fractional Holdco ordinary shares are rounded down.
closing_conditions: The amalgamation is part of the Business Combination. Closing is subject to satisfaction or permitted waiver of: no effective legal restraint making the transactions illegal or prohibiting them; DMY and Horizon shareholder approvals; effectiveness of the registration statement, with no effective SEC stop order or pending or threatened suspension proceedings; approval of Holdco Class A ordinary shares for listing on the selected stock exchange, subject only to official notice of issuance; Holdco's conversion into a Singapore public company and adoption and filing of its amended constitution; applicable representations and warranties being accurate, covenants being complied with in all material respects, and no continuing Material Adverse Effect; required closing certificates; termination of specified Horizon contracts; specified executive employment agreements; required registration rights, sponsor indemnification, Horizon shareholder support and lock-up agreements; and conversion of Horizon preference shares. The separate minimum-cash condition, for Horizon's benefit and waivable by Horizon, requires Aggregate Closing Cash to equal or exceed transaction expenses estimated at $17 million plus $45 million of requisite working capital, for an estimated $62 million total. The PIPE Investment is expected, but not guaranteed, to satisfy that condition. The filing states that the Business Combination is not reportable under the HSR Act and is not subject to an HSR waiting period.
event_status: Pending; the Business Combination Agreement was signed, and the amalgamation and closing are described as future events subject to conditions.
security_description: Issued and outstanding Horizon ordinary shares, including shares resulting from conversion of Horizon preference shares before the amalgamation and any ordinary shares issued in Horizon Pre-Closing Financing. The Founder's ordinary shares receive Holdco Class B ordinary shares; other Horizon shareholders' ordinary shares receive Holdco Class A ordinary shares. SAFEs and options have separately described treatment.
effective_date: Expected on the Closing Date, at the Amalgamation Effective Time specified in the notice of amalgamation issued by Singapore's Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority; no calendar date or clock time is stated.
available_options: No holder election; each affected Horizon ordinary share is automatically converted, with the class of Holdco shares determined by whether the holder is the Horizon Founder.

shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled DMY shareholder special meeting: 3/17/2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time, conducted by live webcast. No Horizon shareholder vote date is stated.
closing_conditions: The SPAC merger is part of the Business Combination. consideration_type: Stock; each outstanding share of TELI Common Stock is to be exchanged for newly issued Telomir common stock at the Exchange Ratio, subject to the stated issuance cap.
stock_exchange_ratio: The exact number of shares of Telomir Pharmaceuticals, Inc. common stock per 1 share of TELI Pharmaceuticals, Inc. common stock is not stated. The Exchange Ratio is based on the companies’ relative valuations as determined by Moore. The Telomir common stock issued may not exceed the number of Telomir common shares outstanding as of the merger closing date, and the ratio is subject to adjustment for specified changes in either company’s shares before the Effective Time. Fractional Telomir shares are rounded down after aggregation for each TELI holder.
shareholder_vote_date: Telomir stockholders are scheduled to vote on the merger-related share issuance at a virtual annual meeting on 3/23/2026 at 10:00 A.M. Eastern Time, unless postponed or adjourned. TELI stockholders approved the Merger Agreement and Merger by written consent on 11/20/2025.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver of applicable conditions, including required approvals by Telomir, TELI and the merger subsidiary stockholders; absence of an effective legal prohibition or restraint; required regulatory approvals, filings, waiting-period expirations and third-party consents; fairness opinions for the Telomir and TELI boards; and Nasdaq notification without objection. TELI’s obligations additionally require Telomir common stock to remain Nasdaq-listed without a delisting notice and approval of the listing notification for merger shares, as well as accuracy of Telomir’s and the merger subsidiary’s representations and warranties, material covenant compliance and no Telomir material adverse effect. Telomir’s and the merger subsidiary’s obligations additionally require accuracy of TELI’s representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, no TELI material adverse effect, and a commitment by specified TELI shareholders to contribute $5 million in assets and/or cash: $1 million at closing, $2 million upon FDA acceptance of the applicable IND, and $2 million upon initiation of a Phase 1 or 2 clinical trial. The filing also describes TELI holding at least $1 million in cash and/or marketable securities at closing; actual post-closing milestone payments are not a closing condition.

security_description: Issued and outstanding common stock of TELI Pharmaceuticals, Inc. immediately before the Effective Time, excluding TELI treasury shares.
effective_date: Not specified. The Merger Agreement states that the merger becomes effective on the date and at the time Delaware issues the Certificate of Merger; the parties intend that issuance and legal effectiveness occur on the Closing Date.
available_options: No holder election; eligible TELI common shares are automatically exchanged for Telomir common shares at the Exchange Ratio.

acquirer: ProCap Financial, Inc.; its direct wholly-owned subsidiary, Silvia Merger Sub, Inc., will merge into the target.
consideration_type: Stock: ProCap Financial, Inc. common stock for outstanding CFO Silvia common stock, with additional ProCap common stock issuable as contingent earnout consideration if the $9.00 trading-price condition is met during the five-year earnout period. Outstanding CFO Silvia SAFEs will be terminated, and their holders will receive allocated merger consideration and any earnout shares. Dissenting shares and treasury shares are excluded from the common-stock conversion.
stock_exchange_ratio: Variable: for each share of CFO Silvia common stock, the per-share merger consideration equals (Total Merger Consideration minus SAFE Merger Consideration) divided by the Fully Diluted Number, in shares of ProCap common stock. Additional per-share earnout consideration, if any, equals (9,000,000 Earnout Shares minus SAFE Holder Earnout Shares) divided by the Fully Diluted Number. Total Merger Consideration equals 9,000,000 ProCap common shares minus a number of shares valued at the ProCap Trading Price on the closing date equal to Unpaid Liabilities. The aggregate number of shares issued to a person for a certificate or SAFE at a particular time is rounded down to the nearest whole share. Dissenting shares and treasury shares are excluded from conversion.
shareholder_vote_date: ProCap stockholders are scheduled to vote on the merger-related share issuance at the virtual annual meeting on 3/27/2026 at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time, unless postponed or adjourned. CFO Silvia stockholders approved the Merger Agreement and Merger by stockholder vote on 2/9/2026.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or applicable waiver of closing conditions, including ProCap stockholder approval of the merger-related share issuance; CFO Silvia stockholder approval, reported as obtained on 2/9/2026; required regulatory approvals and filings, including HSR Act filings if applicable, and expiration or termination of applicable antitrust waiting periods; and absence of a legal restraint prohibiting the merger. Additional stated conditions include accuracy of representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, no CFO Silvia material adverse effect, specified absence of transaction-related litigation and burdensome regulatory conditions, delivery of closing documents and ancillary agreements, payment of transaction expenses, and ProCap’s receipt of a fairness opinion. The filing also states that listing approval for ProCap shares issued in the merger is a closing condition. Approval of Proposals 2, 3 and 4 is not a merger closing condition.
event_status: Pending under a Merger Agreement dated 2/9/2026; CFO Silvia stockholders have approved the agreement and merger, while ProCap stockholder approval remains to be sought.
security_description: Outstanding common stock of CFO Silvia, Inc., par value $0.001 per share, other than dissenting shares and treasury shares. Outstanding CFO Silvia simple agreements for future equity (SAFEs) are also terminated in exchange for allocated merger consideration and any earnout shares; they are not described as receiving the common stock’s per-share ratio.
effective_date: Not specified. The merger is to become effective when the Delaware Secretary of State accepts the certificate of merger filing at closing, or at a later time agreed in writing by ProCap and CFO Silvia and stated in that certificate.
available_options: No holder election; CFO Silvia common shares are automatically converted into the right to receive the specified stock consideration, subject to the stated exceptions and conditions.

consideration_type: Stock; each eligible Real Asset Acquisition Corp. Class A ordinary share is exchanged for one IQM Finland Oy American depositary share (ADS), representing one IQM ordinary share. Treasury shares, redeemed shares and dissenting shares receive different treatment.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration for eligible Class A ordinary shares. Redeeming shares instead receive a pro rata share of the shareholder redemption amount, and dissenting shares instead receive fair value under Cayman Islands law; neither amount is stated per share.
stock_exchange_ratio: 1 IQM Finland Oy ADS, representing 1 IQM ordinary share, per 1 Real Asset Acquisition Corp. Class A ordinary share, including Class A shares issued upon the one-for-one conversion of outstanding Class B ordinary shares not forfeited by the sponsor. No fractional ADSs will be issued; any fractional entitlement is rounded to the nearest whole ADS.
shareholder_vote_date: No meeting date is stated. Real Asset Acquisition Corp. shareholders are to vote at a meeting held as promptly as reasonably practicable and, unless the parties agree otherwise in writing, no more than 30 days after the proxy/registration statement becomes effective. IQM Finland Oy is to seek shareholder approval by irrevocable unanimous written consent; if not obtained within 60 calendar days after the agreement date, it is to call a shareholder meeting by 4/30/2026.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or legally permitted written waiver by the party whose obligation is conditioned: Real Asset Acquisition Corp., IQM Finland Oy and merger-sub shareholder approvals remaining valid; effectiveness of the proxy/registration statement without an outstanding SEC stop order or related proceeding; conditional Nasdaq approval of IQM’s initial listing and listing of the consideration ADSs, with applicable listing requirements satisfied; no material legal restraint preventing closing and all required regulatory approvals obtained or waived. Real Asset Acquisition Corp.’s additional conditions include the specified accuracy of IQM, LuxCo and IQM US LLC representations and warranties, their material covenant compliance, and no continuing uncured IQM material adverse effect. IQM, LuxCo and IQM US LLC’s additional conditions include the specified accuracy of Real Asset Acquisition Corp. representations and warranties, its material covenant compliance, no continuing uncured SPAC material adverse effect, and aggregate transaction proceeds of at least $150,000,000.
event_status: Announced; business combination agreement executed and merger pending, subject to shareholder approvals and other closing conditions.
security_description: Real Asset Acquisition Corp. Class A ordinary shares, par value $0.0001 per share, including shares issued upon conversion of its Class B ordinary shares. Treasury, redeeming and dissenting shares are excluded from the ADS exchange.
effective_date: Not dated. The merger becomes legally effective when the plan of merger is registered by the Cayman Islands Registrar of Companies, or on a later date agreed by IQM US LLC and Real Asset Acquisition Corp. and specified in that plan.
available_options: No holder election between merger consideration alternatives is stated for eligible Class A ordinary shares; they receive the fixed ADS consideration. Separately, eligible public shareholders may exercise redemption rights instead of receiving ADSs.

acquirer: Community West Bancshares
consideration_type: Stock; cash paid only in lieu of fractional shares
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration per share is stated. Instead of issuing fractional shares of Community West Bancshares common stock, Community West Bancshares will pay cash in U.S. dollars, without interest, rounded down to the nearest whole cent. The amount equals the fractional share otherwise due multiplied by the weighted average daily closing sales price of Community West Bancshares common stock on the Nasdaq Capital Market for the 20 consecutive trading days immediately preceding the closing date.
stock_exchange_ratio: 0.4520 shares of Community West Bancshares common stock per 1 share of United Security Bancshares common stock. The fixed ratio does not change with Community West Bancshares' trading price before closing. It is subject to proportionate adjustment for specified share reclassifications, recapitalizations, splits, combinations, exchanges or readjustments, or a specified Community West Bancshares stock dividend. No fractional shares will be issued; cash will be paid in lieu.
shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled special meetings on 3/30/2026: United Security Bancshares shareholders at 2:00 pm PT; Community West Bancshares shareholders at 3:00 pm PT.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver where permitted: approval of the merger agreement by United Security Bancshares shareholders and approval of the merger agreement and related Community West Bancshares stock issuance by Community West Bancshares shareholders; necessary regulatory approvals, including the applicable Federal Reserve approval or waiver and FDIC and California Department of Financial Protection and Innovation approvals for the bank merger, and expiration or termination of applicable waiting periods; no legal restraint or prohibition, or specified proceeding reasonably expected to have a material adverse effect on the surviving entity; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an SEC stop order; Nasdaq Capital Market non-objection to listing the shares to be issued; required accuracy of each party's representations and warranties and material performance of its obligations; each party's receipt of an applicable tax opinion regarding reorganization treatment; and required officers' certificates. Community West Bancshares' additional conditions include a United Security Bancshares FIRPTA certificate and dissenting shares representing less than 10% of United Security Bancshares' issued and outstanding common stock. Regulatory approvals are not assured.
event_status: Pending as of the joint proxy statement/prospectus dated 2/20/2026; the merger agreement was executed, and shareholder meetings and regulatory approvals remained ahead.
security_description: United Security Bancshares common stock, no par value per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the merger's effective time. Shares owned by either merger party, certain benefit-plan or fiduciary shares, and dissenting shares are subject to the stated exceptions; United Security Bancshares equity awards receive separately described treatment.
effective_date: Not specified. The merger is anticipated to be consummated in the second quarter of 2026; it will become legally effective on the date and at the time specified in the certificate of merger filed with the California Secretary of State. The filing describes closing separately.
available_options: No holder election; eligible United Security Bancshares common shares convert into the fixed stock consideration, with cash only in lieu of fractional shares.

acquirer: OceanFirst Financial Corp., through its wholly-owned subsidiary Apollo Merger Sub Corp. in the first merger
consideration_type: Stock; cash is payable only in lieu of fractional shares.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration per share. Cash in lieu of a fractional share of OceanFirst common stock equals the 15-consecutive-full-trading-day volume-weighted average trading price of OceanFirst common stock ending on the last trading day before the merger closing date, multiplied by the fractional share otherwise receivable; the fraction is calculated after aggregating the holder’s Flushing shares and rounded to the nearest thousandth, and the cash payment is rounded to the nearest cent.
stock_exchange_ratio: 0.85 shares of OceanFirst Financial Corp. common stock per 1 share of Flushing Financial Corporation common stock, subject to specified exceptions. The ratio is subject to an appropriate and proportionate adjustment for specified changes in capitalization or extraordinary dividends or distributions before the first merger becomes effective; the Warburg investment is excluded from this adjustment. No fractional shares will be issued.
shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled virtual special meetings on 4/2/2026: Flushing Financial Corporation stockholders at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time to vote on adopting the merger agreement; OceanFirst Financial Corp. stockholders at 4:00 p.m. Eastern Time to vote on the share issuance required for the merger and investment.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where permitted by law, written waiver of the applicable conditions: Flushing stockholders’ adoption of the merger agreement and OceanFirst stockholders’ approval of the share issuance; authorization for Nasdaq listing of the OceanFirst common shares issued under the merger agreement; receipt and continued effectiveness of requisite regulatory approvals, expiration or termination of applicable statutory waiting periods, and absence of a materially burdensome regulatory condition; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an effective stop order or unresolved SEC proceeding; absence of legal restraints or laws preventing or prohibiting the transactions; consummation of the Warburg equity investment before or concurrently with the merger closing; required accuracy of each party’s representations and warranties and performance of its covenants, subject to the agreement’s materiality standards, with the specified officer certificates; and each party’s receipt of a legal opinion that the mergers, taken together, qualify as a reorganization under Section 368(a) of the Internal Revenue Code. Approval of OceanFirst’s exemption amendment and adjournment proposals and Flushing’s compensation and adjournment proposals is not an express closing condition.
event_status: Pending as of the 2/26/2026 joint proxy statement/prospectus; the mergers were proposed, regulatory applications were pending, and the companies expected closing in the second quarter of 2026, subject to closing conditions.
security_description: Flushing Financial Corporation common stock, par value $0.01 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the first merger’s effective time, excluding specified treasury and intercompany-owned shares, subject to exceptions for certain benefit-plan, fiduciary, agency and debt-related holdings.
effective_date: No calendar effective date stated. The first merger becomes effective when its certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a mutually agreed later time specified in that certificate. The second merger becomes effective immediately following the first merger, upon filing its separate certificate of merger or at a specified later time.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Flushing common stockholders receive the fixed stock consideration, with cash only in lieu of fractional shares.

consideration_type: Stock for Roman Class A ordinary shares not redeemed or validly subject to dissenters’ rights; eligible holders may instead elect cash redemption in connection with the transaction.
cash_consideration: For each eligible Roman Class A ordinary share elected for redemption, cash equal to its pro rata portion of the funds then in Roman’s trust account, including interest not previously released to pay taxes. stock_exchange_ratio: 1 PubCo Class A ordinary share per 1 Roman Class A ordinary share not subject to redemption or valid dissenters’ rights.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permissible waiver of applicable antitrust waiting periods; absence of specified legal prohibitions; effectiveness of the Form F-4 registration statement without an unresolved stop order; Roman shareholder approval; approval for listing of the PubCo shares; and the required PubCo board composition. Additional conditions include material compliance with obligations, accuracy of representations and warranties subject to the agreement’s standards, absence of a continuing Material Adverse Effect or Roman Material Adverse Effect, delivery of officer certificates and evidence of termination of specified contracts. ThomasLloyd’s conditions also include effective PubCo articles and incorporation, delivery of the registration rights and lock-up agreements, and material compliance with the sponsor support agreement. No minimum cash closing condition is stated. The parties are seeking financing, but the filing does not identify obtaining it as a closing condition.

acquirer: VICI Properties Inc., through its wholly owned merger subsidiary VICI ROYAL MERGER SUB LLC
target: Golden Entertainment, Inc., through its successor New HoldCo, which will be renamed Royal HoldCo I Inc.
consideration_type: Stock; the separate $2.75-per-share distribution follows the OpCo Sale and precedes the merger. Cash is payable instead of fractional VICI shares.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration is payable in the PropCo Subsidiary Merger. Cash instead of a fractional share of VICI Common Stock equals the fractional part multiplied by the VICI Common Stock VWAP. A separate $2.75-per-share dividend to Golden shareholders is to be distributed after the OpCo Sale and before the merger.
stock_exchange_ratio: Fixed at 0.902 shares of VICI Properties Inc. common stock, par value $0.01 per share, per 1 share of Golden Entertainment, Inc. common stock, par value $0.01 per share, received on a one-for-one basis as New HoldCo common stock in the F Reorganization. The ratio is subject to equitable adjustments for specified capitalization changes or stock dividends; cash is paid instead of fractional VICI shares.
shareholder_vote_date: Golden shareholders: special meeting scheduled for 3/31/2026 at 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time, via live interactive webcast, subject to adjournment or postponement.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permissible waiver, the mutual conditions include Golden shareholder approval; required Gaming and Liquor Law approvals remaining in force; completion of the Pre-Closing Restructuring; no governmental order prohibiting, or law making illegal, the OpCo Sale or PropCo Subsidiary Merger; NYSE listing approval for the VICI shares, subject to official notice of issuance; and effectiveness of the registration statement without an SEC stop order or unwithdrawn related proceeding. New HoldCo's additional conditions include the specified accuracy of OpCo Buyer, VICI and merger subsidiary representations and warranties, their material covenant compliance, no continuing material adverse effect concerning them, officer certificates, and a tax opinion that the merger qualifies as a Section 368(a) reorganization. VICI's and the merger subsidiary's additional conditions include the specified accuracy of Golden and OpCo Buyer representations and warranties, their material covenant compliance, no continuing material adverse effect concerning them, officer certificates, title to each Subject Property vested in the applicable Owner SPE with the required title policy, a Section 368(a) tax opinion, no specified casualty or condemnation meeting the $174,000,000 thresholds, OpCo Buyer's payment of any Excess Debt Amount, and an updated study estimating Golden's specified earnings and profits do not exceed $460,000,000. OpCo Buyer's OpCo Sale conditions include specified representation-and-warranty accuracy, VICI's and the merger subsidiary's material covenant compliance, no continuing material adverse effect concerning Golden, VICI or the merger subsidiary, officer certificates, and VICI's payment of the Target Debt Amount. OpCo Buyer's obligation to consummate the transactions is not conditioned on debt financing.
event_status: Pending as of the 3/4/2026 filing; the Form S-4 registration statement is amended but remains subject to effectiveness, and the transactions remain subject to closing conditions.
security_description: Golden Entertainment, Inc. common stock, par value $0.01 per share, converted one-for-one into New HoldCo common stock before the PropCo Subsidiary Merger. Treasury shares and shares held directly by VICI or its merger subsidiary are excluded from the merger consideration.
effective_date: The merger is expected to be completed in mid-2026, subject to approval and other closing conditions. Its legal Effective Time will be when the articles of merger and certificate of merger have been filed with the Minnesota and Delaware secretaries of state, respectively, or a later date and time agreed by the parties and specified in those filings. It will occur after the OpCo Sale and distribution; no specific calendar effective date is stated.
available_options: No holder election; eligible shares receive the fixed stock consideration, with cash instead of fractional shares.

acquirer: Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. II, through its wholly owned French merger subsidiary Bleichroeder Acquisition 2 France, which survives the reincorporation merger and then absorbs Pasqal Holding SAS
consideration_type: Stock; Pasqal shareholders receive shares of the surviving corporation, subject to cash settlement solely for fractional-share entitlements.
cash_consideration: No regular cash price per Pasqal share is stated. Fractional-share entitlements are settled in cash in accordance with the Draft Merger Agreement.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each Pasqal Holding SAS Class Seed, common, Class A, Class B or Class C ordinary share, the number of Pasqal Holding SA ordinary shares received will be determined using the final Exchange Ratio in the Draft Merger Agreement. The agreement describes a valuation-based method using unit values for Pasqal shares and the parent surviving corporation’s shares, with the latter based on $10 per share; no numerical ratio is stated. No fractional shares will be issued, and fractional entitlements will be settled in cash. The agreement provides for appropriate adjustment of the merger consideration in specified capitalization-change circumstances before the Draft Merger Agreement is signed.
closing_conditions: Closing remains subject to required Bleichroeder and Pasqal shareholder approvals; required governmental filings and notices and expiration or termination of applicable antitrust waiting periods; no law or order prohibiting closing; SEC effectiveness of the Form F-4 registration statement without an effective stop order; at least $150 million of cash available to the surviving corporation before transaction expenses from remaining trust funds after redemptions, specified PIPE proceeds and other agreed financing, excluding Pasqal’s February 27, 2026 Series C raise; adoption or delivery of documents necessary for the reincorporation merger; constitution of the specified nine-member board; and listing approval and continued-listing eligibility for the surviving corporation’s shares and warrants. Party-specific conditions include material covenant compliance; accuracy of representations and warranties subject to the agreement’s qualifications; absence of a continuing Company or Parent Material Adverse Effect, as applicable; required officer certificates; specified good-standing certificates for Pasqal and its subsidiaries; executed lock-up agreements; specified non-competition and non-solicitation agreements; and resignations of Bleichroeder’s officers and directors effective at the merger effective time. Applicable party-specific conditions may be waived as provided in the agreement.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was signed, and the business combination was expected to close in the second half of 2026, subject to closing conditions.
security_description: Pasqal Holding SAS Class Seed ordinary shares, common ordinary shares, Class A ordinary shares, Class B ordinary shares and Class C ordinary shares, each with €0.10 par value. Each listed class is exchanged under the same stated Exchange Ratio mechanism.
effective_date: Conditional: the effective date to be set in the Draft Merger Agreement under French law. The Pasqal merger is to occur as soon as practicable after the reincorporation merger’s effective time and the required merger approvals; no calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: No holder election; the listed Pasqal ordinary-share classes are exchanged for surviving-corporation shares at the Exchange Ratio, with cash settlement of fractional entitlements.

stock_exchange_ratio: Each Pantages Capital Acquisition Corporation right converts into the number of HORIZON MINING LIMITED ordinary shares the holder would have received if the right had converted into Pantages Class A ordinary shares immediately before the merger.
