closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permissible written waiver of applicable conditions: required approvals of Pantages shareholders and board, Company shareholders, Merger Sub’s sole director and shareholder, and Pubco’s directors and shareholders; applicable material governmental consents, antitrust waiting-period expiration or termination, and absence of a law or order prohibiting the transactions; an effective Form F-4 registration statement; Nasdaq listing eligibility for Pubco ordinary shares; Pantages net tangible assets of at least $5,000,001 after redemptions and any funded PIPE investment; adoption of the amended Pubco charter, appointment of the post-closing Pubco board, evidence of Pubco’s foreign-private-issuer status, and applicable PRC approvals. Party-specific conditions include accuracy of representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, no continuing uncured material adverse effect, required closing certificates and other deliveries, sponsor payment of any extension fees, payment of specified Pantages expenses and sponsor loans, effectiveness of specified ancillary agreements, and completion of the reorganization.
event_status: Pending proposed merger under a business combination agreement dated November 18, 2025.
security_description: Issued and outstanding Pantages Capital Acquisition Corporation rights, each entitling its holder to one-fifth of a Class A ordinary share upon a business combination; this includes rights detached from public and private units.
effective_date: Conditional: the merger becomes effective when the Cayman Registrar registers the Plan of Merger and issues the certificate of merger, or on another date specified in the Merger Documents no later than the 90th day after registration. No calendar effective date is stated.
available_options: No holder election; outstanding rights convert automatically into Pubco ordinary shares.

acquirer: Odysseus Holdings Limited, through its wholly owned subsidiary Odysseus (Cayman) Limited, which survives the merger.
consideration_type: Stock for non-redeeming Vine Hill Class A ordinary shares. Outstanding Vine Hill public warrants become warrants of Odysseus Holdings Limited. Public shareholders may separately elect cash redemption instead of receiving shares for the shares redeemed.
cash_consideration: For a validly redeemed Vine Hill public share, cash equal to its pro rata portion of the amount in the trust account, calculated two business days before closing, including interest not previously released to Vine Hill and net of taxes payable, if any. The illustrative amount as of the March 2, 2026 record date was approximately $10.68 per Vine Hill public share; the closing redemption price is not fixed.
stock_exchange_ratio: 1 no-par-value ordinary share of Odysseus Holdings Limited per 1 non-redeemed Vine Hill Class A ordinary share, including a Class A share issued upon conversion of a Class B share. Each outstanding Vine Hill public warrant becomes a warrant to purchase 1 Holdco ordinary share, with substantially the same terms. The merger agreement provides for an appropriate adjustment to the number of Holdco shares issuable for specified share splits, dividends, reorganizations and similar changes before closing.
shareholder_vote_date: Vine Hill shareholders’ extraordinary general meeting is scheduled for 3/27/2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver where permitted: Vine Hill shareholder approval of the business combination, SPAC merger and organizational document proposals; CoinShares shareholder approval of the scheme of arrangement; specified regulatory approvals, including expiration or termination of any Hart-Scott-Rodino Act waiting period; no applicable legal prohibition or injunction; no secured creditors of Vine Hill immediately before the SPAC merger; approval of Holdco ordinary shares for U.S. exchange listing, subject to official notice of issuance; effectiveness of the registration statement with no effective SEC stop order; and Royal Court of Jersey sanction and submission of its scheme order for registration. Additional party-specific conditions include the accuracy of applicable representations and warranties, material pre-closing covenant compliance, absence of the specified continuing material adverse effect, performance under the shareholder support agreement, and cancellation of Vine Hill’s private placement warrants.
event_status: Pending; the business combination agreement was signed and Vine Hill shareholder approval is being sought.
security_description: Vine Hill Class A ordinary shares, par value $0.0001 per share, including public shares and Class A shares issued upon conversion of the sponsor’s remaining Class B shares. Redeemed public shares, treasury shares and shares held by qualifying dissenters receive different treatment; Vine Hill public warrants are assumed separately.
effective_date: The SPAC merger becomes effective when the plan of merger is registered by the Cayman Islands Registrar of Companies, or at a later date or time agreed by CoinShares and Vine Hill and specified in that plan. It is to take effect at least one day before the scheme of arrangement; no calendar effective date is stated.
available_options: A Vine Hill public shareholder may redeem all or part of its public shares for cash, regardless of whether or how it votes, if it follows the stated procedures. Non-redeemed Class A shares convert into Holdco ordinary shares at the stated ratio. Shares held through Vine Hill units must be separated before redemption. Without Vine Hill’s prior consent, a shareholder acting alone or with affiliates or a group cannot redeem more than 15% of the public shares.
default_option: A non-redeemed Vine Hill Class A share converts into 1 Holdco ordinary share at the SPAC merger effective time. The filing also states that a shareholder who takes no action will become a Holdco shareholder and warrant holder if the business combination is consummated.
election_deadline: For the separate Vine Hill public-share cash redemption election: 3/25/2026 at 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time, two business days before the initially scheduled extraordinary general meeting. The holder must submit the written request and deliver its shares and applicable forms to the transfer agent by that deadline.

The merger agreement defines Equity Value to include aggregate Company Filing Fees in addition to $1.2 billion; the effect on the ratio is unclear from the differing descriptions.

acquirer: Calisa Acquisition Corp (through its wholly owned merger subsidiary, Calisa Merger Sub)
consideration_type: Stock: Calisa Acquisition Corp ordinary shares, with an additional 3,600,000 earnout shares subject to revenue and share-price conditions.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each Goodvision AI Inc. ordinary share, a number of Calisa Acquisition Corp ordinary shares equal to 18,000,000 divided by the number of fully diluted Goodvision AI Inc. shares outstanding immediately before the merger. Shares held by each holder are aggregated before applying the ratio, and the result is rounded to the nearest whole share. Ten percent of the shares otherwise issuable as merger consideration will be placed in indemnification escrow. Treasury shares are canceled without consideration; dissenting shares are excluded unless appraisal rights are withdrawn or lost. Goodvision shareholders are also entitled to 3,600,000 additional shares, in two tranches of 1,800,000, if the applicable FY 2026 or FY 2027 revenue and share-price conditions are met.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted written waiver: applicable antitrust waiting periods must expire or terminate and required antitrust approvals must be obtained; no effective legal restraint may prohibit the merger; the registration statement/proxy statement must be effective, without an effective SEC stop order or pending proceeding seeking one; Goodvision and Calisa must obtain their required shareholder approvals; a financing with $5,000,000 in aggregate gross proceeds must close substantially concurrently with the merger; and, if Calisa’s charter requires it, Calisa must have at least $5,000,001 in net tangible assets immediately before or upon consummation. Additional party-specific conditions include the specified accuracy of representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, no Goodvision material adverse effect, no specified proceedings that would prevent or rescind the transaction, execution and effectiveness of required ancillary documents, required closing deliverables, and approval of the Calisa shares for exchange listing.
event_status: Announced; pending. The business combination agreement was executed on March 6, 2026, and closing was expected in the second half of 2026, subject to approvals and other conditions.
security_description: Goodvision AI Inc. ordinary shares, par value $5.00 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the merger, excluding treasury shares and dissenting shares.
effective_date: The merger will become effective when the plan of merger is accepted for filing by the Cayman Islands Registrar of Companies, or at a later date or time agreed by Calisa Acquisition Corp and Goodvision AI Inc. and specified in the plan. No calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: No holder election for the ordinary merger consideration; eligible Goodvision shareholders receive the specified stock consideration, subject to escrow and earnout conditions. Dissenting shareholders have separate statutory appraisal rights.

consideration_type: Stock, with a contingent right for eligible holders to receive additional stock as earnout shares.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration is specified for Company Common Stock. Fractional shares of Domesticated Purchaser Common Stock that would otherwise be issuable will be rounded up to a whole share rather than paid in cash.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each 1 share of Controlled Thermal Resources Holdings Inc. common stock, the holder receives shares of Domesticated Purchaser Common Stock equal to the Exchange Ratio: Aggregate Merger Consideration divided by Company Fully Diluted Capital. Aggregate Merger Consideration equals the $4,500,000,000 Public Company (Pre-Capital Raise) Valuation divided by the Per Share Price, which is the redemption price for Plum Acquisition Corp. IV Class A ordinary shares in the Redemption. The ratio is subject to adjustment for specified changes to Domesticated Purchaser Common Stock before issuance; fractional shares otherwise issuable are rounded up to the nearest whole share. The consideration and ratio are not subject to purchase-price adjustments for net debt, cash, indebtedness, transaction expenses, or working capital. Eligible holders also have a contingent aggregate right to up to 100,000,000 additional shares over ten years after closing: eight 12,500,000-share tranches at VWAP thresholds of $12.50, $15.00, $17.50, $20.00, $22.50, $25.00, $27.50, and $30.00 per share, each measured over any 20 trading days in a 30-consecutive-trading-day period. A qualifying change-of-control event makes all unissued earnout shares due.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or written waiver where permissible: approval by Plum Acquisition Corp. IV shareholders and Controlled Thermal Resources Holdings Inc. stockholders; no effective law or order making the transactions illegal or preventing or prohibiting them; SEC effectiveness of the registration statement at closing, without an effective stop order or unresolved SEC proceeding; conditional listing approval for the Domesticated Purchaser Common Stock to be issued, subject to the agreement's stated qualifications; expiration or termination of applicable HSR Act and other antitrust waiting periods and receipt of required antitrust approvals. The target's additional conditions include specified accuracy of Plum Acquisition Corp. IV and Merger Sub representations and warranties, their material covenant compliance, no continuing Purchaser Material Adverse Effect, completion of the Domestication, Available Closing Cash of at least $100,000,000, and specified closing deliveries. Plum Acquisition Corp. IV and Merger Sub's additional conditions include specified accuracy of target representations and warranties, the target's material covenant compliance, no continuing Company Material Adverse Effect, completion of the Pre-Closing Reorg to the purchaser's reasonable satisfaction, and specified closing deliveries.

Treasury shares and dissenting shares are excluded from the exchange.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted written waiver of applicable conditions: approval by Quetta stockholders and Smart Kreate Group Limited (BVI) shareholders; effectiveness of the proxy/registration statement without an outstanding SEC stop order or related proceeding; conditional approval of PubCo’s Nasdaq listing application and approval to list its Class A ordinary shares and rights, subject to official notice of issuance; and absence of a material legal restraint. Additional Initial Merger conditions include specified standards for the Company’s, acquisition entities’ and Quetta’s representations and warranties, material compliance with their respective pre-closing covenants, and no continuing, uncured Company or Quetta Material Adverse Effect. The Company’s obligation at the Acquisition Closing additionally requires that the Initial Closing and Initial Merger Effective Time have occurred.

acquirer: Devon Energy Corporation; its direct, wholly-owned subsidiary Cubs Merger Sub, Inc. will merge with and into Coterra Energy Inc.
target: Coterra Energy Inc.; it will survive the merger as a wholly-owned, direct subsidiary of Devon Energy Corporation.
consideration_type: Stock; eligible Coterra common stockholders will receive Devon common stock at a fixed exchange ratio, with incidental cash in lieu of fractional shares.
cash_consideration: No cash price per share of Coterra common stock is specified. Cash is payable only in lieu of fractional shares of Devon common stock, based on the net proceeds from the exchange agent’s sale of aggregated fractional shares.
stock_exchange_ratio: 0.70 shares of Devon Energy Corporation common stock, par value $0.10 per share, per 1 share of Coterra Energy Inc. common stock, par value $0.10 per share, other than excluded shares. The ratio is fixed, subject to adjustment for specified changes in outstanding Devon or Coterra shares before the effective time. No fractional Devon shares will be issued; cash will be paid instead.
closing_conditions: Each party’s obligation to close is subject to satisfaction or, where permitted by law, waiver of: Coterra stockholder approval of the merger proposal; Devon stockholder approval of both the stock issuance and authorized-share charter amendment proposals; no applicable law or order prohibiting the merger; expiration or termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period and any agreement not to close under a timing agreement; effectiveness of the Form S-4, with no SEC stop order or initiated or threatened stop-order proceeding; and NYSE approval and authorization for listing of the Devon shares to be issued, subject to official notice of issuance. Devon and Merger Sub additionally require Coterra’s material covenant compliance, the specified accuracy of Coterra’s representations and warranties, including its material-adverse-effect representation, and an officer’s certificate. Coterra has corresponding conditions concerning Devon’s and Merger Sub’s material covenant compliance, the specified accuracy of Devon’s representations and warranties, including its material-adverse-effect representation, and an officer’s certificate. Financing is not a closing condition.
event_status: Pending as described in the preliminary Form S-4 filed March 11, 2026; the merger agreement was signed February 1, 2026, and the merger remained subject to closing conditions.
security_description: Coterra Energy Inc. common stock, par value $0.10 per share; the stated exchange applies to issued and outstanding shares other than excluded shares held by Devon, Merger Sub, their subsidiaries, Coterra or Coterra’s subsidiaries. Coterra equity awards have separate treatment.
effective_date: Not specified. The merger will become legally effective when the certificate of merger is filed with and accepted by the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later date and time agreed by Devon and Coterra and stated in that certificate. The filing is to occur immediately after closing; closing is expected in the second quarter of calendar year 2026, but no actual date is specified.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Coterra common shares convert into the fixed stock consideration, with cash in lieu of fractional Devon shares.

acquirer: flyExclusive, Inc. (parent); FlyX Merger Sub, Inc., its wholly owned subsidiary, will merge into the target.
target: Jet.AI SpinCo, Inc., currently a wholly owned subsidiary of Jet.AI Inc.; it will survive as a wholly owned subsidiary of flyExclusive, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock: holders of Jet.AI SpinCo, Inc. common stock will receive flyExclusive, Inc. Class A common stock. Twenty percent of the merger consideration shares will be reserved rather than issued at closing; their issuance and any additional shares are subject to the post-closing purchase-price adjustment. Cash may be paid solely in lieu of fractional shares.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration per share of Jet.AI SpinCo, Inc. common stock is described. A holder otherwise entitled to a fractional share of flyExclusive, Inc. Class A common stock will receive cash in lieu of that fractional share, based on the net proceeds of the exchange agent’s sale of aggregated fractional shares, subject to withholding and specified charges.
stock_exchange_ratio: Variable shares of flyExclusive, Inc. Class A common stock per 1 share of Jet.AI SpinCo, Inc. common stock. At closing, the ratio is Closing Date Merger Consideration Shares divided by fully diluted SpinCo common shares outstanding on the day immediately before the effective date. Closing Date Merger Consideration Shares equal total Merger Consideration Shares less Reserve Shares. Total Merger Consideration Shares equal the Initial Purchase Price divided by the Parent Trading Price; the Initial Purchase Price equals Estimated Net Cash multiplied by the Applicable Premium Percentage. The premium is 110% for Net Cash of $11,999,999.99 or less, 115% from $12,000,000 through $14,624,999.99, 117.5% from $14,625,000 through $17,249,999.99, and 120% from $17,250,000 upward. The Parent Trading Price is the volume-weighted average closing sale price of flyExclusive Class A common stock over 30 consecutive trading days ending three trading days before the closing date, subject to specified equity-event adjustments. Reserve Shares equal 20% of total Merger Consideration Shares, rounded up to a whole share, and are reserved but not issued at closing. The potential post-closing reserve ratio is Reserve Shares divided by the same fully diluted SpinCo share count. Following final determination of Net Cash, all or part of the Reserve Shares may be issued; an upward purchase-price adjustment may also result in Additional Merger Consideration Shares capped at 20% of total Merger Consideration Shares. No fractional shares will be issued; aggregated fractional interests will be sold and net proceeds distributed.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted waiver: Jet.AI shareholder approval of the Transactions Proposal and SpinCo shareholder approval; completion of the Separation and Distribution under their agreement; required regulatory approvals remaining in force and expiration or termination of statutory waiting periods; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an SEC stop order or related proceedings, and expiration of any applicable distribution notice periods; absence of an effective governmental restraint prohibiting the transaction; and approval for NYSE American listing of flyExclusive Class A shares issuable in the merger, subject to official notice of issuance. Additional conditions include material compliance with each side’s obligations and covenants, accuracy of its representations and warranties under the agreement’s applicable standards, and no continuing flyExclusive, Jet.AI or SpinCo material adverse effect, as applicable. Conditions to flyExclusive and Merger Sub’s obligations also include SpinCo Net Cash of at least $12,000,000 at closing after payment of unpaid transaction expenses, continuing effectiveness of the stockholder support agreements, resignation of SpinCo’s officers and directors effective at the merger effective time, and no determination by flyExclusive’s board that the transactions are not in its stockholders’ best interests. Required closing certificates and transaction documents must also be delivered. The former condition requiring Jet.AI to execute a new third-party financing agreement was eliminated by Amendment No. 4.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement has been amended through Amendment No. 4, dated February 11, 2026. The registration statement filed March 16, 2026 is a preliminary, pre-effective amendment, and the merger remains subject to closing conditions.
security_description: Jet.AI SpinCo, Inc. common stock, par value $0.001 per share, distributed pro rata to Jet.AI Inc. stockholders before the merger and outstanding immediately before the merger effective time, excluding SpinCo treasury shares and shares held by flyExclusive or Merger Sub.
effective_date: The merger will become effective when the Certificate of Merger is duly filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed by the parties and specified in that certificate. No calendar date or clock time is stated.
available_options: No holder election; the merger agreement specifies stock consideration for eligible SpinCo common shares, subject to the reserve-share and post-closing adjustment provisions.

acquirer: Danaher Corporation, through its wholly owned subsidiary Mobius Merger Sub, Inc., which will merge with and into Masimo Corporation
consideration_type: Cash for eligible shares of Masimo Corporation common stock, subject to the stated treatment of excluded, converting and dissenting shares
cash_consideration: USD $180.00 in cash, without interest, per eligible share of Masimo Corporation common stock, subject to required tax withholding. Shares owned by Danaher Corporation, Mobius Merger Sub, Inc. or Masimo Corporation are cancelled without consideration; shares held by holders who validly exercise appraisal rights are subject to those rights; and shares owned by certain wholly owned subsidiaries are converted into shares of the surviving corporation rather than paid cash.
stock_exchange_ratio: No stock consideration for eligible shares of Masimo Corporation common stock. Shares owned by certain wholly owned subsidiaries instead convert into shares of the surviving corporation so that each such subsidiary retains the same ownership percentage.
closing_conditions: The parties' obligations to close are subject to satisfaction or waiver of Masimo stockholder approval; expiration or early termination of the applicable Hart-Scott-Rodino waiting period and any applicable contractual waiting periods with the Department of Justice or Federal Trade Commission; receipt of specified other regulatory approvals; and absence of an effective law or governmental order making the merger unlawful or restraining, enjoining or otherwise prohibiting it. Danaher Corporation's and Mobius Merger Sub, Inc.'s additional conditions include the specified accuracy of Masimo's representations and warranties, Masimo's performance of its obligations in all material respects, no Material Adverse Effect since the merger agreement date, and a Masimo officer's closing certificate. Masimo's additional conditions include the specified accuracy of Danaher's and Merger Sub's representations and warranties, their performance of obligations in all material respects, and their officers' closing certificates. Completion is not subject to a financing condition.
event_status: Pending as described in the preliminary proxy statement dated March 18, 2026; the merger agreement was executed February 16, 2026, and closing remained subject to conditions.
security_description: Eligible shares of Masimo Corporation common stock, par value $0.001 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the merger's effective time. Excluded, converting and dissenting shares have different treatment; Masimo options, restricted stock units and performance-based restricted stock units also have separate treatment.
effective_date: Not fixed. The merger will become legally effective when the certificate of merger is filed with and accepted by the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed in writing by Masimo Corporation and Danaher Corporation and specified in that certificate. The filing is to occur on the closing date; closing is expected in the second half of 2026, subject to conditions.
available_options: No holder election for eligible shares: each is automatically converted into the right to receive USD $180.00 in cash, without interest. Eligible holders may instead seek statutory appraisal if they meet the applicable requirements.

acquirer: Mission Produce, Inc. (acquiring parent); Cantaloupe Merger Sub I, Inc. and Cantaloupe Merger Sub II, LLC are its wholly owned merger subsidiaries. Merger Sub I will merge into Calavo Growers, Inc.; immediately afterward, Calavo will merge into Merger Sub II.
consideration_type: Mixed cash and stock, subject to a provision that replaces a portion of the cash with additional Mission Produce common stock if the stock consideration would otherwise represent less than 43% of the total consideration value. Cash is paid instead of fractional shares.
cash_consideration: USD $14.85 per share of Calavo Growers, Inc. common stock, without interest and subject to applicable withholding taxes. If the specified stock-value threshold is below 43%, enough cash consideration is instead payable in an equivalent amount of Mission Produce common stock to bring the recomputed threshold to 43%. Separately, cash without interest is paid instead of any fractional Mission Produce share, equal to the fractional amount multiplied by the agreed Mission Produce share price of USD $12.41 and rounded to the nearest cent.
stock_exchange_ratio: Fixed exchange ratio of 0.9790 shares of Mission Produce, Inc. common stock, par value $0.001 per share, per 1 share of Calavo Growers, Inc. common stock, par value $0.001 per share. The ratio is not adjusted for stock-price changes before the First Effective Time. No fractional Mission Produce shares are issued; cash is paid instead. The stock portion may increase under the specified 43% stock-value threshold provision.
shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled for 4/28/2026 at 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time: Mission Produce stockholders will vote on the share issuance, and Calavo shareholders will vote on the Merger Agreement. Both meetings are virtual and may be adjourned or postponed.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted waiver: requisite Calavo shareholder and Mission Produce stockholder approvals; expiration or termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period and applicable waiting periods or receipt of clearances under other antitrust laws, including applicable Mexico approvals; no effective law, order, injunction or award prohibiting the mergers; Nasdaq approval for listing the Mission Produce shares to be issued or reserved; effectiveness of the Form S-4 without an effective SEC stop order or unwithdrawn related proceeding; specified accuracy standards for each party’s representations and warranties; material compliance with covenants; no Calavo Material Adverse Effect from the Merger Agreement date through closing; closing-date officer certificates; and each party’s receipt of its counsel’s closing-date opinion that the mergers together qualify for the intended U.S. federal income tax treatment. Consummation is expressly not conditioned on Mission Produce obtaining financing.
event_status: Pending as described in Amendment No. 1 to the Form S-4 filed 3/18/2026; the mergers had not yet been consummated.
security_description: Calavo Growers, Inc. common stock, par value $0.001 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the First Effective Time, excluding specified shares held by Calavo, its subsidiaries, Mission Produce or its subsidiaries, and shares for which dissenters’ rights are properly exercised. Calavo options, RSUs and deferred RSUs have separate treatment.
effective_date: No calendar effective date is specified. The First Merger becomes effective when its certificate of merger is accepted for filing by the California and Delaware secretaries of state, or at a later time specified in that certificate. The Second Merger becomes effective immediately following the First Merger when its certificate is accepted for filing, or at a later specified time. The parties expect consummation in the third fiscal quarter of 2026 but cannot determine the exact timing.
available_options: No holder election; each eligible share is converted into the right to receive the specified cash-and-stock consideration, subject to the stated adjustments and exceptions.

acquirer: Mission Produce, Inc. (parent); its wholly owned subsidiary Cantaloupe Merger Sub I, Inc. will merge into Calavo Growers, Inc. in the first merger, and its wholly owned subsidiary Cantaloupe Merger Sub II, LLC will survive the immediately following second merger.
consideration_type: Mixed cash and stock for eligible Calavo common shares, subject to a possible conversion of some cash consideration into additional Mission Produce common shares if the stock portion would otherwise be less than 43% of total consideration. Cash is paid instead of fractional shares.
cash_consideration: USD $14.85 in cash, without interest, per eligible share of Calavo Growers, Inc. common stock, subject to applicable tax withholding. If the stock portion of total consideration would otherwise be less than 43%, enough otherwise-payable cash consideration will instead be paid in additional Mission Produce common shares to bring the stock portion to 43%. Separately, cash without interest is paid instead of fractional Mission Produce shares, equal to the fractional share amount multiplied by the agreed Mission Produce share price of $12.41 and rounded to the nearest cent. Excluded and properly dissenting shares do not receive the stated merger consideration.
stock_exchange_ratio: Fixed ratio of 0.9790 shares of Mission Produce, Inc. common stock, par value $0.001 per share, per 1 eligible share of Calavo Growers, Inc. common stock, par value $0.001 per share. The ratio is not adjusted for stock-price changes before the first merger takes effect. If the stock portion of total consideration would otherwise be less than 43%, otherwise-payable cash is converted into additional Mission Produce common shares valued for that purpose at $12.41 per share. No fractional shares are issued; holders receive cash instead.
shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled for 4/28/2026 at 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time: Mission Produce, Inc. stockholders will vote on the share issuance, and Calavo Growers, Inc. shareholders will vote on the merger agreement. Both meetings are virtual and may be adjourned or postponed.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where permitted, waiver: approval of the Mission Produce share issuance and Calavo merger agreement by their respective stockholders; expiration or termination of the applicable U.S. HSR waiting period and applicable Mexican and other antitrust waiting periods, or receipt of required clearances; no law, order or injunction prohibiting the mergers; approval for Nasdaq listing of the Mission Produce shares to be issued or reserved; effectiveness of the Form S-4 without an effective SEC stop order or pending or threatened, unwithdrawn stop-order proceedings; specified accuracy standards for each party’s representations and warranties; material compliance with each party’s pre-closing obligations; no Calavo material adverse effect from the agreement date through closing; closing certificates; and closing-date opinions from the parties’ respective counsel that the mergers together qualify for the intended U.S. federal income tax treatment. Obtaining financing is expressly not a closing condition.
event_status: Pending as described in the 3/20/2026 joint proxy statement/prospectus; the merger agreement was executed on 1/14/2026, and shareholder votes and closing were still prospective.
security_description: Calavo Growers, Inc. common stock, par value $0.001 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the first merger takes effect, other than excluded shares and shares whose holders properly exercise dissenters’ rights.
effective_date: No calendar effective date is specified. The first merger takes effect when its certificate of merger is accepted for filing by the California and Delaware Secretaries of State, or at a later time specified in that certificate. The second merger takes effect immediately following the first, when its certificate is accepted for filing or at a later time specified in it. The companies expected consummation in the third fiscal quarter of 2026, subject to closing conditions.
available_options: No holder election; each eligible Calavo common share is converted into the specified cash-and-stock consideration, subject to the stated adjustment and fractional-share treatment.

stock_exchange_ratio: Each outstanding Holdings ordinary share, other than treasury and dissenting shares, is converted into the right to receive PubCo Class A ordinary shares equal to the Exchange Ratio: Per Share Merger Consideration divided by $10.00. Per Share Merger Consideration is the Merger Consideration divided by the aggregate fully diluted Holdings ordinary shares. The $1,100,000,000 aggregate Merger Consideration is reduced by any Closing Net Indebtedness, with $235,000,000 payable at closing and $865,000,000 subject to the earn-out. For each of the four consecutive fiscal quarters after closing, contingent shares are calculated as 21,625,000 × (Revenue Achieved ÷ $87,000,000), with Revenue Achieved measured for the applicable quarter. Fractional shares are rounded to the nearest whole share, with fractions of 0.50 or greater rounded up. The consideration is also subject to the stated post-closing adjustment, and 10% of closing and fully earned contingent consideration shares are held in escrow.

acquirer: Veolia Environnement S.A.; its wholly owned indirect subsidiary Liberty Merger Sub Inc. will merge with and into the target.
target: CLEH, Inc. (CE Holdings), which will hold Enviri Corporation’s Clean Earth Business and survive the Merger as an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Veolia Environnement S.A.
consideration_type: Cash for eligible CE Holdings common shares in the Merger. Separately, before the Merger, CE Holdings stockholders of record as of the Distribution record date will receive New Enviri common stock in the Distribution; that distribution is not stock consideration in the Merger. Treasury shares, shares owned by Veolia or Merger Sub, and shares with perfected appraisal rights are excluded from the ordinary cash conversion.
cash_consideration: USD $14.50–$16.50 per share of CE Holdings common stock (formerly Enviri common stock), without interest and less applicable withholding taxes. The Enviri Board will determine the amount, and Enviri will publicly announce it no later than five business days before Closing; an amount above $16.50 per share requires Veolia’s consent. Excluded shares do not receive the ordinary Merger Consideration.
stock_exchange_ratio: No stock consideration in the Merger. In the separate, pre-Merger Distribution, eligible CE Holdings stockholders receive 1 share of Enviri II Corporation (New Enviri) common stock per 3 shares of CE Holdings common stock held as of the Distribution record date; cash is paid instead of fractional New Enviri shares.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted waiver of conditions: the applicable HSR Act waiting period must expire or terminate (early termination was granted on 3/3/2026); the Holding Company Merger, Reorganization and Distribution must be completed; Enviri stockholders must approve and adopt the Merger Agreement and Merger; the New Enviri registration statement must become effective and not be subject to a stop order or actual or threatened proceedings seeking one; and no post-agreement law may remain in effect restraining, enjoining or prohibiting the Holding Company Merger, Reorganization, Distribution or Merger. Each side’s closing obligation also depends on the other side’s material covenant compliance, specified accuracy of representations and warranties, and delivery of an officer’s certificate. Company, Inc. shareholder receives a pro rata share of aggregate cash equal to WDC’s cash and cash equivalents as of the merger closing date plus the value of WDC’s other publicly traded securities, measured using the average of their high and low trading prices on the last trading day that is two business days before closing. stock_exchange_ratio: No fixed number of Dillard’s shares per WDC share is stated. closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver of applicable conditions: Dillard’s shareholder approval of both the Merger Proposal and the NYSE Proposal; WDC shareholder approval; completion of required HSR Act filings, including required WDC shareholder filings, and expiration or termination of applicable waiting periods; no order of a governmental body of competent jurisdiction restraining, enjoining or otherwise prohibiting the transactions; applicable accuracy requirements for each party’s representations and warranties; and material compliance with required covenants and agreements. security_description: W.D. Company, Inc. voting common stock, $1.00 par value per share, and non-voting common stock, $1.00 par value per share. Both classes have the same stated pro rata merger treatment, except for dissenting shares.
effective_date: No calendar effective date is stated. available_options: No holder election among forms of merger consideration is stated; eligible WDC shareholders receive their specified pro rata portions of both stock and cash. Properly dissenting WDC shareholders instead have rights under the Arkansas Business Corporation Act.

consideration_type: Stock for non-redeeming holders; public shareholders may instead exercise separate cash redemption rights.
cash_consideration: Public shareholders who validly exercise redemption rights receive cash equal to their pro rata share of the amount in MLAC’s Trust Account as of two business days before Closing, including interest but less taxes payable. stock_exchange_ratio: 1 share of Pubco Class A common stock per 1 MLAC Class A ordinary share that is not validly redeemed; 1 share of Pubco Class A common stock per 10 MLAC Rights. Fractional shares arising from rights are rounded down to the nearest whole share. Each MLAC Class B ordinary share not forfeited under the Sponsor Support Agreement converts into 1 share of Pubco Class A common stock.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver where permitted: requisite MLAC shareholder approval of the Business Combination Proposal and Merger Proposal; no applicable law or governmental order prohibiting the transactions; an effective Form S-4 registration statement; and approval of Pubco Class A stock for DTC clearing and listing on Nasdaq, NYSE or another acceptable national securities exchange. Additional conditions include the applicable parties’ representations and warranties meeting the agreement’s standards, material compliance with pre-closing covenants, no specified material adverse effect, and the Sponsor’s material performance under the Sponsor Support Agreement. MLAC’s obligations also require completion of the Dragonfly Contribution and Foundation Transaction.
event_status: Pending; the Business Combination Agreement was amended on January 13, 2026 and March 17, 2026.
security_description: MLAC Class A ordinary shares, par value $0.0001 per share, including Public Shares; MLAC Rights; and MLAC Class B ordinary shares, par value $0.0001 per share, that are not forfeited.
effective_date: Conditional: the MLAC Merger takes effect on the Closing Date when its certificate of merger is accepted for filing by the Delaware Secretary of State, or at another time specified in that certificate, at least two hours after the Domestication. No calendar effective date is stated.
available_options: Public shareholders may retain their Public Shares and receive Pubco Class A stock at the merger exchange ratio, or exercise redemption rights for their pro rata cash share of the Trust Account. default_option: A Public Share for which the holder does not properly demand redemption converts into 1 share of Pubco Class A common stock.

acquirer: Devon Energy Corporation (parent); Cubs Merger Sub, Inc. is Devon’s wholly-owned, direct merger subsidiary.
target: Coterra Energy Inc.; it would survive the merger as a wholly-owned, direct subsidiary of Devon Energy Corporation.
consideration_type: Stock; eligible Coterra common shares convert into Devon common stock. Cash is paid only in lieu of fractional Devon shares.
cash_consideration: No regular cash price per Coterra common share is stated. A holder otherwise entitled to a fractional Devon common share receives cash in lieu of that fraction, based on the net proceeds from the exchange agent’s sale of aggregated fractional shares.
stock_exchange_ratio: Fixed exchange ratio of 0.70 shares of Devon Energy Corporation common stock, par value $0.10 per share, per 1 eligible share of Coterra Energy Inc. common stock, par value $0.10 per share. No fractional Devon shares will be issued; cash will be paid instead. The ratio is subject to adjustment for specified share reclassifications, recapitalizations, splits, mergers, combinations, exchanges, readjustments, subdivisions, similar transactions or stock dividends between the agreement date and the effective time.
shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled virtual meetings for both companies on 5/4/2026 at 10:00 a.m. Central Time: Coterra stockholders will vote on the merger proposal; Devon stockholders will vote on the stock issuance and authorized-share charter amendment proposals.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where permitted by law, waiver: Coterra stockholder approval of the merger proposal; Devon stockholder approval of both the stock issuance and authorized-share charter amendment proposals; no applicable law or order prohibiting the merger; expiration or termination of the HSR Act waiting period and any applicable timing agreement; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an SEC stop order or specified stop-order proceedings; and NYSE approval of the Devon shares issued or issuable under the agreement for listing, subject to official notice of issuance. Devon’s and Merger Sub’s obligations also require Coterra’s material covenant compliance, representations and warranties meeting the specified accuracy standards, including the material-adverse-effect standard for certain representations, and an officer’s certificate. Coterra’s obligation has corresponding requirements concerning Devon and Merger Sub, including an officer’s certificate from Devon. The advisory compensation and adjournment proposals are not closing conditions; obtaining financing is not a condition to Devon’s obligations.
event_status: Pending as described in the joint proxy statement/prospectus: the merger agreement was executed, and the stockholder votes and closing were still prospective.
security_description: Issued and outstanding shares of Coterra Energy Inc. common stock, par value $0.10 per share, other than excluded shares held by Devon, Merger Sub, their subsidiaries, Coterra or Coterra’s subsidiaries. Coterra equity awards have separately described treatment.
effective_date: No calendar effective date or time is stated. Conditionally, immediately following closing, Coterra and Devon will file a certificate of merger with the Delaware Secretary of State; the merger will become effective upon its filing and acceptance, or at a later date and time agreed by the parties and stated in the certificate.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Coterra common shares receive the fixed stock consideration, with cash in lieu of any fractional Devon share.

acquirer: Allegiant Travel Company, through its wholly owned merger subsidiaries Mirage Merger Sub, Inc. (first merger) and Sawdust Merger Sub, LLC (second merger).
consideration_type: Mixed cash and stock for eligible shares of Sun Country common stock in the first merger.
cash_consideration: $4.10 in cash, without interest, per share of Sun Country common stock. Cash is also payable in lieu of fractional shares of Allegiant common stock; that amount depends on proceeds from the exchange agent’s sale of aggregated fractional shares. Treasury shares, shares owned of record by Allegiant or its specified subsidiaries, and dissenting shares are excluded from the regular merger consideration.
stock_exchange_ratio: Fixed ratio of 0.1557 fully paid and nonassessable shares of Allegiant Travel Company common stock per 1 share of Sun Country Airlines Holdings, Inc. common stock, subject to the merger agreement’s equitable-adjustment provision for specified changes to either company’s outstanding common stock. No fractional Allegiant shares will be issued; cash will be paid instead.
shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled for 5/8/2026: Allegiant Travel Company stockholders will vote on the share issuance at 9:00 a.m. Pacific Time; Sun Country Airlines Holdings, Inc. stockholders will vote on adoption of the merger agreement at 9:00 a.m. Central Time. Either meeting may be adjourned or postponed.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or written waiver where permissible: Allegiant stockholder approval of the share issuance and Sun Country stockholder approval of the merger agreement; HSR Act waiting-period clearance, including any applicable timing agreement; required DOT, FAA and DHS (including TSA) approvals or deliveries; no law prohibiting or preventing closing; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an effective SEC stop order or pending or threatened proceeding unless withdrawn; and authorization and approval for Nasdaq listing of the Allegiant shares to be issued. Each party’s obligation is also subject to specified accuracy standards for the other party’s representations and warranties, material compliance with its covenants, absence of a continuing material adverse effect on that party, and receipt of an executive-officer certificate. There is no financing condition. The filing states that the DOJ Antitrust Division granted early termination of the HSR Act waiting period on 3/13/2026.
event_status: Pending as described in the joint proxy statement/prospectus dated 3/31/2026; the merger agreement was executed on 1/11/2026. The filing reports early termination of the HSR Act waiting period but describes the stockholder meetings and closing as future events.
security_description: Sun Country Airlines Holdings, Inc. common stock, par value $0.01 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the first merger’s effective time, excluding treasury shares, shares owned of record by Allegiant or its specified subsidiaries, and dissenting shares. Sun Country equity awards and its warrant have separate treatment.
effective_date: No calendar effective date is stated. Conditional on closing, the first merger becomes legally effective when its certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later date and time agreed by the parties and specified in that certificate. The second merger is to follow as soon as practicable after the first merger and on the closing date; it becomes effective when the required Delaware and Nevada merger filings are made, or at an agreed later date and time specified in those filings. Closing is expected in the second or third quarter of 2026, but that is not a stated legal effective date.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Sun Country common shares convert into the fixed right to receive both $4.10 cash and 0.1557 Allegiant common shares per share, subject to the stated exceptions and fractional-share treatment.

acquirer: IonQ, Inc. (acquiring parent); Iris Merger Subsidiary 1 Inc. will merge into SkyWater Technology, Inc. in the First Merger, and Iris Merger Subsidiary 2 LLC will survive the immediately following Second Merger as a wholly owned subsidiary of IonQ.
consideration_type: Mixed cash and stock for each eligible share of SkyWater Technology, Inc. common stock; cash is also payable in lieu of fractional IonQ common shares. Cancelled shares receive no consideration, and shares with properly exercised appraisal rights are treated separately.
cash_consideration: $15.00 in cash, without interest, per 1 eligible share of SkyWater Technology, Inc. common stock. Separately, a holder otherwise entitled to a fractional IonQ common share receives cash without interest, rounded to the nearest cent, based on the holder’s proportionate interest in proceeds from the exchange agent’s sale of excess IonQ shares.
stock_exchange_ratio: Per 1 eligible share of SkyWater Technology, Inc. common stock, holders receive IonQ, Inc. common stock, par value $0.0001 per share, equal to the Exchange Ratio, rounded to four decimals: 0.5265 IonQ shares if the IonQ Trading Price is $37.99 or less; $20.00 divided by the IonQ Trading Price if it is greater than $37.99 but less than $60.13; or 0.3326 IonQ shares if it is $60.13 or more. The IonQ Trading Price is the specified Bloomberg volume-weighted average price over the 20 full consecutive trading days prior to, but not including, the third business day before closing. No fractional IonQ shares will be issued; cash is paid instead. The merger consideration and Exchange Ratio are subject to adjustment for specified changes in outstanding IonQ or SkyWater capital stock before the Effective Time; permitted cash dividends and equity-compensation grants do not trigger an adjustment.
shareholder_vote_date: SkyWater Technology, Inc. stockholders are scheduled to vote at a virtual special meeting on 5/8/2026 at 9:00 a.m. Central Time. IonQ stockholder approval is not required.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where permitted by law, waiver: adoption of the Merger Agreement by holders of a majority of outstanding SkyWater common shares entitled to vote; expiration or termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period and extensions, including applicable timing agreements or commitments; no applicable law making the Mergers illegal and no judgment, injunction, order or decree prohibiting or enjoining them; SEC effectiveness of the Form S-4, with no effective stop order or pending or threatened SEC stop-order proceeding; and NYSE listing approval for the IonQ shares to be issued, subject to official notice of issuance. IonQ and the merger subsidiaries also require the specified accuracy of SkyWater’s representations and warranties, SkyWater’s material compliance with its obligations and covenants, no continuing SkyWater material adverse effect since the agreement date, and a SkyWater officer’s certificate. SkyWater has corresponding conditions concerning IonQ’s and the merger subsidiaries’ representations and warranties, IonQ’s material compliance with its obligations and covenants, no continuing IonQ material adverse effect, and an IonQ officer’s certificate. Closing is not conditioned on IonQ stockholder approval, receipt of financing by IonQ, or qualification for the intended tax treatment. The HSR waiting period had been restarted by IonQ’s 3/25/2026 refiling.
event_status: Pending as described in the proxy statement dated 3/31/2026; the Merger Agreement was executed on 1/25/2026, and completion remained subject to conditions.
security_description: Issued and outstanding common stock of SkyWater Technology, Inc., par value $0.01 per share, immediately before the First Merger’s Effective Time, excluding Cancelled Shares and shares with properly exercised appraisal rights. SkyWater equity awards have separate treatment.
effective_date: No calendar effective date is stated. The First Merger will become legally effective when its certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed by IonQ and SkyWater and specified in that certificate. The Second Merger will become effective upon filing its separate certificate, or at a later specified time, and must follow the First Merger’s Effective Time. The parties expected completion in the second or third quarter of 2026, subject to closing conditions; that expectation is not a stated legal effective date.
available_options: No holder election; each eligible SkyWater common share receives both the specified cash consideration and IonQ stock consideration.

consideration_type: Elective consideration: holders may elect cash, Boston Scientific common stock, or, for multiple Penumbra shares, a combination of the two. Elections are subject to proration.
cash_consideration: Cash election: $374.00 in cash, without interest, per Penumbra common share, subject to proration. Cash is also payable instead of any fractional Boston Scientific shares otherwise issuable.
stock_exchange_ratio: Stock election: 3.8721 shares of Boston Scientific common stock, par value $0.01 per share, per 1 share of Penumbra common stock, par value $0.001 per share. The fixed ratio is subject to proration; no fractional Boston Scientific shares will be issued, and cash will be paid instead.
shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled Penumbra stockholder special meeting: 5/6/2026 at 10:00 a.m. Pacific Time.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or written waiver where permitted by law: Penumbra stockholder approval by holders of a majority of its outstanding shares entitled to vote; no effective governmental law or order prohibiting or making the merger illegal; expiration or termination of the HSR Act waiting period and any agreement not to close, plus required regulatory approvals in other jurisdictions; effectiveness of Boston Scientific's Form S-4 without a stop order or proceedings seeking one; and NYSE listing approval for the Boston Scientific shares to be issued. Boston Scientific's and Merger Sub's obligations also require Penumbra's representations and warranties to meet the agreement's applicable accuracy standards, material compliance with its covenants, no Penumbra Material Adverse Effect since the agreement date, and an officer certificate. Penumbra's obligations have corresponding requirements concerning Boston Scientific's and Merger Sub's representations, warranties and covenants, no Boston Scientific Material Adverse Effect, and a Boston Scientific officer certificate. The HSR waiting period remained extended following an FTC Second Request. The merger is not subject to a financing condition.
event_status: Pending as described in the 4/1/2026 proxy statement/prospectus; the merger agreement had been executed, but the stockholder vote and regulatory review remained pending.
security_description: Issued and outstanding Penumbra, Inc. common stock, par value $0.001 per share, immediately before the merger's Effective Time, excluding Cancelled Shares and Dissenting Shares. Penumbra options and restricted stock units receive separately described treatment.
effective_date: No calendar date stated. The merger will become legally effective when the certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at another date and time agreed by Boston Scientific and Penumbra and specified in the certificate. Closing and legal effectiveness are described separately; the parties expected the merger to close in 2026.
available_options: For each eligible Penumbra share, a holder may elect $374.00 in cash or 3.8721 Boston Scientific common shares; a holder of multiple Penumbra shares may elect cash for some and stock for the rest. Elections require a properly completed Election Form and applicable transmittal materials and certificates or book-entry instructions by the Election Deadline. The aggregate allocation is 73.26% of eligible Penumbra shares for cash and 26.74% for stock, rounded to whole shares, so holders may receive consideration they did not elect.
default_option: Shares for which the Exchange Agent does not receive an effective, properly completed Election Form by the Election Deadline—including shares covered by an invalid or revoked election unless a proper replacement is timely made—are Non-Election Shares. They receive cash or stock under the merger agreement's proration allocation, not a guaranteed form: Non-Election Shares are allocated to an undersubscribed form before shares with elections for the oversubscribed form are reallocated.
election_deadline: 5:00 p.m., New York City time, on the date five business days before Boston Scientific's good-faith estimate of the Closing Date, unless Boston Scientific and Penumbra agree to another time and date. The date will be announced at least five business days beforehand; if Closing is delayed, the Election Deadline will likewise be delayed and the rescheduled deadline announced.

available_options: No holder election; eligible shares receive the fixed cash-and-stock consideration.

acquirer: Prosperity Bancshares, Inc.
consideration_type: Mixed cash and stock, subject to a cap on the aggregate Prosperity common stock issued.
cash_consideration: $11.36 in cash per share of Stellar Bancorp, Inc. common stock. If the aggregate Prosperity common stock to be issued would exceed 19.9% of Prosperity common stock outstanding immediately before the merger becomes effective, the per-share cash amount increases by the Prosperity share closing price multiplied by the reduction in the exchange ratio, rounded down to the nearest cent. Cash in lieu of fractional Prosperity shares is separate from the per-share cash consideration and is calculated using the Prosperity share closing price.
stock_exchange_ratio: 0.3803 shares of Prosperity Bancshares, Inc. common stock, par value $1.00 per share, per 1 share of Stellar Bancorp, Inc. common stock, par value $0.01 per share. If aggregate shares issued would exceed 19.9% of Prosperity common stock outstanding immediately before the merger becomes effective, the exchange ratio is reduced to the minimum extent necessary, rounded down to the nearest ten-thousandth. No fractional Prosperity shares will be issued; holders otherwise entitled to a fraction receive cash instead. The per-share merger consideration is also subject to an appropriate and proportionate adjustment for the specified changes in capitalization or extraordinary dividends or distributions before the merger becomes effective.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver at or before the merger becomes effective: approval of the merger agreement by holders of at least two-thirds of outstanding Stellar common stock entitled to vote; authorization of the Prosperity shares issuable in the merger for NYSE listing, subject to official notice of issuance; effectiveness of the Form S-4 without an outstanding SEC stop order or unwithdrawn stop-order proceeding; absence of legal restraints or laws preventing, prohibiting or making illegal the merger, bank merger or other contemplated transactions; receipt and continued effectiveness of requisite regulatory approvals or waivers, expiration of statutory waiting periods, and no materially burdensome regulatory condition; the other party’s representations and warranties meeting the agreement’s applicable accuracy standards and its material performance of obligations, covenants and agreements; and each party’s receipt of a satisfactory closing-date legal opinion that the merger will qualify as a reorganization under Section 368(a) of the Internal Revenue Code. The Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas waiver of prior approval was obtained on 3/17/2026; the filing does not state that the remaining regulatory approvals have been obtained.
event_status: Pending as of the 4/3/2026 filing; the merger is proposed and remains subject to closing conditions.
security_description: Stellar Bancorp, Inc. common stock, par value $0.01 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the merger becomes effective, excluding dissenting shares and specified shares owned by Stellar or Prosperity. Stellar equity awards receive separate treatment.
effective_date: Not specified. The merger will become legally effective at the date and time specified in the certificate of merger filed with the Texas Secretary of State, or at another date and time provided by applicable law. Prosperity and Stellar expected to complete the merger in the second quarter of 2026 but stated they could not predict the actual completion date.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Stellar common shares receive the specified cash-and-stock consideration, subject to the stated adjustments and exceptions.

consideration_type: Stock; the $1.0 billion Base Purchase Price is payable entirely in newly issued New ONE Nuclear Common Stock, with up to 13,000,000 additional shares contingent on share-price milestones during the Earnout Period.
cash_consideration: No cash consideration to ONE Nuclear equityholders in the Business Combination. No cash is payable for fractional shares eliminated by rounding.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each outstanding ONE Nuclear Ordinary Membership Unit other than an Excluded Unit, shares of New ONE Nuclear Common Stock equal to ($1,000,000,000 ÷ the Redemption Price) ÷ ONE Nuclear Fully Diluted Capital. Change-of-control provisions may affect the earnout. Consideration for units subject to vesting or forfeiture retains those conditions. Excluded Units receive no consideration; fractional shares are rounded down without cash settlement.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or written waiver where legally permitted: HVII shareholder approval of the Business Combination Proposal, Domestication Proposal, Stock Issuance Proposal, Organizational Documents Proposal, Incentive Plan Proposal and Director Election Proposal, each cross-conditioned on the others; ONE Nuclear member approval; no effective governmental law or order making or prohibiting the Merger; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement at Closing, with no effective stop order or pending or threatened-in-writing SEC suspension proceeding that has not been withdrawn; and conditional Nasdaq listing approval for the New ONE Nuclear Common Stock, subject to the round-lot-holder requirement. ONE Nuclear's additional conditions include the specified accuracy of HVII and Merger Sub representations and warranties, their material covenant compliance, no continuing Purchaser Material Adverse Effect, completion of the Domestication and delivery of its certificate, and specified officer, secretary, registration-rights and lock-up documents. HVII and Merger Sub's additional conditions include the specified accuracy of ONE Nuclear representations and warranties, its material covenant compliance, no continuing Company Material Adverse Effect, and specified officer, secretary, tax, registration-rights and lock-up documents. The filing states that there is no minimum cash condition or financing condition to Closing. It identifies a Hart-Scott-Rodino filing and waiting period as regulatory requirements and states that the filing had not yet been made.

effective_date: Conditional: the Merger becomes effective when its Certificate of Merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed by the parties and specified in that certificate. The filing does not state a calendar effective date or time.
available_options: No holder election; outstanding ONE Nuclear Units other than Excluded Units are converted into the stated stock consideration and contingent earnout right.

acquirer: Sphere 3D Corp., through its wholly-owned subsidiary S3D Acquisition Corp., which will amalgamate with Cathedra Bitcoin Inc.
consideration_type: Stock; subject to the ownership cap, certain holders receive Sphere Series I Preferred Shares instead of Sphere Common Shares for the portion exceeding the cap.
stock_exchange_ratio: 12.3014 Sphere Common Shares per 1 Cathedra multiple voting share, subject to adjustment under the Arrangement Agreement. For specified holders whose resulting common-share ownership would exceed 7% of Sphere Common Shares outstanding immediately after the arrangement on a non-diluted basis, the excess common shares are replaced by an equivalent number of Sphere Series I Preferred Shares. Fractional Sphere Common Shares or Series I Preferred Shares are rounded down to whole shares without compensation.
closing_conditions: The arrangement is subject to satisfaction or permitted waiver of conditions, including: Cathedra shareholder approval by at least 66⅔% in each of two specified voting groups; Sphere shareholder approval of the Share Issuance Proposal, Board Size Proposal and each director nominee; and approval of the Incentive Plan Proposal unless Cathedra waives the condition requiring issuance of replacement equity. It also requires the British Columbia Supreme Court’s Interim and Final Orders; required governmental consents, filings and waiting-period expirations; Nasdaq non-objection to listing the applicable Sphere Common Shares and TSXV acceptance of notice; applicable Canadian and U.S. securities-registration exemptions; absence of prohibitive law or order and specified material-adverse-effect-related governmental action; agreed employment arrangements and a sale-based non-compete agreement; accuracy of representations and warranties, material covenant compliance and absence of a material adverse effect for each party; no more than 5% of outstanding Cathedra Shares, on the stated as-converted basis, subject to unwithdrawn dissent rights; specified resignations, appointments, support agreements and security issuances; and no triggering of specified convertible-security rights, subject to disclosed exceptions. The Interim Order was obtained on April 1, 2026. Approval of the Consolidation Proposal is not a closing condition.
event_status: Pending; the Arrangement Agreement was entered into on March 5, 2026, and completion remains subject to closing conditions. The Interim Order was obtained on April 1, 2026.
security_description: Cathedra Bitcoin Inc. multiple voting shares (Cathedra MV Shares), excluding shares held by Dissenting Shareholders.
effective_date: Not set; the parties will agree in writing on a date no later than the fifth business day after satisfaction or permitted waiver of the specified conditions, unless they agree in writing to another date. The Effective Time is the time on that date agreed by the parties and, to the extent required, denoted on filings with the Registrar.
available_options: No holder election; eligible holders receive the stated stock consideration, subject to the ownership cap.

Southern's additional conditions include XCF's, the merger subsidiaries' and DevvStream's representations, warranties and covenant compliance; absence of specified continuing, uncured material adverse effects; XCF's SAF offtake agreement and public announcement; and specified officer certificates. Closing is not assured.

effective_date: Not yet set; the Southern merger will become effective when the applicable Delaware certificate of merger and Louisiana articles of merger are filed, or at a later time agreed by the parties and specified in those filings.

acquirer: XCF Global, Inc.; its wholly owned subsidiary, DevvStream Merger Sub Inc., will merge into DevvStream Corp.
consideration_type: Stock
stock_exchange_ratio: Each outstanding DevvStream common share following its one-for-one domestication from an Alberta common share into a Delaware common share, other than treasury shares, will be converted into XCF Global, Inc. Class A common stock at a ratio equal to the DevvStream Consideration Shares divided by DevvStream Outstanding Shares. The DevvStream Consideration Shares equal 15% of XCF common shares outstanding immediately before the effective time. For this calculation, DevvStream Outstanding Shares includes shares issuable upon full conversion of the Helena Notes if they remain outstanding and unconverted immediately before the effective time. No fractional XCF shares will be delivered; each shareholder's aggregate entitlement will be rounded down to a whole share.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permissible written waiver: XCF and DevvStream shareholder approvals; no law or order prohibiting the domestication, mergers or other transactions; required regulatory approvals, including expiration or termination of the HSR Act waiting period; Nasdaq and Nasdaq Sweden listing approvals, as applicable; an effective Form S-4 registration statement without a stop order; post-closing governance arrangements; completion of DevvStream's domestication; and, if legally available, dissent rights exercised for no more than 3% of outstanding XCF or DevvStream shares. Southern shareholder approval was obtained before signing and is not an outstanding condition. DevvStream's additional conditions include XCF's, the merger subsidiaries' and Southern's representations, warranties and covenant compliance; absence of specified continuing, uncured material adverse effects; Plant Conversion Funding; Louisiana approval for at least $400 million of Southern bonds, a related state-official announcement and an investment-bank engagement; XCF's and Southern's SAF offtake agreement and Southern's European offtake agreements; XCF blended-fuel-product gross revenue exceeding $1 billion on an annualized, go-forward basis no later than 6/30/2026 and annualized EBITDA of at least $100 million; at least $10 million of specified Southern cash and previously funded cash; EEME Energy SPV I LLC's majority beneficial ownership of Southern shares; and specified officer certificates. Closing is not assured.
event_status: Pending; definitive Business Combination Agreement signed on 4/13/2026. Southern shareholder approval was obtained before signing, but the mergers remain subject to closing conditions.
security_description: DevvStream Corp. common shares following domestication as Delaware common stock (Post-Domestication DevvStream Common Shares); the pre-domestication Alberta common shares convert one-for-one at domestication. Treasury shares and DevvStream shares owned by Southern or XCF are excluded from merger consideration. DevvStream warrants, options, restricted stock units and convertible notes have separate assumption or conversion treatment.
effective_date: Not yet set; the DevvStream merger will become effective when its Delaware certificate of merger and the other applicable merger filings are filed, or at a later time agreed by the parties and specified in those filings. DevvStream's domestication must occur before the merger's effective time.
available_options: No holder election

acquirer: Wintergreen Acquisition Corp., through its wholly owned merger subsidiary, Wintergreen Acquisition Merger Subsidiary Corp.
consideration_type: Stock; KIKA shareholders will receive Wintergreen ordinary shares, referred to as New KIKA ordinary shares following the Business Combination. The aggregate share amount is determined by the merger agreement’s valuation and redemption-price formula.
cash_consideration: No cash consideration to KIKA shareholders is described; the stated merger consideration is ordinary shares.
stock_exchange_ratio: Each issued and outstanding KIKA ordinary share will be converted into the right to receive New KIKA ordinary shares equal to the aggregate Consideration Shares divided by the aggregate number of KIKA ordinary shares outstanding immediately before the Effective Time. Aggregate Consideration Shares equal KIKA’s $80,000,000 valuation divided by the SPAC Per Share Redemption Price, rounded up to the nearest whole share. That price is the lower of the per-share redemption price paid to redeeming Wintergreen shareholders and $10.025. The filing estimates 7,980,050 aggregate consideration shares; it does not state a fixed per-share exchange ratio.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver of the applicable conditions: approval of the Business Combination and required related proposals by Wintergreen shareholders and approval of the merger by KIKA shareholders; SEC effectiveness of the proxy/registration statement without an effective stop order or unresolved related SEC proceeding; absence of a law, order or legal action prohibiting the transaction; required Nasdaq listing approval, subject to stated exceptions or waiver; and Wintergreen having at least $5,000,001 of net tangible assets immediately after closing. The minimum-cash condition is for KIKA’s sole benefit and may be waived only by KIKA, although Wintergreen states that its governing documents prohibit redemptions that would reduce its net tangible assets below $5,000,001. Conditions also include material performance of obligations, accuracy of representations and warranties subject to the stated material-adverse-effect qualifications, absence of a material adverse effect, required officer certificates, election of post-closing directors and officers, and the name change to KIKA Inc. The filing also states a Cayman Islands plan-of-merger filing requirement. It states that no additional federal or state regulatory approval, including under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Act, is required.
event_status: Pending; the Merger Agreement was executed on November 17, 2025, and the filing describes shareholder approvals and other closing conditions as outstanding.
security_description: Issued and outstanding ordinary shares of KIKA Technology INC. immediately before the merger’s Effective Time.
effective_date: The merger will become legally effective on the date its Plan of Merger is registered by the Registrar of Companies of the Cayman Islands; no calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: No holder election; KIKA ordinary shares are to be cancelled and converted into the right to receive stock consideration.

Centessa’s obligations also depend on Lilly’s and the purchaser’s representations and warranties meeting the specified Parent Material Adverse Effect standard, their material covenant compliance, and an officer’s certificate. Receipt of financing is not a closing condition.

consideration_type: Mixed cash and stock, subject to an adjustment if the aggregate Prosperity shares issuable would exceed the 19.9% stock consideration cap.
cash_consideration: $11.36 in cash per share of Stellar Bancorp, Inc. common stock. Cash paid instead of a fractional Prosperity share is separate: the fractional share, rounded to the nearest thousandth after aggregating a holder’s Stellar shares, is multiplied by the Prosperity share closing price.
stock_exchange_ratio: 0.3803 shares of Prosperity Bancshares, Inc. common stock, par value $1.00 per share, per 1 share of Stellar Bancorp, Inc. common stock, par value $0.01 per share. If aggregate shares issuable would exceed 19.9% of Prosperity common stock outstanding immediately before the merger’s effective time, the ratio is reduced to the minimum extent necessary, rounded down to the nearest ten-thousandth, and per-share cash consideration increases accordingly. No fractional Prosperity shares will be issued; cash will be paid instead.
shareholder_vote_date: Stellar Bancorp, Inc. shareholders’ special meeting is scheduled for 5/27/2026 at 10:00 a.m., Central Time.

event_status: Pending proposed merger as described in the proxy statement/prospectus dated 4/21/2026; the Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas waiver of prior approval had been obtained, but shareholder approval and other closing conditions remained. The merger agreement is described as amendable from time to time, but no executed amendment is identified.
security_description: Stellar Bancorp, Inc. common stock, par value $0.01 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the merger’s effective time, excluding dissenting shares and specified shares owned by Stellar or Prosperity. effective_date: Not specified. Prosperity and Stellar expected completion in the second quarter of 2026, but did not predict an actual date.
available_options: No holder election; eligible shares receive the stated cash and stock consideration, subject to the stock consideration cap adjustment. Qualifying dissenting shareholders may instead pursue statutory appraisal rights by following the stated procedures.

closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where legally permissible, waiver: approval of the merger agreement by the requisite majority vote of Adirondack shareholders; Nasdaq authorization for listing the Arrow shares to be issued; required Federal Reserve Board, OCC and NYDFS regulatory approvals or waivers and expiration or termination of applicable statutory waiting periods, without a materially burdensome regulatory condition; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an effective stop order or pending or threatened proceedings for one; absence of a legal restraint or law prohibiting the merger, holdco merger, bank merger or other contemplated transactions; accuracy of the other party’s representations and warranties under the agreement’s materiality standards; material performance of the other party’s obligations, covenants and agreements; and each party’s receipt of a legal opinion that the merger and holdco merger together qualify as a Section 368(a) reorganization.
