target: Webster Financial Corporation, which will merge into its wholly owned subsidiary, Webster Virginia Corporation; Santander will then acquire Webster Virginia Corporation
consideration_type: Mixed cash and stock
cash_consideration: $48.75 in cash, without interest, per share of Webster Virginia common stock received for one share of Webster Financial Corporation common stock. Cash proceeds from the sale of fractional Santander ADS entitlements are separate from the $48.75 cash consideration.
stock_exchange_ratio: 2.0548 Banco Santander, S.A. American Depositary Shares per 1 share of Webster Virginia Corporation common stock received for 1 share of Webster Financial Corporation common stock. Each Santander ADS represents 1 Santander ordinary share. No fractional Santander ADSs will be allotted; fractional entitlements will be aggregated and sold, with net proceeds distributed pro rata. The exchange consideration and ratio are subject to adjustment for specified share changes, but not for Santander share buybacks or related capital reductions.
shareholder_vote_date: Webster Financial Corporation common stockholders: special meeting scheduled for 5/26/2026 at 9 a.m., Eastern Time. Banco Santander, S.A. shareholders: capital-increase approval obtained at the annual general shareholders’ meeting held 3/27/2026.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted waiver: Webster common stockholder approval of the transaction proposal; Santander shareholder approval of the necessary capital increase, obtained 3/27/2026; no applicable law prohibiting or making the reincorporation merger or share exchange illegal; effectiveness of Santander’s Form F-4 registration statement, without an outstanding SEC stop order or related proceeding; filing of an exemption document or verification and registration of a prospectus with the Spanish National Securities Market Commission; Santander’s receipt of the required independent expert report; granting of the necessary capital increase before a Spanish public notary; NYSE approval of the Santander ADSs for listing, subject to official notice of issuance; the other party’s representations and warranties meeting the agreement’s specified accuracy standards and its obligations being performed in all material respects, with confirming certificates; and required regulatory approvals remaining effective with statutory waiting periods expired. Santander’s obligation additionally requires that no requisite regulatory approval impose a materially burdensome regulatory condition. Santander’s obligation to close is not conditioned on obtaining financing.
event_status: Pending as of the document date; the transaction agreement was executed, Santander shareholders approved the necessary capital increase, and Webster common stockholder and requisite regulatory approvals remained closing conditions. Closing was expected in the second half of 2026 but was not assured.
security_description: Webster Financial Corporation common stock, par value $0.01 per share, converted in the reincorporation merger into Webster Virginia Corporation common stock, par value $0.01 per share, which is exchanged for the cash and Santander ADS consideration. Treasury shares and properly perfected dissenting shares have separate treatment.
effective_date: Not specified as a calendar date. Conditionally, the reincorporation merger becomes effective on the closing date at the time agreed by Santander and Webster and specified in the Virginia articles of merger and Delaware certificate of merger, or, if no time is specified, upon issuance and acceptance of the respective merger certificates. The share exchange becomes effective on the closing date immediately after the reincorporation merger, at the agreed time specified in the Virginia articles of share exchange or, if none is specified, upon issuance of the Virginia certificate of share exchange. Closing was expected in the second half of 2026, no earlier than approximately six weeks after the Webster special meeting.
available_options: No holder election among cash, stock or mixed consideration: eligible common stockholders receive the fixed combination of $48.75 cash and 2.0548 Santander ADSs per share. Santander determined that an election to receive Santander ordinary shares instead of ADSs was not reasonably practicable. Recipients may exchange their Santander ADSs for Santander ordinary shares at no charge during a specified period after closing, subject to applicable procedures and certifications.
default_option: The share consideration will be delivered as Santander ADSs because Santander determined that an election to receive ordinary shares is not reasonably practicable; the fixed $48.75 cash consideration also applies.

acquirer: Cintas Corporation (acquiring parent); its wholly owned subsidiary Bruin Merger Sub I, Inc. will merge into UniFirst Corporation in the first merger, and its wholly owned subsidiary Bruin Merger Sub II, LLC will survive the immediately following second merger.
consideration_type: Mixed cash and stock; each eligible share receives both components, without interest and subject to required tax withholding. Cash replaces any fractional share of Cintas common stock.
cash_consideration: $155.00 in cash per share of UniFirst common stock or UniFirst class B common stock, without interest and subject to required tax withholding. Cash in lieu of any fractional share of Cintas common stock is separate from the $155.00 per-share cash consideration.
stock_exchange_ratio: 0.7720 shares of Cintas Corporation common stock per 1 share of UniFirst Corporation common stock or UniFirst Corporation class B common stock. The ratio is fixed and will not change with either company's stock price, but the merger consideration is subject to adjustment for specified share reclassifications, recapitalizations, exchanges, splits, combinations, readjustments, stock dividends or stock distributions between the agreement date and the first effective time. No fractional Cintas shares will be issued; holders will receive cash in lieu.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where permitted by law, waiver: UniFirst shareholder approval by two-thirds of the combined voting power of its outstanding common and class B common stock, voting together; NASDAQ listing approval for the Cintas shares to be issued; effectiveness of the Form S-4 without an SEC stop order or proceeding seeking one; expiration or early termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period and required antitrust authorization or consent; required governmental authorization or consent concerning certain UniFirst permits; and absence of a post-agreement governmental order or law enjoining or prohibiting the mergers. Each party's obligation also depends on the specified accuracy of the other party's representations and warranties, material compliance with its obligations, absence of a continuing material adverse effect on the other party since the agreement date, and receipt of the other party's executive officer certificate. Cintas' obligation is not conditioned on obtaining financing. As of the filing, HSR notifications had been filed, but the filing does not state that the waiting period or the other outstanding approvals had been completed.
event_status: Pending as of the April 24, 2026 preliminary proxy statement/prospectus; the merger agreement was signed March 10, 2026, and completion remained subject to conditions.
security_description: UniFirst Corporation common stock, par value $0.10 per share, and UniFirst Corporation class B common stock, par value $0.10 per share. Both classes receive the same per-share merger consideration; canceled shares are excluded.
effective_date: Not yet determined. The first merger takes effect when the required Massachusetts articles of merger and Delaware certificate of merger are filed, or at another date and time agreed by Cintas and UniFirst and specified in those filings. The second merger takes effect immediately after the first merger, upon the required Delaware and Massachusetts filings or at another agreed and specified date and time that is after the first effective time.
available_options: No holder election; each eligible share receives the fixed cash-and-stock consideration.

cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration is stated for Freenome common shares. Cash may be paid instead of fractional shares of New Freenome Common Stock.
stock_exchange_ratio: A number of shares of New Freenome Common Stock equal to the Exchange Ratio per 1 Freenome Common Share. The Exchange Ratio is the Adjusted Transaction Share Consideration divided by Fully-Diluted Shares; Adjusted Transaction Share Consideration is Adjusted Equity Value divided by the $10.00 PCSC Share Value. Adjusted Equity Value is the $725,000,000 Base Equity Value plus the aggregate vested option exercise price, minus specified Leakage, plus any increase in Net Cash between the Reference Time and the Effective Time. Shares held by each stockholder are aggregated before applying the ratio, and resulting New Freenome shares are rounded down to whole shares.
closing_conditions: The parties’ obligations are subject to satisfaction or, where permitted, waiver of conditions including: expiration or termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period; absence of a governmental legal restraint; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an effective SEC stop order or pending proceeding seeking one; Freenome stockholder written consent; required PCSC shareholder approvals, including the Business Combination, Domestication, Governing Documents, Nasdaq, Equity Incentive Plan and Employee Stock Purchase Plan proposals; Nasdaq approval of the initial listing application and New Freenome Common Stock for listing; and at least $5,000,001 of PCSC net tangible assets immediately after the First Merger. PCSC’s additional conditions include specified accuracy of Freenome’s representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, no continuing Company Material Adverse Effect since December 5, 2025, and delivery of specified certificates and agreements. Freenome’s additional conditions include specified accuracy of the PCSC parties’ representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, no continuing PCSC Material Adverse Effect since December 5, 2025, the specified post-closing board composition, Aggregate Transaction Proceeds of at least $250,000,000, Domestication at least one business day before Closing, and delivery of specified certificates and agreements. Freenome may waive the Aggregate Transaction Proceeds condition.
event_status: Pending under the Business Combination Agreement dated December 5, 2025; the filing describes the First Merger as a future transaction.

effective_date: Expected on the Closing Date, when the First Certificate of Merger is accepted for filing by the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later date and/or time agreed by PCSC and Freenome and specified in that certificate. No calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Freenome common shares are converted into the right to receive New Freenome Common Stock.

stock_exchange_ratio: 1 share of Xtend AI Robotics, Inc. common stock per 1 share of JFB Construction Holdings Class A common stock or Class B common stock, excluding cancelled shares; merger consideration is subject to adjustment for specified capitalization changes.
shareholder_vote_date: JFB stockholder approval obtained by written consent on 2/13/2026; no further JFB stockholder vote is required. Xtend shareholder meeting: no calendar date stated; required to be held no later than ten business days after the Form S-4 registration statement becomes effective.
closing_conditions: Conditions, subject to waiver where permitted, include JFB stockholder approval, obtained by written consent on 2/13/2026; Xtend shareholder approval by holders of at least a majority of its issued and outstanding share capital on an as-converted basis, including the Preferred Majority; New PubCo common stock approved for NYSE listing; an effective Form S-4 without a stop order or SEC proceeding seeking one; expiration or termination of the HSR waiting period, which expired on 4/15/2026; absence of a legal prohibition; specified defense-export, Israeli Ministry of Defense, CFIUS, UK national-security, foreign-direct-investment and Israeli tax approvals or rulings; at least 50 days after filing the Israeli merger proposal, at least 30 days after Xtend shareholder and Merger Sub I shareholder approvals, and at least 60 days after the specified DDTC notice; applicable accuracy of representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, no continuing material adverse effect, and required officer certificates. Xtend's obligation also requires JFB closing cash of at least $110 million, specified board appointments and an Israeli Innovation Authority undertaking. The mergers are not subject to a financing condition.
event_status: Pending as described in the filing; merger agreement amended on 3/21/2026. JFB stockholder approval obtained; Xtend shareholder approval remains a closing condition.
security_description: JFB Construction Holdings Class A common stock and Class B common stock; each has the same stated one-for-one common-stock merger consideration. Cancelled shares are excluded. JFB Series C preferred stock, warrants and equity awards have separately described treatment.
effective_date: No calendar date stated. The JFB merger becomes legally effective when its certificate of merger is filed with and accepted by the Nevada Secretary of State, or at a later date or time agreed by the parties and specified in that certificate. The mergers were expected to close in the third quarter of 2026, subject to closing conditions; closing and legal effectiveness are described separately.

The mergers are not subject to a financing condition.
event_status: Pending as described in the filing; merger agreement amended on 3/21/2026. JFB stockholder approval obtained; Xtend shareholder approval remains a closing condition.
security_description: JFB Construction Holdings Series C preferred stock, subject to conversion and a 4.99% beneficial-ownership cap; consideration above the cap is described as pre-funded warrants exercisable for Xtend AI Robotics, Inc. common stock.
effective_date: No calendar date stated. effective_date: 4/29/2026 (actual); time not stated.
available_options: No holder election for the stated treatment of eligible Shares and ADSs.

acquirer: Beacon Topco, Inc. (Topco), the acquiring parent; its direct wholly owned subsidiary Cdog Merger Sub, Inc. will merge into the target.
consideration_type: Stock; cash is payable only in lieu of fractional shares.
cash_consideration: Cash in lieu of any fractional share of Topco common stock; no cash price per Clywedog share is stated.
stock_exchange_ratio: Between 0.000305 and 0.000508 shares of Beacon Topco, Inc. common stock per 1 share of Clywedog Therapeutics, Inc. common stock or Series Seed Preferred Stock, as finally determined by Clywedog and Barinthus Bio. The ratio is adjusted proportionately to reflect shares of Topco common stock held by former Barinthus shareholders immediately before the Merger, giving effect to the Self-Tender Offer if elected. Shares issuable are rounded down to the nearest whole share, with cash in lieu of fractions.
shareholder_vote_date: Clywedog stockholder approval is to be obtained by written consent no later than 24 hours after the registration statement becomes effective; no calendar consent date is stated. No Topco shareholder vote date is stated.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver where permitted by law: effectiveness of the registration statement without an outstanding SEC stop order or proceeding seeking one; no effective order or law preventing, prohibiting or making the transactions illegal; approval of the scheme and related resolutions by Barinthus shareholders and sanction of the scheme, including the capital reduction, by the High Court of Justice of England and Wales; Clywedog stockholder approval; Nasdaq listing approval for the Topco shares, subject to official notice of issuance; evidence that the UK Cabinet Office notified Topco, OrbiMed and TPAV that no further action will be taken under the NSIA; and expiration, termination or receipt of applicable antitrust waiting periods or consents. Additional party-specific conditions include qualified accuracy of representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, required closing documents, absence of a material adverse effect, continued effectiveness of specified lock-up agreements, termination of Clywedog investor agreements, completion of the Self-Tender Offer if elected, and each party meeting its applicable minimum net cash requirement, subject to its 2% shortfall collar. For assumed closing dates of May 31 and June 30, 2026, the amended minimums are, respectively, $22,850,000 and $20,470,000 for Barinthus Bio and $1,000,000 and $1,000,000 for Clywedog.
event_status: Pending; the September 29, 2025 merger agreement was amended on February 22, 2026. Completion remains subject to closing conditions.
security_description: Clywedog Therapeutics, Inc. common stock, $0.0001 par value per share, and Series Seed Preferred Stock, $0.0001 par value per share, receive the same stated merger consideration. Treasury shares and shares owned by Topco or Merger Sub are excluded; properly perfected dissenting shares have separate appraisal treatment.
effective_date: No calendar date or time is stated. The Merger becomes effective when the certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time specified in that certificate with Barinthus Bio’s and Clywedog’s consent. The scheme transaction precedes the Merger, and the Self-Tender Offer, if elected, is to be completed before the Merger.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Clywedog shares convert into Topco common stock, with cash only in lieu of fractional shares.

Parent Trading Price is the specified 30-trading-day volume-weighted average closing sale price ending three trading days before closing. AES's additional conditions include the specified accuracy of Parent's and Merger Sub's representations and warranties, their material compliance with covenants, and a Parent certificate. acquirer: ATII Holdings Inc. (Pubco), a wholly-owned subsidiary of Archimedes Tech SPAC Partners II Co. before the merger
target: Archimedes Tech SPAC Partners II Co. (ATII)
consideration_type: Stock for outstanding ATII ordinary shares and warrants; public shares validly submitted for redemption instead receive cash under the redemption provisions.
cash_consideration: For ATII public shares validly submitted for redemption, cash per share equals the amount in the Trust Account calculated two business days before consummation, including interest net of taxes paid or payable, divided by the number of issued and outstanding ATII public shares. Approximately $10.43 per public share as of December 31, 2025 was illustrative, not a fixed merger price. No cash consideration is stated for non-redeemed ATII ordinary shares or ATII warrants.
stock_exchange_ratio: 1 share of ATII Holdings Inc. common stock per 1 issued and outstanding ATII ordinary share, excluding redeemed public shares and treasury shares. Each outstanding, unexercised ATII warrant converts into 1 warrant to acquire 1 share of ATII Holdings Inc. common stock at $11.50 per share. Immediately before effectiveness, each ATII unit separates into 1 ATII ordinary share and one-half of 1 ATII warrant.
closing_conditions: The transaction requires approval of the cross-conditioned Business Combination, Domestication Merger, Director Election, Stock Issuance, Organizational Documents and Equity Incentive Plan proposals by ATII shareholders; delivery of Forge Nano stockholder written consent; expiration or termination of the applicable antitrust waiting period; specified third-party consents; no effective law or order preventing the transaction; an effective Form S-4 registration statement without a stop order; and approval of Pubco common stock for Nasdaq listing, subject to official notice of issuance. Additional party-specific conditions include the accuracy of representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, no continuing uncured material adverse effect, and specified closing deliveries. Conditions may be waived in writing where permissible. The PIPE financing is contingent on the Business Combination, not stated as a condition to this merger.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was signed on April 20, 2026, and the proposed merger remained subject to closing conditions in the May 5, 2026 preliminary proxy statement/prospectus.
security_description: ATII ordinary shares, par value $0.0001 per share, including shares resulting from separation of ATII public and private units; ATII public shares validly submitted for redemption have separate cash treatment. Outstanding, unexercised ATII warrants, including public and private warrants, convert into Pubco SPAC warrants. ATII treasury shares, if any, are cancelled without consideration.
effective_date: Conditional: at the time the plan of merger is registered by the Cayman Islands Registrar and the certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or a later time specified in those filings. The domestication merger is to occur at least one day before the First Company Merger; no calendar effective date or clock time is stated.
available_options: ATII public shareholders may elect cash redemption of all or a portion of their public shares, subject to the stated procedures and the 15% aggregate redemption limit absent ATII's consent. Non-redeemed ATII ordinary shares receive the fixed one-for-one stock exchange; ATII warrants convert automatically. Holders of private shares have waived redemption rights.
default_option: An ATII public shareholder that does not validly exercise redemption rights retains its shares for the automatic one-for-one exchange into Pubco common stock. Outstanding, unexercised ATII warrants convert automatically.

consideration_type: Stock, with a contingent right to a proportional allocation of up to 90,000,000 additional Pubco common shares if earn-out milestones are achieved. The stated treatment also replaces Forge Nano warrants, Ascent options and stock options with corresponding Pubco securities.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration is stated for Forge Nano common or preferred shares. No cash settlement is made for fractional earn-out shares eliminated by rounding.
stock_exchange_ratio: Each outstanding Forge Nano preferred share converts into Forge Nano common stock under Forge Nano's organizational documents immediately before the First Company Merger. Each outstanding Forge Nano common share, including common shares issued upon preferred-share conversion but excluding treasury shares, converts into the right to its Applicable Per Share Merger Consideration: its applicable pro rata portion of the Closing Payment Shares. Closing Payment Shares equal ($1,200,000,000 ÷ $10.00) minus Pubco common shares issuable on exercise of Pubco convertible securities issued in exchange for Forge Nano convertible securities. No fixed number of Pubco common shares per Forge Nano common share is stated; fractional Pubco shares otherwise issuable under the merger agreement are rounded down after aggregation.
closing_conditions: The Company Mergers require approval of the cross-conditioned ATII shareholder proposals and delivery of the required Forge Nano stockholder written consent; expiration or termination of the applicable antitrust waiting period; specified third-party consents; no effective law or order preventing the transaction; an effective Form S-4 registration statement without a stop order; and approval of Pubco common stock for Nasdaq listing, subject to official notice of issuance. Additional party-specific conditions include the accuracy of representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, no continuing uncured material adverse effect, and specified closing deliveries. Conditions may be waived in writing where permissible. The PIPE financing is contingent on the Business Combination, not stated as a condition to these mergers.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was signed on April 20, 2026, and the proposed Company Mergers remained subject to closing conditions in the May 5, 2026 preliminary proxy statement/prospectus.
security_description: Forge Nano, Inc. common stock, par value $0.0001 per share, including common shares issued upon conversion of its Series A, Series B, Series C and Series D preferred stock immediately before the First Company Merger. Treasury shares are cancelled without consideration. Forge Nano warrants, Ascent options and stock options have separately stated conversion treatment.
effective_date: Conditional: the First Company Merger takes effect when its certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time specified in that certificate. It is to occur at least one day after the domestication merger takes effect. No calendar effective date or clock time is stated.
available_options: No holder election for Forge Nano stockholders; outstanding preferred shares convert under Forge Nano's organizational documents, and outstanding common shares receive the applicable pro rata stock consideration. Earn-out shares are disbursed only if the specified milestones are achieved.
default_option: Forge Nano preferred shares convert into Forge Nano common shares immediately before the First Company Merger, and outstanding Forge Nano common shares automatically convert into the right to receive Applicable Per Share Merger Consideration without holder action.

acquirer: Air Industries Group (AIR); its wholly owned subsidiary, Transitory Air Sub LLC (Merger Sub), will merge into Tenax.
consideration_type: Stock; Tenax Members will receive AIR common stock as merger consideration, subject to adjustment under the merger agreement. Incidental cash may be paid in lieu of fractional shares.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration per Tenax unit is stated. Cash may be paid in lieu of fractional shares of AIR common stock, based on net proceeds from the sale of aggregated fractional shares; no fixed cash amount per unit is stated.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver where legally permissible: AIR stockholder approval of the stock issuance, authorized shares and written consent proposals; absence of a legal restraint preventing the Transactions; expiration or termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period and required approvals or expiration or termination of waiting periods under specified other antitrust laws; authorization for listing the merger shares on NYSE American; and approval by holders of a majority of Tenax units, which the filing states has already been obtained through support agreements. Tenax’s additional conditions include the requisite accuracy of AIR’s and Merger Sub’s representations and warranties, their material compliance with covenants, an AIR officer’s certificate, no AIR Material Adverse Effect, no specified governmental action or restraint imposing or seeking restrictions on Tenax, and continued effectiveness of the AIR stockholder support agreement. AIR’s and Merger Sub’s additional conditions include the requisite accuracy of Tenax’s representations and warranties, Tenax’s material compliance with covenants, no Tenax Material Adverse Effect, and a Tenax officer’s certificate. Tenax obtaining financing is not a closing condition.
event_status: Announced and pending; the merger agreement was executed on February 16, 2026, and completion remains subject to closing conditions. The requisite Tenax Member approval has been obtained; AIR stockholder approval is still being sought.
security_description: Issued and outstanding membership units of Tenax Aerospace Acquisition, LLC (Tenax units).
effective_date: Not yet determined. The merger will become effective when the certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later date and time specified in that certificate and agreed to in writing by AIR and Tenax. The parties must cause effectiveness to occur one minute after the AIR charter amendment becomes effective.
available_options: No holder election; each outstanding Tenax unit converts into the right to receive its allocated portion of the stock merger consideration.

acquirer: Aptorum Group Limited; its direct, wholly owned Delaware subsidiary, Merger Sub, will merge with and into the target.
target: DiamiR Biosciences Corp., which will survive the merger as a wholly owned subsidiary of Aptorum Group Limited.
consideration_type: Stock, for each outstanding share of DiamiR common stock other than dissenting shares.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each 1 share of DiamiR common stock outstanding at the effective time, other than dissenting shares: a number of shares of Aptorum Delaware common stock equal to the Conversion Ratio. The Conversion Ratio is (Aptorum ordinary shares on a fully diluted basis ÷ DiamiR common shares on a fully diluted basis) ÷ 3/7. The ratio is adjusted to reflect any pre-closing equity issuances and resulting dilution as described in the merger agreement. No fractional shares will be issued; an entitlement to a fractional share will be rounded up to the nearest whole share.
shareholder_vote_date: Aptorum Group Limited shareholders: special meeting scheduled for 6/9/2026 at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time, unless postponed or adjourned. DiamiR stockholder approval is required, but no vote date is stated.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver, to the extent permitted by law: approval of the Aptorum Domestication Proposal and completion of the domestication; approval of the Nasdaq Stock Issuance Proposal; conversion of all outstanding convertible debt of Aptorum and DiamiR; completion of Nasdaq’s review of Aptorum’s listing-of-additional-securities application and continued Nasdaq listing of Aptorum shares; SEC declaration of effectiveness of the Form S-4 registering the merger shares; agreed combined-company board composition and employment agreements for post-merger officers and directors; execution and delivery of the Stockholders Agreement by each counterparty; Aptorum cash of at least $2,260,000 and working capital of at least $1,644,000 at closing; and no effective governmental order or law preventing, prohibiting or making the merger illegal. Each party’s obligation is also conditioned on the other party’s specified representations and warranties meeting the stated accuracy and materiality standards, material performance of obligations and compliance with covenants, receipt of an executive-officer certificate confirming those matters, and absence of a material adverse effect on the other party. DiamiR stockholder approval is also required. The approvals of the share consolidation, incentive plan and director appointments are not merger conditions; financing is not stated to be required to close.
event_status: Pending as described in the 5/8/2026 filing; the merger agreement and related agreements were amended to extend their termination date to 6/30/2026.
security_description: Each outstanding share of DiamiR Biosciences Corp. common stock, other than dissenting shares.
effective_date: Not specified. The merger will become legally effective upon filing a certificate of merger with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed by Aptorum and DiamiR and specified in that certificate. Closing is to occur as promptly as practicable, and in any event within two business days after the closing conditions are satisfied or waived, other than conditions to be satisfied at closing.
available_options: No holder election; eligible DiamiR common shares are converted into Aptorum Delaware common stock at the Conversion Ratio.

consideration_type: Stock; MicroTouch shareholders will receive Future Vision II Acquisition Corp. ordinary shares. The consideration is based on a $90,000,000 valuation of MicroTouch divided by $10.05 per Future Vision ordinary share.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each MicroTouch ordinary share, New MT ordinary shares equal to the quotient of MicroTouch’s $90,000,000 valuation divided by $10.05, divided by the aggregate number of MicroTouch ordinary shares outstanding immediately before the effective time. closing_conditions: Conditions include approval of the Business Combination by Future Vision and MicroTouch shareholders; approval of Future Vision’s interdependent Business Combination, Name Change, Charter Amendment and Director Election proposals and its Nasdaq proposal; SEC effectiveness of the proxy/registration statement; Nasdaq approval of the listing application for the consideration shares and continued Nasdaq listing; filing of the merger plan with the Cayman Registry; absence of a law, order or legal action prohibiting the transaction; required performance of obligations and accuracy of representations and warranties, subject to the stated materiality and material-adverse-effect qualifications; absence of a Company or Purchaser Material Adverse Effect; exchange of officer certificates; election of post-closing directors and officers; and Future Vision’s name change to MicroTouch Inc. The filing states a minimum of $5,000,001 in Future Vision net tangible assets and also describes a $5 million cash closing condition that MicroTouch may waive. It states that Future Vision will not close if redemptions reduce net tangible assets below $5,000,001. The merger subsidiary will merge into MicroTouch, with MicroTouch surviving as Future Vision’s wholly owned subsidiary.

acquirer: Cintas Corporation, the acquiring parent; Bruin Merger Sub I, Inc. and Bruin Merger Sub II, LLC are its wholly owned merger subsidiaries.
consideration_type: Mixed cash and stock; each eligible share of UniFirst common stock or UniFirst class B common stock receives cash and Cintas common stock, subject to applicable withholding taxes. Fractional Cintas shares are paid in cash instead.
cash_consideration: USD $155.00 in cash, without interest, per share of UniFirst common stock or UniFirst class B common stock, subject to applicable withholding taxes. Cash in lieu of any fractional Cintas share is separate from this per-share cash consideration.
stock_exchange_ratio: A fixed 0.7720 shares of Cintas common stock per 1 share of UniFirst common stock or UniFirst class B common stock. The ratio is not adjusted for changes in either company's stock price before completion, but the merger consideration is subject to adjustment for specified changes in the number or type of outstanding shares, including stock splits and stock dividends. No fractional Cintas shares will be issued; holders receive cash in lieu.
shareholder_vote_date: UniFirst shareholders' special meeting is scheduled for 6/11/2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time, in a virtual-only format, to vote on approval of the merger agreement. No Cintas shareholder vote is required.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, to the extent permitted by law, waiver of the applicable conditions: approval of the merger agreement and first merger by two-thirds of the combined voting power of outstanding UniFirst common and class B shares voting together; approval for NASDAQ listing of the Cintas shares to be issued; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an SEC stop order or proceeding seeking one; expiration or early termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period and receipt of specified antitrust authorizations or consents; receipt of governmental authorizations or consents for certain UniFirst permits; and absence of a post-agreement order or law enjoining or prohibiting the mergers. Each party's obligation is also subject to the other party's representations and warranties meeting the agreement's applicable accuracy standards, material compliance with covenants and obligations, absence of a continuing material adverse effect on the other party since the agreement date, and receipt of the other party's officer certificate. Cintas' obligation to complete the mergers is not conditioned on obtaining financing.
event_status: Pending as described in the May 11, 2026 proxy statement/prospectus; the mergers remain subject to shareholder approval and other closing conditions.
security_description: UniFirst Corporation common stock, par value $0.10 per share, and UniFirst Corporation class B common stock, par value $0.10 per share. Both classes receive the same merger consideration, except for canceled shares; equity awards have separate treatment.
effective_date: No calendar effective date is specified. The first merger is to take effect when its articles of merger are filed with the Massachusetts Secretary and its certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary, or at another agreed date and time specified in both filings. The second merger is to take effect immediately after the first merger, when its certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware and Massachusetts Secretaries, or at another agreed date and time specified in that certificate.
available_options: No holder election; eligible shares receive the specified cash-and-stock consideration.

acquirer: Public Storage; its wholly owned direct subsidiary Pelican Merger Sub I, LLC is the merger subsidiary and surviving company.
consideration_type: Stock: Public Storage Series U preferred shares.
stock_exchange_ratio: 1 newly issued Public Storage 6.000% Cumulative Preferred Share, Series U, per 1 National Storage Affiliates Trust 6.000% Series B cumulative redeemable preferred share.
shareholder_vote_date: No shareholder vote required from holders of NSA Series B preferred shares; the NSA common-shareholder special meeting date and time are unspecified.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permissible waiver: approval by NSA common shareholders entitled to cast a majority of all votes on the merger proposal; the requisite NSA OP unitholder approval, with the specified alternative company-wide partnership approval mechanism if initial approval is not obtained; effectiveness of the Form S-4 without an effective stop order or unwithdrawn SEC proceedings seeking one; no effective law, order or other legal restraint prohibiting the mergers; NYSE listing approval for the Public Storage common shares and Series T and Series U preferred shares; specified accuracy of representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, and no continuing company or parent material adverse effect; required officer certificates and REIT-status and Section 368(a) reorganization tax opinions; formation of the Dropdown JV before the company merger and completion of each special redemption with redemption units equal to the JV interest amount before the partnership merger. Financing is expressly not a closing condition.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was signed and the mergers were announced, but closing remains subject to conditions.
security_description: National Storage Affiliates Trust 6.000% Series B cumulative redeemable preferred shares of beneficial interest, par value $0.01 per share.
ticker: PSA, PSA-PF, PSA-PG, PSA-PH, PSA-PI, PSA-PJ, PSA-PK, PSA-PL, PSA-PM, PSA-PN, PSA-PO, PSA-PP, PSA-PQ
effective_date: Not specified. The company merger is to take effect on the closing date when the Maryland State Department of Assessments and Taxation accepts the articles of merger for record, or at another mutually agreed date and time specified in those articles. The parties currently expect the mergers to close in the third quarter of 2026.

acquirer: Public Storage, through Public Storage OP, L.P.; Pelican Merger Sub II, LLC, an indirect Public Storage subsidiary, merges into NSA OP, LP.
consideration_type: Elective consideration for eligible accredited-investor NSA OP unitholders: Public Storage OP common units for units not redeemed, or common membership interests in an Aggregator holding Dropdown JV interests for units redeemed. NSA OP units held by non-accredited investors instead receive cash.
cash_consideration: Each NSA OP unit held by a non-accredited investor immediately before the partnership merger effective time converts into cash, without interest, equal to the Public Storage common share price multiplied by 0.1400. That share price is the volume-weighted average of Public Storage common-share closing prices over the 10 full consecutive trading days ending on and including the third business day before closing. Accredited investors electing Aggregator units may also receive cash in lieu of fractional or de minimis interests, if applicable.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each non-elected NSA OP Class A unit held by an accredited investor, 0.1400 newly issued Public Storage OP common units per 1 NSA OP unit, subject to the merger agreement’s exchange-ratio adjustments. Eligible accredited investors may instead redeem NSA OP units on a one-for-one basis for equal numbers of Aggregator common membership interests; redemption units receive no Public Storage OP unit consideration.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permissible waiver: approval by NSA common shareholders entitled to cast a majority of all votes on the company merger proposal; the requisite NSA OP unitholder approval, with the specified alternative company-wide partnership approval mechanism if initial approval is not obtained; effectiveness of the Form S-4 without an effective stop order or unwithdrawn SEC proceedings seeking one; no effective law, order or other legal restraint prohibiting the mergers; NYSE listing approval for the Public Storage common shares and Series T and Series U preferred shares issued in the company merger; specified accuracy of representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, and no continuing company or parent material adverse effect; required officer certificates and REIT-status and Section 368(a) company-merger tax opinions; formation of the Dropdown JV before the company merger and completion of each special redemption with redemption units equal to the JV interest amount before the partnership merger. Financing is expressly not a closing condition.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was signed and the mergers were announced, but closing remains subject to conditions.
security_description: Class A units of limited partnership interest in NSA OP, LP (NSA OP units), including eligible NSA OP LTIP units converted into NSA OP units before the partnership merger; accredited-investor units and non-accredited-investor units receive different treatment.
ticker: PSA, PSA-PF, PSA-PG, PSA-PH, PSA-PI, PSA-PJ, PSA-PK, PSA-PL, PSA-PM, PSA-PN, PSA-PO, PSA-PP, PSA-PQ
effective_date: Not specified. The partnership merger is to take effect on the closing date when its certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at another mutually agreed date and time specified in that certificate. It follows the company merger, Dropdown JV contribution and financing, and special redemption. The parties currently expect the mergers to close in the third quarter of 2026.
available_options: Eligible NSA OP limited partners who are accredited investors may elect to redeem some or all NSA OP units on a one-for-one basis for Aggregator common membership interests; the Aggregator will hold 80% of the Dropdown JV units. These elections are subject to the JV interest amount and redemption or proration mechanics; units not redeemed receive 0.1400 Public Storage OP common units per NSA OP unit. Non-accredited-investor NSA OP units are not eligible for this choice and instead receive the stated cash formula.
default_option: Failure to deliver a timely special-redemption election is deemed an election not to participate indirectly in the special redemption. Nevertheless, non-elected NSA OP units of eligible limited partners may be redeemed if additional units are required to meet the JV interest amount. Remaining non-elected accredited-investor units receive Public Storage OP units; non-accredited-investor units receive cash.

consideration_type: Mixed cash and stock; eligible holders receive allocated portions of aggregate cash and stock merger consideration under the merger agreement and funds flow.
shareholder_vote_date: SVRE shareholders approved the merger by written consent on 4/19/2026. USA Rare Earth, Inc. stockholders are to vote on the share issuance proposal at a special meeting in 2026; the meeting date and time are not specified.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where legally permissible, waiver of the specified conditions: USA Rare Earth, Inc. stockholder approval of the share issuance proposal (not waivable); SVRE shareholder written consent (satisfied on 4/19/2026); expiration or termination of the applicable Hart-Scott-Rodino waiting period; no applicable law or governmental order prohibiting the merger; required consents, amendments or waivers under the Parent Loan Agreement, Retained Finance Agreement, Royalty Agreements, Call Option Agreement and Offtake Agreement, including applicable releases or waivers of credit-support requirements; and full disbursement to SVRE of the $100 million Incremental Loan. Each party's additional conditions include the other party's representations and warranties meeting the agreement's standards, material compliance with covenants, no continuing and uncured material adverse effect, and an officer's certificate. SVRE's additional conditions include specified third-party consents, executed Lockup and Registration Rights Agreements from USAR, appointment of Sir Mick Davis and Thras Moraitis to USAR's board, and delivery of the merger consideration. USAR's additional conditions include no specified governmental action or investigation, specified third-party consents, any DFC-nominated Merger Sub director or observer appointment, executed Lockup and Registration Rights Agreements from applicable SVRE securityholders, and evidence that specified SVRE related-party agreements have terminated.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was executed, and SVRE shareholder approval was obtained by written consent. USAR stockholder approval and other closing conditions remained required.
security_description: SVRE Holdings Ltd. ordinary shares and Class A ordinary shares outstanding immediately before the effective time, including shares issued upon the automatic exercise of specified SVRE warrants; dissenting shares and treasury shares are excluded from the stated conversion treatment.
effective_date: Not specified as a calendar date. The merger will become effective when the British Virgin Islands Registrar registers the Articles of Merger, or at a later time agreed in writing by USAR and SVRE and specified in the Articles of Merger, not more than 30 days after registration.

The Auddia Adjustment Amount is 0.20 plus an adjustment factor that increases Auddia holders’ ownership by 0.50 percentage points per $1 million of Auddia net cash above $20 million, makes no adjustment between $12 million and $20 million, and decreases it by 0.50 percentage points per $1 million below $12 million. closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver where permitted: approval by Gold Resource shareholders and Goldgroup shareholders at their respective meetings; receipt of the British Columbia Supreme Court's Interim Order and Final Order; required regulatory and stock-exchange approvals, including TSX Venture Exchange conditional approval for listing and trading the shares issued in the transaction; no applicable law or proceeding prohibiting the transaction; and an exemption from U.S. Securities Act registration under Section 3(a)(10) or, if applicable, an effective registration statement. Goldgroup's conditions also include necessary third-party consents, approvals and notices. Gold Resource's conditions also include Goldgroup dissent rights not being exercised by holders of more than 5% of its outstanding shares and Goldgroup depositing the merger consideration with the exchange agent. Mexican antitrust approval was received unconditionally on 4/27/2026.

stock_exchange_ratio: 15.235 common registered shares of Transocean Ltd., par value $0.10 per share, for each common share of Valaris Limited, par value $0.01 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the effective time, other than excluded treasury or subsidiary-held shares. Board and compensation committee elections and the additional Transocean articles amendment are not closing conditions. Obtaining financing is not a closing condition.

effective_date: Not specified as a calendar date. The effective time is the time on the date when the Bermuda court's Sanction Order is filed with the Bermuda Registrar of Companies. available_options: No holder election; eligible Valaris shareholders receive the fixed stock exchange ratio, with cash only in lieu of fractional shares.

acquirer: Columbia Financial, Inc., a newly formed Maryland corporation that will acquire Northfield Bancorp, Inc. and survive the merger.
consideration_type: Elective consideration: holders of Northfield Bancorp, Inc. common stock may elect Columbia Financial, Inc. common stock or cash, subject to proration and a limit of no more than 30% of eligible Northfield shares receiving cash.
cash_consideration: Cash election per 1 share of Northfield Bancorp, Inc. common stock: $14.25 if Columbia Financial, Inc.’s Final Independent Valuation is less than $2.3 billion; $14.50 if it is at least $2.3 billion but less than $2.6 billion; or $14.65 if it is at least $2.6 billion. The election is subject to proration and the 30% aggregate cash limit. Separately, cash instead of a fractional Columbia Financial, Inc. share equals the applicable per-share cash consideration multiplied by the fractional share.
stock_exchange_ratio: Stock election per 1 share of Northfield Bancorp, Inc. common stock: 1.425 shares of Columbia Financial, Inc. common stock if Columbia Financial, Inc.’s Final Independent Valuation is less than $2.3 billion; 1.450 shares if it is at least $2.3 billion but less than $2.6 billion; or 1.465 shares if it is at least $2.6 billion. Elections are subject to proration; no fractional Columbia Financial, Inc. shares will be issued, and cash will be paid instead.
shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled virtual shareholder votes on 6/25/2026: Northfield Bancorp, Inc. special meeting at 9:00 a.m. Eastern time to consider approval of the Merger Agreement; Columbia Financial, Inc. (Delaware corporation) annual meeting at 10:00 a.m. Eastern time to consider approval of the Merger Agreement and the related conversion.
closing_conditions: The merger is conditional on completion of Columbia Financial’s conversion, including approval by Columbia Financial stockholders and Columbia Bank MHC members, and approval of the Merger Agreement by Columbia Financial and Northfield Bancorp stockholders; Nasdaq listing authorization for the merger shares; required nongovernmental third-party notices, consents or waivers, subject to the stated material-adverse-effect exception; effectiveness of the Form S-4 with no SEC stop order; required regulatory approvals without a materially burdensome regulatory condition and expiration or termination of applicable statutory waiting periods; no legal restraint or prohibition on the merger or bank merger; deposit with the exchange agent of sufficient cash and shares; no specified material adverse effect on Northfield Bancorp or its subsidiaries; accuracy of the parties’ representations and warranties and material performance of their obligations, subject to the agreement’s standards; and each party’s receipt of a legal opinion that the merger qualifies as a reorganization under Section 368(a). The Federal Reserve Board’s approvals of the conversion and merger and the OCC’s approval of the bank merger were described as conditional; stockholder approvals remained outstanding.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was executed on 1/31/2026, regulatory approvals were described as conditional, and shareholder approvals remained outstanding.
security_description: Northfield Bancorp, Inc. common stock, par value $0.01 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the merger’s effective time. Shares canceled under the merger agreement and shares with perfected appraisal rights are excluded from ordinary merger consideration. Northfield restricted stock and performance-based restricted stock units that vest immediately before the effective time are treated as outstanding common shares; stock options receive separate treatment.
effective_date: Not specified as a calendar date or time. The merger is to occur immediately after completion of the conversion; its legal effective time will be specified in the Delaware certificate of merger and Maryland articles of merger. The parties expected to complete the merger early in the third quarter of 2026, without assurance that it would be completed.
available_options: Northfield Bancorp common stockholders may elect stock—1.425, 1.450 or 1.465 Columbia Financial, Inc. common shares per Northfield share—or cash—$14.25, $14.50 or $14.65 per Northfield share—at the corresponding Final Independent Valuation thresholds of less than $2.3 billion, at least $2.3 billion but less than $2.6 billion, or at least $2.6 billion. No more than 30% of eligible Northfield shares may receive cash; if cash elections exceed the limit, cash-electing holders receive stock for a prorated portion of their shares. A valid election requires a properly completed form received by the exchange agent by the deadline, with certificates or an appropriate delivery guarantee where applicable; holders of shares in street name follow their broker’s instructions.
default_option: Shares for which no valid cash or stock election is made are non-election shares. They may receive cash, stock or both, as determined by Columbia Financial, Inc. in its sole discretion, subject to the merger agreement’s allocation and proration procedures. An improperly made election is ineffective unless a proper election is subsequently made on time.
election_deadline: 5:00 p.m., Eastern time, on a date approximately five business days before merger completion; the exact date was to be announced by press release 10 to 20 business days beforehand. No calendar date was specified. A Northfield holder may change or revoke an election by submitting written notice and a properly completed revised election form received before the deadline.

acquirer: Inventurus Knowledge Solutions, Inc. (IKS); its wholly owned subsidiary, IKS Next Horizon, Inc. (Merger Sub), will merge with and into TruBridge, Inc.
consideration_type: Cash, without interest and subject to applicable withholding taxes, for eligible shares; excluded shares do not receive the merger consideration, and dissenting shares are subject to appraisal rights.
cash_consideration: $26.25 in cash per share of TruBridge, Inc. common stock, without interest and subject to applicable withholding taxes, for each eligible share held immediately before the Effective Time; excludes shares owned by specified transaction parties or their wholly owned subsidiaries and dissenting shares.
stock_exchange_ratio: No stock consideration to holders of eligible TruBridge, Inc. common stock.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, to the extent permitted by law, waiver at or before closing: adoption of the merger agreement by holders of a majority of outstanding TruBridge common shares entitled to vote; expiration or earlier termination of the HSR Act waiting period and any applicable contractual waiting periods under governmental timing agreements; and no effective law or governmental restraint prohibiting the transaction. IKS and Merger Sub also require TruBridge’s specified representations and warranties to meet their applicable accuracy standards, material performance of its material obligations, no continuing Company Material Adverse Effect since the agreement date, and an officer certificate confirming those conditions. TruBridge also requires IKS’s, Merger Sub’s and TopCo’s representations and warranties to meet their applicable accuracy standards, material performance of their material obligations, and an officer certificate confirming those conditions. Debt financing is expressly not a closing condition.
event_status: Announced and pending as described in the preliminary proxy statement; the merger agreement was executed on April 23, 2026, and the merger remains subject to closing conditions.
security_description: TruBridge, Inc. common stock, par value $0.001 per share. Eligible outstanding shares receive the merger consideration; excluded shares, including dissenting shares, have separate treatment. Outstanding restricted share awards and performance share awards are treated under separate equity-award provisions.
effective_date: Not fixed. The merger is expected to be completed in the third quarter of 2026, subject to closing conditions; it will legally become effective when the certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State on the Closing Date, or at a later time agreed in writing and specified in that certificate.
available_options: No holder election; eligible shares are converted into the fixed cash consideration. Eligible holders may instead pursue appraisal rights only if they satisfy the stated Delaware-law requirements.

acquirer: Columbia Financial, Inc., a newly formed Maryland corporation that will acquire Northfield Bancorp, Inc. and survive the merger.
target: Northfield Bancorp, Inc., a Delaware corporation.
consideration_type: Elective consideration: eligible Northfield Bancorp common stockholders may elect Columbia Financial, Inc. common stock or cash, subject to proration and a cap on cash consideration.
cash_consideration: Cash election per share of Northfield Bancorp common stock: $14.25 if the Final Independent Valuation is less than $2.3 billion; $14.50 if it is at least $2.3 billion but less than $2.6 billion; or $14.65 if it is at least $2.6 billion. No more than 30% of eligible outstanding Northfield Bancorp shares may be converted into cash consideration. Separately, cash instead of a fractional Columbia Financial, Inc. share equals the applicable Per Share Cash Consideration multiplied by the fractional share.
stock_exchange_ratio: Stock election per 1 share of Northfield Bancorp common stock: 1.425 shares of Columbia Financial, Inc., a Maryland corporation, common stock if the Final Independent Valuation is less than $2.3 billion; 1.450 shares if it is at least $2.3 billion but less than $2.6 billion; or 1.465 shares if it is at least $2.6 billion. The agreement provides for proportionate adjustment after specified changes in capitalization. No fractional shares will be issued; cash will be paid instead.
shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled virtual shareholder votes on 6/25/2026: Northfield Bancorp, Inc. special meeting at 9:00 a.m. Eastern time; Columbia Financial, Inc., the Delaware corporation, annual meeting at 10:00 a.m. Eastern time.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or applicable waiver of closing conditions, including completion of Columbia Financial’s conversion, with approval by Columbia Financial stockholders and Columbia Bank MHC members and the required minimum offering; approval of the merger agreement by Columbia Financial and Northfield Bancorp stockholders; authorization to list the merger shares on Nasdaq; required third-party notices, consents or waivers, subject to the stated material-adverse-effect exception; effectiveness of the Form S-4 without an SEC stop order; required regulatory approvals, expiration or termination of applicable waiting periods, and no materially burdensome regulatory condition; no legal restraint or prohibition of the merger or bank merger; sufficient cash and shares deposited with the exchange agent; no specified material adverse effect on Northfield Bancorp; accuracy of representations and warranties and material performance of obligations and covenants; and each party’s receipt of a legal opinion that the merger qualifies as a reorganization under Section 368(a) of the Internal Revenue Code. The filing states that regulatory approvals for the conversion, merger and bank merger had been conditionally received.
event_status: Pending as described in the 5/11/2026 joint proxy statement/prospectus; the merger agreement was executed on 1/31/2026, and the merger remained subject to the conversion and other closing conditions.
security_description: Northfield Bancorp, Inc. common stock, par value $0.01 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the merger’s effective time, including restricted stock and performance-based restricted stock units that vest and are treated as outstanding shares. Shares specified for cancellation and shares with perfected appraisal rights are excepted from the ordinary consideration treatment; stock options are treated separately.
effective_date: No calendar effective date is stated. The merger is to close immediately after completion of the conversion; it legally becomes effective at the time specified in the Delaware certificate of merger and Maryland articles of merger, or as otherwise provided by applicable law. The parties expected to complete the merger early in the third quarter of 2026, without assurance that it would be completed.
available_options: Each eligible Northfield Bancorp common stockholder may elect, for specified shares, either the applicable stock exchange ratio or the applicable per-share cash amount. A properly completed and signed election form must reach the exchange agent by the election deadline, accompanied by stock certificates or an appropriate delivery guarantee if applicable; holders of book-entry shares need not deliver certificates. If cash elections exceed the cash conversion cap, cash-electing holders receive stock for a prorated portion of those shares and cash for the remainder. A holder may change or revoke an election before the deadline.
default_option: Shares for which no valid cash or stock election is made are Non-Election Shares. They may receive cash, stock, or a combination, as determined by Columbia Financial, Inc. in its sole discretion, subject to the merger agreement’s allocation and proration procedures. An improperly made election is treated as no election unless a proper election is subsequently made on time; all elections are automatically revoked if the merger agreement is terminated.
election_deadline: 5:00 p.m. local time in the city of the exchange agent’s principal office, on a date determined to be as close as possible to the fifth business day before closing. The exact date is to be announced by press release at least 10 and no more than 20 business days before the deadline; no calendar date is stated.

acquirer: SeeQC, Inc. (SEEQC), through its wholly owned merger subsidiary, SEEQC Merger Sub, Inc.
consideration_type: Conditional stock treatment: if the Allegro warrant amendment is approved and the merger closes, each outstanding Allegro warrant converts into the right to receive SEEQC common stock without additional consideration. If the amendment is not approved but the merger closes, SEEQC will assume the outstanding warrants instead.
cash_consideration: No cash is payable upon conversion under the proposed Allegro warrant amendment; the shares are received without additional consideration. If the amendment is not approved and the merger closes, the assumed warrants retain an $11.50-per-share exercise price, rather than providing a cash merger payment.
stock_exchange_ratio: If the Allegro warrant amendment is approved, 0.1 share of SEEQC common stock per 1 outstanding Allegro common stock purchase warrant, subject to equitable adjustment for specified changes to SEEQC common stock other than the SEEQC preferred-stock conversion and SEEQC stock split. If the amendment is not approved, the warrants are assumed by SEEQC on their existing 1-for-1 share-conversion terms and $11.50 exercise price, but become exercisable for SEEQC common stock instead of Allegro common stock, subject to customary anti-dilution adjustments.
closing_conditions: The merger is subject to satisfaction or permitted waiver of conditions, including: no effective governmental order restraining, enjoining or prohibiting the merger; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an effective stop order or pending SEC stop-order proceeding; consummation of the PIPE investment before or substantially concurrently with closing; SEEQC stockholder approval, including approval of the preferred-stock conversion and stock split; and Allegro stockholder written consent. Allegro's additional conditions include the specified accuracy of SEEQC and Merger Sub representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, absence of specified litigation and an ongoing SEEQC material adverse effect, forgiveness of insider and affiliate indebtedness owed to SEEQC and termination of related guarantees, execution of SEEQC lock-up agreements, and appointment of Allegro's board designees. SEEQC's additional conditions include the specified accuracy of Allegro representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, absence of specified litigation and an ongoing Allegro material adverse effect, execution of Allegro lock-up agreements, approval of SEEQC common stock for listing on Nasdaq, the NYSE or NYSE American subject only to official notice of issuance, and consummation of the public offering concurrently with closing. The warrant amendment requires written consent from holders of at least 65% of Allegro warrants, but its approval is not a condition to consummating the merger.
event_status: Merger pending; the proposed Allegro warrant amendment is also pending. The filing states that consents representing an aggregate of approximately 48.8% of outstanding Allegro warrants favor the amendment, below the required 65%.
security_description: Allegro Merger Corp. redeemable common stock purchase warrants, each entitling its holder to purchase one share of Allegro common stock at an exercise price of $11.50; 15,322,500 warrants are stated to be outstanding.
effective_date: Not dated; the merger becomes effective upon filing a certificate of merger with the Delaware Secretary of State on the closing date, or at a later time agreed in writing by Allegro and SEEQC and specified in that certificate. Under the proposed amendment, warrant conversion occurs immediately before the merger's effective time.
available_options: No individual holder election between merger consideration forms is stated. Warrant holders are being asked to consent to the proposed amendment; if it receives the required approval and the merger closes, the warrants convert into SEEQC shares. If it is not approved and the merger closes, SEEQC assumes the warrants.
default_option: If the Allegro warrant amendment is not approved and the merger is consummated, SEEQC will assume the outstanding Allegro warrants on their existing terms, except that they become exercisable for SEEQC common stock instead of Allegro common stock, subject to customary anti-dilution adjustments.

consideration_type: Stock; the aggregate base purchase price of US$185,000,000 is payable entirely in newly issued CPRO Holding Limited ordinary shares valued at US$10.00 per share, subject to a dollar-for-dollar downward adjustment for Company Group indebtedness immediately before closing above US$26,000,000.
cash_consideration: No cash consideration is payable to holders of CPRO Electronics Holding Limited ordinary shares under the stated merger consideration; the consideration is entirely stock. Dissenting shareholders instead have rights to payments under the applicable British Virgin Islands dissent procedure.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each 1 ordinary share of CPRO Electronics Holding Limited, the number of CPRO Holding Limited ordinary shares equals the Closing Payment Shares divided by the Aggregate Fully Diluted Company Ordinary Shares. Closing Payment Shares equal the Base Purchase Price divided by US$10.00; the US$185,000,000 Base Purchase Price is reduced dollar-for-dollar to the extent Company Group indebtedness immediately before closing exceeds US$26,000,000. Treasury or subsidiary-owned CPRO shares and dissenting shares are excluded. Fractional CPRO Holding Limited ordinary shares are rounded down to the nearest whole share after aggregation by holder.
closing_conditions: Outstanding conditions include consummation and registration of the Reincorporation Merger; approval by Lakeshore and CPRO shareholders; no applicable law or order prohibiting closing and no non-affiliate third-party action to enjoin or restrict it; effectiveness of the Form F-4 registration statement without an outstanding stop order or related SEC proceeding; and conditional approval for listing the CPRO Holding Limited ordinary shares on Nasdaq or an alternate exchange. The purchaser parties’ additional waivable conditions include CPRO Group covenant compliance in all material respects, subject to stricter compliance where an obligation has a materiality qualifier; accuracy of CPRO Group representations and warranties subject to the stated material-adverse-effect standard; no Company Group material adverse effect; required Company Group consents and governmental approvals remaining effective; delivery of specified officer and corporate certificates, executed employment agreements for key personnel, an updated disclosure schedule if applicable, British Virgin Islands counsel opinions, additional agreements, written acknowledgment concerning directors’ and officers’ indemnification agreements, and a closing indebtedness certificate; and completion of the CPRO Korea reorganization with satisfactory evidence. CPRO’s additional waivable conditions include purchaser-party covenant compliance and representation accuracy under the stated materiality standards, no purchaser-party material adverse effect, material compliance with securities-law reporting requirements, execution of applicable additional agreements, completion of Parent share redemptions, and appointment of CPRO-designated directors. PIPE financing is described as an efforts covenant, not a stated closing condition.
event_status: Pending; merger agreement entered into on 5/22/2026 and the proposed business combination announced on 5/26/2026. Closing was expected in the fourth quarter of 2026.
security_description: Ordinary shares of CPRO Electronics Holding Limited, par value US$1.00 per share; shares owned by CPRO or its subsidiaries and dissenting shares receive different treatment.
effective_date: Pending: the Acquisition Merger becomes legally effective when the British Virgin Islands Registrar registers the articles of merger, or at a later time agreed in writing by CPRO Electronics Holding Limited and CPRO Holding Limited and specified in those articles. The merger is to occur at least one business day after completion of the Reincorporation Merger. The transaction was expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026; no specific legal effective date is stated.
available_options: No holder election; eligible CPRO ordinary shares automatically convert into the right to receive the applicable number of CPRO Holding Limited ordinary shares. Dissenters’ statutory payment rights are a separate exception, not a merger-consideration election.

acquirer: The Brink’s Company (Brink’s), through its wholly owned merger subsidiaries Novus Merger Sub, Inc. (first merger) and Novus Merger Sub II, LLC (second merger).
consideration_type: Mixed cash and stock, fixed for each eligible share of NCR Atleos Common Stock.
cash_consideration: $30.00 in cash, without interest, per share of NCR Atleos Common Stock, less any applicable tax withholding. No fractional shares of Brink’s Common Stock will be issued; holders otherwise entitled to a fractional share will receive cash, without interest and rounded down to the nearest cent, equal to that fraction multiplied by the NYSE closing price of Brink’s Common Stock on the last trading day immediately preceding the First Effective Time. Shares held by Brink’s or either merger subsidiary are canceled without consideration.
stock_exchange_ratio: 0.1574 shares of The Brink’s Company common stock, par value $1.00 per share, per 1 share of NCR Atleos Corporation common stock, par value $0.01 per share. The ratio is fixed and will not be adjusted for changes in either company’s market price, but the merger agreement provides for appropriate adjustments for specified stock splits, dividends, reorganizations and similar changes, subject to its stated aggregate-value limitation. Fractional shares are paid in cash instead of issued.
shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled virtual meetings on 6/30/2026 at 10:00 a.m., Eastern Time: Brink’s shareholders will vote on the share issuance, and NCR Atleos stockholders will vote on the transactions, including the mergers. Either meeting may be adjourned or postponed.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or written waiver, if legally permissible: approval of the share issuance by Brink’s shareholders and of the transactions by NCR Atleos stockholders; no governmental judgment or applicable law preventing or prohibiting the transactions; expiration or early termination of the HSR waiting period (the filing states this occurred on 5/11/2026); receipt and continued effectiveness of specified governmental clearances and applicable money transmitter approvals, subject to the stated alternative-arrangements provision after 8/26/2026 for certain jurisdictions; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an unresolved SEC stop order or proceeding; and NYSE authorization for listing the Brink’s shares to be issued. Each party’s additional conditions include the other party’s representations and warranties meeting the agreement’s specified accuracy standards, required covenant compliance, no material adverse effect since the agreement date, and delivery of an officer’s certificate. NCR Atleos’ obligation also requires Brink’s to comply in all respects with its covenant to appoint the jointly designated NCR Atleos director to the Brink’s board. Financing availability is not stated as a general closing condition; the agreement describes a limited exception tied to NCR Atleos’ material breach of financing-cooperation obligations.
event_status: Pending as described in the 5/27/2026 joint proxy statement/prospectus. The merger agreement was executed on 2/26/2026; the filing states that the HSR waiting period expired on 5/11/2026, while shareholder votes and other closing conditions remained prospective.
security_description: NCR Atleos Corporation common stock, par value $0.01 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the First Effective Time, excluding shares held by Brink’s, Novus Merger Sub, Inc. or Novus Merger Sub II, LLC.
effective_date: No calendar effective date is stated. Conditionally, the First Merger takes effect when its articles of merger are accepted for record by Maryland’s State Department of Assessments and Taxation, or at a later agreed time specified in those articles within 30 days after acceptance. The Second Merger takes effect after the First Merger when its articles are accepted for record, or at a later agreed time specified in those articles within 30 days after acceptance.
available_options: No holder election.

consideration_type: Stock; each outstanding TDAC Class A ordinary share, other than a dissenting share, is exchanged for one Prologium Holding Inc. Class A ordinary share. Validly dissenting shares instead carry a right to payment of fair value under Cayman Islands law.

closing_conditions: The two mergers are subject to conditions that may be waived in writing by all parties if permitted by law: Nasdaq listing eligibility for Prologium Class A ordinary shares and warrants; no applicable governmental order enjoining, restraining, prohibiting or making the transactions illegal; TDAC and Prologium shareholder approvals; effectiveness of the registration statement without an SEC stop order or threatened or initiated proceeding seeking one; at least $5,000,001 in net tangible assets for the second-merger surviving company after the business combination and TDAC redemptions; and completion of Prologium's recapitalization. TDAC's additional conditions include specified accuracy of Prologium's representations and warranties, material performance of its covenants, no continuing Company Material Adverse Effect, and receipt of Prologium's closing deliverables. Prologium and its merger subsidiaries' additional conditions include specified accuracy of TDAC's representations and warranties, material performance of its covenants, no TDAC Material Adverse Effect, an extension of TDAC's business-combination deadline to a date after June 24, 2026, receipt of TDAC's closing deliverables, and Available Cash of at least $250,000,000. The agreement separately requires the parties to use commercially reasonable efforts to obtain a PIPE investment; it does not state a completed PIPE investment as a closing condition.
event_status: Announced and pending; the merger agreement was entered into on May 27, 2026, and closing remains subject to conditions.

Consideration for each holder will be specified in the Allocation Certificate.
