acquirer: PubCo, a Swiss public limited company to be formed by Axiom Intelligence Holdings 1, LLC; PubCo is the surviving company in the Acquisition Merger.
target: Swiss HoldCo, a Swiss company to be formed by Terra Quantum AG shareholders to hold their Terra Quantum AG shares.
consideration_type: Stock plus a contingent right to additional PubCo ordinary shares: each eligible Swiss HoldCo ordinary share is exchanged for PubCo ordinary shares at the Exchange Ratio. Eligible Swiss HoldCo shareholders, including holders of assumed virtual share awards, may also receive earnout shares if specified VWAP or qualifying change-of-control conditions are met within eight years. Treasury shares receive no consideration.
stock_exchange_ratio: A number of newly issued PubCo ordinary shares equal to the Exchange Ratio per 1 Swiss HoldCo ordinary share; the Exchange Ratio is the Price per Share divided by $10.00, and Price per Share is $3,500,000,000 divided by issued and outstanding Swiss HoldCo shares on a fully diluted basis, including dilution from conversion of Company Virtual Share Awards and the Tax Election. No fractional PubCo ordinary share is issued; aggregate fractional entitlements are rounded up to the nearest whole share. The exchange is subject to compatibility with Swiss law.
closing_conditions: Outstanding conditions include approval by SPAC, Company and Swiss HoldCo shareholders; effectiveness of the Proxy/Registration Statement without an outstanding SEC stop order or proceeding; conditional Nasdaq approval of PubCo’s initial listing application and approval of the transaction shares for listing, subject to official notice of issuance; absence of a material legal restraint; a combined-company D&O policy providing tail coverage for SPAC; and SPAC’s receipt of an independent financial fairness opinion. The agreement also specifies Initial Closing conditions concerning the accuracy of Company, Swiss HoldCo, SPAC and acquisition-entity representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, execution of joinders and senior-management employment agreements, Swiss HoldCo’s incorporation, and favorable Swiss tax rulings. Conditions may be waived as provided in the agreement. The Acquisition Closing follows the Initial Merger and satisfaction or waiver of applicable conditions. The parties’ efforts to obtain at least $30 million of PIPE investments or other financing are not stated as a closing condition.

acquirer: PubCo, a Swiss public limited company to be formed by Axiom Intelligence Holdings 1, LLC; PubCo is the surviving company in the Acquisition Merger.
target: Swiss HoldCo, a Swiss company to be formed by Terra Quantum AG shareholders to hold their Terra Quantum AG shares.
consideration_type: Treatment of vested Company Virtual Share Awards in the Acquisition Merger: conversion into options to purchase PubCo ordinary shares under the PubCo Virtual Share Plan, unless the award holder elects PubCo ordinary shares instead. Assumed awards participate in the contingent PubCo ordinary-share earnout. Share delivery is subject to the stated withholding, costs and exercise-price terms.
stock_exchange_ratio: Default treatment: each Company Virtual Share Award converts into a number of Assumed Virtual Share Awards equal to the Exchange Ratio multiplied by 1.2, rounded down to the nearest whole share; each assumed award is exercisable for 1 PubCo ordinary share, net of stated shares sold or withheld. Elective treatment: PubCo ordinary shares equal to the number of virtual shares subject to the Company Virtual Share Award multiplied by the Exchange Ratio and 1.2, rounded down to the nearest whole share and net of stated shares sold or withheld. The Exchange Ratio is Price per Share divided by $10.00; Price per Share is $3,500,000,000 divided by fully diluted issued and outstanding Swiss HoldCo shares, including dilution from conversion of Company Virtual Share Awards and the Tax Election.
closing_conditions: The Acquisition Merger remains subject to SPAC, Company and Swiss HoldCo shareholder approvals; effectiveness of the Proxy/Registration Statement without an outstanding SEC stop order or proceeding; the specified Nasdaq listing approvals; absence of a material legal restraint; the specified combined-company D&O insurance; and SPAC’s receipt of an independent financial fairness opinion. The agreement also specifies Initial Closing conditions concerning the accuracy of representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, acquisition-entity and Swiss HoldCo joinders, Swiss HoldCo’s incorporation, executed senior-management employment agreements, and favorable Swiss tax rulings. Conditions may be waived as provided in the agreement. The Acquisition Closing follows the Initial Merger and satisfaction or waiver of applicable conditions. The parties’ efforts to obtain at least $30 million of PIPE investments or other financing are not stated as a closing condition.
event_status: Pending; the Business Combination Agreement was signed on 5/25/2026, and closing remains subject to shareholder approvals and other conditions.
security_description: Vested and outstanding Terra Quantum AG Company Virtual Share Awards under its phantom share plan; treated separately from Swiss HoldCo ordinary shares.
effective_date: Conditional: the Acquisition Merger becomes effective when it is registered with the respective Swiss commercial register. No calendar date or clock time is stated.
available_options: A holder of a Company Virtual Share Award may elect PubCo ordinary shares in lieu of an Assumed Virtual Share Award, subject to a shareholder-like lock-up and stated deductions. Otherwise, a vested outstanding award is assumed by PubCo and converted into an option to purchase PubCo ordinary shares under the PubCo Virtual Share Plan.
default_option: Absent the stated written election for PubCo ordinary shares, each vested and outstanding Company Virtual Share Award is assumed by PubCo and converted into an option to purchase PubCo ordinary shares under the PubCo Virtual Share Plan.
election_deadline: Written election delivered to the Company within 20 Business Days following the Company’s invitation to make the election, but in any case at least 10 Business Days before the Initial Closing.

acquirer: QXO, Inc.; Titanium MergerCo, Inc. is QXO's merger subsidiary for the first merger, and Titanium MergerCo 2, LLC is QXO's merger subsidiary and surviving company for the immediately following merger.
consideration_type: Elective consideration: eligible TopBuild common stockholders may elect cash or QXO common stock, subject to proration.
cash_consideration: Cash election: $505.00 in cash per TopBuild common share, without interest, subject to proration. Separately, cash is paid instead of any fractional QXO share otherwise issuable.
stock_exchange_ratio: Stock election: 20.200 shares of QXO common stock, par value $0.00001 per share, per 1 share of TopBuild common stock, par value $0.01 per share, subject to proration and equitable adjustment for specified share changes. No fractional QXO shares will be issued; cash will be paid instead.
shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled for 6/29/2026 at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time: QXO stockholders will vote on the QXO share issuance proposal, and TopBuild stockholders will vote on adoption of the merger agreement. Both meetings are virtual and may be adjourned or postponed.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver, as applicable: TopBuild stockholder approval by holders of a majority of outstanding TopBuild shares entitled to vote; QXO share issuance approval by a majority of votes cast by QXO voting stockholders present in person or by proxy; NYSE listing approval for QXO shares issued as stock consideration; expiration or termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period and Canadian antitrust clearance or expiration of the applicable Canadian waiting period; required consents, registrations, approvals, permits and authorizations; no effective legal restraint prohibiting the mergers; effectiveness of the Form S-4 without an SEC stop order or threatened or initiated stop-order proceeding; material compliance with covenants and accuracy of representations and warranties subject to specified qualifications; no material adverse effect on TopBuild or QXO since the merger agreement; and TopBuild's receipt of a qualifying-reorganization tax opinion. The filing states that the HSR waiting period expired on 5/26/2026 and that the Canadian Competition Bureau issued a no-action letter on 5/28/2026. Approval of the QXO charter amendment, TopBuild compensation proposal and either adjournment proposal is not a closing condition. QXO's obligation to complete the mergers is not conditioned on obtaining financing.
event_status: Pending proposed mergers under the merger agreement signed 4/18/2026; the filing does not state that the mergers have completed.
security_description: TopBuild Corp. common stock, par value $0.01 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the Titanium Merger effective time, other than specified excluded, cancelled and dissenting shares. TopBuild equity awards receive separately described treatment.
effective_date: No calendar effective date is stated. Each merger becomes effective when its certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed by QXO and TopBuild and specified in that certificate; the Titanium Merger must precede the Forward Merger. The mergers are expected to be completed during the third quarter of 2026, but the actual date cannot be predicted.
available_options: Eligible TopBuild common stockholders may elect either $505.00 cash per share, without interest, or 20.200 QXO common shares per TopBuild common share. Cash consideration is capped at 45% of outstanding TopBuild shares other than cancelled shares; stock consideration is initially capped at 55%, but QXO may increase, not decrease, that cap in its sole discretion if holders elect stock for more than 55% of eligible shares. Oversubscribed elections are prorated, so a holder may receive both forms. Elections require a properly completed election form and applicable transmittal materials by the election deadline; holders who submit valid elections cannot transfer the elected shares until closing or valid revocation.
default_option: Eligible TopBuild shares with no valid, timely election, or with an election revoked and not resubmitted by the deadline, are treated as having elected the stock consideration of 20.200 QXO shares per TopBuild share, subject to proration.
election_deadline: 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time on the business day five business days before the TopBuild stockholder meeting, or another date and time publicly announced by QXO with TopBuild's consent. If the meeting is delayed, the election deadline will be similarly delayed. A broker, bank, other nominee or plan trustee may set an earlier deadline for holders through it.

consideration_type: Stock. stock_exchange_ratio: For each 1 share of Mobilewalla Holdco, Inc. common stock eligible for exchange, a number of shares of SPACSphere Acquisition Corp. common stock equal to 25,000,000 divided by Company Fully Diluted Capital Stock. The per-share consideration is subject to equitable adjustment for specified changes to SPACSphere common stock before the merger becomes effective.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permissible written waiver at or before closing: Mobilewalla stockholder approval; SPACSphere shareholder approval of the required proposals; no effective governmental restraint making the transactions illegal or prohibiting them; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an effective stop order or unresolved SEC suspension proceeding; and conditional Nasdaq listing approval for the SPACSphere common stock and warrants to be issued. SPACSphere’s and Merger Sub’s additional conditions include specified accuracy of Mobilewalla representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, no Company Material Adverse Effect, closing certificates and ancillary agreements, no more than 5% dissenting Mobilewalla capital stock, delivery of audited financial statements, specified consents, conversion of Mobilewalla preferred stock and convertible notes and exercise or expiration of its warrants, and other specified closing deliverables. Mobilewalla’s additional conditions include specified accuracy of SPACSphere and Merger Sub representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, a closing certificate and ancillary agreements, adoption of the SPACSphere equity incentive plan, and the specified executive employment, registration rights, voting and lock-up agreements and charter and bylaws requirements.
event_status: Pending; the definitive business combination agreement was entered into on May 29, 2026, and the proposed merger remains subject to closing conditions.
security_description: Mobilewalla Holdco, Inc. common stock, par value $0.0001 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the merger becomes effective, including common shares resulting from conversion of its preferred stock and convertible notes and exercise of warrants. effective_date: Upon filing the certificate of merger with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed by the parties and specified in that certificate; no calendar date or clock time is stated. The filing is to occur at closing.
available_options: No holder election; eligible common shares receive the specified stock consideration, subject to the stated exclusions.

stock_exchange_ratio: No stock consideration for eligible shares of Organon common stock.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where legally permitted, waiver at or before closing: approval of the merger agreement by holders of a majority of outstanding Organon common shares entitled to vote; expiration or early termination of applicable HSR Act, specified other antitrust, foreign direct investment and EU foreign-subsidies waiting periods, and any applicable governmental timing-agreement waiting periods; and no effective legal prohibition. effective_date: At the date and time the certificate of merger is executed and filed with the Delaware Secretary of State on the closing date, or at a later date and time agreed by the parties in writing and specified in the filed certificate. No calendar effective date is stated.

acquirer: US Elemental Inc., through USE Merger Sub 2 Inc., which will become its wholly owned subsidiary before merging into HiTech Minerals Inc.
consideration_type: Stock.
stock_exchange_ratio: Each HiTech Minerals Inc. common share is exchanged for a number of US Elemental Inc. common shares equal to 50,000,000 divided by the aggregate number of HiTech common shares outstanding immediately before the Acquisition Merger becomes effective. HiTech common shareholders receive 50,000,000 US Elemental common shares in the aggregate. Treasury shares are excluded.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver where permitted: approval of the transaction by Constellation Acquisition Corp. I shareholders, Jindalee Lithium Limited shareholders and HiTech Minerals Inc.; effectiveness of the proxy/registration statement without an outstanding SEC stop order; conditional approval of US Elemental Inc.'s initial U.S. securities-exchange listing application and approval to list its common shares and public converted warrants; and no material legal restraint preventing either closing. The parties also have specified conditions concerning the accuracy of representations and warranties, performance of covenants and closing deliverables, and the absence of a continuing HiTech material adverse effect. HiTech may waive its $14,000,000 minimum cash condition, which must otherwise be met at the acquisition closing.
event_status: Pending; the Business Combination Agreement was entered into on April 9, 2026, and closing remained subject to conditions.
security_description: HiTech Minerals Inc. common stock, without par value; treasury shares have separate treatment.
effective_date: The Acquisition Merger will take effect when the Articles of Acquisition Merger are filed with the Nevada Secretary of State, or at a later time permitted by Nevada law that US Elemental Inc., USE Merger Sub 2 Inc. and HiTech Minerals Inc. agree to in writing and specify in the articles. It is to follow the Initial Merger and transfer of Merger Sub 2; no calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: No holder election for the stated common-share merger consideration.

acquirer: Hall Chadwick Acquisition Corp; its wholly owned subsidiary, HCAC Star Merger Sub, Inc., will merge into the target.
consideration_type: Stock; REEcycle common stockholders receive Domesticated HCAC common stock at the effective time and are eligible for additional stock if the Milestone Event occurs.
cash_consideration: No cash consideration at closing for REEcycle common stockholders.
stock_exchange_ratio: A number of shares of Domesticated HCAC common stock equal to the Exchange Ratio per 1 share of REEcycle common stock. The Exchange Ratio equals Aggregate Merger Consideration divided by REEcycle Fully Diluted Capital; Aggregate Merger Consideration equals ($400,000,000 divided by $10.00) minus 5,000,000 Earnout Shares. Eligible holders receive a pro rata share of the 5,000,000 Earnout Shares if the Milestone Event occurs. Fractional shares are rounded down.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or written waiver where permissible: approval by HCAC shareholders and REEcycle stockholders; no effective governmental law or order prohibiting the transactions; SEC effectiveness of the registration statement, without an effective stop order or pending or threatened SEC proceeding for one; and conditional Nasdaq listing approval for the Domesticated HCAC common stock, subject to sufficient round-lot holders. REEcycle’s additional conditions include accuracy of HCAC’s and Merger Sub’s representations and warranties, their material covenant compliance, no continuing HCAC Material Adverse Effect, completed domestication, availability of remaining trust proceeds after redemptions, Closing Aggregate Cash Amount of at least $40,000,000, and specified closing certificates and ancillary documents. HCAC’s and Merger Sub’s additional conditions include accuracy of REEcycle’s representations and warranties, its material covenant compliance, no continuing Company Material Adverse Effect, no liens materially impairing consummation, and specified closing certificates and the Registration Rights Agreement.
event_status: Pending; the Business Combination Agreement was entered into on May 31, 2026, and the merger remained subject to closing conditions.
security_description: REEcycle Holdings, Inc. common stock issued and outstanding immediately before the merger’s effective time. Shares held by HCAC, Merger Sub or REEcycle are cancelled without consideration; REEcycle options receive separate treatment.
effective_date: Conditionally, on the Closing Date upon filing the Certificate of Merger with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed in writing by REEcycle, Merger Sub and HCAC and specified in that certificate. No calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: No holder election; merger consideration for REEcycle common stock is fixed under the agreement, with additional stock contingent on the Milestone Event.

Ignite may waive its additional conditions, including the specified accuracy of SPAC's representations and warranties, material compliance by the SPAC parties with their pre-closing covenants, effectiveness of specified ancillary documents, required closing deliveries, and at least $15,000,000 in cash available from SPAC's trust after redemptions plus net proceeds of transaction financings conducted by SPAC. consideration_type: Stock or Pubco Common Stock Equivalents, at Ignite Proteomics, LLC's election before the Effective Time; this is a company election, not a holder election.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permissible written waiver by Copley and Ignite: requisite approvals of Copley's shareholders and Ignite's members; expiration or termination of applicable antitrust waiting periods; required governmental and specified third-party consents; no law or order prohibiting the transactions; appointment of the post-closing Pubco board; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without a stop order; completion of Copley's Delaware conversion; amendment and restatement of Pubco's certificate of incorporation; NYSE listing approval for Pubco Common Stock and Pubco Public Warrants; and adoption of Pubco's incentive plan. Ignite's additional waivable conditions include specified accuracy of SPAC-party representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, effectiveness of specified ancillary agreements, and at least $15,000,000 from cash available for release from Copley's trust account after redemptions plus net proceeds of transaction financings conducted by Copley. Copley's additional waivable conditions include specified accuracy of Ignite's representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, no material adverse effect on the target companies since signing, effectiveness of specified ancillary agreements, required employment agreements, at least $7,500,000 in net proceeds of transaction financings conducted by Ignite, satisfaction or agreed resolution of Ignite's indebtedness, and specified employee intellectual-property assignment agreements.
event_status: Announced; proposed and pending closing conditions.
security_description: Issued and outstanding membership interests of Ignite Proteomics, LLC, excluding interests held in its treasury or owned by its subsidiaries; unexercised or unconverted Company Convertible Securities are cancelled without a right to acquire membership interests.
effective_date: The Company Merger and SPAC Merger are to become effective simultaneously at 5:00 p.m. New York City time on the Closing Date, or at another date and/or time agreed in writing by Ignite and Copley and specified in both merger certificates; the Closing Date is not stated.
available_options: No holder election. Ignite Proteomics, LLC may elect, in its sole discretion before the Effective Time, to replace all or any number of Pubco Common Stock shares issuable to sellers with the same number of Pubco Common Stock Equivalents: either prefunded warrants to purchase Pubco Common Stock or preferred shares convertible one-for-one into Pubco Common Stock. The total number of shares and equivalents issued may not exceed the shares otherwise constituting the Merger Consideration.

cash_consideration: Cash election: US$13.80 per share of RE/MAX Holdings, Inc. Class A common stock, without interest, subject to proration and the $60 million minimum and $80 million maximum aggregate cash proceeds. Cash is paid separately in lieu of fractional New Wildlife shares.
stock_exchange_ratio: Stock election: 5.150 shares of Rome Wildlife, Inc. common stock per 1 share of RE/MAX Holdings, Inc. Class A common stock before Real’s 10-for-1 share consolidation; the ratio is adjusted by dividing 5.150 by 10, to 0.5150 New Wildlife share per REMAX Class A share, before the First Merger Effective Time. Subject to cash-election proration; fractional New Wildlife shares are paid in cash instead.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted waiver of: the required Real securityholder vote approving the Arrangement Resolution—at least 66⅔% of votes cast by Real shareholders and at least 66⅔% of votes cast by Real shareholders, optionholders and RSU holders voting together; the required REMAX stockholder votes adopting the merger agreement and approving the RIHI-related share issuance; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement; Nasdaq listing approval for New Wildlife common stock; expiration or termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period; absence of specified legal restraints or burdensome regulatory conditions; the British Columbia court’s Interim and Final Orders; consummation of the RIHI merger; and the RIHI tax receivable agreement termination amendment remaining in force. Each party also has conditions concerning the other party’s representations and warranties, material covenant compliance and absence of a material adverse effect. Real’s obligation is conditioned on receipt of the Willkie tax opinion, and REMAX’s on receipt of the Morrison Foerster tax opinion. Receipt of financing is not a closing condition.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement dated April 26, 2026 was amended June 12, 2026.
security_description: RE/MAX Holdings, Inc. Class A common stock, par value $0.0001 per share, including Class A shares issued in the RIHI merger. Treasury shares, shares owned by specified transaction parties and dissenting shares are excluded from the ordinary election consideration; the sole outstanding REMAX Class B share is to be surrendered and cancelled in connection with the RIHI merger for no consideration.
effective_date: Pending. The First Merger takes effect upon filing its certificate of merger with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time mutually agreed by Real and REMAX in writing and specified in the certificate. The Second Merger takes effect upon filing its certificate of merger, or at a similarly agreed later time; it is to occur as soon as practicable after the First Merger and on the same day. The transactions were expected to be completed during the second half of 2026, but no actual effective date is stated.
available_options: Eligible REMAX Class A holders may elect either New Wildlife common stock at the adjusted 0.5150-for-1 ratio or US$13.80 cash per share. If aggregate cash elections exceed $80 million, cash electing shares receive prorated cash plus stock; if they total less than $60 million, stock electing shares receive some cash plus stock. A valid election requires a properly completed and signed REMAX Election Form, including executed transmittal materials, received by the exchange agent before the deadline. Beneficial holders should follow their intermediary’s instructions.
default_option: Shares for which no properly completed election form is submitted by the deadline, or for which an election is revoked before the deadline, are treated as stock elections, subject to proration that may allocate cash if aggregate cash elections are below $60 million.
election_deadline: 5:00 p.m. Mountain time on the date Real and REMAX agree is as near as practicable to three business days before closing, or another date they agree. No calendar date is stated.

effective_date: Not specified as a calendar date. available_options: No holder election for NSA common shareholders; each eligible outstanding common share is converted into the specified Public Storage common-share consideration, with cash instead of any fractional share.

acquirer: Public Storage, a Maryland real estate investment trust; its wholly owned direct subsidiary Pelican Merger Sub I, LLC will be the surviving company in the company merger.
target: National Storage Affiliates Trust, a Maryland real estate investment trust
consideration_type: Stock: one newly issued Public Storage Series T preferred share for each NSA Series A preferred share.
cash_consideration: No cash merger consideration is specified for an NSA Series A preferred share.
stock_exchange_ratio: 1 newly issued Public Storage 6.000% Cumulative Preferred Share, Series T, par value $0.01 per share, per 1 NSA 6.000% Series A cumulative redeemable preferred share of beneficial interest, par value $0.01 per share; the new series has materially unchanged terms.
shareholder_vote_date: National Storage Affiliates Trust common shareholders: special meeting scheduled for 7/14/2026 at 10:00 a.m., Mountain Daylight Time, virtually. NSA preferred shareholders may attend but cannot vote on the proposals.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or legally permissible waiver: approval by NSA common shareholders entitled to cast a majority of all votes on the Merger Proposal; the requisite NSA OP unitholder consent; effectiveness of the Form S-4 without an effective stop order or unwithdrawn SEC proceeding seeking one; absence of a law, order or other legal restraint prohibiting the mergers; NYSE listing approval for the Public Storage common shares and Series T and Series U preferred shares to be issued; specified accuracy of each side’s representations and warranties, material compliance with its obligations, and absence of a continuing company or parent material adverse effect; closing-date certificates and specified REIT-status and Section 368(a) tax opinions; formation of the Dropdown JV before the company merger and completion of each special redemption, with redemption units equal to the JV interest amount, before the partnership merger. The transactions are not conditioned on financing.
event_status: Announced and pending; the NSA board approved the merger agreement, but shareholder and unitholder approvals and other closing conditions remained required.
security_description: National Storage Affiliates Trust 6.000% Series A cumulative redeemable preferred shares of beneficial interest, par value $0.01 per share.
effective_date: Not specified as a calendar date. The company merger is to become effective when Maryland accepts the articles of merger for record, or at another date and time mutually agreed by NSA and Public Storage and specified in those articles. The parties intend the effective time to occur on the closing date, immediately before the Dropdown JV contribution. The mergers were expected to close in the third quarter of 2026, subject to closing conditions.
available_options: No holder election; each eligible outstanding NSA Series A preferred share is converted into one newly issued Public Storage Series T preferred share.
default_option: No holder election; each eligible outstanding NSA Series A preferred share is automatically converted into the right to receive one newly issued Public Storage Series T preferred share.

acquirer: Public Storage, a Maryland real estate investment trust; Pelican Merger Sub II, LLC, its indirect subsidiary, will merge into the target partnership.
target: NSA OP, LP, a Delaware limited partnership; it will survive the partnership merger as an indirect subsidiary of Public Storage.
consideration_type: Elective consideration for eligible accredited-investor NSA OP unitholders: Public Storage OP common units or, through the special redemption before the partnership merger, interests in an Aggregator holding Dropdown JV units. Non-accredited-investor NSA OP units receive cash instead of Public Storage OP units.
cash_consideration: Each non-accredited-investor NSA OP unit issued and outstanding immediately before the partnership merger effective time is converted into cash, without interest, equal to 0.1400 multiplied by the volume-weighted average of Public Storage common-share closing prices over the 10 full consecutive trading days ending on and including the third business day before closing. The special redemption may also include cash in lieu of fractional or de minimis interests; no amount for that incidental cash is specified.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each eligible, non-elected NSA OP Class A unit issued and outstanding immediately before the partnership merger effective time, 0.1400 newly issued common units of Public Storage OP, L.P. Accredited-investor limited partners may instead have some or all NSA OP units redeemed before the merger, one-for-one for Aggregator common membership interests corresponding to Dropdown JV units, subject to allocation or proration to the $800 million JV interest amount. Redeemed units receive no partnership merger consideration; non-accredited-investor units receive cash rather than Public Storage OP units. The 0.1400 ratio is subject to specified merger-agreement adjustments.
shareholder_vote_date: National Storage Affiliates Trust common shareholders: special meeting scheduled for 7/14/2026 at 10:00 a.m., Mountain Daylight Time, virtually. NSA OP unitholder approval is to be sought by written consent no later than that meeting; no specific consent date is stated.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or legally permissible waiver: approval by NSA common shareholders entitled to cast a majority of all votes on the Merger Proposal; the requisite NSA OP unitholder consent; effectiveness of the Form S-4 without an effective stop order or unwithdrawn SEC proceeding seeking one; absence of a law, order or other legal restraint prohibiting the mergers; NYSE listing approval for the Public Storage common shares and Series T and Series U preferred shares to be issued in the company merger; specified accuracy of each side’s representations and warranties, material compliance with its obligations, and absence of a continuing company or parent material adverse effect; closing-date certificates and specified REIT-status and Section 368(a) tax opinions; formation of the Dropdown JV before the company merger and completion of each special redemption, with redemption units equal to the JV interest amount, before the partnership merger. The transactions are not conditioned on financing.
event_status: Announced and pending; the NSA board approved the merger agreement, but shareholder and unitholder approvals and other closing conditions remained required.
security_description: Class A units of limited partnership interest in NSA OP, LP (NSA OP units). Accredited-investor units may participate in the special redemption; non-elected accredited-investor units and non-accredited-investor units have different partnership-merger treatment. Eligible NSA OP LTIP units will vest and convert into NSA OP units before the partnership merger, except specified 2026 performance-based units cancelled without consideration.
effective_date: Not specified as a calendar date. The partnership merger is to become effective when the merger certificate is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at another date and time mutually agreed by NSA and Public Storage and specified in that certificate. The parties intend that effective time to occur on the closing date after the company merger, Dropdown JV contribution and financing, and immediately after the special redemption. The mergers were expected to close in the third quarter of 2026, subject to closing conditions.
available_options: For accredited-investor limited partners of NSA OP: (1) retain non-elected NSA OP units for conversion into 0.1400 newly issued Public Storage OP common units per NSA OP unit; or (2) elect to redeem some or all units immediately before the partnership merger, one-for-one for Aggregator common membership interests corresponding to Dropdown JV units, potentially with cash in lieu of fractional or de minimis interests. The Aggregator will hold 80% of the Dropdown JV units. Participation is subject to allocation or proration to the $800 million JV interest amount; units of eligible holders who did not elect may also be redeemed if elections fall short. Non-accredited-investor units are converted into formula-based cash rather than Public Storage OP units.
default_option: Failure to deliver a timely special-redemption election is deemed an election not to participate indirectly in the special redemption. Subject to possible additional redemption of eligible non-elected units if elections fall short of the JV interest amount, an accredited investor’s non-elected NSA OP unit converts into 0.1400 Public Storage OP common units. A non-accredited-investor NSA OP unit converts into formula-based cash.

acquirer: Public Storage, a Maryland real estate investment trust; Pelican Merger Sub II, LLC, its indirect subsidiary, will merge into the target partnership.
target: NSA OP, LP, a Delaware limited partnership; it will survive the partnership merger as an indirect subsidiary of Public Storage.
consideration_type: Stock or partnership equity: one newly issued preferred unit of Public Storage OP, L.P. in the corresponding class or series for each outstanding NSA OP preferred unit.
cash_consideration: No cash merger consideration is specified for an NSA OP preferred unit.
stock_exchange_ratio: 1 newly issued Public Storage OP preferred partnership unit of the corresponding class or series per 1 outstanding NSA OP preferred unit of that class or series; the new units have materially unchanged rights, preferences, privileges and voting powers.
shareholder_vote_date: National Storage Affiliates Trust common shareholders: special meeting scheduled for 7/14/2026 at 10:00 a.m., Mountain Daylight Time, virtually. NSA OP unitholder approval is to be sought by written consent no later than that meeting; no specific consent date is stated.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or legally permissible waiver: approval by NSA common shareholders entitled to cast a majority of all votes on the Merger Proposal; the requisite NSA OP unitholder consent; effectiveness of the Form S-4 without an effective stop order or unwithdrawn SEC proceeding seeking one; absence of a law, order or other legal restraint prohibiting the mergers; NYSE listing approval for the Public Storage common shares and Series T and Series U preferred shares to be issued in the company merger; specified accuracy of each side’s representations and warranties, material compliance with its obligations, and absence of a continuing company or parent material adverse effect; closing-date certificates and specified REIT-status and Section 368(a) tax opinions; formation of the Dropdown JV before the company merger and completion of each special redemption, with redemption units equal to the JV interest amount, before the partnership merger. The transactions are not conditioned on financing.
event_status: Announced and pending; the NSA board approved the merger agreement, but shareholder and unitholder approvals and other closing conditions remained required.
security_description: Each outstanding preferred unit of NSA OP, LP, in its applicable class or series.
effective_date: Not specified as a calendar date. The partnership merger is to become effective when the merger certificate is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at another date and time mutually agreed by NSA and Public Storage and specified in that certificate. The parties intend that effective time to occur on the closing date after the company merger, Dropdown JV contribution and financing, and immediately after the special redemption. The mergers were expected to close in the third quarter of 2026, subject to closing conditions.
available_options: No holder election; each outstanding NSA OP preferred unit is converted into one newly issued Public Storage OP preferred unit of the corresponding class or series.
default_option: No holder election; each outstanding NSA OP preferred unit is automatically cancelled and converted into one newly issued Public Storage OP preferred unit of the corresponding class or series.

acquirer: Mountain Holding, Inc. (New Equitable); its wholly owned subsidiary Marcy Holding, Inc. is Equitable Merger Sub.
consideration_type: Stock; incidental cash is payable only in lieu of fractional shares.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration is stated for eligible Equitable common shares. Cash is payable only in lieu of fractional New Equitable common shares, based on the stated post-closing volume-weighted average price formula.
stock_exchange_ratio: Fixed ratio of 1.55516 shares of Mountain Holding, Inc. (New Equitable) common stock per 1 eligible share of Equitable Holdings, Inc. common stock, subject to the stated equitable adjustments to prevent dilution. No fractional shares will be issued.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver: adoption of the merger agreement by the requisite majorities of Corebridge and Equitable common stockholders; NYSE listing approval for New Equitable common stock and Series 1-A and Series 1-C preferred stock; requisite regulatory approvals and waiting-period expiration, with the HSR waiting period reported expired on June 5, 2026 and FINRA membership-continuance approval reported received on June 8, 2026; absence of applicable governmental restraints; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an operative SEC stop order or proceeding; each party’s receipt of a satisfactory Section 351 tax opinion; consent of Equitable clients representing at least 75% of the specified annualized recurring fees; the other party’s representations and warranties meeting the stated accuracy standards, material compliance with merger-agreement obligations, no continuing material adverse effect, and the required officer certificate. Additional stated conditions address representations and material covenant compliance by New Equitable and the merger subsidiaries. The parties waived the NYSE listing condition for Series 2 New Equitable preferred stock.
event_status: Pending as described in the June 15, 2026 preliminary S-4/A; the mergers had not been reported completed.
security_description: Eligible issued and outstanding Equitable Holdings, Inc. common stock, par value $0.01 per share; excludes specified company-owned or treasury shares, subject to stated benefit-plan, third-party and fund exceptions, and outstanding performance share units granted under an Equitable stock plan.
effective_date: Immediately following consummation of the Corebridge Merger, on the closing date when the Equitable certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed by Corebridge and Equitable and specified in that certificate; no calendar date is stated.
available_options: No holder election; eligible shares are converted at the fixed stock exchange ratio.

The HSR filings and Indian approval application had been submitted, but the filing does not state that the required waiting period or Indian approval had been satisfied.

acquirer: Mountain Holding, Inc. (New Equitable), the parent company; its merger subsidiary Palisade Holding, Inc. will merge with Corebridge Financial, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock; eligible common shares receive New Equitable common stock, with incidental cash instead of fractional shares.
cash_consideration: No regular cash price per Corebridge common share is stated. Cash in lieu of any fractional New Equitable common share equals the fractional share interest multiplied by the stated New Equitable common-stock volume-weighted average price calculated on the first business day immediately following closing, rounded to the nearest cent and without interest.
stock_exchange_ratio: 1.000 shares of New Equitable common stock per 1 eligible share of Corebridge common stock. The ratio is fixed, subject to the merger agreement’s equitable adjustment for specified share changes; no fractional shares will be issued.
shareholder_vote_date: Corebridge common stockholders’ special meeting is scheduled virtually for 7/30/2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time. Equitable common stockholders’ separate special meeting is scheduled virtually for the same date and time.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted waiver: requisite approval by both Corebridge and Equitable common stockholders; NYSE listing approval for New Equitable common stock and Series 1-A and Series 1-C preferred stock; requisite regulatory approvals, including the HSR waiting period, specified insurance approvals and other domestic and foreign approvals; no applicable governmental restraint; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an operative stop order or proceeding; tax opinions that the mergers together qualify under Section 351; and consent from Equitable clients representing at least 75% of the specified annualized fees. Each party also has conditions concerning the other party’s representations and warranties, material compliance with obligations, no continuing material adverse effect and an officer’s certificate. Additional conditions apply to Corebridge and the merger subsidiaries. The HSR waiting period expired on 6/5/2026, FINRA membership-continuance approval was received on 6/8/2026, and the Series 2 preferred-stock NYSE listing condition was waived on 4/14/2026. Obtaining debt financing is not a closing condition.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was executed and announced on 3/26/2026. Closing is expected by year-end 2026 but is not assured.
security_description: Corebridge Financial, Inc. common stock, par value $0.01 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the Corebridge merger effective time, excluding specified shares owned by the transaction parties or their wholly owned subsidiaries or held in treasury; the exclusion does not include specified benefit-plan, third-party or fund-held shares.
effective_date: Not specified as a calendar date. The Corebridge merger becomes legally effective when its certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed by Corebridge and Equitable and specified in that certificate. Filing is to occur on the closing date immediately after closing; the Equitable merger takes effect afterward.
available_options: No holder election; each eligible Corebridge common share is converted into the fixed stock consideration, with cash only in lieu of a fractional share.

acquirer: Mountain Holding, Inc. (New Equitable), the parent company; its merger subsidiary Marcy Holding, Inc. will merge with Equitable Holdings, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock; eligible common shares receive New Equitable common stock, with incidental cash instead of fractional shares.
cash_consideration: No regular cash price per Equitable common share is stated. Cash in lieu of any fractional New Equitable common share equals the fractional share interest multiplied by the stated New Equitable common-stock volume-weighted average price calculated on the first business day immediately following closing, rounded to the nearest cent and without interest.
stock_exchange_ratio: 1.55516 shares of New Equitable common stock per 1 eligible share of Equitable common stock. The ratio is fixed, subject to the merger agreement’s equitable adjustment for specified share changes; no fractional shares will be issued.
shareholder_vote_date: Equitable common stockholders’ special meeting is scheduled virtually for 7/30/2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time. Corebridge common stockholders’ separate special meeting is scheduled virtually for the same date and time.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted waiver: requisite approval by both Equitable and Corebridge common stockholders; NYSE listing approval for New Equitable common stock and Series 1-A and Series 1-C preferred stock; requisite regulatory approvals, including the HSR waiting period, specified insurance approvals and other domestic and foreign approvals; no applicable governmental restraint; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an operative stop order or proceeding; tax opinions that the mergers together qualify under Section 351; and consent from Equitable clients representing at least 75% of the specified annualized fees. Each party also has conditions concerning the other party’s representations and warranties, material compliance with obligations, no continuing material adverse effect and an officer’s certificate. Additional conditions apply to Corebridge and the merger subsidiaries. The HSR waiting period expired on 6/5/2026, FINRA membership-continuance approval was received on 6/8/2026, and the Series 2 preferred-stock NYSE listing condition was waived on 4/14/2026. Obtaining debt financing is not a closing condition.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was executed and announced on 3/26/2026. Closing is expected by year-end 2026 but is not assured.
security_description: Equitable Holdings, Inc. common stock, par value $0.01 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the Equitable merger effective time, excluding specified shares owned by the transaction parties or their wholly owned subsidiaries or held in treasury; the exclusion does not include specified benefit-plan, third-party or fund-held shares. Outstanding Equitable performance share units receive separate equity-award treatment.
effective_date: Not specified as a calendar date. The Equitable merger becomes legally effective when its certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed by Corebridge and Equitable and specified in that certificate. Filing is to occur on the closing date immediately after closing; its effective time must follow the Corebridge merger effective time.
available_options: No holder election; each eligible Equitable common share is converted into the fixed stock consideration, with cash only in lieu of a fractional share.

shareholder_vote_date: Corebridge common stockholders: special meeting scheduled for 7/30/2026 at 10:00 a.m., Eastern Time.

Party-specific conditions include the other party’s representations and warranties meeting the agreement’s applicable standards, material compliance with obligations, no continuing material adverse effect on the other party, and a confirming officer certificate. The HSR waiting period expired on 6/5/2026, and specified FINRA membership-continuance approval was received on 6/8/2026. Obtaining debt financing is expressly not a closing condition.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was executed and the transaction announced on 3/26/2026, and the filing describes stockholder votes and closing as future events.

effective_date: Not specified as a calendar date or time. available_options: No holder election; eligible Corebridge common shares are converted into the fixed stock consideration, with cash only in lieu of fractional shares.

acquirer: Akzo Nobel N.V. (AkzoNobel), the acquiring parent; its wholly owned Bermuda subsidiaries Merger Sub and Merger Sub 2 carry out the two mergers.
consideration_type: Stock; eligible Axalta common shares convert into the right to receive AkzoNobel ordinary shares. Cash is payable only in lieu of fractional shares. AkzoNobel’s pre-completion cash distribution is payable to AkzoNobel shareholders, not as consideration for Axalta common shares.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration per Axalta common share is specified. For a fractional AkzoNobel ordinary share, the holder receives cash, at MergeCo’s election, either equal to the fraction multiplied by the average AkzoNobel ordinary-share closing price on Euronext Amsterdam over the five consecutive trading days ending immediately before the completion date, rounded to the nearest cent and without interest, or a proportionate share of the proceeds from the exchange agent’s sale of aggregated fractional shares.
stock_exchange_ratio: 0.6539 AkzoNobel ordinary shares, par value €0.50 each, per 1 Axalta common share, par value $1.00 each. The ratio may be equitably adjusted for specified share reclassifications, recapitalizations, splits, combinations, exchanges, readjustments, stock dividends or securities distributions between signing and the effective time. No fractional AkzoNobel ordinary shares will be issued; cash will be paid in lieu.
shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled: Axalta shareholders’ special general meeting on 8/5/2026 at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time, unless adjourned or postponed. The filing also describes AkzoNobel shareholder approval as expected on 8/5/2026, but does not state a time for that meeting.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted waiver of conditions including: required regulatory clearances and waiting-period expirations or terminations, including U.S., EU and U.K. merger control and specified foreign investment and subsidy filings, without materially burdensome remedies; adoption of the Axalta merger proposal and AkzoNobel completion proposals; effectiveness of the Form F-4 without a stop order or pending SEC proceeding; public availability of the required EU listing document; NYSE listing authorization for the shares issuable in the merger; declaration and payment of AkzoNobel’s pre-completion distribution; absence of specified legal prohibitions and insolvency proceedings; accuracy of each party’s representations and warranties subject to specified qualifications, material covenant compliance, and absence of a material adverse effect on either party. AkzoNobel’s central works council consultation was completed in December 2025. The filing specifies which conditions may be waived by AkzoNobel, by Axalta or jointly; AkzoNobel may waive the distribution condition alone in the stated fiduciary-duty circumstances. Financing is discussed but is not listed as a closing condition.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was signed on 11/18/2025 and amended on 5/27/2026. Shareholder votes and other closing conditions remained prospective in the proxy statement.
security_description: Issued Axalta Coating Systems Ltd. common shares, par value $1.00 per share, other than Axalta treasury shares and shares owned by AkzoNobel or its specified subsidiaries, which are cancelled without consideration. Dissenting shares convert into the merger consideration, subject to potential additional cash if their court-appraised fair value exceeds the consideration paid.
effective_date: No calendar effective date is stated. The first merger becomes effective when the Bermuda Registrar of Companies issues its certificate of merger, or at another date and time stated in that certificate. The second merger becomes effective when its separate certificate is issued, or at another date and time stated in that certificate.
available_options: No holder election. Eligible Axalta common shares receive the fixed stock exchange ratio, with cash in lieu of fractional shares. MergeCo, rather than holders, chooses between the two stated methods of calculating fractional-share cash.

acquirer: Global Net Lease Operating Partnership, L.P., through its wholly owned subsidiary GNL Motion OpCo Merger Sub, LLC (OpCo Merger Sub), which will merge into the target.
target: Modiv Operating Partnership, LP, which will survive the OpCo Merger.
consideration_type: Units of limited partnership interest in Global Net Lease Operating Partnership, L.P. for Modiv Operating Partnership Class C Units, with cash in lieu of fractional GNL OP Units; excluded units receive no consideration.
cash_consideration: No stated cash price per Modiv Operating Partnership Class C Unit. Cash is payable only in lieu of fractional GNL OP Units, without interest; excluded units receive no consideration.
stock_exchange_ratio: 1.975 GNL Operating Partnership limited partnership units designated as OP Units per 1 Modiv Operating Partnership Class C Unit. The ratio is fixed with respect to stock-price changes but may be equitably adjusted for specified changes in capitalization. No fractional OP Units will be issued; cash will be paid instead.
shareholder_vote_date: Modiv Industrial, Inc. common stockholders’ Special Meeting to approve the Modiv Merger and other transactions under the Merger Agreement is scheduled for 8/10/2026 at 12:00 p.m. Mountain Time, virtually; the meeting may be adjourned or postponed. Modiv Operating Partnership unitholders do not vote on the Mergers.
closing_conditions: The OpCo Merger is part of the Mergers, whose completion is subject to satisfaction or, where legally permissible, waiver of: approval of the Modiv Merger by holders of Modiv common stock entitled to cast a majority of all votes entitled to be cast; SEC effectiveness of GNL’s Form S-4 registration statement, with no stop order or pending or threatened-in-writing stop-order proceeding; no effective governmental law or order making the Mergers illegal or restricting, preventing or prohibiting them; and NYSE listing authorization for the GNL common shares to be issued, subject to official notice of issuance. Additional party-specific conditions include specified accuracy of representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants and obligations, no applicable material adverse effect, closing certificates, opinions regarding Modiv’s and GNL’s REIT qualification, and opinions that the Modiv Merger qualifies as a reorganization under Section 368(a) of the Internal Revenue Code. Completion is not subject to a financing condition or GNL stockholder approval.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was executed on 5/3/2026, and completion remains subject to conditions, including Modiv common stockholder approval.
security_description: Issued and outstanding Class C limited partnership units in Modiv Operating Partnership, LP, other than Excluded Units. Class X Units that vest and convert one-for-one into Class C Units immediately before the OpCo Merger Effective Time are addressed separately.
effective_date: Not specified as a calendar date. On the Closing Date, contemporaneously with or immediately following the Modiv Merger effective time, the OpCo Merger becomes effective upon filing its Delaware certificate of merger, or at a later date and time mutually agreed by GNL and Modiv and specified in that certificate. The parties anticipate completing the Mergers in the third quarter of 2026, without guarantee.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Modiv Operating Partnership Class C Units convert into the stated GNL OP Units, with cash in lieu of fractional units.

consideration_type: Units of limited partnership interest in Global Net Lease Operating Partnership, L.P. following full vesting and one-for-one conversion of Modiv Operating Partnership Class X Units into Class C Units; cash is payable in lieu of fractional GNL OP Units. cash_consideration: No stated cash price per Modiv Operating Partnership Class X Unit. After each eligible Class X Unit converts into one Class C Unit, cash is payable only in lieu of fractional GNL OP Units, without interest; excluded units receive no consideration.
stock_exchange_ratio: Each outstanding Modiv Operating Partnership Class X Unit vests in full and converts into 1 Modiv Operating Partnership Class C Unit immediately before the OpCo Merger effective time. closing_conditions: The OpCo Merger is part of the Mergers, whose completion is subject to satisfaction or, where legally permissible, waiver of: approval of the Modiv Merger by holders of Modiv common stock entitled to cast a majority of all votes entitled to be cast; SEC effectiveness of GNL’s Form S-4 registration statement, with no stop order or pending or threatened-in-writing stop-order proceeding; no effective governmental law or order making the Mergers illegal or restricting, preventing or prohibiting them; and NYSE listing authorization for the GNL common shares to be issued, subject to official notice of issuance. effective_date: Not specified as a calendar date. Class X Units vest and convert immediately before the OpCo Merger effective time. acquirer: Somnigroup International Inc.; Sparrow Unity Corporation is its direct, wholly owned merger subsidiary.
consideration_type: Stock; cash is payable only in lieu of fractional shares. A separate special cash dividend is payable to Leggett & Platt shareholders immediately before the merger becomes effective only if the specified U.S. federal competition-law proceeding occurs and the merger closes afterward.
cash_consideration: No cash consideration is payable in exchange for Leggett & Platt common stock, other than cash in lieu of fractional Somnigroup common shares. For that fractional-share payment, the exchange agent will sell excess whole shares on the NYSE and allocate the proceeds in proportion to each holder’s fractional interest. Separately, if the specified DOJ or FTC proceeding begins and the merger closes afterward, Leggett & Platt will pay a special dividend to holders immediately before the merger becomes effective. Its aggregate amount equals 6% of the 30-trading-day volume-weighted average price of Leggett & Platt common stock ending immediately before closing, multiplied by the number of Leggett & Platt common shares outstanding immediately before the merger becomes effective, multiplied by the number of calendar days from commencement of the proceeding through closing divided by 365. No special dividend is payable if the merger does not close, no such proceeding begins, or closing occurs on or before its commencement.
stock_exchange_ratio: Fixed ratio of 0.1455 shares of Somnigroup International Inc. common stock, par value $0.01 per share, per 1 share of Leggett & Platt, Incorporated common stock, par value $0.01 per share. The ratio is not adjusted for market-price changes but is subject to equitable adjustment for specified stock splits, stock dividends, reclassifications, distributions or similar changes before the merger becomes effective. No fractional Somnigroup shares will be issued; cash will be paid in lieu.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where legally permissible, waiver: approval of the merger agreement by holders of at least two-thirds of the outstanding Leggett & Platt common shares entitled to vote; absence of specified governmental orders, actions or laws restraining, prohibiting or making the merger illegal; expiration or termination of applicable HSR waiting periods and specified competition-law delay commitments, plus required competition-law filings, clearances or waiting-period expirations; NYSE approval of the Somnigroup shares to be issued, subject to official notice of issuance; and SEC effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an outstanding stop order or unwithdrawn proceeding for one. Each party’s obligation is also conditioned on the other party’s representations and warranties meeting the applicable contractual accuracy standards, material compliance with its covenants, absence of the other party’s material adverse effect, and delivery of the specified officer’s certificate. Leggett & Platt’s obligation additionally requires its written tax counsel opinion that the merger will qualify for the intended tax treatment. The U.S. HSR waiting period expired on 6/3/2026; the filing states that clearance or expiration of waiting periods in certain other jurisdictions remains required. Financing is expressly not a closing condition.
event_status: Pending as described in the registration statement filed 6/24/2026; the merger agreement was executed on 4/13/2026. The U.S. HSR waiting period has expired, but the merger remains subject to shareholder approval and other closing conditions.
security_description: Leggett & Platt, Incorporated common stock, par value $0.01 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the merger becomes effective, excluding shares cancelled under the merger agreement and dissenting shares. Outstanding restricted shares vest immediately before the merger becomes effective and then receive the same merger consideration.
effective_date: Not specified. default_option: Eligible outstanding Leggett & Platt common shares are automatically converted into the right to receive the fixed merger consideration without holder action; no consideration election is described. Cancelled shares and dissenting shares are excluded.

acquirer: Churchill Capital Corp XI, through its direct, wholly-owned subsidiary BLB Merger Sub, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock; each eligible share of Agility Robotics, Inc. common stock converts into the right to receive Churchill Capital Corp XI common stock. Excluded shares receive no consideration, and dissenting shares are treated separately.
cash_consideration: No cash consideration to existing Agility Robotics shareholders; the merger consideration is stock. The agreement rounds fractional stock entitlements to the nearest whole share rather than providing cash for fractions.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each 1 share of Agility Robotics, Inc. common stock outstanding immediately before the merger effective time, after the specified conversions, the holder receives a number of shares of Churchill Capital Corp XI common stock equal to the Exchange Ratio: Per Share Equity Value divided by the SPAC Stockholder Redemption Per Share Price. Per Share Equity Value equals ($2,500,000,000 plus the aggregate exercise price of outstanding Company Options) divided by Company Total Shares, as defined in the merger agreement. The redemption price is the amount payable from Churchill's trust account for each eligible share tendered for redemption. The agreement provides for equitable adjustments upon specified changes in share capitalization; each holder's aggregate fractional share entitlement is rounded to the nearest whole share, with 0.5 or greater rounded up.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or legally permitted waiver: expiration or termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period; absence of a governmental order or law preventing or materially restraining the transactions; approval of the SPAC Stockholder Matters by Churchill shareholders and approval of the merger agreement by Agility stockholders; adoption or execution of required governance arrangements and appointment of the contemplated post-closing board; listing of the contemplated common shares on Nasdaq and eligibility for continued listing; and effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an SEC stop order or threatened or initiated action seeking one. Churchill's additional conditions include the specified accuracy of Agility's representations and warranties, material compliance with Agility's covenants, no continuing Material Adverse Effect affecting Agility, delivery of an officer's certificate, expiration of the appraisal-rights deadline, and holders of no more than 5% of Agility stock on an as-converted basis beneficially owning dissenting shares at closing. Agility's additional conditions include the specified accuracy of the SPAC parties' representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, no continuing SPAC Material Adverse Effect, Available Closing SPAC Cash of at least $200,000,000, completed Domestication with delivery of the specified Delaware charter copy, delivery of an officer's certificate, and material performance of the Sponsor Agreement covenants without the specified threats to its validity or continuation.
event_status: Announced and pending; the parties entered into a definitive merger agreement on June 24, 2026, and closing remained subject to approvals and other conditions described in the filing.
security_description: Agility Robotics, Inc. common stock, par value $0.0001 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the merger effective time after conversion of Agility preferred stock, SAFEs and applicable bridge-financing securities; excludes treasury or company/acquirer-owned shares and dissenting shares. Outstanding Agility options are assumed and converted into options rather than exchanged for ordinary share consideration.
effective_date: The merger is to become legally effective when the Certificate of Merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State on the Closing Date, or at a later time agreed by Agility Robotics, Inc. and Churchill Capital Corp XI and specified in that certificate. No calendar date or time is stated for legal effectiveness.
available_options: No holder election; each eligible Agility common share is exchanged for stock under the stated Exchange Ratio, subject to the separate treatment of excluded and dissenting shares.

consideration_type: Stock; cash is payable only in lieu of fractional Equity Residential common shares.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration per share is stated. Holders who would otherwise receive a fractional Equity Residential common share will receive, without interest, their proportionate share of the net proceeds from the Exchange Agent’s sale of aggregated fractional shares.

No fractional Equity Residential common shares will be issued; cash will be paid in lieu.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver where permitted by law: approval of the Equity Residential share issuance by its shareholders and approval of the merger by AvalonBay stockholders; no law or governmental order making the merger illegal or prohibiting it; SEC effectiveness of the Form S-4, with no effective stop order or pending, unwithdrawn stop-order proceeding; and approval of the merger shares for NYSE listing, subject to official notice of issuance. security_description: Eligible outstanding shares of AvalonBay Communities, Inc. common stock, par value $0.01 per share. Shares held in treasury or held or owned by AvalonBay, Equity Residential or Canopy Merger Sub LLC immediately before the effective time will be cancelled without consideration.
effective_date: Not specified. acquirer: Angel Studios, Inc.; Angel TCP Merger Sub, LLC is its wholly owned merger subsidiary and will be the surviving entity.
consideration_type: Stock; TCP unitholders receive Angel Studios, Inc. Class A Common Stock, subject to the merger agreement's consideration calculation.
cash_consideration: No cash consideration payable to TCP unitholders.
stock_exchange_ratio: Each outstanding TCP Common Unit, Class A Preferred Unit and Class B Preferred Unit converts into the right to receive a portion of the aggregate Angel Studios, Inc. Class A Common Stock consideration equal to that aggregate multiplied by the holder's adjusted percentage interest. The aggregate stock consideration is calculated under the merger agreement using the merger consideration, a $5.65 buyer stock price and a deduction of 516,620 incentive shares; it is reduced for specified indebtedness, unpaid transaction expenses and change-in-control payments. No fixed number of acquirer shares per TCP unit is stated. Fractional shares are rounded down to the nearest whole share; specified equity changes are subject to adjustment.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver of the applicable conditions: required governmental authorizations and third-party consents; no specified legal restraint or proceeding; no material adverse effect or one reasonably likely to occur; accuracy of TCP's representations and warranties, including fundamental representations, and material covenant compliance; TCP unitholder approval by written consent; required closing deliverables, including merger filing documents, good-standing and officer certificates, closing calculations, intellectual-property documentation and assignments, the amended license agreement, key-operator agreements and a tail insurance policy; required Section 280G documentation; reservation of incentive shares; and filing and continuing effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without a stop order or threatened proceeding. Angel Studios' and the merger subsidiary's representations, warranties, covenants and closing deliverables are also conditions to TCP's obligation to close.
event_status: Pending; the original merger agreement dated 11/14/2025 was amended and restated on 6/29/2026. Completion remains subject to closing conditions.
security_description: Toothy Cow Productions, LLC Common Units, Class A Preferred Units and Class B Preferred Units; each class receives the same stated stock-consideration allocation method. Units owned by Angel Studios, Inc., the merger subsidiary or TCP are cancelled without consideration.
effective_date: Conditional upon closing: the date and time the certificate of merger is accepted for filing by the Delaware and Tennessee authorities, or a later time specified in the certificate. No calendar effective date is stated.
available_options: No holder election.

stock_exchange_ratio: 1 share of SEEQC Common Stock per 1 share of Allegro Common Stock, subject to the Merger Agreement’s equitable adjustment provision. A holder otherwise entitled to a fractional SEEQC share after aggregation receives 1 SEEQC share instead.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted waiver of the stated conditions: no effective governmental order restraining, enjoining or prohibiting the Merger; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an effective stop order or pending SEC proceeding seeking one; consummation of the PIPE Investment before or substantially concurrently with closing; SEEQC stockholder approval, including approval of the preferred-stock conversion and stock split; and Allegro stockholder approval by written consent. SEEQC’s obligations also require specified accuracy of Allegro’s representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, absence of specified litigation or an ongoing Allegro material adverse effect, delivery of Allegro lock-up agreements, approval of SEEQC Common Stock for listing on a qualifying national exchange, and concurrent consummation of the Public Offering. event_status: Pending as described in the filing; the Merger Agreement has been entered into, and completion remains subject to closing conditions.

available_options: No holder election; eligible Allegro Common Stock is converted into the fixed stock consideration. Qualifying dissenting stockholders may instead seek statutory appraisal by not consenting to the Merger Proposal and complying with Section 262 of the DGCL.

If the amendment is not approved but the Merger is consummated, SEEQC will assume the warrants instead.
stock_exchange_ratio: If the Allegro Warrant Amendment is approved and the Merger is consummated, 0.1 share of SEEQC Common Stock per 1 Allegro Warrant, subject to the amendment’s equitable adjustment provision; a holder otherwise entitled to a fractional SEEQC share after aggregation receives 1 SEEQC share instead. If the amendment is not approved but the Merger closes, each assumed warrant remains exercisable for 1 share of SEEQC Common Stock at $11.50 per share, subject to customary anti-dilution adjustments; this is an exercise right, not stock delivered as merger consideration.
closing_conditions: The Merger is subject to satisfaction or permitted waiver of the stated conditions: no effective governmental order restraining, enjoining or prohibiting it; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an effective stop order or pending SEC proceeding seeking one; consummation of the PIPE Investment before or substantially concurrently with closing; SEEQC stockholder approval, including approval of the preferred-stock conversion and stock split; and Allegro stockholder approval by written consent. Allegro’s obligations also require specified accuracy of SEEQC’s and Merger Sub’s representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, absence of specified litigation or an ongoing SEEQC material adverse effect, forgiveness of specified insider indebtedness and termination of specified guarantees, delivery of SEEQC lock-up agreements, and appointment of Allegro’s board designee or designees. SEEQC’s obligations also require specified accuracy of Allegro’s representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, absence of specified litigation or an ongoing Allegro material adverse effect, delivery of Allegro lock-up agreements, approval of SEEQC Common Stock for listing on a qualifying national exchange, and concurrent consummation of the Public Offering. The warrant conversion separately requires approval by holders of at least 65.0% of outstanding Allegro Warrants; the Merger itself is not conditioned on that approval.
event_status: Pending as described in the filing; the proposed warrant amendment had not obtained the required 65.0% approval, although support agreements covered approximately 48.8% of outstanding Allegro Warrants.
security_description: Allegro Merger Corp. redeemable common stock purchase warrants (Allegro Warrants), each initially entitling its holder to purchase 1 share of Allegro Common Stock at an exercise price of $11.50.
effective_date: The Merger will become effective when its certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed in writing by Allegro and SEEQC and specified in that certificate. No calendar date or time is stated; the Merger was expected to close in the third quarter of 2026. If approved, the Allegro Warrant Amendment provides for conversion immediately before the Merger’s effective time.
available_options: No holder election among forms of consideration; warrant treatment depends on approval of the Allegro Warrant Amendment. If approved and the Merger closes, conversion into SEEQC Common Stock is automatic. If not approved and the Merger closes, SEEQC assumes the warrants.
default_option: If the Allegro Warrant Amendment is not approved and the Merger is consummated, SEEQC will assume the Allegro Warrants on their existing terms, except that they will be exercisable for SEEQC Common Stock instead of Allegro Common Stock, subject to customary anti-dilution adjustments.
