acquirer: AbbVie Inc., through its wholly owned subsidiary Andor LLC (Parent) and Parent’s wholly owned subsidiary Andor Merger Co. (Merger Sub), which will merge into the target.
consideration_type: Cash; fixed consideration for eligible shares, subject to the exceptions for canceled shares and shares with perfected appraisal rights.
cash_consideration: $135.11 in cash per share of Apogee Therapeutics, Inc. common stock, without interest and subject to applicable tax withholding. Shares owned by Apogee or specified AbbVie entities are canceled without consideration; holders who properly perfect appraisal rights receive the amount determined through appraisal instead. The per-share amount is subject to adjustment for specified changes in outstanding shares before the merger becomes effective.
stock_exchange_ratio: No stock consideration is payable to holders of Apogee common stock.
shareholder_vote_date: Apogee voting common stockholders are to vote at a virtual special meeting on an unspecified date in 2026, at an unspecified time, Eastern time. Holders of all outstanding Apogee non-voting common stock delivered written consent approving the merger on 6/18/2026. No AbbVie stockholder vote is required.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver where permitted: approval by holders of a majority of outstanding Apogee voting common stock and, while at least 6,061,821 non-voting shares remain outstanding, approval by holders of a majority of outstanding non-voting common stock; the non-voting approval was obtained by written consent on 6/18/2026. There must be no effective legal restraint prohibiting or making the transactions illegal. Applicable HSR Act waiting periods and specified antitrust waiting periods or commitments must expire or terminate; other specified antitrust filings and approvals must be made or obtained and remain effective, including conditional U.K. or EU processes if triggered. Party-specific conditions include the required accuracy of representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, and delivery of officer certificates. Parent’s and Merger Sub’s obligations also require that no continuing Material Adverse Effect on Apogee has occurred since the merger agreement date. The merger has no financing condition.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was executed on 6/18/2026, and the merger remains subject to closing conditions, including approval by Apogee voting common stockholders. Approval by non-voting common stockholders was obtained by written consent.
security_description: Apogee Therapeutics, Inc. voting common stock and non-voting common stock, each with par value $0.00001 per share. Both classes receive the same merger consideration, except for canceled shares and shares with perfected appraisal rights.
effective_date: Not specified. The merger will become effective when the certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later date or time agreed by Apogee and Parent and specified in the certificate. Closing is separately scheduled for two business days after the closing conditions are satisfied or waived, unless Apogee and Parent agree otherwise.
available_options: No holder election; eligible shares convert into a fixed right to cash consideration. Eligible holders may instead exercise statutory appraisal rights by complying with the stated requirements.

consideration_type: Stock; eligible Huntsman common shares are exchanged for Olin common stock under either merger structure, with incidental cash instead of fractional shares.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration per share. stock_exchange_ratio: 0.5476 shares of Olin Corporation common stock, par value $1.00 per share, per 1 share of Huntsman Corporation common stock, par value $0.01 per share. The ratio is subject to equitable adjustment for specified changes in outstanding stock before the merger takes effect. No fractional Olin shares will be issued; cash is paid instead.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver on or before closing: Huntsman stockholder approval and approval of either the Olin direct-merger proposal or the Olin subsidiary-merger share-issuance proposal; NYSE listing approval for Olin shares issued as merger consideration; required regulatory approvals, including expiration or termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period; no effective legal restraint preventing the applicable merger; effectiveness of the Form S-4 with no SEC stop order or initiated or threatened proceeding for one; the other party's representations and warranties meeting the merger agreement's applicable accuracy and materiality standards; each party's performance in all material respects of its pre-closing obligations; and a closing tax opinion for Huntsman that the applicable merger should qualify for the intended tax treatment, plus such an opinion for Olin if the direct merger is used. Obtaining debt financing is expressly not a closing condition.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was executed and announced, but the merger remains subject to approvals and other closing conditions.
security_description: Issued and outstanding Huntsman Corporation common stock, par value $0.01 per share, immediately before the applicable merger effective time, excluding shares owned by Olin, Huntsman or their wholly owned subsidiaries and shares held in Huntsman's treasury.
effective_date: No calendar date is specified. The direct merger will become effective at the time Olin and Huntsman agree and specify in the Delaware certificate of merger and Virginia articles of merger. Under the alternative subsidiary-merger structure, the first merger will become effective upon filing its Delaware certificate of merger or at a later specified time; the second merger will become effective upon filing its Delaware certificate of merger or at a later specified time.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Huntsman common shares receive the fixed stock consideration under either merger structure, subject to cash instead of fractional shares.

acquirer: Somnigroup International Inc. (parent); Sparrow Unity Corporation is its direct, wholly owned merger subsidiary.
consideration_type: Stock; if applicable, cash in lieu of fractional shares. A Special Dividend is payable separately to Leggett & Platt common shareholders immediately before the merger becomes effective only if the specified DOJ or FTC proceeding occurs and the merger closes afterward.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration is payable per share of Leggett & Platt common stock. A holder otherwise entitled to a fractional Somnigroup share will instead receive cash, without interest, based on that holder’s proportionate interest in the proceeds from the exchange agent’s sale of excess whole shares. A separate, conditional Special Dividend is payable to holders of Leggett & Platt common stock immediately before the merger becomes effective if a DOJ or FTC proceeding under applicable U.S. federal competition law seeks to prohibit or delay the merger and closing occurs after the proceeding commences. The aggregate dividend equals 6% of the 30-trading-day volume-weighted average price of Leggett & Platt common stock immediately before closing, multiplied by the number of shares outstanding immediately before the merger becomes effective, multiplied by the number of calendar days from commencement of the proceeding through closing divided by 365. No Special Dividend is payable if the merger does not close, no such proceeding commences, or closing occurs on or before its commencement.
stock_exchange_ratio: Fixed exchange ratio of 0.1455 shares of Somnigroup International Inc. common stock, par value $0.01 per share, per 1 share of Leggett & Platt, Incorporated common stock, par value $0.01 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the merger becomes effective, excluding cancelled and dissenting shares. The ratio is not adjusted for changes in market prices but is subject to equitable adjustment for specified stock splits, stock dividends, reclassifications or similar changes before the merger becomes effective. No fractional Somnigroup shares will be issued; applicable fractional interests are paid in cash.
shareholder_vote_date: Leggett & Platt shareholders’ special meeting is scheduled for 8/20/2026 at 10:00 a.m. Central Time, unless adjourned or postponed. No Somnigroup stockholder vote is required.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver where legally permissible: Leggett & Platt shareholder approval by holders of at least two-thirds of its outstanding common shares entitled to vote; absence of specified governmental orders, actions or laws restraining, prohibiting or making the merger illegal; expiration or termination of applicable HSR Act waiting periods and specified competition-law delay commitments, plus required competition-law filings, consents and approvals; NYSE listing approval for Somnigroup shares issued in the merger; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an outstanding stop order or specified SEC proceeding; each party’s representations and warranties meeting the agreement’s applicable accuracy standards, material covenant compliance, and absence of a material adverse effect on that party; each party’s required officer certificate; and Leggett & Platt’s receipt of a closing-date tax opinion that the merger will qualify for the intended tax treatment. The U.S. HSR Act waiting period expired on 6/3/2026, but clearance or expiration of waiting periods in certain jurisdictions outside the United States remained required as described in the filing. A financing transaction is expressly not a closing condition.
event_status: Pending as described in the 7/9/2026 proxy statement/prospectus; the merger agreement was executed on 4/13/2026, and completion remained subject to shareholder approval and other closing conditions. The parties expected completion by year-end 2026 but gave no assurance it would occur.
security_description: Issued and outstanding Leggett & Platt, Incorporated common stock, par value $0.01 per share, immediately before the merger becomes effective, other than cancelled shares and dissenting shares. Outstanding restricted shares vest immediately beforehand and are then treated as common shares receiving merger consideration; other equity awards have separate treatment.
effective_date: No calendar effective date is stated. The merger becomes legally effective when the articles of merger are filed with the Missouri Secretary of State, or at a later date and time agreed by the parties and specified in those articles. Closing is separately anticipated by year-end 2026, subject to conditions.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Leggett & Platt common shareholders receive the fixed stock consideration, with cash instead of any fractional Somnigroup share. Dissenting shareholders who properly perfect appraisal rights receive separate statutory treatment.

consideration_type: Elective consideration: eligible holders may elect New Wildlife common stock or cash, subject to proration requiring aggregate cash proceeds of at least $60 million and no more than $80 million.
cash_consideration: Cash election: US$13.80 per share of RE/MAX Holdings, Inc. Class A common stock, without interest, subject to proration. Cash is paid instead of any fractional New Wildlife common share otherwise receivable as merger consideration.
stock_exchange_ratio: Stock election: 5.150 shares of Rome Wildlife, Inc. (New Wildlife) common stock per 1 share of RE/MAX Holdings, Inc. Class A common stock before Real's 10-for-1 share consolidation; adjusted to 0.5150 New Wildlife share per 1 RE/MAX Class A share before the first merger becomes effective. Fractional New Wildlife shares are paid in cash instead of issued.
shareholder_vote_date: RE/MAX Holdings, Inc. stockholders are scheduled to vote on the merger proposal and the related RIHI share-issuance proposal on 8/14/2026 at 8:00 a.m. Mountain time. The Real Brokerage Inc. securityholders are scheduled to vote on the related arrangement resolution on 8/14/2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern time.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted waiver of conditions, including the required Real securityholder vote: at least 66⅔% of votes cast by Real shareholders and at least 66⅔% of votes cast by Real shareholders, optionholders and RSU holders together; the required REMAX stockholder votes: a majority of the voting power of all outstanding REMAX common stock to adopt the merger agreement and a majority of voting power present or represented and entitled to vote to approve the RIHI-related Class A share issuance; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement; Nasdaq listing approval for New Wildlife common stock; expiration or termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period; absence of applicable legal restraints or a Burdensome Condition; the British Columbia court's interim and final orders; consummation of the RIHI merger; the RIHI tax-receivable-agreement termination amendment remaining effective; applicable accuracy of representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, and absence of a material adverse effect for each party; and receipt of the specified tax opinions by Real and REMAX. Receipt of financing is expressly not a closing condition.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was amended on 6/12/2026 to make technical changes to the transaction steps. The filing schedules the required shareholder votes and does not report completion.
security_description: RE/MAX Holdings, Inc. Class A common stock, including Class A shares issued in the RIHI merger, outstanding immediately before the first merger becomes effective; treasury shares, certain shares owned by New Wildlife or its or REMAX's subsidiaries, and dissenting shares are excluded from the ordinary election treatment.
effective_date: No calendar date is specified. The first merger is to become effective when its certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later mutually agreed time specified in that certificate, following the arrangement. The second merger is to become effective upon filing its certificate, or at a later agreed time specified in it, as soon as practicable after the first merger and on the same day. Completion was expected during the second half of 2026, subject to closing conditions.
available_options: Eligible REMAX Class A holders may elect either stock at the adjusted 0.5150 New Wildlife share-per-share ratio or US$13.80 cash per share. The election is subject to allocation and proration: if aggregate cash elections are below $60 million, stock-electing shares receive some cash; if they exceed $80 million, cash-electing shares receive some stock. A properly completed and signed REMAX election form, including transmittal materials, must reach the exchange agent by the election deadline. Beneficial holders should follow their intermediary's instructions.
default_option: Shares for which no properly completed election form is received by the deadline, or for which an election is revoked without a valid replacement, are treated as stock elections, subject to the aggregate-cash minimum and related proration.
election_deadline: 5:00 p.m. Mountain time on a date Real and REMAX agree is as near as practicable to three business days before closing, or another date they agree upon. No calendar date is specified.

Closing TASE Cash Merger Consideration equals [(Aggregate Consideration Amount ÷ SoundHound Closing Stock Price) × SoundHound Closing VWAP Stock Price] × (Fully Diluted TASE Common Number ÷ Fully Diluted Common Number), capped at $7,500,000 in aggregate. Aggregate Consideration Amount equals $42,784,532.64 minus LivePerson Shortfall Cash plus the aggregate exercise prices of in-the-money LivePerson options other than assumed options. Shortfall Cash is the excess, if positive, of the applicable minimum cash amount over the closing cash balance; the minimum is $74,000,000, or $71,000,000 if closing occurs in July, less cash paid to repurchase and retire the 2026 notes between April 1, 2026 and closing. The closing cash balance gives effect to specified unpaid transaction-related amounts. The SoundHound Closing VWAP Stock Price is the average daily Nasdaq VWAP over the ten consecutive trading days ending on the third trading day before closing, rounded down to the nearest penny; the SoundHound Closing Stock Price applies a $7 floor and $12 cap to that VWAP. The per-share cash amount is not finalized in the filing.
stock_exchange_ratio: No stock consideration for eligible TASE Shares.
shareholder_vote_date: LivePerson stockholders’ special meeting is scheduled for 8/20/2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where permitted by law, waiver: LivePerson stockholder approval by a majority of outstanding common shares entitled to vote; required regulatory consents, filings and waiting-period expirations, including foreign investment approvals in Bulgaria, Canada, Italy, Germany and the United Kingdom (clearance had been received from Italy and Canada on 6/25/2026, Germany on 6/29/2026 and the United Kingdom on 7/1/2026; Bulgaria remained open as described in the filing); no effective legal restraint prohibiting the Mergers; SEC effectiveness of the registration statement without a stop order; and Nasdaq authorization for listing the SoundHound shares issued in the First Merger. SoundHound’s and its merger subsidiaries’ further conditions include LivePerson’s representations and warranties meeting contractual accuracy standards, material compliance with its obligations, no LivePerson material adverse effect since 4/21/2026, specified officer certificate and tax affidavit, and consummation of the Notes Restructuring Transactions. LivePerson’s further conditions include the SoundHound parties’ representations and warranties meeting contractual accuracy standards, material compliance with their obligations, and a specified SoundHound officer certificate. The cash threshold adjusts consideration for a shortfall; it is not identified as a separate closing condition.
event_status: Pending; the original merger agreement dated 4/21/2026 was amended and restated on 7/2/2026 to provide for two mergers and cash consideration for TASE Shares. Completion remains subject to closing conditions.
security_description: LivePerson, Inc. common stock, par value $0.001 per share, held through the Tel-Aviv Stock Exchange Clearing House Ltd. (TASE Shares) and issued and outstanding immediately before the Second Merger, excluding Dissenting Shares.
effective_date: No fixed legal effective date is stated. The Second Merger becomes effective when its certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at another date and time agreed by the parties and specified in that certificate, but at least one minute after the First Merger becomes effective. Closing is expected in the third quarter of 2026, subject to conditions.
available_options: No holder election between stock and cash; eligible TASE Shares receive the specified cash consideration. Eligible TASE holders or beneficial owners who do not vote in favor of the merger, properly demand appraisal, continuously hold through TASECH, meet Section 262 requirements and do not withdraw or lose appraisal rights may instead seek court-determined fair value.

acquirer: 1001550000 Ontario Inc. (Pubco), through its wholly owned subsidiary MBH Merger Sub, Inc. (Matinas Merger Sub), which will merge into Matinas BioPharma Holdings, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock
stock_exchange_ratio: 0.1 Pubco common share per 1 share of Matinas common stock underlying each Matinas preferred share on an as-converted basis, subject to the agreement’s adjustment provisions. Fractional Pubco shares will not be issued; each holder’s aggregate entitlement will be rounded down to a whole share.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permissible written waiver of the applicable conditions: Matinas stockholder approval; GH Power shareholder approval; completion of GH Power’s PIPE financing with at least $15 million deposited; effectiveness of the Form F-4 registration statement without a stop order or related proceeding; Ontario Interim and Final Orders; NYSE listing approval for the Pubco shares; no law or order preventing the transaction; appointment of the post-closing Pubco board; acceptable Pubco organizational documents; and evidence of Pubco’s foreign-private-issuer status. Party-specific conditions include the applicable accuracy of representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, absence of a continuing uncured material adverse effect, and specified closing deliveries. Matinas’s obligation is also conditioned on completion of the GH Power amalgamation.
event_status: Pending; the Business Combination Agreement was entered into on 7/10/2026, and completion was expected in the fourth quarter of 2026.
security_description: Matinas BioPharma Holdings, Inc. preferred stock, par value $0.0001 per share, including Series D Convertible Preferred Stock, issued and outstanding immediately before the merger, excluding shares held by Matinas or in its treasury.
effective_date: Immediately after the GH Power arrangement becomes effective, upon filing the Delaware certificate of merger or at a later time specified in that certificate; no calendar date is stated.
available_options: No holder election

Holders otherwise entitled to a fractional Equity Residential common share will receive cash, without interest, representing their proportionate interest in the net proceeds from the exchange agent’s sale of aggregated fractional shares.
stock_exchange_ratio: Fixed ratio of 2.793 Equity Residential common shares of beneficial interest, par value $0.01 per share, per 1 eligible share of AvalonBay common stock, par value $0.01 per share. The ratio is not adjusted for stock-price changes but is subject to specified capitalization adjustments. No fractional Equity Residential common shares will be issued; cash will be paid in lieu.
shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled for 8/12/2026: Equity Residential shareholders vote on the share issuance at 8:00 a.m. Central Time; AvalonBay stockholders vote on the merger at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time. Either virtual meeting may be adjourned or postponed.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver to the extent permitted by law: approval of the Equity Residential share issuance by its shareholders and approval of the merger by AvalonBay stockholders; no effective law making the merger illegal and no effective governmental order prohibiting it; effectiveness of the Form S-4 without an effective stop order or pending, unwithdrawn stop-order proceeding; and authorization and approval for NYSE listing of the Equity Residential shares issued in the merger, subject to official notice of issuance. Each party’s obligations also depend on the other side’s representations and warranties meeting the agreement’s specified standards, material compliance with covenants, no continuing material adverse effect, delivery of an officer’s certificate, and receipt of specified REIT-status and Section 368(a) reorganization tax opinions. Completion is not conditioned on the Bridge Facility or other financing. Approval of the Equity Residential charter amendment and the AvalonBay merger-related compensation proposal is not required for completion.
event_status: Pending as described in the joint proxy statement/prospectus: the merger agreement was executed and the merger announced; shareholder votes were scheduled, and completion remained subject to closing conditions.
security_description: Eligible issued and outstanding shares of AvalonBay Communities, Inc. common stock, par value $0.01 per share. Shares held in treasury or held or owned by AvalonBay, Equity Residential or Canopy Merger Sub LLC immediately before the effective time are cancelled without consideration; AvalonBay equity awards receive separate treatment.
effective_date: Not specified. The merger is expected to be completed in the second half of 2026, but no particular date is assured. Legal effectiveness will occur on the closing date upon filing the articles of merger with Maryland’s State Department of Assessments and Taxation, or at a later date and time agreed by the parties and specified in those articles, after the asset contribution.
available_options: No holder election; each eligible AvalonBay common share converts into the fixed stock consideration, with cash only in lieu of fractional shares.

acquirer: Olin Corporation (acquiring parent); Olympus Merger Sub, Inc. and Hook Merger Sub LLC are Olin’s wholly owned subsidiaries used if the subsidiary-merger structure is implemented.
consideration_type: Stock; eligible Huntsman common shares are exchanged for Olin common stock under either merger structure, with incidental cash in lieu of fractional shares.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration per share of Huntsman common stock. Cash is paid only in lieu of a fractional Olin common share: the fractional interest multiplied by the average volume-weighted average price per Olin common share over the five consecutive trading days ending on and including the first trading day immediately before closing, rounded to the nearest cent and without interest.
stock_exchange_ratio: 0.5476 shares of Olin Corporation common stock, par value $1.00 per share, per 1 eligible share of Huntsman Corporation common stock, par value $0.01 per share, under either merger structure. The ratio is fixed with respect to stock-price changes, but is subject to equitable adjustment for specified changes in outstanding stock before the effective time. No fractional Olin shares will be issued; cash will be paid in lieu.
shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled virtual special meetings on 8/25/2026: Olin Corporation shareholders at 8:00 a.m. Central Time; Huntsman Corporation stockholders at 9:00 a.m. Central Time.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver on or before closing: Huntsman stockholder approval and approval of either the Olin direct-merger proposal or the Olin subsidiary-merger share-issuance proposal; NYSE listing approval for Olin shares issued as merger consideration, subject to official notice of issuance; required regulatory approvals, including expiration or termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period and applicable required non-U.S. clearances; no effective legal restraint preventing, enjoining or prohibiting the applicable merger; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement, with no SEC stop order or initiated or threatened proceeding for one; the other party’s representations and warranties meeting the agreement’s applicable accuracy standards and material performance of required obligations, with executive-officer certificates; and Huntsman’s receipt of a tax-counsel opinion on the intended tax treatment, plus Olin’s receipt of such an opinion if the direct merger is used. Financing is not a closing condition.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was executed and announced, and shareholder votes and other closing conditions remained outstanding as described in the proxy statement.
security_description: Issued and outstanding Huntsman Corporation common stock, par value $0.01 per share, immediately before the applicable merger effective time, excluding shares owned by Olin, Huntsman or their wholly owned subsidiaries or held in Huntsman treasury; those excluded shares are canceled without consideration.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Huntsman common shares receive the fixed stock consideration under either merger structure, with cash only in lieu of fractional Olin shares.

acquirer: Sono Group S.à r.l. (Sono Luxembourg), the wholly owned subsidiary of Sono Group N.V. that will absorb Sono Group N.V. in the cross-border merger
consideration_type: Stock for ordinary shares exchanged in the merger; eligible shareholders who vote against the merger may instead exercise a statutory withdrawal right for cash compensation.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration for Sono Group N.V. ordinary shares exchanged for stock. An eligible withdrawing shareholder will instead receive cash equal to the nominal value of each ordinary share, €0.01 per share, net of any tax required to be withheld. The Dutch independent auditor concluded that this proposed withdrawal compensation is not reasonable.
stock_exchange_ratio: 1 Sono Luxembourg Class A ordinary share per 1 issued and outstanding Sono Group N.V. ordinary share exchanged in the merger, excluding treasury shares and dissenting shares. Following the merger, each Sono Luxembourg Class A ordinary share will convert into 1 share of Sono Group, Inc. Class A common stock.
closing_conditions: The merger requires approval of the Redomiciliation Proposal and the Merger Proposal by Sono Group N.V. shareholders and approval by Sono Luxembourg’s shareholder; the Merger Proposal requires a two-thirds majority of votes cast at a meeting where at least one third of Sono Group N.V.’s issued shares are represented. Completion is subject to mandatory waiting periods and statutory formalities under Dutch and Luxembourg law, including the Dutch pre-merger certificate and the Luxembourg merger process. The registration statement must be declared effective by the SEC, with no stop order, and Nasdaq-CM must approve continued listing of the Class A common stock. The transaction must not be prohibited by a decree, order or injunction, and neither board may have terminated or abandoned it. Sono Group N.V. and Sono Luxembourg also reserve the right to abandon the merger if withdrawal claims create specified financial or legal difficulties or a withdrawing shareholder requests additional compensation. Conditions may be waived to the extent waivable.
event_status: Pending and proposed as of the filing; the boards approved the transaction, but shareholder approvals and other closing conditions remained outstanding.
security_description: Sono Group N.V. ordinary shares, nominal value €0.01 per share. Treasury shares are cancelled without exchange; eligible dissenting shares are subject to the statutory withdrawal mechanism.
effective_date: Not fixed. The merger is intended to complete on a date to be determined in the fall of 2026 or later, after the required legal steps; its legal effective time is the date set forth in a certificate of legality issued by a Luxembourg public notary.
available_options: An eligible Sono Group N.V. ordinary shareholder may receive 1 Sono Luxembourg Class A ordinary share per ordinary share exchanged in the merger, subsequently converting 1-for-1 into Sono Group, Inc. Class A common stock. A registered shareholder who votes against the Merger Proposal may instead submit a withdrawal request for shares held on the record date and still held when the request is made, receiving cash equal to their nominal value of €0.01 per ordinary share, net of applicable withholding tax. Shares submitted through an intermediary must be transferred as instructed and cannot then be traded.
default_option: A shareholder who votes in favor of the merger, abstains, or is not present or represented has no right to file a withdrawal request; ordinary shares other than treasury and dissenting shares are exchanged for Sono Luxembourg Class A ordinary shares under the merger terms.
election_deadline: A withdrawal request may be filed during the period beginning at the conclusion of the Sono Group N.V. special meeting and ending at the close of business one month after that meeting. No calendar date is stated. The withdrawal request form separately leaves the intermediary submission and receipt dates blank.

acquirer: Sono Group S.à r.l. (Sono Luxembourg), the wholly owned subsidiary of Sono Group N.V. that will absorb Sono Group N.V. in the cross-border merger
consideration_type: Stock for high voting shares exchanged in the merger; eligible shareholders who vote against the merger may instead exercise a statutory withdrawal right for cash compensation.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration for Sono Group N.V. high voting shares exchanged for stock. An eligible withdrawing shareholder will instead receive cash equal to the nominal value of each high voting share, €0.25 per share, net of any tax required to be withheld.
stock_exchange_ratio: 25 Sono Luxembourg Class B ordinary shares per 1 issued and outstanding Sono Group N.V. high voting share exchanged in the merger, excluding treasury shares and dissenting shares. closing_conditions: The merger requires approval of the Redomiciliation Proposal and the Merger Proposal by Sono Group N.V. shareholders and approval by Sono Luxembourg’s shareholder; the Merger Proposal requires a two-thirds majority of votes cast at a meeting where at least one third of Sono Group N.V.’s issued shares are represented. Completion is subject to mandatory waiting periods and statutory formalities under Dutch and Luxembourg law, including the Dutch pre-merger certificate and the Luxembourg merger process. The registration statement must be declared effective by the SEC, with no stop order, and Nasdaq-CM must approve continued listing of the Class A common stock. The transaction must not be prohibited by a decree, order or injunction, and neither board may have terminated or abandoned it. Sono Group N.V. and Sono Luxembourg also reserve the right to abandon the merger if withdrawal claims create specified financial or legal difficulties or a withdrawing shareholder requests additional compensation. Conditions may be waived to the extent waivable.
event_status: Pending and proposed as of the filing; the boards approved the transaction, but shareholder approvals and other closing conditions remained outstanding.
security_description: Sono Group N.V. high voting shares, nominal value €0.25 per share. Treasury shares are cancelled without exchange; eligible dissenting shares are subject to the statutory withdrawal mechanism.
effective_date: Not fixed. The merger is intended to complete on a date to be determined in the fall of 2026 or later, after the required legal steps; its legal effective time is the date set forth in a certificate of legality issued by a Luxembourg public notary.
available_options: An eligible Sono Group N.V. high voting shareholder may receive 25 Sono Luxembourg Class B ordinary shares per high voting share exchanged in the merger, with each set of 25 subsequently converting into 1 share of Sono Group, Inc. Class B common stock. A registered shareholder who votes against the Merger Proposal may instead submit a withdrawal request for shares held on the record date and still held when the request is made, receiving cash equal to their nominal value of €0.25 per high voting share, net of applicable withholding tax. Shares submitted through an intermediary must be transferred as instructed and cannot then be traded.
default_option: A shareholder who votes in favor of the merger, abstains, or is not present or represented has no right to file a withdrawal request; high voting shares other than treasury and dissenting shares are exchanged for Sono Luxembourg Class B ordinary shares under the merger terms.
election_deadline: A withdrawal request may be filed during the period beginning at the conclusion of the Sono Group N.V. special meeting and ending at the close of business one month after that meeting. No calendar date is stated. The withdrawal request form separately leaves the intermediary submission and receipt dates blank.

acquirer: Orion Merger Parent, Inc. (Parent); its wholly owned subsidiary, Orion MergerCo X, Inc. (Merger Sub), will merge with and into the target.
consideration_type: Cash, without interest and subject to applicable withholding taxes, for each outstanding share of AstroNova common stock other than Cancelled Shares.
cash_consideration: $29.00 in cash per share of AstroNova common stock, without interest and less applicable withholding taxes; shares held by Parent, AstroNova or their respective direct or indirect wholly owned subsidiaries immediately before the Effective Time are cancelled without consideration.
stock_exchange_ratio: No stock consideration payable to holders of AstroNova common stock.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where permitted by law, waiver: approval and adoption of the merger agreement by holders of a majority of outstanding AstroNova common shares; expiration or termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period and any applicable antitrust timing commitment, completion of required antitrust filings and receipt of required antitrust approvals; and absence of a governmental law or order making the merger illegal, enjoining it or otherwise prohibiting it. Parent's and Merger Sub's obligations additionally require AstroNova's representations and warranties to meet the agreement's specified accuracy standards, AstroNova's material compliance with its obligations and covenants, no Company Material Adverse Effect or event reasonably expected to have one since the agreement date, and an AstroNova officer's certificate. AstroNova's obligation additionally requires Parent's and Merger Sub's representations and warranties to meet the specified accuracy standard, their material compliance with obligations and covenants, and a Parent officer's certificate. The merger is not conditioned on financing.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was executed on 6/16/2026 and announced on 6/17/2026. Completion remains subject to closing conditions.
security_description: AstroNova, Inc. common stock, par value $0.05 per share. Outstanding shares other than Cancelled Shares receive the merger consideration; Cancelled Shares receive none. Equity awards have separate treatment.
effective_date: Conditional: upon issuance of a certificate of merger by the Rhode Island Secretary of State following filing of the Articles of Merger, or at a later date or time agreed in writing by AstroNova and Parent and specified in the Articles of Merger. No calendar date is stated.
available_options: No holder election; eligible common shares are converted into a fixed right to receive $29.00 per share in cash, without interest.

acquirer: Destination XL Group, Inc. (DXL); its wholly owned direct subsidiary, Divine Merger Sub I, Inc., is the merger subsidiary that would merge into the target.
target: FBB Holdings I, Inc. (FBB), which would survive as a wholly owned subsidiary of DXL.
consideration_type: Stock for FBB common stock, except that shares held by unaccredited FBB stockholders would receive cash instead. Excluded shares and appraisal shares have separate treatment.
cash_consideration: For each share of FBB common stock held by an unaccredited investor: cash in U.S. dollars, without interest, equal to the exchange ratio multiplied by the DXL stock price. The DXL stock price is the average of the daily volume-weighted average sales prices per DXL common share for the ten consecutive trading days immediately preceding the trading day two days before the merger closing date. Other eligible FBB common shares receive stock, not regular cash consideration.
stock_exchange_ratio: A variable number of shares of DXL common stock, par value $0.01 per share, per 1 share of FBB common stock, par value $0.01 per share: the new issuance of DXL shares divided by FBB common shares issued and outstanding immediately before the merger becomes effective. The new issuance equals fully diluted DXL shares multiplied by 55% divided by 45%. The ratio may be adjusted for specified capital-structure changes. Fractional DXL shares otherwise issuable to a holder are aggregated and rounded up to the nearest whole share. Unaccredited investor shares receive no stock.
shareholder_vote_date: FBB stockholders adopted the merger agreement and approved the merger and related transactions by written consent on 12/11/2025. The DXL stockholders' special meeting to vote on the issuance proposal is scheduled for [●], 2026, at [●] a.m. Eastern Time; a full meeting date and time are not provided.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver, as applicable: FBB stockholder approval, obtained by written consent; approval of the DXL share issuance by a majority of votes cast at the special meeting, not stated as obtained; authorization for Nasdaq listing of the DXL shares issued as merger consideration, subject to official notice of issuance; completion of FBB's pre-closing investment in the amounts specified in the commitment and subscription agreements; and absence of an effective injunction or law prohibiting or making the merger illegal. DXL's obligation also depends on the required accuracy of FBB's representations and warranties, FBB's material performance of its obligations, no material adverse effect on FBB since the agreement date, an FBB officer's certificate, and specified amendments and conversion of FBB preferred stock. FBB's obligation similarly depends on the required accuracy of DXL's representations and warranties, DXL's material performance, no material adverse effect on DXL since the agreement date, and a DXL officer's certificate. Reverse-stock-split approval is not an express closing condition, but is expected to be necessary to satisfy Nasdaq's $4.00-per-share initial-listing minimum bid-price requirement. Approval of the 2016 plan and adjournment proposals is not a closing condition.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement remains in effect, but the DXL Board has withdrawn its prior recommendation and recommends voting against the issuance proposal. FBB stockholder approval has been obtained; DXL stockholder approval remains subject to a vote.
security_description: FBB common stock, par value $0.01 per share. FBB common shares held by unaccredited investors receive cash rather than DXL stock; excluded shares are cancelled without consideration, and appraisal shares are subject to separate appraisal-rights treatment.
effective_date: No calendar date is stated. If the merger closes, it becomes legally effective when the certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later date and time specified in that certificate. Closing is described separately as occurring on the third business day after satisfaction or permitted waiver of the closing conditions, unless DXL and FBB agree otherwise in writing.
available_options: No holder election. Eligible FBB common shares are converted into the right to receive DXL common stock; unaccredited investor shares instead receive cash under the merger agreement.

acquirer: Apex Treasury Corporation (parent); Stepping Stone Merger Sub, Inc. is its direct, wholly-owned merger subsidiary.
consideration_type: Stock; each eligible TECfusions, Inc. common share converts into the right to receive Domesticated Purchaser Common Stock. Shares owned by Apex Treasury Corporation, Merger Sub or TECfusions, Inc. are canceled without consideration; converted shares that were subject to vesting or forfeiture retain those restrictions.
cash_consideration: No cash consideration per TECfusions, Inc. common share is stated; the merger consideration is stock, and no cash settlement is made for fractional shares.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each 1 eligible share of TECfusions, Inc. common stock, a number of shares of Apex Treasury Corporation common stock following domestication equal to the Exchange Ratio, defined as Aggregate Consideration divided by Company Fully Diluted Shares. Aggregate Consideration equals the $4,000,000,000 Base Purchase Price divided by $10.00. Fractional shares are rounded down to the nearest whole share, with no cash settlement.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or written waiver where legally permitted: approval by Apex Treasury Corporation shareholders and TECfusions, Inc. stockholders; expiration or termination of any applicable HSR Act waiting period; no effective law or order making the merger illegal or preventing or prohibiting it; SEC effectiveness of the registration statement through closing, without an effective stop order or an unwithdrawn SEC proceeding for one; and conditional Nasdaq listing approval for the shares issued in the transactions, subject to the round-lot-holder requirement. TECfusions' obligation also requires, unless it waives the applicable condition, accuracy of specified Apex and Merger Sub representations and warranties under the agreement's standards, material performance of their covenants, no continuing uncured Purchaser Material Adverse Effect, completed domestication with the specified Delaware certificate delivered, at least $45,000,000 in Available Closing Cash, and specified closing certificates and executed ancillary agreements. Apex and Merger Sub's obligation also requires, unless Apex waives the applicable condition, accuracy of specified TECfusions representations and warranties under the agreement's standards, material performance of TECfusions' covenants, no continuing uncured Company Material Adverse Effect, and specified closing certificates and executed ancillary agreements and shareholder tax forms.
event_status: Announced; pending. The parties signed the Business Combination Agreement on 7/21/2026, and closing remains subject to conditions.
security_description: Issued and outstanding shares of TECfusions, Inc. common stock, other than shares owned by Apex Treasury Corporation, Stepping Stone Merger Sub, Inc. or TECfusions, Inc. in treasury or otherwise. Company options have separate treatment.
effective_date: Conditional: on the Closing Date, at the time the certificates of merger are filed with the Delaware Secretary of State and the Florida Department of State, or at a later time agreed in writing by TECfusions, Inc., Merger Sub and Apex Treasury Corporation and specified in those certificates. No calendar date or clock time is stated.
available_options: No holder election; eligible TECfusions, Inc. common shares convert into the right to receive the stated stock consideration.

stock_exchange_ratio: For each 1 share of Nth Cycle, Inc. common stock, a number of shares of Kensington Capital Acquisition Corp. effective_date: The First Merger is to become effective when its certificate of merger is accepted for filing by the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed by the specified parties and set out in that certificate. available_options: No holder election

acquirer: IB Acquisition Corp. (IBAC), through its subsidiaries GNQ Call Inc. (CallCo) and GNQ Exchange Inc. (ExchangeCo). IBAC will directly or indirectly own all outstanding equity of GNQ Insilico Inc. following the arrangement.
consideration_type: Elective consideration: eligible Canadian holders of GNQ common shares may elect ExchangeCo exchangeable shares; holders who do not make a valid election receive IBAC Class A common stock. The exchangeable shares are exchangeable for IBAC Class A common stock. GNQ shareholders may also receive contingent earnout shares if the applicable milestone is met; the revenue and share-price earnouts are not cumulative.
cash_consideration: No cash consideration per GNQ common share is specified. Fractional IBAC Class A common stock or ExchangeCo exchangeable shares otherwise issuable under the arrangement are rounded down to whole shares without payment in lieu. GNQ shareholders who validly exercise dissent rights instead have a right to be paid the fair value of their dissenting shares.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each GNQ common share, a non-electing shareholder receives a number of IBAC Class A common shares equal to the GNQ Exchange Ratio; an eligible Canadian shareholder making a valid election instead receives the same number of ExchangeCo exchangeable shares. The GNQ Exchange Ratio is 50,000,000 divided by Fully-Diluted GNQ Common Shares. Each ExchangeCo exchangeable share is exchangeable for one IBAC Class A common share. The per-share consideration is subject to adjustment for specified stock splits, dividends, reorganizations, recapitalizations or like changes before the arrangement becomes effective; aggregate fractional entitlements are rounded down without payment.
closing_conditions: The business combination remains subject to satisfaction or written waiver, where permitted, of stated closing conditions. Conditions for both parties include IBAC stockholder approval; GNQ shareholder approval of the arrangement; IBAC's conversion to a Delaware corporation at least one business day before closing; satisfactory Interim and Final Orders from the Ontario court; required regulatory approvals or expiration or termination of applicable periods; effectiveness of the proxy/registration statement without an outstanding SEC stop order or proceeding; applicable Nasdaq or NYSE listing approvals and requirements; absence of a law or order preventing the transaction; filing and continued validity of the SPAC Certificate of Designation; and IBAC net tangible assets of at least $5,000,001 after redemptions and the PIPE investment. IBAC's additional conditions include GNQ's representations and warranties meeting the agreement's material-adverse-effect standard, material compliance with pre-closing covenants, absence of a GNQ Material Adverse Effect, shareholder support agreements from key GNQ shareholders holding at least 51% of fully diluted GNQ common shares, registration-rights agreement counterparts from key GNQ shareholders, and lock-up agreements from holders of at least 95% of fully diluted GNQ common shares. GNQ's additional conditions include the corresponding IBAC representations, covenants and material-adverse-effect requirements; required Sponsor and other IBAC registration-rights and lock-up agreements; and Available Cash of at least $15,000,000 at closing. For this minimum, Available Cash is calculated after specified redemptions, fees, expenses and accrued redemption-related taxes and includes specified financing proceeds; financing is not stated as a separate closing condition.
event_status: Pending. IBAC and GNQ signed the Business Combination Agreement on 3/16/2026. The 7/24/2026 filing describes the proxy statement/prospectus as preliminary and states that the registration statement has not yet been declared effective and that closing remains subject to conditions.
security_description: GNQ Insilico Inc. common shares, excluding treasury shares and shares of holders who validly exercise dissent rights. GNQ options, warrants and convertible notes have separately described treatment and are not the affected security for this record.
effective_date: The arrangement is to become effective at 12:01 a.m. Eastern Time on the Closing Date, or another time on that date agreed to in writing by IBAC and GNQ before closing. No calendar Closing Date is stated; the timing is conditional.
available_options: A registered GNQ common shareholder who is an Eligible Canadian Shareholder may elect ExchangeCo exchangeable shares for some or all GNQ common shares by submitting a valid Exchangeable Share Election with the required Letter of Transmittal, share certificates or DRS Advice, and reasonably required documents. Each elected share receives exchangeable shares equal to the GNQ Exchange Ratio. A shareholder who does not make a valid election receives IBAC Class A common shares equal to the GNQ Exchange Ratio for each non-elected share. The exchangeable-share election is unavailable to other GNQ shareholders and dissenting shareholders.
default_option: An eligible Canadian holder who does not submit a duly completed Letter of Transmittal before the Election Deadline, or otherwise fails to satisfy the election requirements, is treated as not having elected exchangeable shares and receives IBAC Class A common stock equal to the GNQ Exchange Ratio for each GNQ common share. A holder ultimately not entitled to dissent payment is likewise treated as a non-electing shareholder.
election_deadline: 9:00 a.m. Toronto time on the date of the GNQ shareholder meeting, or another date before the Arrangement Effective Date agreed to in writing by IBAC and GNQ. The calendar date of the shareholder meeting is not stated.

acquirer: NextEra Energy, Inc.; its direct wholly owned subsidiary WG Development Corp. will merge with and into Dominion Energy, Inc. in the first merger.
target: Dominion Energy, Inc.; it will survive the first merger as a wholly owned subsidiary of NextEra Energy, Inc.
consideration_type: Mixed cash and stock for each eligible share of Dominion Energy common stock.
cash_consideration: For each eligible share of Dominion Energy common stock, cash without interest equal to $360 million divided by the closing share count. Cash is also payable instead of any fractional share of NextEra Energy common stock; that amount equals the fractional share multiplied by the specified 10-trading-day volume-weighted average price, rounded to the nearest cent.
stock_exchange_ratio: 0.8138 shares of NextEra Energy, Inc. common stock, par value $0.01 per share, per 1 eligible share of Dominion Energy, Inc. common stock, without par value. The ratio is fixed and will not be adjusted for changes in either company's market price between signing and the effective time. No fractional shares will be issued; the merger consideration is subject to the agreement's adjustment provision for specified share changes or similar transactions.
shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled: NextEra Energy shareholders—9/3/2026 at 9:00 a.m., Eastern Time, on the share issuance proposal; Dominion Energy shareholders—9/3/2026 at 9:30 a.m., Eastern Time, on the merger agreement and first plan of merger. The meetings may be adjourned or postponed.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, to the extent permitted by law, waiver: Dominion Energy shareholder approval of the merger agreement and first plan of merger by a majority of its outstanding common shares entitled to vote; NextEra Energy shareholder approval of the share issuance proposal by more votes cast for than against at a meeting with a quorum; no effective legal restraint or order prohibiting or making the first merger illegal; expiration or early termination of applicable HSR Act waiting periods; specified FERC, NRC, VSCC, NCUC and SCPSC regulatory orders or approvals; no burdensome condition imposed by regulatory clearances or orders with respect to the first merger; NYSE listing approval for the NextEra Energy shares to be issued, subject to official notice of issuance; and effectiveness of the Form S-4 without a stop order or proceeding seeking one. Each party's obligation is also subject to the other party's representations and warranties meeting the agreement's applicable accuracy standards, performance of its obligations in all material respects, receipt of an officer's certificate confirming those matters, and no continuing applicable material adverse effect since the agreement date. Approval of NextEra Energy's charter amendment is not a closing condition. Obtaining financing or existing-lender consent is not a closing condition; FCC consent is described as required for license transfers but not as a closing condition.
event_status: Pending as described in the 7/24/2026 joint proxy statement/prospectus; the merger agreement was executed on 5/15/2026, and the shareholder meetings were scheduled for 9/3/2026.
security_description: Eligible shares of Dominion Energy, Inc. common stock, without par value, issued and outstanding immediately before the first merger's effective time. cash_consideration: No cash is payable in lieu of fractional shares of PubCo Common Stock; no cash consideration per share of Company Common Stock is stated.
stock_exchange_ratio: A variable number of shares of PubCo Common Stock per 1 share of First Choice Healthcare Solutions, Inc. common stock, determined as the Aggregate Merger Consideration divided by the Aggregate Fully Diluted Company Shares. The per-share amount is subject to the Closing Consideration Spreadsheet and adjustment for specified changes to Parent securities or Company Capital Stock before the Merger Effective Time. Fractional PubCo shares will be rounded down to whole shares, with no cash in lieu.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver where permitted: no applicable legal prohibition or restraint; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an effective stop order or pending or threatened SEC suspension proceeding; approval of PubCo's initial exchange listing application and listing of the PubCo Common Stock to be issued. Parent's and Merger Sub's additional conditions include the Company's material covenant compliance, representations and warranties meeting the specified standards, no continuing Company Material Adverse Effect, an officer's certificate, a FIRPTA certificate and IRS notice, termination of specified contracts, Company Stockholder Approval, required Company consents, no unresolved adverse DEA or other regulatory communication of the specified kind, executed lock-up agreements, filing of specified outstanding material tax returns, and substantially simultaneous acquisition of the Pointe Med Entities. The Company's additional conditions include Parent's and Merger Sub's material covenant compliance and representations and warranties meeting the specified standards, a Parent officer's certificate, effectiveness of PubCo's Nevada articles of incorporation, executed registration rights and lock-up agreements, Parent Supporting Shareholders' material compliance with their support agreement, Parent Shareholder Approval, and no continuing Parent Material Adverse Effect.

cash_consideration: No cash merger consideration is stated for Powerus Common Stock; the stated merger consideration consists of AGH Common Stock, including the Earn Out Shares. Fractional AGH shares are rounded up to whole shares rather than paid in cash.
stock_exchange_ratio: 599.18229 shares of AGH common stock, par value $0.001 per share, per 1 share of Powerus common stock, par value $0.001 per share, plus each eligible Powerus stockholder’s allocation of 55,000,000 additional AGH common shares issued at closing. The exchange ratio is subject to equitable adjustment for specified changes in outstanding capital stock before the effective time. Fractional shares resulting from the exchange ratio are rounded up to the nearest whole AGH share.
shareholder_vote_date: AGH: written consent delivered on 3/9/2026 approving the merger agreement and other approval matters except the Newco Charter; a second written consent on 7/14/2026 approved the Newco Charter and Amendment No. 1. Powerus: written consent delivered on 3/9/2026 adopting the merger agreement; written consent delivered on 7/21/2026 approved Amendment No. 1. No shareholder meeting or further shareholder vote is planned.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver of applicable conditions: the already-obtained AGH and Powerus shareholder approvals; SEC effectiveness of the Form S-4 with no effective stop order; compliance with Rule 14c-2, including at least 20 calendar days after mailing the information statement/prospectus, or a longer period if required by SEC rules; expiration or termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period and no HSR Act restraint; AGH’s receipt of $10,000,000 in gross proceeds from its private placement; Nasdaq approval for listing the AGH shares issued to Powerus stockholders; no applicable legal restraint prohibiting the merger; required accuracy of the other party’s representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, no material adverse effect, and delivery of officer certificates. AGH’s additional conditions include receipt of Powerus lock-up agreements and the Earn Out Spreadsheet and satisfactory evidence that the repurchased Powerus shares are excluded from consideration. Powerus’ additional conditions include receipt of AGH leak-out agreements, replacement warrants and options, satisfaction of the preferred-stock purchase agreement’s closing conditions, and AGH director and officer resignation letters.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was amended on 7/17/2026, and shareholder approvals were obtained by written consent. The merger had not been consummated through 7/29/2026, the stated date the interim financial statements were available to be issued.

effective_date: No calendar date or clock time is stated. Conditionally, the merger becomes effective when the certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed by the parties and specified in the certificate.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Powerus Common Stock holders receive the specified AGH stock consideration. Qualifying dissenting holders may instead pursue statutory appraisal rights, subject to the applicable procedures.

closing_conditions: The proposed Business Combination requires approval of the Indenture Amendment Proposal by a majority in interest of Trust unitholders present at the Special Meeting, assuming a quorum. Conditions to the PBT contribution closing also include the Trustee entering into the amendment; NYSE listing authorization for the Class A shares; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without a stop order or action seeking one; expiration or termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period; absence of a legal restraint; specified accuracy of representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, and absence of specified material adverse effects; a cap of $112,700,000 on principal outstanding under the USLG Legacy credit facility and $200,000 on associated interest, penalties and fees, excluding specified amendment fees; and completion of specified pre-closing restructuring steps. The subsequent Blackbeard contribution closing is conditioned on completion of the PBT contribution closing and specified additional conditions, including no Form S-4 stop order or action seeking one, no legal restraint, specified accuracy of representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, absence of specified material adverse effects, the same credit-facility amount limits, completion of remaining restructuring steps, and delivery of specified closing documents. Conditions may be waived to the extent permitted by applicable law. Obtaining the credit-facility consents is expressly not a closing condition.
event_status: Pending; Combination Agreement entered into on 7/28/2026. Completion is not assured.
security_description: Units of beneficial interest of Permian Basin Royalty Trust (Trust Units).
available_options: No holder election for the one-for-one distribution of Class A shares in the Business Combination. A separate, optional rights offering permits Trust unitholders to subscribe for additional Class A shares.

acquirer: Eli Lilly and Company (Lilly); Albali Acquisition Corporation is Lilly’s wholly owned merger subsidiary.
consideration_type: Cash plus one contingent value right (CVR) per eligible share; the CVR provides for up to three contingent cash payments upon specified clinical and regulatory milestones.
cash_consideration: $6.75 in cash per eligible share of AtaiBeckley Inc. common stock at closing, without interest and less applicable tax withholding, plus one CVR representing the right to receive up to an aggregate of $2.50 in contingent cash payments per CVR, without interest and less applicable tax withholding. The CVR payments are subject to milestone achievement before the applicable deadlines and termination of the CVR agreement, and may be reduced by a Milestone Offset Amount: up to $1.00 for initiation of a Phase 3 clinical trial of VLS-01 before the fourth anniversary of closing; up to $0.50 for U.S. regulatory approval and DEA rescheduling of BPL-003 before the fifth anniversary; and up to $1.00 for U.S. regulatory approval and DEA rescheduling of VLS-01 before the seventh anniversary. Shares held by AtaiBeckley or specified affiliates and dissenting shares are excluded from the ordinary merger consideration.
stock_exchange_ratio: No stock consideration
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver, where permitted, of: AtaiBeckley stockholder approval; expiration or termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period; required antitrust notices, approvals and clearances for Australia and Germany and any triggered Springing Jurisdictions; expiration or termination of applicable agreements with governmental bodies not to consummate or to delay the merger; and absence of a governmental order or law preventing, prohibiting or making the merger illegal. Lilly’s and Merger Sub’s additional conditions include AtaiBeckley’s representations and warranties meeting the applicable accuracy standards, its material compliance with covenants, no continuing AtaiBeckley material adverse effect, receipt of its closing certificate, and absence of a pending governmental proceeding seeking specified prohibitions, material ownership or operating limitations, or divestitures. AtaiBeckley’s additional conditions include Lilly’s and Merger Sub’s representations and warranties meeting the applicable accuracy standards, their material compliance with covenants, and receipt of Lilly’s closing certificate. There is no financing condition.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was executed on July 15, 2026, and completion remains subject to closing conditions.
security_description: Issued and outstanding AtaiBeckley Inc. common stock, par value $0.01 per share, other than shares held in AtaiBeckley’s treasury or owned by AtaiBeckley, its subsidiaries, Lilly, Merger Sub or specified wholly owned subsidiaries, and dissenting shares.
effective_date: Not specified. The merger will become legally effective when the Delaware Secretary of State accepts the certificate of merger for filing, or at a later date and time agreed by Merger Sub and AtaiBeckley and specified in that certificate. AtaiBeckley expects to complete the merger in the third quarter of 2026, but the exact timing is uncertain.
available_options: No holder election

acquirer: Newbridge Acquisition Limited (Parent), acting through its wholly owned merger subsidiary, Newbridge Merger Sub, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock; eligible Startech Class A and Class B common stock is exchanged for shares of the corresponding specified class of the domesticated Parent's common stock. Cash is payable only instead of fractional Parent common shares.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration is stated. A holder otherwise entitled to a fractional Parent common share after aggregation receives cash instead, without interest, equal to the fraction multiplied by $10.00, rounded to the nearest cent.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each 1 share of Startech Class A common stock, a number of Parent Class B common shares equal to the Conversion Ratio. The Conversion Ratio is the number of Parent common shares constituting the Aggregate Merger Consideration divided by Aggregate Fully Diluted Company Common Stock; Aggregate Merger Consideration is the Base Purchase Price of US$1,000,000,000 divided by US$10.00. The Aggregate Merger Consideration and Conversion Ratio are subject to adjustment for specified changes in Parent common shares before issuance. No fractional Parent common shares will be issued; fractional interests are paid in cash.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permissible written waiver by Parent and Startech of the parties' conditions: no applicable law or order restraining, prohibiting or imposing a condition on the transaction; expiration or termination of any applicable HSR Act waiting period and receipt of specified governmental consents; no final, non-appealable law or order prohibiting or making the merger illegal; Startech stockholder approval and approval of the Required Parent Proposals at Parent's shareholder meeting; conditional approval of Parent's initial Nasdaq or alternate-exchange listing application, satisfaction of applicable listing requirements immediately after the effective time, no notice of noncompliance, and approval for listing of the merger shares; and effectiveness of the registration statement without an effective SEC stop order or pending, unwithdrawn proceeding seeking one. Parent's and Merger Sub's additional conditions include Startech's material covenant compliance, accuracy of its representations and warranties under the agreement's applicable standards, no continuing Startech Material Adverse Effect, required certificates and ancillary agreements, specified tax documentation, required Company Consents and specified director resignations (subject to the stated removal exception). Startech's additional conditions include Parent's and Merger Sub's material covenant compliance, accuracy of their representations and warranties under the applicable standards, no continuing Parent or Merger Sub Material Adverse Effect, Parent's domestication at least one business day before closing, effectiveness of Parent's Delaware certificate of incorporation, required certificates and ancillary agreements, appointment of the post-closing Parent board and resignations of Parent's directors and officers. A PIPE Investment is discussed but is not stated to be a closing condition.
event_status: Pending; the Business Combination Agreement was entered into on 8/3/2026, and closing remains subject to shareholder approvals and other conditions.
security_description: Startech Group Inc. Class A common stock, $0.00001 par value per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the merger's effective time, excluding shares cancelled under Section 3.1(a) and Dissenting Shares. Company options and convertible notes have separate treatment.
effective_date: The merger becomes effective upon filing the Certificate of Merger with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed by the parties and specified in that certificate; no calendar date or clock time is stated.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Startech Class A common shares are converted into the specified Parent Class B common-share consideration, subject to the stated exclusions and cash instead of fractional shares.

acquirer: Newbridge Acquisition Limited (Parent), acting through its wholly owned merger subsidiary, Newbridge Merger Sub, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock; eligible Startech Class B common stock is exchanged for shares of the domesticated Parent's Class A common stock. Cash is payable only instead of fractional Parent common shares.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration is stated. A holder otherwise entitled to a fractional Parent common share after aggregation receives cash instead, without interest, equal to the fraction multiplied by $10.00, rounded to the nearest cent.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each 1 share of Startech Class B common stock, a number of Parent Class A common shares equal to the Conversion Ratio. The Conversion Ratio is the number of Parent common shares constituting the Aggregate Merger Consideration divided by Aggregate Fully Diluted Company Common Stock; Aggregate Merger Consideration is the Base Purchase Price of US$1,000,000,000 divided by US$10.00. The Aggregate Merger Consideration and Conversion Ratio are subject to adjustment for specified changes in Parent common shares before issuance. No fractional Parent common shares will be issued; fractional interests are paid in cash.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permissible written waiver by Parent and Startech of the parties' conditions: no applicable law or order restraining, prohibiting or imposing a condition on the transaction; expiration or termination of any applicable HSR Act waiting period and receipt of specified governmental consents; no final, non-appealable law or order prohibiting or making the merger illegal; Startech stockholder approval and approval of the Required Parent Proposals at Parent's shareholder meeting; conditional approval of Parent's initial Nasdaq or alternate-exchange listing application, satisfaction of applicable listing requirements immediately after the effective time, no notice of noncompliance, and approval for listing of the merger shares; and effectiveness of the registration statement without an effective SEC stop order or pending, unwithdrawn proceeding seeking one. Parent's and Merger Sub's additional conditions include Startech's material covenant compliance, accuracy of its representations and warranties under the agreement's applicable standards, no continuing Startech Material Adverse Effect, required certificates and ancillary agreements, specified tax documentation, required Company Consents and specified director resignations (subject to the stated removal exception). Startech's additional conditions include Parent's and Merger Sub's material covenant compliance, accuracy of their representations and warranties under the applicable standards, no continuing Parent or Merger Sub Material Adverse Effect, Parent's domestication at least one business day before closing, effectiveness of Parent's Delaware certificate of incorporation, required certificates and ancillary agreements, appointment of the post-closing Parent board and resignations of Parent's directors and officers. A PIPE Investment is discussed but is not stated to be a closing condition.
event_status: Pending; the Business Combination Agreement was entered into on 8/3/2026, and closing remains subject to shareholder approvals and other conditions.
security_description: Startech Group Inc. Class B common stock, $0.00001 par value per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the merger's effective time, excluding shares cancelled under Section 3.1(a) and Dissenting Shares. Company options and convertible notes have separate treatment.
effective_date: The merger becomes effective upon filing the Certificate of Merger with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed by the parties and specified in that certificate; no calendar date or clock time is stated.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Startech Class B common shares are converted into the specified Parent Class A common-share consideration, subject to the stated exclusions and cash instead of fractional shares.

cash_consideration: No regular cash price per target share is stated. A holder otherwise entitled to a fractional Parent share will receive cash, without interest, equal to that fraction multiplied by the Redemption Price, rounded to the nearest cent.
stock_exchange_ratio: Each share of Blackstar common stock converts into the right to receive Parent shares equal to the Conversion Ratio; each share of Blackstar preferred stock converts into the right to receive Parent common shares equal to the Conversion Ratio multiplied by the number of Blackstar common shares into which that preferred share is convertible immediately before the Effective Time. The Conversion Ratio is the number of Parent shares constituting Aggregate Merger Consideration divided by the aggregate fully diluted Company shares. Aggregate Merger Consideration equals $380,000,000 divided by the Redemption Price. No fixed numerical exchange ratio is stated. The aggregate consideration and Conversion Ratio are subject to adjustment for specified changes to Parent shares before issuance, but not for net debt or debt-based purchase-price adjustments. No fractional Parent shares will be issued.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or written waiver where permissible by Parent and the Company: Blackstar stockholder approval and approval of the Required Parent Proposals at Pono’s shareholder meeting; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an effective SEC stop order or pending proceeding seeking one; conditional approval of Parent’s Nasdaq initial listing application, satisfaction of applicable Nasdaq listing requirements immediately after the Effective Time, and approval of the merger-consideration shares for listing; expiration or termination of applicable HSR waiting periods and receipt of specified governmental consents; no applicable legal restraint or final, non-appealable prohibition of the merger; termination of specified non-arm’s-length related-party transactions and transfer to Blackstar of business assets held or licensed by affiliates or related parties; and execution and delivery of the registration rights, lock-up, non-compete and employment agreements and equity incentive plan. Additional party-specific conditions include material covenant compliance, the specified accuracy of representations and warranties, and no continuing material adverse effect on the relevant party, plus specified certificates, consents, agreements and other closing deliverables. Pono’s domestication must occur at least one business day before closing. Neither the contemplated pre-merger financing nor the $30,000,000 closing financing is a closing condition.

stock_exchange_ratio: No stock consideration is payable to holders of Theravance Biopharma ordinary shares.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver where permitted: Theravance Biopharma shareholder approval by holders representing at least two-thirds of ordinary shares present and voting, in person or by proxy, as a single class at an extraordinary general meeting with a quorum; no effective order prohibiting, restraining, making illegal or enjoining the transactions; and expiration or termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period, for which the FTC granted early termination on 8/4/2026.
