acquirer: Langham Project, LLC (Parent); its wholly owned subsidiary, Langham Merger Sub, Inc., will merge with and into the target.
consideration_type: Stock conversion followed by cash merger consideration, with a contingent cash make-whole payment: each outstanding share of LogicMark, Inc. Series J convertible preferred stock converts into 0.976 shares of LogicMark common stock, which receive the cash merger consideration. A make-whole payment is due if the aggregate merger consideration for all Series J shares is less than USD $320,000.
cash_consideration: The resulting LogicMark common stock receives USD $1.31 per common share, without interest and subject to applicable withholding taxes; the per-common-share price is subject to adjustment for specified changes to the common stock before the merger becomes effective. Series J holders are entitled to a make-whole payment if aggregate merger consideration received for all Series J preferred shares is less than USD $320,000. No separate fixed cash amount per Series J preferred share is stated.
stock_exchange_ratio: 0.976 shares of LogicMark, Inc. common stock per 1 share of LogicMark, Inc. Series J convertible preferred stock; the resulting common stock receives the cash merger consideration, not acquirer stock.
shareholder_vote_date: LogicMark, Inc. stockholders’ special meeting is scheduled for 9/25/2026 at 1:00 p.m. Eastern Time.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permissible waiver: LogicMark stockholder approval by holders of a majority of the aggregate voting power of outstanding common stock, Series C preferred stock and Series J preferred stock, voting together, plus approval by a majority of shares voting at the meeting excluding the Series J holder’s shares but including officers’ and directors’ shares; no effective law or order prohibiting or preventing the merger; and required third-party consents. The buyer parties’ additional conditions include the specified accuracy of LogicMark’s representations and warranties, material compliance with its covenants, no Company Material Adverse Effect or Insolvency Event, termination of specified related-party agreements, the specified absence of executive compensation arrangements except as disclosed, redemption/cancellation/termination or acceptable amendment of Series C preferred stock, termination of the rights agreement, exercise/redemption/cancellation/termination of all company warrants, delivery of an officer’s certificate and a FIRPTA certificate, and dissenters’ rights exercised or still exercisable by holders of no more than 1% of outstanding common stock. LogicMark’s additional conditions include the specified accuracy of the buyer parties’ representations and warranties, their material compliance with covenants, delivery of $1,500,000 in cash to LogicMark for merger expenses, and delivery of an officer’s certificate. The filing states that no regulatory approvals are necessary. The agreement discusses Parent Acquisition Financing, but does not list receipt of that financing as a closing condition.
event_status: Pending under the merger agreement dated 7/31/2026; this is a preliminary proxy statement seeking LogicMark stockholder approval.
security_description: LogicMark, Inc. Series J convertible preferred stock, par value $0.0001 per share; its merger treatment differs from that of LogicMark common stock and Series C preferred stock.
effective_date: Not specified as a calendar date. The merger is expected to be completed in the third quarter of 2026, subject to stockholder approval and other closing conditions. It will become legally effective when articles of merger are filed with the Nevada Secretary of State, or at a later date and time agreed by the parties and specified in those articles.
available_options: No holder election. Outstanding Series J preferred shares automatically convert into LogicMark common stock in connection with the merger, with the stated contingent make-whole payment.

consideration_type: Conditional treatment of LogicMark, Inc. Series C non-convertible preferred stock: it must be redeemed, cancelled or otherwise terminated before the merger becomes effective, or its certificate of designation must be amended. If not redeemed and terminated, it remains outstanding as Series C preferred stock of the surviving corporation with the same rights, preferences and privileges.
stock_exchange_ratio: If the Series C preferred stock is not redeemed and terminated before the merger becomes effective, each outstanding share remains 1 share of Series C preferred stock of the surviving corporation, with the same rights, preferences and privileges; it is not converted or exchanged in the merger. No exchange ratio for a new security is stated.
shareholder_vote_date: LogicMark, Inc. stockholders’ special meeting is scheduled for 9/25/2026 at 1:00 p.m. Eastern Time.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permissible waiver: LogicMark stockholder approval by holders of a majority of the aggregate voting power of outstanding common stock, Series C preferred stock and Series J preferred stock, voting together, plus approval by a majority of shares voting at the meeting excluding the Series J holder’s shares but including officers’ and directors’ shares; no effective law or order prohibiting or preventing the merger; and required third-party consents. The buyer parties’ additional conditions include the specified accuracy of LogicMark’s representations and warranties, material compliance with its covenants, no Company Material Adverse Effect or Insolvency Event, termination of specified related-party agreements, the specified absence of executive compensation arrangements except as disclosed, redemption/cancellation/termination or acceptable amendment of Series C preferred stock, termination of the rights agreement, exercise/redemption/cancellation/termination of all company warrants, delivery of an officer’s certificate and a FIRPTA certificate, and dissenters’ rights exercised or still exercisable by holders of no more than 1% of outstanding common stock. LogicMark’s additional conditions include the specified accuracy of the buyer parties’ representations and warranties, their material compliance with covenants, delivery of $1,500,000 in cash to LogicMark for merger expenses, and delivery of an officer’s certificate. The filing states that no regulatory approvals are necessary. The agreement discusses Parent Acquisition Financing, but does not list receipt of that financing as a closing condition.

cash_consideration: Approximately USD $14.28 in cash per share of NSTS Bancorp, Inc. common stock, currently expected. Aggregate Merger Consideration is reduced dollar for dollar by pre-tax Company Transaction Expenses exceeding $4,500,000; there is no adjustment if those expenses are at or below $4,500,000. Shares for which appraisal rights are perfected are excepted from conversion into the cash consideration.
stock_exchange_ratio: No stock consideration
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver of applicable conditions: approval by holders of at least a majority of outstanding NSTS Bancorp, Inc. common shares entitled to vote; all required regulatory approvals remaining in effect, expiration or termination of statutory waiting periods, and no regulatory approval imposing a Burdensome Condition. Parent's OCC application was approved on August 10, 2026; Parent's Federal Reserve application and the Bank's OCC application remained pending. Each party's representations and warranties must meet the agreement's applicable accuracy standards, and each must comply with its covenants and obligations under the applicable standards. Required closing certificates, documents and payments must be delivered. Neither party may have suffered a Material Adverse Effect since the agreement date. The merger must not be prohibited by the specified regulatory orders, and the specified proceedings must not have commenced or been threatened. Conditions to Parent's obligation also include termination of the ESOP, repayment of its outstanding loans, and completion of the Mortgage Division Disposition. The parties state that they cannot guarantee that all conditions will be satisfied or waived.
event_status: Pending; merger agreement executed May 12, 2026, with stockholder approval and some regulatory approvals still outstanding.
security_description: NSTS Bancorp, Inc. common stock, $0.01 par value per share. Treasury shares are cancelled without consideration, and shares for which appraisal rights are perfected are subject to appraisal treatment.
effective_date: Not specified; the merger will become legally effective on the date specified in the Delaware Certificate of Merger, which the parties agree to file on or immediately before the closing date. Completion is expected in the fourth quarter of 2026, but is not guaranteed.

acquirer: ON Semiconductor Corporation (onsemi), through its wholly owned merger subsidiary, Sonic Acquisition Corp.
consideration_type: Stock; cash is payable only in lieu of fractional shares of ON Semiconductor Corporation common stock.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration per share of Synaptics common stock. A holder otherwise entitled to a fractional share of ON Semiconductor Corporation common stock, after aggregating fractional interests, will receive cash in U.S. dollars equal to that fraction multiplied by the average of the volume-weighted average trading prices per share of ON Semiconductor Corporation common stock on Nasdaq for the five consecutive trading days ending three trading days before the merger's effective date. The payment is rounded to the nearest cent, without interest and subject to required tax withholding.
stock_exchange_ratio: A fixed 1.350 shares of ON Semiconductor Corporation common stock, par value $0.01 per share, per 1 share of Synaptics Incorporated common stock, par value $0.001 per share, excluding cancelled shares. The ratio will not change with either company's market price, but is subject to an equitable adjustment for specified stock splits, stock dividends, reclassifications and similar share changes. No fractional shares will be issued; cash will be paid in lieu.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver, to the extent permitted by applicable law: effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an effective SEC stop order or unresolved stop-order proceeding; adoption of the merger agreement by holders of a majority of issued and outstanding Synaptics common shares entitled to vote; expiration or termination of applicable antitrust waiting periods and receipt of required antitrust and foreign-direct-investment authorizations; Nasdaq listing approval for the ON Semiconductor Corporation shares to be issued, including shares issuable upon settlement of converted Synaptics equity awards; and absence of a specified legal restraint preventing, enjoining or making the merger illegal. Each party's obligation also depends on the other party's representations and warranties meeting the agreement's applicable accuracy standards, material compliance with covenants, absence of a continuing applicable material adverse effect, an officer's certificate and receipt of the specified closing tax opinions that the merger will qualify as a reorganization under Section 368(a) of the Internal Revenue Code. Early termination of the U.S. HSR Act waiting period was granted effective 8/12/2026. Completion is not subject to a financing condition.
event_status: Pending as of the 8/21/2026 filing: the merger agreement was executed on 6/25/2026, and completion remained subject to closing conditions. Early termination of the U.S. HSR Act waiting period had been granted.
security_description: Synaptics Incorporated common stock, par value $0.001 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the merger's effective time. Shares held in Synaptics' treasury or by a Synaptics subsidiary, ON Semiconductor Corporation, an ON Semiconductor Corporation subsidiary or Sonic Acquisition Corp. will be cancelled without consideration; Synaptics equity awards have separate treatment.
effective_date: Not specified. Subject to closing, the merger becomes legally effective when the certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time mutually agreed in writing by ON Semiconductor Corporation and Synaptics Incorporated and specified in that certificate.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Synaptics common stock converts at the fixed stock exchange ratio, with cash only in lieu of fractional shares.

acquirer: Research Alliance Corporation III (RACC), which plans to domesticate in Delaware and be renamed Oak Hill Bio Inc.
consideration_type: Stock; Oak Hill Bio shareholders will receive newly issued New OHB Common Stock for their shares, subject to the applicable exchange ratio.
stock_exchange_ratio: A variable number of shares of New OHB Common Stock per Oak Hill Bio Share, equal to the Exchange Ratio. The Exchange Ratio is the Closing Consideration divided by fully diluted Oak Hill Bio Shares immediately before Closing; Closing Consideration is the Adjusted Equity Value divided by $10.00, and Adjusted Equity Value is $160,000,000 plus the Oak Hill Bio SAFE Amount. Each holder of deferred shares will receive one share of New OHB Common Stock. Fractional New OHB shares are rounded to the nearest whole share: down below 0.5 and up at or above 0.5. The filing's estimated Exchange Ratio is 0.1381, not a final fixed ratio.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted written waiver of applicable conditions, including approval of the required transaction proposals by RACC shareholders; approval of the Business Combination Agreement and transactions by Oak Hill Bio shareholders; expiration or termination of the HSR Act waiting period, if applicable; no applicable governmental order or law preventing or materially restraining the transactions; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an effective SEC stop order; Nasdaq approval of RACC's initial listing application and the New OHB Common Stock for listing; completion of the pre-closing reorganization and the Domestication at least one business day before Closing; constitution of the post-closing board; and delivery of the executed Investor Rights Agreement. RACC's additional conditions include the specified accuracy of Oak Hill Bio and shareholder representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, no continuing Company Material Adverse Effect, specified third-party consents, and executed stock transfer forms transferring all Oak Hill Bio Shares. Oak Hill Bio's additional conditions include the specified accuracy of RACC's representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, no continuing RACC Material Adverse Effect, and the Backstop Agreement remaining in force with the purchaser materially complying. RACC must have at least $5,000,001 in net tangible assets immediately after Closing. The Business Combination Agreement has no minimum cash proceeds condition; PIPE Financing is not identified as a merger closing condition.
event_status: Pending; the Business Combination Agreement was executed on July 26, 2026, and the transactions remain subject to closing conditions.
security_description: Issued shares in the capital of OHB Pediatrics Ltd., including ordinary shares and Series A convertible preferred shares, and deferred shares with separately specified one-share consideration. effective_date: The Share Acquisition will become effective upon Closing. Closing is scheduled for the fifth business day after satisfaction or permitted waiver of the applicable conditions, except conditions to be satisfied at Closing, at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time, unless RACC and Oak Hill Bio agree otherwise in writing. available_options: No holder election; Oak Hill Bio shareholders receive New OHB Common Stock under the stated exchange terms.

acquirer: Idaho USA, Inc., an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of Intersnack Group GmbH & Co. KG; its subsidiary Idaho Merger Sub, Inc. will merge with and into the target.
consideration_type: No consideration for outstanding Class V Common Stock, except that holders who properly perfect appraisal rights may receive amounts payable under Delaware appraisal law.
cash_consideration: No cash consideration for outstanding Utz Brands, Inc. Class V Common Stock; holders who properly perfect appraisal rights may instead receive amounts payable under Section 262 of the Delaware General Corporation Law.
stock_exchange_ratio: No stock consideration
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permissible waiver: approval by both a majority of issued and outstanding Utz Common Stock and a majority of votes cast by disinterested stockholders, excluding stockholders who are not Unaffiliated Utz Stockholders; absence of specified legal restraints; expiration or termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period and clearance or deemed approval under Ukraine’s Law on the Protection of Economic Competition of 2001; applicable accuracy of the parties’ representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, and closing certificates; no continuing Company Material Adverse Effect since the Merger Agreement date; no Burdensome Condition attached to required regulatory approval; substantially concurrent TRA Payment, termination of the Tax Receivable Agreement, Recapitalization and effectiveness of specified Company LLC operating-agreement provisions; and specified Continuing Stockholder representations and certificates. If the Redemption Shortfall Amount would exceed the Redemption Note Cap at closing, the Parent Entities’ related closing condition would not be satisfied. Obtaining debt or other financing is not a closing condition.
event_status: Pending as described in the preliminary proxy statement dated 8/24/2026; the merger agreement was signed on 7/20/2026, and consummation remained subject to closing conditions.
security_description: Utz Brands, Inc. Class V Common Stock, par value $0.0001 per share. This class is canceled for no consideration, unlike Class A Common Stock.
effective_date: Conditional: when the certificate of merger is duly filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later date and time agreed by Utz and Idaho USA, Inc. and specified in that certificate. No calendar effective date is stated.
available_options: No holder election

consideration_type: Stock: New Ursa Major common stock for outstanding Ursa Major common stock, other than excluded shares.

event_status: Announced; pending closing, shareholder approvals and other closing conditions.
security_description: Ursa Major Technologies, Inc. common stock issued and outstanding immediately before the merger, including common stock resulting from conversion of its preferred stock other than Pre-Funded Preferred Stock; excludes shares owned by Mach X, Merger Sub or Ursa Major, which are cancelled without consideration. effective_date: At the Effective Time on the Closing Date, when the certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed in writing by the parties and specified in that certificate. No calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: No holder election

acquirer: Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. III ("Mach X"), through its wholly owned merger subsidiary, Inflection Point Mach X Bleichroeder Merger Sub, Inc.
consideration_type: New Ursa Major Series A Investor Warrants to purchase New Ursa Major common stock in exchange for outstanding, unexercised Ursa Major Pre-Funded Preferred Investor Warrants.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each outstanding Ursa Major Pre-Funded Preferred Investor Warrant, one or more New Ursa Major Series A Investor Warrants to purchase a number of New Ursa Major common shares equal to that old warrant’s aggregate exercise price immediately before the Effective Time divided by $12.00. No fixed ratio of new warrants per old warrant is stated.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver of the applicable conditions, including Mach X shareholder approval of the transaction proposals; Ursa Major stockholder approval; no adverse law or order; an effective registration statement without an effective stop order; conditional approval to list the new common stock on Nasdaq or another mutually agreed national exchange, subject to the round-lot-holder requirement; expiration or termination of applicable HSR Act waiting periods and receipt of other required governmental approvals; completion of the Domestication; and a minimum of $150,000,000 comprising post-redemption trust cash plus gross Closing PIPE proceeds, excluding Pre-Funded PIPE proceeds, less specified underwriting fees and transaction costs. Ursa Major may waive the minimum cash condition in whole or in part. Party-specific conditions include the applicable accuracy of representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, no continuing uncured material adverse effect, and specified closing deliveries. Mach X and Merger Sub also require specified Ursa Major consents and approvals and treatment of certain outstanding Ursa Major warrants.
event_status: Announced; pending closing, shareholder approvals and other closing conditions.
security_description: Ursa Major Technologies, Inc. Pre-Funded Preferred Investor Warrants to purchase its common stock that remain outstanding and unexercised immediately before the merger; these are excluded from the pre-merger exercise requirement for other Ursa Major warrants.
effective_date: At the Effective Time on the Closing Date, when the certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed in writing by the parties and specified in that certificate. No calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: No holder election

closing_conditions: Pending conditions include no law or order prohibiting closing and no unaffiliated third-party action seeking to enjoin or restrict it; consummation of the SPAC Merger and required filings; SEC effectiveness of the registration statement without an outstanding stop order or proceeding; executed and effective additional agreements; requisite Starry Sea Acquisition Corp and SuperiorMed Holdings Limited shareholder approvals; and continued Nasdaq listing of Purchaser, approval of the additional listing application, and no unresolved listing-deficiency notice. Purchaser-party conditions include material covenant compliance, representations and warranties meeting the agreement's standards, no material adverse effect, a compliance certificate, material securities-law reporting compliance, appointment of SuperiorMed-designated directors, and execution and delivery of applicable additional agreements. The agreement permits waiver of specified party-specific conditions.

security_description: SuperiorMed Holdings Limited ordinary shares, par value $0.0001 per share, other than shares held by SuperiorMed or its direct or indirect subsidiaries.
effective_date: The Acquisition Merger is to become effective on the date specified in the Plan of Acquisition Merger; no calendar date is stated.
available_options: No holder election; eligible SuperiorMed shareholders receive an allocated portion of the Closing Payment Shares.

consideration_type: Stock; each eligible Starry Sea Acquisition Corp ordinary share converts into one SuperiorMed Healthcare Group Class A ordinary share. Each Starry Sea Acquisition Corp right first converts into a Purchaser Right, which is canceled at closing in exchange for Purchaser Class A ordinary shares. The filing conflicts on whether each Purchaser Right receives one-sixth of a share or one share.
stock_exchange_ratio: 1 SuperiorMed Healthcare Group Class A ordinary share per 1 Starry Sea Acquisition Corp ordinary share. For rights, 1 Purchaser Right per 1 Starry Sea Acquisition Corp right at the SPAC Merger effective time; the subsequent Purchaser Right-to-Class A share ratio is unresolved because the Form 8-K states one-sixth of a share per right, while the merger agreement states one share per right, with fractional shares rounded down. Parent treasury shares and Parent ordinary shares owned by wholly owned subsidiaries are canceled without conversion or payment.
closing_conditions: Pending conditions include no law or order prohibiting closing and no unaffiliated third-party action seeking to enjoin or restrict it; consummation of the SPAC Merger and required filings; SEC effectiveness of the registration statement without an outstanding stop order or proceeding; executed and effective additional agreements; requisite Starry Sea Acquisition Corp and SuperiorMed Holdings Limited shareholder approvals; and continued Nasdaq listing of Purchaser, approval of the additional listing application, and no unresolved listing-deficiency notice. SuperiorMed-related conditions include material covenant compliance, representations and warranties meeting the agreement's standards, no material adverse effect, required consents and governmental approvals, resolution and documentation of Dale Li funding, continuity of material leased premises, specified certificates and corporate documents, UAE and Cayman Islands legal opinions, applicable additional agreements, an updated disclosure schedule if materially changed, and completion of the restructuring giving SuperiorMed 100% ownership of the Dubai subsidiary. Purchaser-party conditions include material covenant compliance, representations and warranties meeting the agreement's standards, no material adverse effect, a compliance certificate, material securities-law reporting compliance, appointment of SuperiorMed-designated directors, and execution and delivery of applicable additional agreements. The agreement permits waiver of specified party-specific conditions.
event_status: Announced and pending; the merger agreement was signed on August 22, 2026, and closing remains subject to conditions.
security_description: Starry Sea Acquisition Corp ordinary shares, par value $0.0001 per share, including shares separated from units; and Starry Sea Acquisition Corp rights, including rights separated from units. Parent treasury shares and ordinary shares held by its wholly owned subsidiaries are excluded from conversion.
effective_date: The SPAC Merger is to become effective when the Plan of SPAC Merger is filed with the Registrar of Companies in the Cayman Islands, or at a later time specified in that plan; no calendar date is stated.
available_options: No holder election; eligible ordinary shares convert into Purchaser Class A ordinary shares, and rights convert into Purchaser Rights for cancellation at closing in exchange for Purchaser Class A ordinary shares.

consideration_type: Mixed cash and stock for each eligible share of Iridium common stock; holders cannot elect a different form of consideration. Excluded and dissenting shares receive different treatment.
cash_consideration: USD $27.00 in cash, without interest, per eligible share of Iridium common stock. Separately, instead of any fractional Rocket Lab common share otherwise due, a holder receives cash without interest equal to the Rocket Lab Stock Price multiplied by the fractional share.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each eligible share of Iridium common stock, holders receive Rocket Lab common stock at an Exchange Ratio of 0.4000 shares if the Rocket Lab Stock Price is at or below $67.50; $27.00 divided by the Rocket Lab Stock Price, rounded to four decimal places, if that price is above $67.50 and below $112.50; or 0.2400 shares if that price is at or above $112.50. The Rocket Lab Stock Price is the Nasdaq volume-weighted average price over the ten consecutive trading days ending on and including the second full trading day before the First Effective Time. The ratio is subject to equitable adjustment for specified changes in Iridium or Rocket Lab capital stock before the First Effective Time. Fractional shares are aggregated and replaced with cash.
shareholder_vote_date: Iridium stockholders’ special meeting is scheduled for 9/24/2026 at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time, virtually, to vote on adoption of the Merger Agreement. Rocket Lab stockholder approval is not required.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted written waiver: adoption of the Merger Agreement by holders of a majority of outstanding Iridium common shares entitled to vote; absence of specified effective legal restraints; expiration or termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period and any applicable timing-agreement period, plus required regulatory approvals remaining effective, including FCC and other satellite and communications approvals; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an SEC stop order or pending or threatened stop-order proceeding; and Nasdaq listing approval for Rocket Lab common shares issued in the Mergers. Each side’s additional conditions include the other side’s material covenant compliance, accuracy of representations and warranties under the agreement’s specified materiality standards, absence of a continuing material adverse effect since the agreement date, and delivery of an officer’s certificate. The HSR waiting period expired on 8/12/2026. Completion is not conditioned on Rocket Lab obtaining financing, Rocket Lab stockholder approval, or the intended tax treatment.
event_status: Pending under the Merger Agreement dated 6/28/2026. The parties expect completion in mid-2027, subject to required approvals and other closing conditions; the conditional second merger may not occur.
security_description: Iridium Communications Inc. common stock, par value $0.001 per share, other than specified treasury or parent-owned shares, shares held by Iridium subsidiaries, and shares for which appraisal rights are properly maintained.
effective_date: First Merger: no calendar date stated; it becomes effective when the First Certificate of Merger is accepted for filing by the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later date and time specified in that certificate. Conditional Second Merger: if the Second Merger Condition is satisfied, it is to occur immediately after the First Effective Time; if the Equity Threshold Condition but not the Second Merger Condition is satisfied, it is to occur on the second trading day after the First Effective Time. The Second Merger becomes effective when its certificate is accepted for filing, or at a later date and time specified in that certificate. The parties expect the Mergers to be completed in mid-2027, but no actual effective date is stated.
available_options: No holder election; each eligible Iridium common share receives both the cash and stock portions of the Merger Consideration.

acquirer: Curium US Holdings LLC (Parent), acting through its wholly owned merger subsidiary Coco Merger Sub Inc.
consideration_type: Cash plus one contractual contingent value right (CVR) per eligible share; the CVR provides for contingent cash payments if specified commercial milestones are achieved.
cash_consideration: $102.50 in cash, without interest, per share of Lantheus Holdings, Inc. common stock, plus one CVR per share representing the right to receive up to an additional $12.00 in cash, without interest, if specified commercial milestones are achieved and payment becomes due under the CVR agreement. Subject to applicable withholding taxes. Treasury shares, shares owned by specified transaction parties or subsidiaries, and shares with properly exercised appraisal rights are excluded from this treatment.
stock_exchange_ratio: No stock consideration
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver, where permitted, of: Lantheus stockholder approval; no effective governmental order or law preventing, prohibiting or making the merger illegal; expiration or termination of the HSR Act waiting period; no effective voluntary agreement with a governmental entity not to consummate the merger; and the other required regulatory approvals, filings, notifications, clearances or waiting-period expirations or terminations. Parent's and Merger Sub's additional conditions include the specified accuracy of Lantheus's representations and warranties, Lantheus's material compliance with its obligations, no continuing Company material adverse effect since the merger agreement date, and a Company officer's certificate. Lantheus's additional conditions include the specified accuracy of Parent's and Merger Sub's representations and warranties, their material compliance with their obligations, a Parent officer's certificate, and an executed CVR agreement in full force and effect. Obtaining financing is expressly not a closing condition.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was executed and the proposed acquisition was announced, but stockholder approval and other closing conditions remained applicable.
security_description: Common stock, par value $0.01 per share, of Lantheus Holdings, Inc., issued and outstanding immediately before the merger's effective time, excluding specified canceled shares and dissenting shares. Company equity awards have separate treatment.
effective_date: Not specified. The merger will become legally effective when the certificate of merger is filed with and accepted by the Delaware Secretary of State, or at another date and time agreed in writing by the parties and specified in that certificate.
available_options: No holder election; eligible common shares receive the fixed cash payment and one CVR. Eligible holders may instead seek statutory appraisal by complying with Delaware law, in which case they do not receive the merger consideration.

consideration_type: Cash, subject to applicable tax withholding and a possible reduction for certain dividends, distributions or returns of capital before the Effective Date
cash_consideration: $17.37 in cash, without interest, per Luxfer Holdings PLC ordinary share held immediately before the Effective Time, subject to applicable tax withholding. Buyer may reduce the amount by all or part of any dividend, distribution or return of capital announced, declared, made or paid on or after 7/26/2026 and before the Effective Date, other than the permitted $0.13 quarterly dividend. A shareholder not entitled to the relevant dividend, distribution or return of capital receives the full consideration; the consideration is not reduced if Buyer receives and retains it or it is cancelled.
stock_exchange_ratio: No stock consideration
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where permitted by applicable law, written waiver: Luxfer shareholder approval at the Scheme Meeting and Company GM; Court sanction of the scheme, with any non-de minimis modification acceptable to both parties acting reasonably and in good faith, and delivery of the Court Order to the Registrar of Companies in England and Wales; absence of an effective governmental order or applicable law restraining, prohibiting or making the Transaction illegal; expiration or termination of the HSR Act waiting period, satisfaction of conditions in the Company Disclosure Schedule, and termination or expiration of agreements with governmental authorities to delay closing. The filing also identifies required foreign investment approvals or authorizations, including in the United Kingdom and Italy. Each party's obligation is conditioned on the other party's representations and warranties meeting the agreement's specified accuracy standards and material compliance with its obligations. Buyer's obligation is additionally conditioned on no Company Material Adverse Effect since 7/26/2026. The HSR waiting period was scheduled to expire on 9/8/2026 unless earlier terminated or extended; the filing does not state that it has expired. Buyer obtaining financing is not a closing condition.
event_status: Pending; the Transaction Agreement was executed on 7/26/2026, and completion remained subject to shareholder, Court, regulatory and other closing conditions in this preliminary proxy statement
security_description: Luxfer Holdings PLC ordinary shares, £0.50 par value per share; shares held in treasury or registered in the name of or beneficially owned by Buyer or a member of Buyer's Group are excluded from Scheme Shares
effective_date: Expected in the fourth quarter of 2026, subject to completion conditions; the Scheme legally becomes effective when a copy of the Court Order sanctioning it is delivered to the Registrar of Companies in England and Wales for registration. No specific calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: No holder election; eligible holders receive the specified cash consideration for each Scheme Share

available_options: Eligible non-Insider holders of public JATT ordinary shares may request cash redemption of all or part of their public shares, regardless of how they vote or whether they held shares on the voting record date, by submitting the required written request and delivering their shares and applicable forms. A holder acting with affiliates or a group needs JATT's prior written consent to redeem more than 15% of the public shares in aggregate. Eligible outstanding JATT ordinary shares not redeemed or subject to appraisal convert into Talawar common stock at the stated one-for-one ratio.
default_option: An eligible JATT ordinary share that is not properly redeemed and is not a treasury or dissenting share automatically converts into the right to receive one post-closing Talawar common share at the Effective Time.
election_deadline: For the separately available public-share cash redemption right: two business days before the initially scheduled JATT Extraordinary General Meeting. The calendar date and time are blank in the preliminary filing. This is a redemption deadline, not a deadline for choosing among alternative merger consideration for the same share.

stock_exchange_ratio: No stock consideration for eligible holders of Atkore Inc. common stock.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver, to the extent permitted by law, of Atkore stockholder adoption of the Merger Agreement; expiration or termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period and applicable waiting periods or receipt of clearances or approvals in other jurisdictions, including Austria, Australia and Canada; and absence of a law or governmental order preventing, prohibiting or making the transaction illegal. Atkore’s additional conditions include specified accuracy standards for Prysmian’s and Merger Sub’s representations and warranties, their material covenant compliance, and an officer certificate. Prysmian’s and Merger Sub’s additional conditions include specified accuracy standards for Atkore’s representations and warranties, Atkore’s material covenant compliance, no Company Material Adverse Effect since the Merger Agreement date, and an officer certificate. Prysmian’s receipt or availability of financing is not a closing condition.
event_status: Pending; the Merger Agreement was executed, but completion remains subject to closing conditions.
security_description: Atkore Inc. common stock, par value $0.01 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the merger; excludes shares canceled or converted under the Merger Agreement and shares for which appraisal rights are properly exercised.
available_options: No holder election.

cash_consideration: If Tempus makes a Tempus Cash Election, $16.25 in cash, without interest, per Personalis common share allocated to the holder's pro rata portion of the shares subject to that election; the cash election may cover up to 50% of aggregate outstanding Personalis common shares, subject to potential reduction to preserve the intended tax treatment of the mergers. closing_conditions: The First Merger's closing is subject to satisfaction or, to the extent permitted under the Merger Agreement and applicable law, waiver of the closing conditions set forth in the Merger Agreement, including satisfaction or permitted waiver at closing of conditions that by their nature are to be satisfied then. consideration_type: Mixed cash and stock, subject to a possible adjustment relating to dissenting shares.
cash_consideration: $96.00 in cash per share of Roku Class A common stock or Roku Class B common stock, without interest and subject to applicable withholding taxes. stock_exchange_ratio: 0.9693 shares of FOX Class A common stock per 1 share of Roku Class A common stock or Roku Class B common stock. No fractional FOX Class A shares will be issued to Roku stockholders; they will receive cash instead.
shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled for 10/14/2026, unless adjourned or postponed: Roku stockholders will vote at 12:30 p.m. Pacific Time on adoption of the Merger Agreement; FOX Class B common stockholders will vote at 3:00 p.m. Eastern Time on the FOX stock issuance.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver by the party entitled to the benefit of each condition: effectiveness of the registration statement, with no effective SEC stop order or unresolved proceeding for one; Roku stockholder approval of the Merger Agreement and FOX Class B stockholder approval of the stock issuance; expiration or termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period and receipt of required antitrust and investment-screening consents in specified jurisdictions; absence of applicable legal restraints or pending litigation seeking a specified antitrust or investment-screening order; and Nasdaq listing approval for the FOX Class A shares to be issued, subject to official notice of issuance. Each party's obligation is also subject to the other party's required covenant compliance, accuracy of representations and warranties under the agreement's stated standards, absence of a continuing material adverse effect on the other party, and receipt of the specified officer certificates. FOX obtaining debt financing is not a closing condition.
event_status: Pending as described in the filing: the Merger Agreement was executed on 6/14/2026, the Mergers were announced on 6/15/2026, and consummation remained subject to closing conditions.
security_description: Roku Class A common stock and Roku Class B common stock, each par value $0.0001 per share. Both classes receive the same merger consideration, except for specified excluded shares and dissenting shares; Roku equity awards have separate treatment.
effective_date: No calendar effective date is stated. The First Merger takes effect when its certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at another time specified in that certificate as agreed in writing by FOX and Roku. The Second Merger is to take effect immediately following the First Merger, when its certificate is filed or at another agreed time specified in it.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Roku stockholders receive the stated combination of cash and FOX Class A common stock, subject to the agreement's adjustments and exceptions.

Each holder’s aggregate NewCo shares are rounded down to a whole share, with no cash in lieu. cash_consideration: No cash merger consideration is specified for Data443 common stock. No cash is payable in lieu of fractional NewCo shares. Properly perfected dissenting shares instead carry a right to payment of fair value under Nevada law.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each share of Data443 common stock, including shares issued upon preferred-stock conversion or debt conversion, a number of NewCo common shares equal to the Exchange Ratio: Aggregate Merger Consideration divided by Data443 Outstanding Shares, carried to four decimal places. Aggregate Merger Consideration equals Data443 Stock Consideration (the Base Value as finally determined in the Closing Statement) divided by $10.00, rounded down to a whole share and capped at 60,000,000 NewCo common shares. The Base Value is $100,000,000, reduced dollar-for-dollar if less than $10,000,000 of Data443 debt is converted. Each holder’s aggregate NewCo shares are rounded down to a whole share, with no cash in lieu. An additional pool of up to 1,260,000 NewCo common shares is contingent on the stated net-operating-loss milestones; no per-share ratio for those shares is specified.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted waiver: expiration or termination of applicable HSR Act waiting periods and specified governmental commitments, and receipt of specified legal consents; no effective legal restraint prohibiting the transaction; effectiveness of the Form S-4 without an effective stop order or pending SEC stop-order proceeding; Data443 stockholder written consent and required Parent stockholder approval; conversion of at least $10,000,000 of Data443 indebtedness under effective conversion agreements, NewCo’s joinder, and effectiveness of the Parent Merger at or concurrently with Closing. Parent’s obligations also require Data443’s representations and warranties to meet the stated standards, material covenant compliance, no continuing Company Material Adverse Effect, and specified closing documents. Data443’s obligations likewise require the Parent Parties’ representations and warranties to meet the stated standards, material covenant compliance, no continuing Parent Material Adverse Effect, the specified post-closing board composition, and closing documents. The Form 8-K also identifies approval of NewCo common stock for Nasdaq listing as a closing condition.
event_status: Pending; the Business Combination Agreement was entered into on 8/27/2026, and the proposed transactions remained subject to approvals and other closing conditions when announced on 9/2/2026.
security_description: Data443 Risk Mitigation, Inc. common stock, par value $0.001 per share, including common shares issued upon conversion of convertible Data443 preferred stock and in the Debt Conversion. Dissenting and treasury shares have separate treatment.
effective_date: No calendar date or time is specified. The Data443 merger will become effective at the date and time agreed by Parent and Data443 and specified in articles of merger filed with the Nevada Secretary of State; it is to occur immediately following the Parent Merger.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Data443 common shares convert into the right to receive NewCo common shares. Properly perfected dissenters’ rights and the treatment of treasury shares are exceptions, not consideration elections.

The ratio's numerical value is not stated. Merger consideration is rounded to the nearest whole share per holder after aggregation, with 0.5 or greater rounded up. closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver where permitted: expiration or termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period; no governmental order or law preventing or materially restraining the transactions; TVA having at least $5,000,001 in net tangible assets after shareholder redemptions; required TVA shareholder and Plus Automation stockholder approvals; adoption or execution of required governance documents and arrangements and appointment of the contemplated TVA board; listing and eligibility for continued listing of the contemplated TVA Class A common stock, including earnout shares, on the agreed exchange; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement, without an SEC stop order or threatened or initiated action seeking one; and Available Closing SPAC Cash of at least $40,000,000 unless waived by TVA and Plus Automation. acquirer: Repligen Corporation, through its wholly owned subsidiaries Bravo Merger Sub I, Inc. and Bravo Merger Sub II, LLC
consideration_type: Mixed cash and stock, subject to adjustment if the aggregate Repligen Common Stock issuable would exceed the Maximum Share Number.
cash_consideration: USD $11.25 in cash, without interest, per eligible share of BioLife Solutions, Inc. common stock. If the aggregate Repligen Common Stock issuable would exceed the Maximum Share Number, the per-share cash amount increases by the specified five-trading-day volume-weighted average price of Repligen Common Stock multiplied by the reduction in the exchange ratio, rounded up to the nearest cent. Cash, without interest, is also paid instead of fractional Repligen shares, based on the specified ten-trading-day volume-weighted average price.
stock_exchange_ratio: 0.1442 shares of Repligen Corporation common stock, par value $0.01 per share, per 1 eligible share of BioLife Solutions, Inc. common stock, par value $0.001 per share. The ratio is fixed except for specified adjustments, including a reduction, rounded down to four decimal places, if aggregate stock consideration would exceed the Maximum Share Number, which cannot exceed 19.9% of Repligen Common Stock outstanding immediately before the First Merger Effective Time. The ratio and consideration may also be adjusted for specified stock splits and similar changes. No fractional Repligen shares will be issued; cash will be paid instead.
shareholder_vote_date: BioLife Solutions, Inc. stockholders are scheduled to vote at a virtual special meeting on 10/5/2026 at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time. No Repligen stockholder vote is required.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted waiver: adoption of the Merger Agreement by holders of a majority of outstanding BioLife common shares entitled to vote; expiration or termination of the HSR Act waiting period and required antitrust consents or waiting periods in specified jurisdictions; no effective governmental restraint or law prohibiting the transactions; SEC effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without a stop order or proceeding seeking one; and Nasdaq authorization to list the Repligen shares, subject to customary listing requirements. Each side also has conditions concerning the other side’s representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants and absence of a continuing material adverse effect, plus receipt of the specified officer’s certificate. The filing says the HSR waiting period was scheduled to expire on 9/3/2026 but does not state that it expired. The agreement has no financing condition.
event_status: Pending; the Merger Agreement was executed on 7/21/2026 and the mergers remained subject to closing conditions in the proxy statement.
security_description: Eligible shares of BioLife Solutions, Inc. common stock, par value $0.001 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the First Merger Effective Time. Treasury shares, shares owned by Repligen or either merger subsidiary, and shares with properly exercised appraisal rights are excluded from the ordinary merger consideration.
effective_date: No calendar effective date is stated. Conditionally, the First Merger becomes effective upon filing and acceptance of its certificate of merger with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time specified in that certificate; the Second Merger becomes effective immediately thereafter upon filing and acceptance of its certificate, or at a later specified time. Closing was anticipated in the fourth quarter of 2026, but the filing distinguishes closing from legal effectiveness.
available_options: No holder election; each eligible BioLife common share converts into the right to receive both the cash and stock consideration, subject to the stated adjustments. Holders who properly exercise and maintain appraisal rights receive appraisal treatment instead of merger consideration.

acquirer: MiMedx Group, Inc.; its wholly-owned subsidiary, Mustang Merger Sub, Inc., will merge into Sanara MedTech Inc.
consideration_type: Mixed cash and stock for each eligible share of Sanara Common Stock, subject to applicable withholding taxes and adjustment. Excluded shares and properly perfected dissenting shares do not receive the merger consideration.
cash_consideration: $33.00 in cash, without interest, per eligible share of Sanara Common Stock, subject to applicable withholding taxes and adjustment. Cash is also paid instead of any fractional MiMedx Common Stock share, without interest, based on the fractional share multiplied by MiMedx Common Stock's Nasdaq closing price on the last trading day immediately before the closing date, rounded to the nearest cent.
stock_exchange_ratio: 0.4735 shares of MiMedx Group, Inc. common stock, par value $0.001 per share, per 1 eligible share of Sanara MedTech Inc. common stock, par value $0.001 per share, subject to adjustment for specified changes in outstanding capital stock before the effective time. No fractional MiMedx shares will be issued; cash will be paid instead.
shareholder_vote_date: Sanara MedTech Inc. shareholders: special meeting scheduled for 9/30/2026 at 9:00 a.m., Central Time.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver where permitted by law: Sanara shareholder approval; no effective legal restraint prohibiting the merger; expiration or termination of applicable HSR Act waiting periods and any U.S. governmental agreement to delay closing, plus required antitrust approvals; SEC effectiveness of the registration statement without a stop order; and Nasdaq listing approval for the MiMedx shares, subject to official notice of issuance. MiMedx and Merger Sub also require Sanara's material covenant compliance, representations and warranties meeting the agreement's specified accuracy standards and exceptions, no Material Adverse Effect since the agreement date, and an executive-officer certificate. Sanara also requires MiMedx and Merger Sub's material covenant compliance, MiMedx's representations and warranties meeting the specified accuracy standards and exceptions, and a MiMedx executive-officer certificate. Obtaining financing is explicitly not a closing condition.
event_status: Pending as described in the proxy statement: the merger agreement has been executed, and Sanara shareholder approval and other closing conditions remain required.
security_description: Sanara MedTech Inc. common stock, par value $0.001 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the effective time, other than excluded shares and shares held by shareholders who properly demand appraisal.
effective_date: Not specified as a calendar date. The filing states that closing is expected in the fourth quarter of 2026, but does not give an effective date.
available_options: No holder election; each eligible share is converted into the fixed cash-and-stock merger consideration.

acquirer: First Financial Bancorp. (parent acquirer); its wholly owned subsidiary First Financial Bank is the surviving bank in the related bank merger.
target: Finward Bancorp (parent target); its wholly owned subsidiary Peoples Bank is the target in the related bank merger.
consideration_type: Stock; cash is paid only in lieu of fractional First Financial common shares. The consideration is subject to the merger agreement’s terms and conditions.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration per share of Finward common stock is stated. A holder otherwise entitled to a fractional First Financial common share receives USD cash, rounded to the nearest cent, equal to the average closing-sale price of First Financial common shares on Nasdaq for the five full trading days ending on the day preceding the closing date, multiplied by the holder’s fractional share entitlement after aggregating the holder’s Finward shares and rounding the fraction to the nearest thousandth.
stock_exchange_ratio: 1.35 First Financial Bancorp. common shares, no par value, per 1 share of Finward Bancorp common stock, no par value. The ratio is subject to an appropriate and proportionate adjustment for specified changes in capitalization or an extraordinary dividend or distribution. No fractional First Financial common shares will be issued; cash is paid in their place.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where legally permissible, waiver at or before the effective time: approval of the merger by a majority of outstanding Finward common stock entitled to vote; authorization to list the First Financial common shares issued in the merger on Nasdaq, subject to official notice of issuance; receipt of required regulatory approvals, including from the Federal Reserve Board and the Ohio Department of Commerce, Division of Financial Institutions, with applicable statutory waiting periods expired or terminated and no materially burdensome regulatory condition; effectiveness of the Form S-4, with no SEC stop order or pending or threatened proceeding for one that has not been withdrawn; absence of legal restraints or laws prohibiting or making the merger, bank merger or other contemplated transactions illegal; each party’s representations and warranties satisfying the applicable contractual accuracy standards and each party’s material compliance with its obligations, covenants and agreements, supported by officers’ certificates; receipt by each party of a legal opinion that the merger will qualify as a reorganization under Section 368(a) of the Internal Revenue Code; and Finward’s delivery to First Financial of the specified FIRPTA statement. The representation-and-warranty conditions include the stated material-adverse-effect standards.
event_status: Announced and pending as described in the registration statement filed September 4, 2026; completion remains subject to conditions, including Finward shareholder approval and regulatory approvals.
security_description: Finward Bancorp common stock, no par value per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the merger’s effective time, excluding specified shares owned by Finward or First Financial. Outstanding Finward restricted stock awards and performance share unit awards have separately described vesting and conversion treatment.
effective_date: The merger will become effective on the date and at the time specified in the certificate of merger filed with the Ohio Secretary of State and the articles of merger filed with the Indiana Secretary of State on the closing date. No calendar date or effective time is specified. The parties expect to complete the merger in the fourth quarter of 2026 or early in the first quarter of 2027, but state that they cannot predict the actual completion date.
available_options: No holder election; eligible shares of Finward common stock convert into the fixed stock consideration, with cash only in lieu of fractional shares.

cash_consideration: No cash consideration for Company Series C Preferred Shares in this merger. stock_exchange_ratio: 1 Surviving Entity Series C Preferred Unit per 1 LXP Industrial Trust 6.50% Series C Cumulative Convertible Preferred Share. shareholder_vote_date: No shareholder vote required for holders of LXP Industrial Trust Company Series C Preferred Shares; they are entitled to notice of the Special Meeting, but their vote is not required or solicited.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where permitted by law, valid waiver at or before closing: LXP Industrial Trust common-shareholder approval by holders entitled to cast a majority of all votes entitled to be cast on the merger; specified governmental consents remaining in force; no effective governmental order or subsequently enacted law prohibiting, restraining, enjoining or making the merger illegal; applicable accuracy requirements for each party’s representations and warranties; each party’s material compliance with applicable obligations and covenants; no continuing Company Material Adverse Effect since the agreement date; delivery of required officer certificates; and Parent’s receipt of the specified REIT tax opinion covering the period from the taxable year ended December 31, 2019 through the short taxable year ending at the Effective Time. The merger is not conditioned on financing, on obtaining an assumption of existing indebtedness, or on completion of a repurchase, cash-out merger or liquidation of the Series C Preferred Shares.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was executed and announced, but shareholder approval and closing are described as prospective.

effective_date: Conditional timing, not a specified calendar date: the merger becomes effective at the later of the Maryland State Department of Assessments and Taxation’s acceptance of the Articles of Merger for record and a time designated by the parties in those articles, no more than 30 days after acceptance.
available_options: No holder election; each Company Series C Preferred Share converts into one Surviving Entity Series C Preferred Unit in the merger.

acquirer: Leyte Parent, Inc. (Pubco), through its wholly owned subsidiary Leyte Merger Sub I, Inc. (SPAC Merger Sub)
consideration_type: Stock for Meshflow Delaware common stock; warrants for Meshflow Delaware warrants. Shares validly submitted for redemption instead receive the applicable cash redemption amount.
cash_consideration: No regular cash merger consideration is stated for non-redeeming shares. A validly redeemed Meshflow Class A ordinary share, or the domesticated share into which it converted, receives the applicable cash amount under Meshflow’s organizational documents and trust agreement; the amount per share is not stated.
stock_exchange_ratio: 1 share of Leyte Parent, Inc. common stock per 1 share of Meshflow Delaware common stock, including domesticated Class A and Class B shares. A Meshflow Delaware unit detaches into one share and one-third of a warrant before the underlying securities convert. Each Meshflow Delaware warrant converts into one Pubco warrant. Redeemed shares do not convert into Pubco common stock.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permissible written waiver of the applicable conditions: approval of the transaction proposals by Meshflow shareholders and the transactions by HGP equity holders; no law or order prohibiting the transactions; an effective SEC registration statement with no operative stop order; conditional exchange listing approval for Pubco common stock; expiration or termination of applicable HSR and other antitrust waiting periods and receipt of required antitrust approvals. HGP’s additional conditions include accuracy of the SPAC parties’ representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, no continuing SPAC material adverse effect, availability of net trust proceeds, at least $40 million of Available Closing Cash and receipt by Pubco of PIPE Proceeds, applicable post-closing listing compliance, required resignations and board appointments, Pubco charter amendment, certificates and ancillary documents, and completion of Meshflow’s domestication.
event_status: Pending; the business combination agreement was executed, but closing remained subject to conditions.
security_description: Meshflow Delaware common stock converted from Meshflow Acquisition Corp. Class A ordinary shares and Class B ordinary shares; Meshflow Delaware units and warrants also have specified treatment. Validly redeemed Class A shares are excepted from the stock conversion.

acquirer: Leyte Parent, Inc. (Pubco), through its wholly owned subsidiary Leyte Merger Sub II, LLC (HGP Merger Sub)
consideration_type: Stock; HGP units are exchanged for the applicable portion of an aggregate 80,000,000 newly issued Pubco common shares. Outstanding HGP SAFEs convert into eligible Class C units immediately before the merger, conditioned on its occurrence.
cash_consideration: No cash merger consideration is specified for HGP units; the stated merger consideration consists of newly issued Pubco common stock.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permissible written waiver of the applicable conditions: approval of the transaction proposals by Meshflow shareholders and the transactions by HGP equity holders; no law or order prohibiting the transactions; an effective SEC registration statement with no operative stop order; conditional exchange listing approval for Pubco common stock; expiration or termination of applicable HSR and other antitrust waiting periods and receipt of required antitrust approvals. The SPAC parties’ additional conditions include accuracy of HGP’s representations and warranties, HGP’s material covenant compliance, no continuing HGP material adverse effect, required officer and secretary certificates and delivery and continuing effectiveness of specified ancillary documents.
event_status: Pending; the business combination agreement was executed, but closing remained subject to conditions.
security_description: Issued and outstanding HGP Intelligent Energy, LLC Class A, Class B and Class C units, other than treasury interests and compensatory units treated separately. Class C units issued upon conversion of HGP SAFEs immediately before the merger are eligible for merger consideration.
effective_date: Proposed: 5:00 p.m. New York City time on the Closing Date, or another date and/or time agreed in writing by HGP and Meshflow and specified in the merger certificates. No calendar Closing Date is stated.
available_options: No holder election for HGP unit merger consideration; holders receive their applicable portion of Pubco common stock. The separate pre-merger SAFE conversion agreement provides for conversion into Class C units.

acquirer: Sunrise Realty Trust, Inc. (SUNS), through its wholly owned merger subsidiary Sunrise Merger Sub, LLC, which will survive the merger as a wholly owned subsidiary of SUNS.
consideration_type: Mixed cash and stock; eligible SRT common shares receive SUNS common stock from SUNS and cash from Sunrise Manager LLC. Excluded shares and certain unvested restricted shares receive different treatment.
cash_consideration: $0.05 in cash per eligible share of Southern Realty Trust Inc. common stock, payable by Sunrise Manager LLC as additional merger consideration, without interest. Continuing participants' rollover restricted shares receive a restricted cash payment on the same vesting terms and conditions as the original awards.
stock_exchange_ratio: A fixed 1.45 shares of Sunrise Realty Trust, Inc. common stock, par value $0.01 per share, per 1 eligible share of Southern Realty Trust Inc. common stock, par value $0.01 per share. No fractional SUNS shares will be issued; any fractional share otherwise receivable will be rounded up to the nearest whole share. Continuing participants' rollover restricted shares convert into restricted SUNS shares at the same ratio, with their original vesting terms and conditions.
shareholder_vote_date: SUNS stockholders are scheduled to vote on approval of the stock issuance at a virtual special meeting on 10/23/2026 at 9:30 a.m. Eastern Time. SRT stockholders must approve the merger at a separate meeting; its date and time are not stated.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where permitted by law, waiver: required governmental consents, authorizations, orders and approvals identified in the parties' disclosure letters; approval of the SUNS stock issuance by a majority of votes cast at a meeting with a quorum and approval of the merger by holders of a majority of outstanding SRT common shares; and no effective governmental order or law prohibiting, restraining, enjoining or making the merger or related transactions illegal. Each party's additional conditions include the other side's representations and warranties meeting the specified materiality standards, material performance of obligations and covenants, no material adverse effect since the agreement date, and delivery of an officer certificate. Closing also requires specified opinions concerning SUNS's and SRT's REIT qualification and the merger's qualification as a reorganization under Section 368(a) of the Internal Revenue Code. SRT's obligation is conditioned on the amended and restated SUNS management agreement being in full force and effect. SUNS's and Merger Sub's obligations are additionally conditioned on SRT granting SUNS a 100% excepted holder limit, the lock-up agreement being in full force and effect, and performance of the SRT manager termination agreement so that the SRT management agreement terminates at the merger effective time without further liability.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was executed on 8/5/2026, the SUNS stockholder vote was scheduled, and completion remained subject to closing conditions. The parties expected completion in the fourth quarter of 2026 but gave no assurance that it would occur.
security_description: Southern Realty Trust Inc. common stock, par value $0.01 per share. Issued and outstanding eligible shares are affected by the merger consideration; cancelled shares receive none. Unvested SRT restricted shares held by continuing service providers roll over into restricted SUNS shares and a restricted cash payment, while other unvested SRT restricted shares vest immediately before the effective time and then receive the merger consideration.
effective_date: Not specified as a calendar date. The merger will become legally effective when Maryland's State Department of Assessments and Taxation accepts the articles of merger for record, or at another date and time specified in the articles, not more than 30 days after acceptance; the agreement states that the parties will cause the effective time to occur on the closing date. Completion was expected during the fourth quarter of 2026, subject to conditions.
available_options: No holder election; each eligible SRT common share is converted into the right to receive the fixed combination of SUNS common stock and cash, subject to the stated excluded-share and restricted-share treatment.

acquirer: Indivior Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (parent); its wholly owned subsidiary Artemis Merger Sub Inc. will merge into Supernus Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock; eligible Supernus common shares convert into Indivior common shares. Cash is payable only in lieu of fractional Indivior shares.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration per Supernus common share. A holder otherwise entitled to a fractional Indivior share receives cash instead, rounded to the nearest cent, without interest and subject to required tax withholding. The amount equals the fractional share multiplied by the volume-weighted average trading price of an Indivior share on Nasdaq for the five consecutive trading days ending on the trading day three trading days before the effective time.
stock_exchange_ratio: 1.5401 shares of Indivior Pharmaceuticals, Inc. common stock, par value $0.001 per share, per 1 share of Supernus Pharmaceuticals, Inc. common stock, par value $0.001 per share, other than excluded shares. The ratio is fixed against changes in either stock's market price, but is subject to equitable adjustment for specified share-count changes before the effective time. Fractional Indivior shares will not be issued; cash will be paid instead.
shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled for 10/15/2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time: Indivior stockholders vote on the share issuance and Supernus stockholders vote on adoption of the merger agreement, each at a separate virtual special meeting.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver, where permitted: Supernus stockholder approval of the merger proposal and Indivior stockholder approval of the share issuance; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without a stop order; expiration or termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period; no effective governmental order or applicable law enjoining or prohibiting the merger; and Nasdaq listing approval for the Indivior shares issuable in the merger, subject to official notice of issuance. Each party's obligation is also subject to the other party's specified representations and warranties being accurate under the agreement's applicable materiality standards, material compliance with covenants, no material adverse effect since the merger agreement date, and delivery of an officer's certificate. Indivior and Merger Sub's obligations are conditioned on Supernus satisfying those party-specific requirements; Supernus' obligations are conditioned on Indivior and Merger Sub satisfying theirs. The merger is not conditioned on obtaining debt financing.
event_status: Pending as described in the joint proxy statement/prospectus dated 9/11/2026; the merger agreement was executed on 8/1/2026, and the companies were seeking stockholder approvals and satisfaction or waiver of other closing conditions.
security_description: Issued and outstanding shares of Supernus Pharmaceuticals, Inc. common stock, par value $0.001 per share, immediately before the effective time, excluding treasury shares and shares held by Indivior, Merger Sub, or a direct or indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Supernus or Indivior.
effective_date: No specific effective date stated. The merger will become legally effective when the certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later date or time agreed in writing by Indivior and Supernus and specified in that certificate. Completion was expected in the fourth quarter of 2026, but the actual date could not be predicted.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Supernus common shares convert into the fixed stock consideration, with cash in lieu of any fractional Indivior share.

acquirer: DTSQ Purchaser Inc., the wholly owned subsidiary of DT Cloud Star Acquisition Corporation that survives the Redomestication Merger
consideration_type: Stock; eligible holders who do not redeem also receive a pro rata allocation of Non-Redemption Warrants.
cash_consideration: No regular cash merger consideration is stated for DTCS Ordinary Shares converted in the Redomestication Merger. Public Shares properly tendered for redemption are instead redeemed for cash at the pro rata portion of the Trust Account calculated two Business Days before consummation of the Business Combination; the final per-share amount is not stated. Dissenting shares have separate fair-value rights.
stock_exchange_ratio: 1 share of DTSQ Purchaser Inc. Class A Common Stock per 1 DTCS Ordinary Share, including a DTCS Ordinary Share resulting from conversion of a DTCS Unit or Right; excludes Parent Excluded Shares and Parent Dissenting Shares. Each DTCS Right entitles its holder to 1/9 of a DTCS Ordinary Share upon consummation of the Business Combination; fractional-share interests upon conversion of Rights are rounded down to whole shares without cash in lieu.
closing_conditions: The Redomestication Merger is a condition to the Business Combination, and the Redomestication Merger Proposal requires DTCS shareholder approval. Closing conditions, subject to written waiver where permissible, include required DTCS and PrimeGen US, Inc. stockholder approvals; expiration or termination of applicable antitrust waiting periods and receipt of specified third-party consents; no law or order prohibiting the transactions; appointment of the Purchaser board; an effective Form S-4 with no effective stop order; and Nasdaq listing approval and applicable listing compliance. Additional party-specific conditions include the accuracy of representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, no continuing uncured material adverse effect, specified closing documents and deliveries, and the amendment of the PGB patent license required by the Parent Parties. The filing states that the Business Combination Agreement has no minimum cash requirement and that no PIPE financing had closed.
event_status: Pending; the Business Combination Agreement was executed on February 2, 2026, and the Redomestication Merger had not been completed as of the filing.
security_description: DT Cloud Star Acquisition Corporation ordinary shares, par value $0.0001 per share, including ordinary shares resulting from DTCS Units and Rights; excluding Parent Excluded Shares and Parent Dissenting Shares. Public Shares may be redeemed before the merger. Eligible holders who do not redeem may receive Non-Redemption Warrants.
effective_date: Not stated as a calendar date or time. The Redomestication Merger takes effect when the Cayman plan of merger has been accepted and the Delaware merger certificate has been filed, whichever is later, or at a later time specified in those documents under applicable law.
available_options: Public Shareholders may elect to redeem all or part of their Public Shares for cash before the Redomestication Merger, regardless of their vote, subject to the stated procedures and 15% aggregate redemption limit. Shares not redeemed convert into Purchaser Class A Common Stock, and eligible non-redeeming holders receive a pro rata allocation of the 1,931,900 Non-Redemption Warrants. A redeeming Public Shareholder does not receive those warrants for redeemed shares but may retain Public Rights.
default_option: A Public Shareholder who does not elect redemption has its DTCS Ordinary Shares converted into Purchaser Class A Common Stock and receives a pro rata allocation of Non-Redemption Warrants if eligible. The filing does not state a default treatment for an invalid or revoked redemption request.
election_deadline: For a Public Shareholder’s redemption election: 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time, two Business Days before the initially scheduled DTCS extraordinary general meeting. The calendar date is blank in the filing. No separate deadline to choose among merger consideration forms is stated.

cash_consideration: No regular cash merger consideration is stated for PrimeGen US, Inc. Class A common stock. The agreement provides for Pubco Class A common stock as merger consideration and rounds fractional shares down without cash in lieu.
closing_conditions: Subject to written waiver where permissible, conditions include required DTCS shareholder approval and PrimeGen US, Inc. stockholder approval; expiration or termination of applicable antitrust waiting periods and specified third-party consents; no law or order prohibiting the transactions; appointment of the Pubco board; an effective Form S-4 without an effective stop order; and Nasdaq approval and applicable listing compliance for Pubco Class A common stock. Party-specific conditions include the accuracy of representations and warranties subject to the stated material-adverse-effect exceptions, material covenant compliance, no continuing uncured material adverse effect, specified closing documents and deliveries, termination of PrimeGen US, Inc.’s September 17, 2024 stockholders’ agreement, and amendment of its PGB patent license. The agreement states no minimum cash requirement, and no PIPE financing had been consummated.
event_status: Pending; the Business Combination Agreement was executed on February 2, 2026, and the Acquisition Merger had not been completed as of the filing.
security_description: PrimeGen US, Inc. Class A common stock issued and outstanding immediately before the Acquisition Merger Effective Time, other than shares canceled under the agreement and Dissenting Shares. Outstanding PrimeGen US, Inc. warrants and stock options convert separately into Pubco warrants and options.
effective_date: Not stated as a calendar date or time. The Acquisition Merger takes effect when its Delaware merger certificate is filed, or at a later time specified in that certificate. Closing is to occur at least one Business Day after the Redomestication Merger, subject to the agreement’s conditions.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Class A common stockholders receive a pro rata share of the stock Merger Consideration. Properly dissenting stockholders have separate appraisal rights rather than the ordinary merger consideration unless those rights are lost or withdrawn.
default_option: Eligible Class A common stock is automatically converted into the right to receive its pro rata share of Merger Consideration in Pubco Class A common stock; delivery is subject to the stated transmittal-document requirements.
