Bluechip’s conditions also include Parent’s material compliance with applicable securities-reporting requirements, appointment of Bluechip’s designated director, and execution of applicable additional agreements.
event_status: Announced; proposed and pending completion of closing conditions.
security_description: Bluechip & Co. consideration_type: Stock; each issued and outstanding Flag Ship Acquisition Corporation ordinary share converts into one Bluechip Holdings Corp. ordinary share. Flag Ship units separate into an ordinary share and a right, which receive the respective stated treatment; at closing, each Purchaser right is cancelled in exchange for one-tenth of a Purchaser ordinary share, with fractional shares rounded down.
stock_exchange_ratio: 1 Bluechip Holdings Corp. ordinary share per 1 Flag Ship Acquisition Corporation ordinary share. Each Flag Ship unit separates into 1 Flag Ship ordinary share and 1 Flag Ship right; those components are exchanged for 1 Bluechip Holdings Corp. ordinary share and 1 Bluechip Holdings Corp. right, respectively, subject to the rights agreement. At closing, 1 Bluechip Holdings Corp. ordinary share is received for each 10 Bluechip Holdings Corp. rights, with fractional shares rounded down. Receipt of the applicable rights merger consideration is subject to the holder’s affirmative election to convert and surrender the Flag Ship right in accordance with the rights agreement.
closing_conditions: The SPAC Merger is to be consummated following satisfaction or applicable waiver of the Article X closing conditions, except for the condition requiring consummation of the SPAC Merger itself and conditions to be performed at closing. These include effectiveness of the Form F-4 registration statement without a stop order; requisite Parent and Bluechip shareholder approvals; execution and effectiveness of the additional agreements; required governmental approvals and applicable antitrust waiting-period expiration or termination; absence of specified legal restraints or third-party actions; and continued Nasdaq listing of Purchaser and approval of the additional listing application for the Closing Payment Shares. Additional party-specific conditions include material covenant compliance, accuracy of representations and warranties subject to the stated material-adverse-effect standard, and absence of a material adverse effect. The Purchaser Parties’ conditions also include required Company consents, closing certificates, governmental approvals, legal opinions, additional agreements, satisfactory due diligence, and key-personnel agreements. Bluechip’s conditions also include Parent’s material compliance with applicable securities-reporting requirements, appointment of Bluechip’s designated director, and execution of applicable additional agreements.
event_status: Announced; proposed and pending completion of closing conditions.
security_description: Flag Ship Acquisition Corporation ordinary shares, par value $0.001 per share, including the ordinary-share component of its units; its units also contain a right to receive one-tenth of an ordinary share, which is separately exchanged for a Purchaser right under the stated terms.
effective_date: Proposed: the SPAC Merger becomes effective when the filed plan of merger is registered by the Registrar of Companies in the Cayman Islands, or at a later time specified in that plan. No calendar date is stated.
available_options: No holder election for the ordinary-share conversion. For the right component, receipt of the applicable rights merger consideration requires an affirmative election to convert and surrender the Flag Ship right under the rights agreement; no alternative consideration choices are stated.

acquirer: First Hawaiian, Inc.; its wholly owned subsidiary Horizon Merger Sub, Inc. will merge into TriCo Bancshares to carry out the acquisition.
consideration_type: Stock; eligible TriCo shareholders receive a fixed exchange ratio of First Hawaiian common stock, with cash only in lieu of fractional shares.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration per share of TriCo common stock. Cash is payable only in lieu of a fractional share of First Hawaiian common stock, rounded to the nearest cent, equal to the fractional share multiplied by the average closing-sale price of First Hawaiian common stock on Nasdaq for the five full trading days ending on the day before the closing date. The fractional share is calculated after aggregating the holder’s TriCo shares and rounded to the nearest thousandth.
stock_exchange_ratio: 2.095 shares of First Hawaiian, Inc. common stock, par value $0.01 per share, per 1 eligible share of TriCo Bancshares common stock, no par value. The ratio is subject to appropriate proportionate adjustment for specified changes in First Hawaiian common stock capitalization or an extraordinary dividend or distribution before the effective time. No fractional shares will be issued; cash will be paid in lieu.
shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled virtual special meetings on 10/29/2026: First Hawaiian stockholders at 10:00 a.m., Hawaii Standard Time, to vote on the share issuance proposal; TriCo shareholders at 1:00 p.m., Pacific Time, to vote on the merger agreement.
closing_conditions: Completion is subject to satisfaction or waiver of applicable conditions, including: First Hawaiian stockholder approval of the share issuance by a majority of shares present or represented by proxy and entitled to vote, and TriCo shareholder approval of the merger agreement by at least two-thirds of outstanding shares entitled to vote; filing of the Nasdaq additional-share listing notification with no further listing authorization required; receipt of all requisite regulatory approvals, continued effectiveness of those approvals, and expiration or termination of statutory waiting periods without a materially burdensome regulatory condition; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an outstanding SEC stop order or unwithdrawn proceeding; absence of a court or agency order or other law preventing or making illegal the mergers, bank merger or other contemplated transactions; accuracy of the other party’s representations and warranties under the merger agreement’s materiality standards and receipt of the related officer certificate; performance by the other party of its obligations in all material respects and receipt of the related officer certificate; and each party’s receipt of a satisfactory legal opinion that the mergers, taken together, will qualify as a reorganization under Section 368(a) of the Internal Revenue Code. The advisory TriCo compensation vote and the adjournment proposals are not closing conditions.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was signed, but the shareholder votes, regulatory approvals and other closing conditions were described as outstanding. Completion was not assured.
security_description: TriCo Bancshares common stock, no par value, issued and outstanding immediately before the merger’s effective time, excluding treasury shares and specified shares owned by TriCo, First Hawaiian or their wholly owned subsidiaries; shares held in a fiduciary capacity or as a result of debts previously contracted are excepted from that exclusion.
effective_date: No calendar date stated. The merger will become legally effective at the time specified in the filings with the California Secretary of State. The second-step merger of TriCo into First Hawaiian is to become effective immediately afterward at the time specified in the applicable Delaware and California filings.
available_options: No holder election; eligible TriCo common shares are converted at the fixed stock exchange ratio, with cash only in lieu of fractional shares.

acquirer: ACP Holdings Acquisition Corp.; its wholly owned subsidiary, Maestro Merger Sub, Inc., will merge into May Mobility, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock; each eligible share of May Mobility common stock converts into the right to receive shares of ACP Holdings Acquisition Corp. common stock following its domestication. Excluded shares receive no consideration, and dissenting shares are subject to appraisal treatment.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each 1 share of May Mobility common stock, a number of shares of domesticated ACP Holdings Acquisition Corp. common stock equal to the Exchange Ratio. The Exchange Ratio is Aggregate Consideration divided by Company Fully Diluted Capital. Aggregate Consideration is ($1,350,000,000 ÷ $10.00) minus the lesser of (i) 50% of the sum of Non-Redemption Shares subject to payment by ACP and Backstop Shares issuable by ACP and (ii) 1,375,000 shares. No fractional shares will be issued; fractional shares will be rounded down to the nearest whole share. The Aggregate Consideration and Exchange Ratio are subject to adjustment for specified changes to the domesticated purchaser common stock before issuance.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or written waiver where permissible: ACP shareholder approval and May Mobility stockholder approval; no law or order making the transactions illegal or preventing or prohibiting them; effectiveness of the registration statement at closing without an effective stop order or pending SEC proceeding for that purpose; expiration or termination of applicable HSR waiting periods and governmental timing commitments, and receipt of other required governmental consents. Additional conditions include the specified accuracy of each party’s representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, and no continuing, uncured material adverse effect on ACP or the May Mobility target companies; completion of ACP’s domestication; at least $120,000,000 in remaining trust-account net proceeds after redemptions and specified cash debt payments, plus PIPE proceeds to be funded at or before closing; arrangements making remaining trust proceeds available at closing; conditional Nasdaq listing approval for the common shares to be issued, subject to the round-lot-holder requirement; and specified closing certificates, ancillary documents, and applicable debt payoff letters and lien-release documentation.
event_status: Pending; the parties entered into the Business Combination Agreement on September 15, 2026, and closing remains subject to approvals and other conditions.
security_description: May Mobility, Inc. common stock, par value $0.0001 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the merger effective time, other than Excluded Shares. May Mobility preferred stock is to convert into May Mobility common stock immediately before the effective time; company options receive separate treatment.
effective_date: At the filing of the certificate of merger with the Delaware Secretary of State on the Closing Date, or at a later time agreed in writing by the parties and specified in that certificate. No calendar date is stated.
available_options: No holder election; each eligible share of May Mobility common stock is converted into a right to receive stock consideration.

FortuneX’s and Merger Sub’s additional conditions include WT Realty’s material covenant compliance, accuracy of its representations and warranties under the specified standards, no continuing Material Adverse Effect, an officer’s certificate, required consents, termination of specified contracts, execution and effectiveness of required lock-up and registration rights agreements, and continued effectiveness and material performance of the Company Shareholder Support Agreement. WT Realty’s additional conditions include FortuneX’s and Merger Sub’s material covenant compliance, accuracy of their representations and warranties under the specified standards, an officer’s certificate, filing of the PubCo certificate of incorporation, execution of the registration rights agreement by required parties, continued effectiveness and material performance of the Sponsor Support Agreement, and former WT Realty stockholders holding at least 51% of PubCo’s total voting power immediately after closing. Effectiveness of the warrant amendment implementing the Cash Exercise Requirement is also stated to be a condition to WT Realty’s obligations, waivable by WT Realty in its sole discretion.

acquirer: FortuneX Acquisition Corporation, through its wholly owned merger subsidiary FortuneX Merger Sub Inc.
consideration_type: Stock
stock_exchange_ratio: For each 1 share of WT Realty Group Inc. Class B common stock, a number of shares of PubCo Class B common stock equal to the Consideration Ratio: 60,000,000 shares of PubCo common stock divided by the aggregate number of WT Realty Group Inc. common shares issued and outstanding immediately before the merger effective time, without adding shares for warrants, options, convertible securities or other acquisition rights. The aggregate and per-share consideration are subject to equitable adjustment for specified share changes before the merger effective time. No fractional PubCo shares will be issued; amounts otherwise resulting in fractional shares will be rounded down to whole shares. Treasury shares and dissenting shares are excluded from this conversion.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where permitted by law, written waiver of the applicable conditions: no law or order making the transactions illegal or prohibiting or enjoining them; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement, without an effective stop order or pending SEC proceeding seeking one; FortuneX shareholder approval and WT Realty stockholder approval; the specified seven-member PubCo board composition; and Nasdaq approval of PubCo’s listing application and the shares issued in the transaction, with PubCo meeting applicable initial listing requirements immediately after closing. FortuneX’s and Merger Sub’s additional conditions include WT Realty’s material covenant compliance, accuracy of its representations and warranties under the specified standards, no continuing Material Adverse Effect, an officer’s certificate, required consents, termination of specified contracts, execution and effectiveness of required lock-up and registration rights agreements, and continued effectiveness and material performance of the Company Shareholder Support Agreement. WT Realty’s additional conditions include FortuneX’s and Merger Sub’s material covenant compliance, accuracy of their representations and warranties under the specified standards, an officer’s certificate, filing of the PubCo certificate of incorporation, execution of the registration rights agreement by required parties, continued effectiveness and material performance of the Sponsor Support Agreement, and former WT Realty stockholders holding at least 51% of PubCo’s total voting power immediately after closing. Effectiveness of the warrant amendment implementing the Cash Exercise Requirement is also stated to be a condition to WT Realty’s obligations, waivable by WT Realty in its sole discretion.
event_status: Announced; pending. The business combination agreement was executed on September 18, 2026, and closing remains subject to conditions.
security_description: WT Realty Group Inc. Class B common stock, par value $0.00001 per share, other than treasury shares and dissenting shares.
effective_date: Conditional: the merger becomes effective on the closing date when the certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed by the parties and specified in that certificate. No calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Class B shares convert into the right to receive PubCo Class B common stock.

effective_date: Not specified. cash_consideration: No cash merger consideration is stated for Company Convertible Notes.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each Astro Digital US, Inc. Company Convertible Note, Parent Common Shares equal to the Conversion Ratio multiplied by the number of Company Common Stock shares issuable upon conversion of that note immediately before the First Effective Time. The Conversion Ratio is the number of Parent Common Shares constituting Aggregate Merger Consideration divided by Aggregate Fully Diluted Company Common Stock. Aggregate Merger Consideration is the Base Purchase Price ($525,000,000 plus the Aggregate Exercise Price) divided by US$10.00. The consideration and ratio are subject to the stated adjustments for changes to Parent Common Shares before issuance.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permissible waiver of conditions, including Company Stockholder Approval and approval of each Required Parent Proposal at the Parent Shareholder Meeting; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an effective stop order or unresolved SEC proceeding seeking one; conditional exchange listing approval and satisfaction of applicable listing requirements; required governmental consents and approvals; no applicable legal restraint or final, non-appealable prohibition; required accuracy of representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, and no continuing, uncured Material Adverse Effect for either the Company or Parent; specified certificates, ancillary agreements and other deliverables; completion of the Domestication; consummation of the PIPE Financing immediately before Closing with gross proceeds of at least $50,000,000; and Parent Closing Cash of at least $30,000,000 after the specified redemptions and expenses.
event_status: Pending; definitive Merger Agreement entered into on 9/26/2026, with closing subject to conditions.

effective_date: The First Company Merger becomes effective when its certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed by the parties and specified in that certificate, at least one Business Day after the Domestication. No calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: No holder election

consideration_type: Stock; REDLattice Class A-1 Units convert into the right to receive PubCo common stock. Treasury units are excluded.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration is specified for REDLattice Class A-1 Units. No fractional shares will be issued; fractional shares will be rounded down, with no cash-in-lieu payment stated.
stock_exchange_ratio: A number of shares of PubCo common stock per 1 REDLattice Class A-1 Unit equal to the Consideration Ratio: Aggregate Merger Consideration divided by Aggregate Fully Diluted REDLattice Units. Aggregate Merger Consideration equals Equity Value divided by $10.00; Equity Value equals $1,250,000,000 minus Closing Indebtedness, plus the aggregate exercise price of REDLattice options assuming full cash exercise immediately before the merger effective time. Aggregate Fully Diluted REDLattice Units includes outstanding units and units issuable upon or subject to outstanding options. Fractional PubCo shares are rounded down.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permissible written waiver of applicable conditions: Bold Eagle shareholder approval and Ultimate Holdings’ approval as REDLattice’s sole member; no effective legal prohibition; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an effective stop order or unresolved SEC suspension proceeding; stock-exchange listing approval for PubCo common stock; and expiration or receipt of applicable antitrust waiting periods and approvals. Bold Eagle and Merger Sub additionally require material REDLattice covenant compliance, specified accuracy of REDLattice representations and warranties, no continuing Material Adverse Effect, an officer’s certificate, Ultimate Holdings’ execution of the registration rights and lock-up agreements, termination of specified contracts, execution of specified employment agreements, completion of REDLattice’s recapitalization, and delivery of the specified tax certificate and notice. REDLattice additionally requires material compliance and specified representation accuracy by Bold Eagle and Merger Sub, an officer’s certificate, an effective Delaware PubCo certificate of incorporation, execution of the registration rights, nomination and lock-up agreements, convertible-note closing cash greater than $250,000,000, common-stock closing cash of at least $100,000,000, delivery of Merger Sub’s tax-classification election, the specified nine-member PubCo board, completion of domestication, and receipt by Ultimate Holdings of a Non-Resident Tax Certificate.
event_status: Pending; the business combination agreement was signed on 9/25/2026, and closing remained subject to approvals and other conditions.
security_description: REDL Intermediate Holdings, LLC Class A-1 Units issued and outstanding immediately before the merger effective time, including units resulting from recapitalization; treasury units are excluded.
effective_date: Not fixed. The merger is to become effective upon filing the certificate of merger with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed by the parties and specified in the certificate, no later than one business day after domestication becomes effective.
available_options: No holder election; each eligible Class A-1 Unit automatically converts into the right to receive PubCo common stock.

consideration_type: Stock; REDLattice Class A-2 Units convert into restricted PubCo common stock subject to the same applicable vesting and other provisions. Treasury units are excluded.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration is specified for REDLattice Class A-2 Units. No fractional shares will be issued; fractional shares will be rounded down, with no cash-in-lieu payment stated.
stock_exchange_ratio: A number of restricted shares of PubCo common stock per 1 REDLattice Class A-2 Unit equal to the Consideration Ratio: Aggregate Merger Consideration divided by Aggregate Fully Diluted REDLattice Units. Aggregate Merger Consideration equals Equity Value divided by $10.00; Equity Value equals $1,250,000,000 minus Closing Indebtedness, plus the aggregate exercise price of REDLattice options assuming full cash exercise immediately before the merger effective time. Aggregate Fully Diluted REDLattice Units includes outstanding units and units issuable upon or subject to outstanding options. Fractional PubCo shares are rounded down.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permissible written waiver of applicable conditions: Bold Eagle shareholder approval and Ultimate Holdings’ approval as REDLattice’s sole member; no effective legal prohibition; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an effective stop order or unresolved SEC suspension proceeding; stock-exchange listing approval for PubCo common stock; and expiration or receipt of applicable antitrust waiting periods and approvals. Bold Eagle and Merger Sub additionally require material REDLattice covenant compliance, specified accuracy of REDLattice representations and warranties, no continuing Material Adverse Effect, an officer’s certificate, Ultimate Holdings’ execution of the registration rights and lock-up agreements, termination of specified contracts, execution of specified employment agreements, completion of REDLattice’s recapitalization, and delivery of the specified tax certificate and notice. REDLattice additionally requires material compliance and specified representation accuracy by Bold Eagle and Merger Sub, an officer’s certificate, an effective Delaware PubCo certificate of incorporation, execution of the registration rights, nomination and lock-up agreements, convertible-note closing cash greater than $250,000,000, common-stock closing cash of at least $100,000,000, delivery of Merger Sub’s tax-classification election, the specified nine-member PubCo board, completion of domestication, and receipt by Ultimate Holdings of a Non-Resident Tax Certificate.
event_status: Pending; the business combination agreement was signed on 9/25/2026, and closing remained subject to approvals and other conditions.
security_description: REDL Intermediate Holdings, LLC Class A-2 Units issued and outstanding immediately before the merger effective time, resulting from the recapitalization of unvested Class B Units; treasury units are excluded.
effective_date: Not fixed. The merger is to become effective upon filing the certificate of merger with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed by the parties and specified in the certificate, no later than one business day after domestication becomes effective.
available_options: No holder election; each eligible Class A-2 Unit automatically converts into restricted PubCo common stock.

acquirer: Olympian Global Inc. (Purchaser), the surviving company in the merger with Futurewave Acquisition Corporation
consideration_type: Stock
stock_exchange_ratio: 1 Olympian Global Inc. Class A ordinary share per 1 Futurewave Acquisition Corporation ordinary share, excluding treasury or wholly owned subsidiary shares, redeemed shares and shares subject to valid dissenters’ rights. Each Futurewave unit separates into 1 ordinary share, 1 warrant and 1 right; each warrant becomes 1 Purchaser warrant and each right becomes 1 Purchaser right. At closing, each Purchaser right is exchanged for 1/4 of a Purchaser Class A ordinary share, with fractional shares rounded down to the nearest whole share.
closing_conditions: Outstanding conditions include no law or order prohibiting closing and no third-party action seeking to enjoin or restrict it; effectiveness of the Form F-4 registration statement without a stop order; execution and effectiveness of the ancillary agreements; requisite Parent and Company shareholder approvals; completion of required HSR Act and other antitrust filings and expiration or termination of applicable waiting periods or timing commitments; accuracy of representations and warranties, material covenant compliance and absence of a material adverse effect, subject to the agreement’s standards and applicable waivers; and Purchaser remaining listed on Nasdaq with approval to list the Closing Payment Shares. Consummation of the Reincorporation Merger is itself a condition to the Acquisition Merger closing.
event_status: Pending; merger agreement signed on 9/28/2026
security_description: Futurewave Acquisition Corporation ordinary shares, par value $0.0001 per share, including ordinary shares separated from its units; related units, warrants and rights receive the treatment specified in the stock_exchange_ratio field. Treasury or wholly owned subsidiary shares, redeemed shares and shares subject to valid dissenters’ rights receive different treatment.
effective_date: Pending: the time the plan of Reincorporation Merger is filed with the Registrar of Companies in the Cayman Islands, or a later time specified in that plan; no calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: No holder election for merger consideration; eligible Parent ordinary shareholders have a separate right to redeem all or a portion of their shares under Parent’s memorandum and articles of association.

acquirer: OAG Pipeline Technologies Inc. (PubCo), through its wholly-owned subsidiary OAG Merger Sub I
consideration_type: Stock for eligible Acquiror Class A ordinary shares; redeeming shares receive cash instead, and dissenting shares have appraisal rights.
cash_consideration: Redeeming Acquiror Public Shares receive the Acquiror Redemption Price per share, payable in cash: the amount on deposit in the Trust Account, including interest net of taxes payable and excluding interest previously released to pay taxes, divided by the number of then-issued Acquiror Public Shares, calculated as of two business days before the Second Closing or another time agreed in writing by Acquiror and the Company. This is redemption treatment, not cash payable to holders receiving merger shares.
stock_exchange_ratio: 1 newly issued PubCo ordinary share per 1 eligible Harvard Ave Acquisition Corporation Class A ordinary share outstanding immediately before the First Merger Effective Time, including Class A ordinary shares resulting from unit separation, right conversion and Class B ordinary share conversion. Each right converts into one-tenth of a Class A ordinary share, rounded down to a whole Class A ordinary share for each holder; each Class B ordinary share converts into one Class A ordinary share. Redeeming shares, dissenting shares and treasury shares are excluded from the PubCo-share exchange.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or written waiver by the parties whose obligations are conditioned: Acquiror and Company shareholder approvals; effectiveness of the Proxy/Registration Statement without an outstanding SEC stop order or proceeding; Nasdaq listing approval for the PubCo shares; necessary regulatory approvals and third-party consents; no applicable legal restraint making either closing illegal or preventing it, other than an immaterial restraint; no stated material adverse effect; completion of the pre-closing actions; and execution, delivery and effectiveness of the Transaction Documents. First Closing additionally requires the specified Acquiror, Company and acquisition-entity representations and warranties to meet their contractual accuracy standards, material compliance with pre-closing covenants, delivery of applicable good-standing certificates and officer certificates, and at least $10,000,000 of cash after the specified redemption, financing-proceeds and transaction-expense adjustments. The agreement also requires specified holders of future financing participation rights to waive or terminate those rights, subject to the stated disclosure-letter exception. Financing proceeds count toward the minimum-cash calculation only if received or unconditionally committed; the separately discussed $30,000,000 financing effort is not stated as a closing condition.
event_status: Announced; pending shareholder approvals and other closing conditions.
security_description: Harvard Ave Acquisition Corporation Class A ordinary shares, including shares resulting from separation of Acquiror units, conversion of Acquiror rights and conversion of Acquiror Class B ordinary shares; redeeming, dissenting and treasury shares receive different treatment.
effective_date: Conditional: when the Plan of First Merger is registered by the Cayman Registrar, or at a later time agreed in writing by Merger Sub I and Acquiror and specified in that plan, no later than the second Business Day after filing and registration. No calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: Eligible holders of Acquiror Public Shares may elect to redeem all or a portion of those shares for the cash Acquiror Redemption Price; eligible nonredeeming, nondissenting Class A ordinary shares are exchanged for PubCo shares at the stated 1-for-1 ratio. The redemption right is distinct from a choice between merger consideration forms.

Per Share Price equals the sum of $230,000,000 plus the aggregate exercise prices of all in-the-money Key Mining Corp. options and warrants outstanding immediately before the Effective Time, divided by Fully-Diluted Company Shares outstanding immediately before the Effective Time. Fractional Pubco shares otherwise receivable by a holder are aggregated and rounded up to the nearest whole share. Dissenting shares and treasury or subsidiary-owned shares are excluded.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or written waiver, where permissible, by Key Mining Corp. and Compass Digital Acquisition Corp. of: Compass Digital shareholder approval; Key Mining stockholder approval; expiration or termination of applicable antitrust waiting periods; required governmental and specified third-party consents; no law or order preventing the transactions; appointment of the post-closing Pubco board; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without a stop order; at least $5,000,000 in cash at closing after the specified redemptions, financing proceeds and payments; effectiveness of amended Pubco organizational documents; and approval of Pubco common stock for listing on Nasdaq or NYSE American. Additional party-specific conditions include accuracy of representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, no continuing and uncured material adverse effect, and specified ancillary documents and closing deliveries. The parties agreed to use commercially reasonable efforts to obtain transaction financing, but financing itself is not stated as a separate closing condition.

acquirer: Trailblazer Holdings, Inc. (the acquiring parent); Trailblazer Merger Sub, Ltd. is the merger subsidiary that will merge into Cyabra Strategy Ltd.
consideration_type: Stock, with up to 3,000,000 additional shares of Holdings Common Stock contingent on post-closing share-price targets. Holders of Cyabra Series B Preferred Shares may instead elect Holdings Series A Preferred Stock.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration is stated. Cash in lieu of a fractional share of Holdings Common Stock equals the fraction multiplied by $10.00, rounded to the nearest cent, without interest.
stock_exchange_ratio: Each Cyabra Ordinary Share converts into the right to receive Holdings Common Stock equal to the Conversion Ratio: 10,600,000 shares of Holdings Common Stock divided by Cyabra’s outstanding shares on a fully diluted basis, rounded down to four decimal places. Each Cyabra Preferred Share other than the specified Series B Preferred Shares converts into Holdings Common Stock equal to the Conversion Ratio multiplied by the number of Cyabra Ordinary Shares issuable upon conversion of that preferred share. For holders of Cyabra Series B Preferred Shares, the preferred-stock election provides Holdings Series A Preferred Stock equal to the holder’s Series B Preferred Shares multiplied by their original issue price, divided by 1,000. The number of Earnout Shares is subject to the stated share-price triggers.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver of applicable conditions, including: no law or order restraining or prohibiting the business combination; expiration or termination of any applicable HSR Act waiting period and required governmental consents; Cyabra shareholder approval and approval of the required Trailblazer proposals; conditional Nasdaq listing approval for the merger consideration shares; effectiveness of the registration statement without an effective SEC stop order; passage of at least 50 days after filing the Israeli merger proposal and at least 30 days after Cyabra shareholder approval; required tax certificates and tax rulings or interim tax rulings; required Cyabra consents and an exemption from filing an Israeli prospectus; appointment of the post-closing board as specified; consummation of the PIPE Investment and financing of the 2024 Convertible Notes; accuracy of the parties’ representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, and absence of a continuing material adverse effect as specified. The PIPE closing condition may be unnecessary if sufficient trust funds remain after redemptions to eliminate the need for the PIPE Investment.
event_status: Pending; merger agreement dated July 22, 2024, amended November 11, 2024 and November 6, 2025. Closing remains subject to conditions.
security_description: Cyabra Ordinary Shares, NIS 0.01 par value; Cyabra Preferred Shares, with a distinct elective treatment for Cyabra Series B Preferred Shares. Outstanding Cyabra Options, Convertible Notes and Warrants have separate treatments under the merger agreement.
effective_date: The Acquisition Merger becomes effective on the date stated in the certificate issued by the Israeli Registrar of Companies; no calendar date or time is stated. The parties intend legal effectiveness and issuance of the certificate to occur on, or as soon as practicable before, the closing date. The Parent Merger is to occur immediately before closing.
available_options: Holders of Cyabra Series B Preferred Shares may elect either Holdings Common Stock or Holdings Series A Preferred Stock calculated as their Series B Preferred Shares multiplied by the original issue price and divided by 1,000. No holder election is stated for Cyabra Ordinary Shares or the other Cyabra Preferred Shares.

acquirer: Churchill Capital Corp X (CCX), through its wholly owned subsidiaries AH Merger Sub I, Inc. and AH Merger Sub II, LLC. Merger Sub I will merge into ColdQuanta, Inc.; immediately afterward, ColdQuanta will merge into Merger Sub II, which will survive as a wholly owned subsidiary of CCX.
consideration_type: Stock; subject to the stated treatment of excluded and dissenting shares.
cash_consideration: No cash consideration is payable to holders of eligible Infleqtion common stock; the consideration is paid entirely in Post-Closing Company common stock. Fractional shares are rounded to the nearest whole share rather than paid in cash.
stock_exchange_ratio: One issued and outstanding share of Infleqtion common stock, after conversion of Infleqtion preferred stock, is exchanged for a number of shares of Post-Closing Company common stock equal to the Exchange Ratio, estimated at approximately 0.347 shares per Infleqtion common share. The Exchange Ratio is the per-share Equity Value divided by $10.00; the per-share Equity Value is the $1,800,000,000 Equity Value plus the aggregate exercise price of outstanding Infleqtion options, divided by Infleqtion Total Shares. Fractional shares otherwise issuable to a stockholder are aggregated and rounded to the nearest whole share, with 0.5 or more rounded up. Excluded and Dissenting Shares do not receive this exchange treatment.
closing_conditions: Closing is subject to satisfaction or, where permitted, waiver of the Merger Agreement’s conditions, including: approval of the condition precedent proposals by CCX shareholders and approval of the Merger Agreement, Mergers and other Transactions by the requisite Infleqtion stockholder consent; expiration or termination of the HSR Act waiting period (the filing states that the initial waiting period expired on November 3, 2025); the specified UK national-security clearance or determination and Australian foreign-investment clearance or lapse of the applicable power to make an order; absence of a governmental order or law preventing or materially restraining the Transactions; CCX having at least $5,000,001 in net tangible assets after redemptions and net PIPE proceeds, a requirement the filing says CCX cannot waive; required governance documents and agreements and constitution of the contemplated post-closing board; stock-exchange listing and eligibility for continued listing of Post-Closing Company common stock; and effectiveness of the registration statement without an SEC stop order or an action seeking one. CCX’s additional conditions include Infleqtion’s representations and warranties meeting the applicable standards, material compliance with its covenants, no continuing Infleqtion Material Adverse Effect, expiration of the appraisal-rights demand period, and Dissenting Shares not being beneficially owned by holders of more than 5% of outstanding Infleqtion capital stock. Infleqtion’s additional conditions include CCX’s and the merger subsidiaries’ representations and warranties meeting the applicable standards, material compliance with their covenants, at least $100 million of Available Closing SPAC Cash, completion of the Domestication and delivery of the specified Delaware filing, no continuing SPAC Material Adverse Effect, and material compliance by the Sponsor and Insiders with the Sponsor Agreement without the specified challenges or termination threats. The PIPE Investment has its own closing conditions; the filing does not state that completion of the PIPE Investment is itself a separate merger-closing condition.
event_status: Pending as described in the preliminary proxy statement/prospectus filed on 1/20/2026; the business combination remained subject to shareholder approvals and other closing conditions.
security_description: Issued and outstanding Infleqtion common stock, including common stock resulting from the pre-closing conversion of Infleqtion preferred stock. Excluded Shares and Dissenting Shares are excepted. Infleqtion options and restricted stock awards have separately described treatment.
effective_date: The First Merger becomes effective when its certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed by CCX and Infleqtion and specified in that certificate. The Second Merger becomes effective immediately afterward, when its certificate of merger is filed, or at a later agreed time specified in that certificate. No full calendar date or clock time is stated.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Infleqtion common shares are exchanged for Post-Closing Company common stock under the stated Exchange Ratio, subject to the exceptions for Excluded Shares and Dissenting Shares.

acquirer: Trailblazer Merger Corporation I, through its wholly owned subsidiary Trailblazer Merger Sub, Ltd.; Trailblazer Holdings, Inc. will be the surviving parent after Trailblazer merges into it.
consideration_type: Stock; Cyabra shareholders and optionholders may also receive contingent earnout shares.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration is described. Cash paid instead of a fractional share of Holdings Common Stock equals the fractional share multiplied by $10.00, rounded to the nearest cent, without interest.
stock_exchange_ratio: Each Cyabra ordinary share converts into the right to receive Holdings Common Stock equal to the Conversion Ratio: 10,600,000 shares of Holdings Common Stock divided by Cyabra’s outstanding shares on a fully diluted basis, rounded down to four decimal places. Each Cyabra preferred share other than Series B preferred shares issued upon conversion of the 2024 Convertible Notes receives the Conversion Ratio multiplied by the number of Cyabra ordinary shares issuable upon conversion of that preferred share. The Series B holders’ separate election is described in available_options.
shareholder_vote_date: Trailblazer stockholders’ special meeting is scheduled for 2/18/2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern time. A date for Cyabra shareholder approval is not stated.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted waiver of applicable conditions, including Trailblazer approval of the Merger Proposal, Charter Amendment Proposal, First Nasdaq Proposal and Incentive Plan Proposal; Cyabra shareholder approval; no law or order restraining or prohibiting the combination; expiration or termination of any applicable HSR Act waiting period; required Nasdaq listing approval and effectiveness of the registration statement; at least 50 days after filing the merger proposal with the Israeli Registrar of Companies and at least 30 days after Cyabra shareholder approval; specified tax documentation and tax rulings or interim rulings; required consents and Israeli prospectus exemption; appointment of the specified board; consummation of the PIPE Investment and 2024 Convertible Notes financing; accuracy of representations and warranties under the applicable materiality standards; material performance of obligations; and no continuing material adverse effect under the applicable party-specific conditions.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was amended on 11/11/2024 and 11/6/2025.
security_description: Cyabra Strategy Ltd. ordinary shares, NIS 0.01 par value, and preferred shares. Series B preferred shares issued to holders upon conversion of the 2024 Convertible Notes have the separate elective treatment described in available_options; Cyabra options and warrants have separate award or warrant treatment.
effective_date: The Acquisition Merger becomes effective on the date stated in the certificate issued by the Israeli Registrar of Companies. The parties intend legal effectiveness and issuance of that certificate to occur on, or as soon as practicable before, the Closing Date; no calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: Holders of Cyabra Series B preferred shares may elect either Holdings Common Stock or Holdings Series A Preferred Stock. Under the preferred-stock option, the number of Series A shares equals the holder’s number of Cyabra Series B preferred shares multiplied by their original issue price, divided by 1,000. No holder election is described for other Cyabra ordinary or preferred shares.

acquirer: Churchill Capital Corp X (CCX), through its wholly owned subsidiaries AH Merger Sub I, Inc. and AH Merger Sub II, LLC
consideration_type: Stock; subject to the Merger Agreement, eligible Infleqtion common shares are exchanged for Post-Closing Company common stock. Excluded Shares and Dissenting Shares are treated separately.
cash_consideration: No cash consideration is payable for eligible Infleqtion common shares; the stated merger consideration is entirely Post-Closing Company common stock. No fractional share is issued; a holder otherwise entitled to a fractional share receives a whole-share amount rounded up or down, rather than cash in lieu.
stock_exchange_ratio: Approximately 0.347 shares of Post-Closing Company common stock per 1 share of Infleqtion common stock, after conversion of Infleqtion preferred stock; this is an estimate subject to the stated assumptions. Under the Merger Agreement, the Exchange Ratio is the per-share Equity Value divided by $10.00, rounded to the nearest 0.001. Each holder’s aggregate fractional entitlement is rounded to the nearest whole share, with 0.5 or more rounded up.
shareholder_vote_date: Churchill Capital Corp X shareholders’ extraordinary general meeting was scheduled for 2/12/2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time. Infleqtion stockholder approval was to be obtained by written consent; no consent date is stated.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted written waiver of applicable Merger Agreement conditions, including: CCX shareholder approval of the condition precedent proposals and requisite Infleqtion stockholder approval; expiration or termination of the HSR Act waiting period, which the filing states expired on 11/3/2025; specified UK national-security clearance or no-further-action determination and Australian foreign-investment clearance or expiration of the applicable power to object; absence of a governmental restraint or law preventing or materially restraining the transactions; at least $5,000,001 of CCX net tangible assets after redemptions and net PIPE proceeds; required governance documents and board appointments; exchange listing and eligibility for continued listing of Post-Closing Company common stock; and effectiveness of the registration statement without an SEC stop order or threatened or initiated action seeking one. CCX’s additional conditions include Infleqtion’s representations and warranties meeting the applicable accuracy standards, material performance of its covenants, no continuing Infleqtion Material Adverse Effect, expiration of the appraisal-rights demand period and Dissenting Shares held by no more than 5% of Infleqtion capital stock on the stated basis. Infleqtion’s additional conditions include applicable accuracy of CCX and the merger subsidiaries’ representations and warranties, material performance of their covenants, at least $100 million of Available Closing SPAC Cash, completion of the Domestication and delivery of the specified Delaware filing, no continuing SPAC Material Adverse Effect, and material performance of Sponsor Agreement covenants without the specified threats concerning that agreement.
event_status: Pending as described in the preliminary proxy statement/prospectus filed on 1/22/2026; the merger agreement was signed on 9/8/2025, and closing remained subject to conditions.
security_description: Issued and outstanding ColdQuanta, Inc. common stock immediately before the First Effective Time, including common stock resulting from the conversion of its preferred stock, but excluding Excluded Shares and Dissenting Shares. Outstanding Infleqtion restricted stock awards and options have separately described treatment.
effective_date: Not stated as a calendar date. The First Merger is to become effective when its certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed by CCX and Infleqtion and specified in that certificate. The Second Merger is to become effective immediately following the First Merger, upon filing its certificate or at a later agreed time specified in it. acquirer: Black Hawk Acquisition Corporation, the acquiring parent; its wholly-owned subsidiary, BH Merger Sub, Inc., will merge with and into Vesicor Therapeutics, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock; Vesicor shareholders will receive PubCo common stock, and outstanding unexercised Vesicor warrants will be assumed and converted into warrants to purchase PubCo common stock.
cash_consideration: No cash proceeds will be paid to existing Vesicor shareholders as merger consideration; no cash will be issued instead of fractional shares.
stock_exchange_ratio: The Consideration Ratio is the number of shares of PubCo Common Stock issued per 1 issued and outstanding share of Vesicor Common Stock. It equals Aggregate Merger Consideration divided by Aggregate Fully Diluted Company Shares; Aggregate Merger Consideration equals $70,000,000 divided by the Redemption Price for Black Hawk Class A Ordinary Shares. The filing’s pro forma calculation uses a 0.714882 consideration exchange ratio. Fractional shares otherwise issuable to Vesicor shareholders will be rounded to the nearest whole share.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permissible waiver of closing conditions, including: no law or order prohibiting the Business Combination; SEC effectiveness of the registration statement, with no effective stop order or SEC proceeding to suspend effectiveness; requisite Black Hawk shareholder and Vesicor stockholder approvals; PubCo board size and composition as specified in the agreement; Nasdaq listing approval for PubCo common stock; and Black Hawk’s receipt of a fairness opinion. Black Hawk and Merger Sub also require Vesicor’s material covenant compliance, representations and warranties meeting the applicable bring-down standards, no continuing Material Adverse Effect, specified officer and FIRPTA certificates, termination of certain Vesicor stockholder agreements, required third-party consents, specified non-competition and lock-up agreements and other ancillary agreements, and a PPM Investment of at least $10,000,000 before Closing. Vesicor also requires Black Hawk’s and Merger Sub’s material covenant compliance and representations and warranties meeting the applicable bring-down standards, a Black Hawk officer certificate, an effective Delaware certificate of incorporation for PubCo, and specified ancillary agreements. The PPM Investment had no issued securities, investment commitments or funding as of the proxy statement/prospectus date and may be waived by Black Hawk and Vesicor. consideration_type: Stock for eligible Falcon common shareholders; cash is designated for certain shareholders subject to sanctions, rather than paid alongside stock to every holder.

shareholder_vote_date: Tamboran Resources Corporation stockholder special meeting scheduled for 3/3/2026 at 5:00 p.m. Central time (3/4/2026 at 10:00 a.m. AEDT). The Falcon Oil & Gas Ltd. shareholder meeting is expected on or about the same day; no exact Falcon meeting date is stated.
closing_conditions: Conditions include approval of the arrangement by Falcon shareholders; approval of the Falcon Parent stock issuance by Tamboran stockholders; satisfactory interim and final orders of the Supreme Court of British Columbia; authorization of the Tamboran shares for NYSE listing; and no law or order prohibiting the transaction. Tamboran’s additional conditions include Falcon’s representations and warranties meeting the agreement’s standards, material covenant compliance, no Falcon material adverse effect, an officer’s certificate, outstanding dissent rights covering no more than 5% of Falcon common shares, required regulatory approvals remaining effective, effective option-cancellation and support agreements, and engagement of the Blocked Account Agent. Falcon’s additional conditions include corresponding representation, covenant, material-adverse-effect and officer-certificate requirements for Tamboran. The required Falcon Australia minority shareholder approval was obtained on 12/30/2025; the Hungarian mining and foreign-direct-investment approvals were also obtained. TSXV approval is required, and Falcon applied for it on 1/7/2026. The specified conditions may be waived by the applicable parties to the extent permitted by law. An OFAC license is not an agreement closing condition, but would have to be obtained before closing if OFAC determines one is required.
event_status: Pending; the arrangement agreement was executed, but completion remains subject to conditions. Falcon Australia minority shareholder approval and the specified Hungarian approvals have been obtained.
security_description: Falcon Oil & Gas Ltd. common shares. Shares held by dissenting shareholders or shareholders subject to sanctions receive different treatment.
available_options: No holder election is stated for Falcon common shares; eligible holders receive stock under the arrangement. The separate potential cash-or-stock treatment of Falcon Australia minority stock is not an election for Falcon common shareholders.

consideration_type: Stock; eligible RTB common stockholders receive Ryvyl common stock. RTB shares with perfected appraisal rights are excluded from the stock exchange.

The applicable ratio is determined using share counts immediately before closing. An illustrative ratio of 0.38 is stated, but not as a fixed final ratio. closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted waiver of conditions, including Ryvyl and RTB stockholder approvals; Form S-4 effectiveness without an effective SEC stop order or pending proceeding seeking one; Nasdaq approval to list the merger shares and continued listing of Ryvyl common stock; required governmental and antitrust approvals or waiting-period expirations, including applicable digital-asset or cryptocurrency-related approvals, subject to the stated alternative-compliance provision; and absence of a governmental order or law preventing the merger. acquirer: StablecoinX Inc., through its wholly-owned subsidiary StablecoinX SPAC Merger Sub LLC
consideration_type: Stock for TLGY Class A Ordinary Shares not redeemed; holders of Public Shares may separately elect cash redemption before the merger.
cash_consideration: For Public Shares properly redeemed before the SPAC Merger, cash per Public Share equals a pro rata portion of TLGY’s Trust Account calculated as of two business days before completion of the Business Combination. This is a pre-merger redemption, not cash merger consideration.
stock_exchange_ratio: 1 share of StablecoinX Class A Common Stock per 1 TLGY Class A Ordinary Share not redeemed. Each outstanding TLGY Class B Ordinary Share first converts into 1 TLGY Class A Ordinary Share. The TLGY Insiders have separately agreed to exchange their Founder Shares and Private Placement Warrants for Retained Shares under the Sponsor Support Agreement.
closing_conditions: The Business Combination requires approval of both the Business Combination Proposal and the SPAC Merger Proposal by TLGY shareholders; no applicable legal restraint; an effective registration statement; approval of StablecoinX Class A Common Stock for listing on Nasdaq or another acceptable national exchange, subject only to notice of issuance; full funding of the PIPE; completion of Ethena’s ENA Contribution and Ethena OpCo’s Locked ENA Token sale, with the applicable tokens placed in custodial accounts; the Collaboration Agreement and Token Purchase Agreements remaining in force; expiration of applicable antitrust waiting periods and receipt of necessary governmental consents. Additional party-specific conditions include the accuracy of representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants and agreements, no continuing applicable Material Adverse Effect, and performance of the Sponsor Support Agreement. Conditions may be waived only where permitted.
event_status: Pending; the Business Combination Agreement was amended on January 21, 2026 to extend the Outside Date.
security_description: TLGY Class A Ordinary Shares, including Public Shares not redeemed; TLGY Class B Ordinary Shares convert into Class A Ordinary Shares before the SPAC Merger. Founder Shares held by TLGY Insiders are subject to a separate Sponsors Securities Exchange.
effective_date: Proposed: the SPAC Merger becomes effective on the Closing Date when the SPAC Plan of Merger is registered by the Cayman Registrar, or at another time specified in that plan. No calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: Public Shareholders may request cash redemption of all or part of their Public Shares before the SPAC Merger, regardless of whether or how they vote; Public Shares not redeemed are exchanged for StablecoinX Class A Common Stock. Redemption requires a written request identifying the beneficial holder and delivery of the shares and applicable forms.
default_option: Public Shares not validly redeemed are exchanged for StablecoinX Class A Common Stock in the SPAC Merger.

consideration_type: Stock
stock_exchange_ratio: 1 share of Eagle Nuclear Energy Corp. common stock per 1 SVII Class A ordinary share outstanding immediately before the First Merger, including the Class A share resulting from conversion of the sole outstanding SVII Class B ordinary share and Class A shares resulting from conversion of SVII rights. SVII units first separate into their component securities. SVII warrants convert separately, one-for-one, into warrants to acquire Eagle Nuclear Energy Corp. common stock.
shareholder_vote_date: SVII shareholders: scheduled for 2/23/2026 at 10:00 a.m., Eastern Time, subject to adjournment or postponement. Eagle Energy Metals Corp. stockholder approval is to be solicited by written consent after the Form S-4 registration statement becomes effective; no consent date is stated.
closing_conditions: Conditions to closing, subject to waiver in writing where permissible, include: any applicable HSR Act waiting period expiring or terminating; no law or final restraint preventing the transaction; completion of the redemption offer; SVII and Eagle Energy Metals Corp. stockholder approvals; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement; approval of New Eagle’s Nasdaq listing application and listing of the common stock issued in the transaction; and adoption of the New Eagle charter and bylaws. SVII approval requires the Transaction Proposal, Cayman Merger Proposal and Equity Plan Proposal, each conditioned on approval of the others. Additional party-specific conditions include the specified accuracy of representations and warranties, material compliance with pre-closing covenants, delivery of officer certificates and executed ancillary agreements, and absence of a continuing, uncured material adverse effect affecting Eagle Energy Metals Corp. or SVII, as applicable. The Merger Agreement has no minimum cash condition.
event_status: Pending; the original merger agreement was amended and restated on 9/29/2025. SVII shareholder approval was being solicited, and closing was anticipated after the scheduled extraordinary general meeting if the conditions were satisfied or waived.
security_description: SVII Class A ordinary shares, par value $0.0001 per share, outstanding immediately before the First Merger, including shares issued upon conversion of the sole outstanding Class B ordinary share and SVII rights. Public shares validly redeemed before closing are excluded from the merger exchange. SVII warrants receive separate warrant treatment.

acquirer: Eagle Nuclear Energy Corp. (New Eagle), through its wholly owned subsidiary Spring Valley Merger Sub II, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock; an additional 1,500,000 shares of New Eagle common stock may be issued to designated earnout recipients if the stated share-price target is met during the five-year earnout period or a change of control occurs during that period.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each share of Eagle Energy Metals Corp. common stock outstanding immediately before the Second Merger, a number of shares of Eagle Nuclear Energy Corp. common stock equal to the Exchange Ratio, rounded down to the nearest whole share. The Exchange Ratio is the aggregate merger consideration of 23,350,000 New Eagle common shares divided by the aggregate fully diluted Eagle Energy Metals Corp. common shares outstanding immediately before the Second Merger. No fixed per-share numerical ratio is stated.
shareholder_vote_date: Eagle Energy Metals Corp. stockholder approval is to be solicited by written consent as soon as reasonably practicable after the Form S-4 registration statement becomes effective; no consent date is stated. SVII shareholders: scheduled to vote on transaction approval at an extraordinary general meeting on 2/23/2026 at 10:00 a.m., Eastern Time, subject to adjournment or postponement.
closing_conditions: Conditions to closing, subject to waiver in writing where permissible, include: any applicable HSR Act waiting period expiring or terminating; no law or final restraint preventing the transaction; completion of the SVII redemption offer; SVII and Eagle Energy Metals Corp. stockholder approvals; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement; approval of New Eagle’s Nasdaq listing application and listing of the common stock issued in the transaction; and adoption of the New Eagle charter and bylaws. SVII approval requires the Transaction Proposal, Cayman Merger Proposal and Equity Plan Proposal, each conditioned on approval of the others. Additional party-specific conditions include the specified accuracy of representations and warranties, material compliance with pre-closing covenants, delivery of officer certificates and executed ancillary agreements, and absence of a continuing, uncured material adverse effect affecting Eagle Energy Metals Corp. or SVII, as applicable. The Merger Agreement has no minimum cash condition.
event_status: Pending; the original merger agreement was amended and restated on 9/29/2025. Shareholder approvals were being sought, and closing was anticipated after the scheduled SVII extraordinary general meeting if the conditions were satisfied or waived.
security_description: Eagle Energy Metals Corp. common stock, par value $0.0001 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the Second Merger. Shares of merger subsidiary Spring Valley Merger Sub II, Inc. receive separate treatment. The aggregate merger consideration includes shares attributable to Eagle stock sold to the PIPE investor and shares to be transferred to Aurora Energy for the Oregon Energy acquisition.
effective_date: The Second Merger is to take effect when its articles of merger are filed with the Nevada Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed in writing and specified in those articles. No calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: No holder election; each outstanding Eagle Energy Metals Corp. common share receives stock consideration under the Exchange Ratio, subject to rounding down to a whole share.

closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or written waiver, where permissible, of Parent shareholder approval; Company stockholder approval; expiration or termination of applicable antitrust waiting periods; specified third-party consents; absence of a prohibiting law or order; appointment of the Purchaser board; registration statement effectiveness without a stop order; and Nasdaq listing approval and compliance. Party-specific conditions include accuracy of representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, and absence of continuing, uncured material adverse effects. Conditions to the Parent Parties’ obligations also include termination of the September 17, 2024 Company stockholders’ agreement, the specified amendment to the PrimeGen Biotech LLC license agreement, and stated closing deliverables.

consideration_type: Stock for outstanding Pelican ordinary shares other than shares cancelled under the merger agreement and shares for which public shareholders validly exercise redemption rights; redemption shares instead receive cash under the redemption-rights formula.
cash_consideration: No fixed cash amount per Pelican ordinary share is stated for the merger exchange. A validly redeemed public share receives cash equal to its pro rata portion of the trust account, calculated as of two business days before consummation of the business combination, including eligible interest and less specified taxes and permitted withdrawals.
stock_exchange_ratio: 1 share of Pelican Holdco, Inc. common stock per 1 Pelican Acquisition Corporation ordinary share issued and outstanding immediately before the Pelican merger effective time, excluding shares cancelled under the merger agreement and redemption shares. Immediately before that time, each Pelican right represents one-tenth of a Pelican ordinary share.
closing_conditions: The mergers are subject to the required Pelican and company shareholder approvals; no effective law or governmental order making the transactions illegal or preventing consummation; Pelican Holdco having net tangible assets of at least $5,000,001 after redemptions and any PIPE investment; SEC effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without a stop order; approval for listing the merger shares on Nasdaq or another agreed exchange, subject to official notice of issuance; and amendment of Holdco's organizational documents to authorize 500,000,000 common shares. Additional conditions include the specified accuracy of representations and warranties, performance of covenants, required certificates and other closing deliverables, and no continuing, uncured material adverse effect on the companies. Conditions may be waived in writing where permissible. A PIPE investment is not itself a closing condition.
event_status: Pending; the business combination agreement has been executed, but the preliminary proxy statement/prospectus states that the securities may not be issued until the registration statement is effective.
security_description: Pelican Acquisition Corporation ordinary shares, par value $0.0001 per share, including public shares subject to redemption rights; shares cancelled under the merger agreement and redemption shares have different treatment.
effective_date: Proposed: the Pelican merger becomes effective when its certificate of merger is filed and effective, or at another time specified in the merger filings by agreement of the parties. It is to occur after Pelican's conversion from a Cayman Islands company to a Texas corporation and before the Greenland and March GL mergers. No calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: Pelican public shareholders may elect to redeem all or part of their public shares for cash, regardless of how they vote, instead of receiving Holdco stock for those redeemed shares. Holders of units must first separate them into ordinary shares and rights to exercise redemption rights. Rights themselves have no redemption rights. Without Pelican's prior consent, a public shareholder and its affiliates or group cannot redeem more than 15% of the public shares.
default_option: A Pelican ordinary share for which redemption rights are not validly exercised, and which is not otherwise cancelled, converts into the right to receive one share of Holdco common stock.

consideration_type: Stock.
stock_exchange_ratio: Each share of March GL Company common stock issued and outstanding immediately before the March GL merger effective time converts into the right to receive a pro rata portion of an aggregate 20,000,000 shares of Pelican Holdco, Inc. common stock. Additional conditions include the specified accuracy of representations and warranties, performance of covenants, required certificates and other closing deliverables, and no continuing, uncured material adverse effect on the companies. Conditions may be waived in writing where permissible. A PIPE investment is not itself a closing condition.
event_status: Pending; the business combination agreement has been executed, but the preliminary proxy statement/prospectus states that the securities may not be issued until the registration statement is effective.
security_description: March GL Company common stock issued and outstanding immediately before the March GL merger effective time.
effective_date: Proposed: the March GL merger becomes effective when its certificate of merger is filed with the Texas Secretary of State, or at another time specified in that certificate by agreement of March GL and Pelican Acquisition Corporation. available_options: No holder election; March GL common-stock holders receive a pro rata portion of the fixed aggregate stock consideration.

acquirer: Volato Group, Inc. (parent); Volato Merger Subsidiary, Inc. is its wholly owned merger subsidiary.
consideration_type: Stock, subject to adjustment under the Merger Agreement; dissenting shares are subject to separate appraisal-rights treatment.
cash_consideration: No cash is payable for fractional shares eliminated by rounding; no regular cash merger consideration is stated.
stock_exchange_ratio: Each share of M2i Global, Inc. common stock outstanding immediately before the merger converts into the right to receive shares of Volato Group, Inc. Class A common stock. The number issued for all eligible M2i Global common shares is set to represent 85% of Volato capital stock on an as-converted, fully diluted basis at closing, excluding shares underlying outstanding Volato warrants but including shares underlying outstanding Volato options, subject to adjustments mutually agreed by the parties. A fixed number of Volato shares per M2i Global common share is not stated. Each holder’s aggregate fractional entitlement is rounded down if less than 0.5 share and up if at least 0.5 share, with no cash paid for the eliminated fraction.
shareholder_vote_date: Volato Group, Inc. stockholders: special meeting scheduled for 3/31/2026 at 9:00 AM Eastern Time, unless postponed or adjourned. M2i Global, Inc. stockholder approval is to be obtained by written consent; no consent date is stated and no M2i Global stockholder meeting is required.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted written waiver: effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an operative SEC stop order or pending or threatened stop-order proceeding; expiration or termination of any applicable HSR Act waiting period; absence of a legal order or law preventing or making the merger illegal; required board and stockholder approvals, including Volato’s Merger, Stock Issuance and Election of Directors Proposals and M2i Global’s written consent; approval of the combined company’s Nasdaq listing, subject to official notice of issuance; completion of due diligence to the satisfaction of Sichenzia Ross Ference Carmel LLP and Alliance Global Partners; required accuracy of representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, absence of a continuing material adverse effect for each party, and delivery of specified certificates, documents and applicable tax opinions. M2i Global’s additional conditions include termination of specified Volato agreements and rights without post-merger liability and Volato net debt of no more than $10,000,000 at closing; M2i Global may waive the net-debt condition. The filing says Volato lacks binding agreements or commitments ensuring it will meet that debt threshold.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was executed on 7/28/2025 and amended on 1/19/2026 to extend the termination outside date to 3/31/2026. Closing remains subject to conditions.
security_description: M2i Global, Inc. common stock, $0.001 par value per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the merger. M2i Global preferred stock is to convert into common stock immediately before the merger; properly dissenting shares receive separate appraisal-rights treatment.
effective_date: Not stated as a calendar date. The merger becomes legally effective when articles of merger are filed with the Nevada Secretary of State, or at a later time specified in that filing with Volato’s and M2i Global’s consent. The parties expected closing in the first quarter of 2026, but stated that it could occur later or not at all.
available_options: No holder election; eligible M2i Global common shares convert into the right to receive stock consideration. A holder who properly exercises Nevada appraisal rights may instead obtain payment of fair value, subject to the statutory requirements.

cash_consideration: No cash consideration is specified for holders of Merlin Common Stock. No consideration is delivered for excluded shares. Fractional shares of New Merlin Common Stock are rounded down, not paid in cash.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each share of Merlin Common Stock issued and outstanding immediately before the merger effective time, other than an excluded share, a variable number of shares of New Merlin Common Stock equal to the Exchange Ratio. The Exchange Ratio is the Aggregate Consideration divided by Merlin’s fully diluted capital. Aggregate Consideration is the number of New Merlin Common Stock shares equal to $800,000,000 divided by the price at which each Inflection Point public share may be redeemed in connection with the extraordinary general meeting. Fractional New Merlin Common Stock shares are rounded down to the nearest whole share.
shareholder_vote_date: Inflection Point shareholders’ extraordinary general meeting was scheduled for 3/12/2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time. Merlin stockholder approval was also required by vote or written consent; no date for that approval is stated.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver where permitted: Inflection Point shareholder approval of the condition precedent proposals, including the business combination, domestication, stock issuance, organizational documents, director election, incentive plan and employee stock purchase plan proposals; requisite Merlin stockholder approval of the agreement and business combination; no law or order preventing or prohibiting the transactions; the Form S-4 registration statement becoming and remaining effective, without an effective stop order or unwithdrawn SEC proceeding for one; conditional Nasdaq listing approval for New Merlin Common Stock, subject to the round-lot-holder requirement; completion of the domestication; required governmental consents and approvals; and accuracy of the parties’ representations and warranties, covenant compliance and absence of an applicable continuing, uncured material adverse effect, each subject to the agreement’s qualifications. The applicable 30-day HSR Act waiting period expired on 10/30/2025. Additional party-specific closing deliverables include specified certificates and agreements, and, for Inflection Point’s and Merger Sub’s obligations, specified Merlin consents, warrant-holder consents or cancellation where needed, and payoff letters and lien-release documentation for closing indebtedness paid under the agreement. effective_date: No calendar effective date is stated. The filed form of certificate specifies effectiveness upon filing.
available_options: No holder election for Merlin Common Stock merger consideration; eligible shares convert into the right to receive New Merlin Common Stock.

acquirer: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. IV (formerly Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. I), the acquiring parent; its wholly owned subsidiary IPDX Merger Sub, Inc. will merge with and into the target.
consideration_type: Stock; each outstanding Merlin common share other than an Excluded Share converts into a right to receive New Merlin common stock. Excluded Shares are canceled without consideration.
cash_consideration: No cash consideration is stated for outstanding Merlin common shares. Excluded Shares are canceled without consideration.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each 1 share of Merlin Labs, Inc. common stock outstanding immediately before the merger, other than an Excluded Share, the holder receives New Merlin common shares equal to the Exchange Ratio. The Exchange Ratio is Aggregate Consideration divided by Merlin's fully diluted capital; Aggregate Consideration is the number of New Merlin common shares equal to $800,000,000 divided by the redemption price per Inflection Point public share. Fractional New Merlin common shares are rounded down to the nearest whole share.
shareholder_vote_date: Inflection Point shareholders are scheduled to vote on the Business Combination Proposal at an extraordinary general meeting on 3/12/2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time. Merlin Labs, Inc. stockholder approval is also required, but no vote or written-consent date is stated.

consideration_type: Warrants; each outstanding, unexercised Pre-Funded Warrant is canceled and converted into the right to receive one or more New Merlin Series A Warrants to purchase New Merlin common stock.
cash_consideration: No cash merger consideration is stated for an outstanding Pre-Funded Warrant; its aggregate exercise price determines the number of New Merlin common shares purchasable under the replacement warrant or warrants.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each outstanding, unexercised Merlin Labs, Inc. Pre-Funded Warrant, the holder receives one or more New Merlin Series A Warrants to purchase a number of New Merlin common shares equal to the Pre-Funded Warrant's aggregate exercise price immediately before the Effective Time divided by $12.00.
