shareholder_vote_date: Inflection Point shareholders are scheduled to vote on the Business Combination Proposal at an extraordinary general meeting on 3/12/2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time. Merlin Labs, Inc. stockholder approval is also required, but no vote or written-consent date is stated.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permissible waiver: approval of the cross-conditioned Condition Precedent Proposals by Inflection Point shareholders and approval of the agreement and Business Combination, including the merger, by Merlin stockholders; no law or order prohibiting the transactions; effectiveness of the registration statement without an effective stop order; conditional Nasdaq listing approval for New Merlin common stock, subject to the round-lot-holder requirement; expiration or termination of applicable HSR waiting periods and receipt of other required governmental consents, waivers and approvals; completion of the Domestication; accuracy of each party's representations and warranties, material compliance with its covenants, and absence of a continuing, uncured material adverse effect as specified for each party; required closing certificates and transaction agreements; and Merlin's required consents, warrant-holder consents or cancellation, and applicable indebtedness payoff and lien-release documentation. The filing states that the HSR waiting period expired on 10/30/2025. Nasdaq listing approval may be waived by the parties.
event_status: Pending as described in the preliminary proxy statement/prospectus dated 2/11/2026; the Business Combination Agreement was executed on 8/13/2025, and the merger remains subject to closing conditions.
security_description: Outstanding and unexercised warrants of Merlin Labs, Inc. identified as Pre-Funded Warrants, exercisable for Merlin common stock.
effective_date: No calendar date or time is stated. The merger becomes effective when its Certificate of Merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State on the Closing Date, or at a later time agreed in writing by the parties and specified in that certificate. The Closing Date is conditional on satisfaction or waiver of the closing conditions.
available_options: No holder election between forms of merger consideration is stated; each outstanding, unexercised Pre-Funded Warrant converts into the right to receive the specified replacement warrant or warrants.

acquirer: Pelican Holdco, Inc. (PubCo), through its wholly owned subsidiary Pelican Merger Sub, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock for non-redeemed ordinary shares; public shares validly submitted for redemption instead receive cash under the redemption rights.
cash_consideration: For public shares validly submitted for redemption, cash per share equals the amount calculated under the holder’s redemption rights: the aggregate amount in the Trust Account as of two business days before closing, including interest and less applicable taxes and permitted withdrawals, divided by the number of then-outstanding public shares. No fixed dollar amount is stated.
stock_exchange_ratio: 1 share of Pelican Holdco, Inc. common stock per 1 Pelican Acquisition Corporation ordinary share outstanding immediately before the merger, excluding shares canceled under the agreement and shares validly submitted for redemption. Each Pelican Acquisition Corporation right represents one-tenth of an ordinary share before that exchange.
closing_conditions: The shared closing conditions are requisite Pelican Acquisition Corporation and company shareholder approvals; no effective law or order making the transactions illegal or preventing completion; Pelican Holdco, Inc. having net tangible assets of at least $5,000,001 after redemptions and any PIPE investment; an effective Form S-4 registration statement with no effective stop order; approval for listing of the merger-issued Pelican Holdco, Inc. common stock on Nasdaq or another exchange agreed by the parties, subject to official notice of issuance; and amendment of Pelican Holdco, Inc.’s organizational documents to authorize 500,000,000 common shares. Additional conditions include the specified parties’ representations and warranties being true as required by the agreement, performance of required covenants, no continuing uncured material adverse effect on Greenland Exploration Limited and March GL Company, and delivery of the specified certificates, good-standing documents, letters of transmittal, indemnification agreements and requested resignations. Conditions may be waived where permitted by the party entitled to their benefit. A PIPE investment is expressly not a closing condition.
event_status: Pending; definitive merger agreement executed, with shareholder approval and other closing conditions still described as outstanding.
security_description: Pelican Acquisition Corporation ordinary shares, including public shares subject to redemption rights. Its units separate into ordinary shares and rights before the merger.
effective_date: Not stated as a calendar date. The Pelican Acquisition Corporation merger becomes effective when the applicable merger filings become effective, or at another time agreed in writing and specified in the merger certificates; it is to occur after the domestication and before the Greenland Exploration Limited and March GL Company mergers.
available_options: Public shareholders may redeem all or part of their public shares for cash in connection with the merger, regardless of how they vote. Public shares not redeemed receive Pelican Holdco, Inc. common stock at the stated exchange ratio. Units must first be separated into ordinary shares and rights to redeem the underlying public shares; rights themselves have no redemption rights. A public shareholder and its affiliates or group generally cannot redeem more than 15% of the public shares without Pelican Acquisition Corporation’s prior consent.

The filing also states that Greenland common stockholders are entitled to 1,500,000 Pelican Holdco, Inc. common shares in the aggregate. Any fractional Pelican Holdco, Inc. share otherwise issuable under the merger agreement is rounded up to the nearest whole share, subject to the agreement’s provision reducing March GL merger consideration if rounding would exceed total merger consideration.
closing_conditions: The shared closing conditions are requisite Pelican Acquisition Corporation and company shareholder approvals; no effective law or order making the transactions illegal or preventing completion; Pelican Holdco, Inc. having net tangible assets of at least $5,000,001 after redemptions and any PIPE investment; an effective Form S-4 registration statement with no effective stop order; approval for listing of the merger-issued Pelican Holdco, Inc. common stock on Nasdaq or another exchange agreed by the parties, subject to official notice of issuance; and amendment of Pelican Holdco, Inc.’s organizational documents to authorize 500,000,000 common shares. Additional conditions include the specified parties’ representations and warranties being true as required by the agreement, performance of required covenants, no continuing uncured material adverse effect on Greenland Exploration Limited and March GL Company, and delivery of the specified certificates, good-standing documents, letters of transmittal, indemnification agreements and requested resignations. Conditions may be waived where permitted by the party entitled to their benefit. A PIPE investment is expressly not a closing condition.
event_status: Pending; definitive merger agreement executed, with shareholder approval and other closing conditions still described as outstanding.
security_description: Greenland Exploration Limited common stock.
effective_date: Not stated as a calendar date. The Greenland Exploration Limited merger becomes effective when its Texas certificate of merger is filed, or at another time Greenland Exploration Limited and Pelican Acquisition Corporation agree in writing and specify in that certificate. It is to occur immediately after the Pelican Acquisition Corporation merger and before the March GL Company merger.
available_options: No holder election; Greenland Exploration Limited common stockholders receive stock consideration under the merger agreement.

stock_exchange_ratio: A pro rata portion of an aggregate 20,000,000 shares of Pelican Holdco, Inc. common stock for each share of March GL Company common stock; no fixed per-share exchange ratio is stated. Any fractional Pelican Holdco, Inc. share otherwise issuable under the merger agreement is rounded up to the nearest whole share, with an excess over total merger consideration reducing the March GL merger consideration.
closing_conditions: The shared closing conditions are requisite Pelican Acquisition Corporation and company shareholder approvals; no effective law or order making the transactions illegal or preventing completion; Pelican Holdco, Inc. having net tangible assets of at least $5,000,001 after redemptions and any PIPE investment; an effective Form S-4 registration statement with no effective stop order; approval for listing of the merger-issued Pelican Holdco, Inc. common stock on Nasdaq or another exchange agreed by the parties, subject to official notice of issuance; and amendment of Pelican Holdco, Inc.’s organizational documents to authorize 500,000,000 common shares. Additional conditions include the specified parties’ representations and warranties being true as required by the agreement, performance of required covenants, no continuing uncured material adverse effect on Greenland Exploration Limited and March GL Company, and delivery of the specified certificates, good-standing documents, letters of transmittal, indemnification agreements and requested resignations. Conditions may be waived where permitted by the party entitled to their benefit. A PIPE investment is expressly not a closing condition.
event_status: Pending; definitive merger agreement executed, with shareholder approval and other closing conditions still described as outstanding.
security_description: March GL Company common stock.
effective_date: Not stated as a calendar date. The March GL Company merger becomes effective when its Texas certificate of merger is filed, or at another time March GL Company and Pelican Acquisition Corporation agree in writing and specify in that certificate. It is to occur immediately after the Greenland Exploration Limited merger.
available_options: No holder election; March GL Company common stockholders receive a pro rata allocation of the stock consideration.

acquirer: Contango ORE, Inc., through its indirect wholly owned subsidiary 1566004 B.C. Ltd. (Acquiror)
consideration_type: Elective consideration: Contango common stock, or exchangeable shares of Acquiror for eligible Canadian holders who elect them.
cash_consideration: No cash consideration per Dolly Varden common share is described. Fractional Contango or exchangeable shares are rounded down without payment or other adjustment; dissenting shareholders who qualify instead receive fair value from Dolly Varden.
stock_exchange_ratio: Contango-stock option: 0.1652 share of Contango voting common stock per 1 Dolly Varden common share. Eligible-holder exchangeable-share option: 0.1652 exchangeable share of Acquiror per 1 Dolly Varden common share; each exchangeable share is exchangeable for 1 Contango common share, subject to stated adjustments. The ratio is fixed, subject to applicable adjustments under the Arrangement Agreement. Fractional Contango and exchangeable shares are rounded down to whole shares.
shareholder_vote_date: Contango stockholders: special meeting scheduled for 3/17/2026 at 12:00 P.M. Central Time, subject to adjournment or postponement. Dolly Varden shareholders: meeting required to approve the Arrangement, but no full meeting date is stated.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver: Contango stockholder approval of the Arrangement Proposal and Dolly Varden shareholder approval by at least 66⅔% of votes cast; the Arrangement Proposal and Share Increase Proposal are cross-conditioned on approval of each other. Other conditions include required regulatory approvals from the NYSE American and TSXV, required third-party consent from Contango's lenders Macquarie Bank Limited and ING Capital LLC, British Columbia Supreme Court Interim and Final Orders, no applicable legal prohibition or specified governmental proceeding, and applicable U.S. and Canadian securities-law issuance and resale exemptions. Contango's additional conditions include the accuracy of Dolly Varden's representations and warranties subject to stated materiality limits, material compliance with its covenants, no Dolly Varden Material Adverse Effect, and valid exercise of dissent rights by holders of no more than 5% of Dolly Varden shares. Dolly Varden's additional conditions include corresponding accuracy of Contango's and Acquiror's representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, no Contango Material Adverse Effect, NYSE American listing approval for the relevant Contango shares, execution of exchangeable-share and nine-month transition-services agreements, and specified post-closing board and president appointments. Mutual conditions may be waived only by mutual consent; party-specific conditions may be waived by the beneficiary.
event_status: Pending as described in the definitive proxy statement dated 2/13/2026; the Arrangement had not been reported as completed in the supplied text.
security_description: Issued and outstanding common shares of Dolly Varden Silver Corporation, excluding shares held by dissenting shareholders entitled to fair-value payment. Dolly Varden options and restricted share units receive separate treatment.
effective_date: No calendar Effective Date is stated. Closing and legal effectiveness are conditional on satisfaction or waiver of the closing conditions and are scheduled for the fifth Business Day afterward, or another written-agreed date. The Plan of Arrangement specifies an Effective Time of 12:01 a.m. Vancouver time on the Effective Date, unless the parties agree in writing to another time.
available_options: Eligible beneficial holders who are Canadian residents meeting the stated tax criteria, or qualifying Canadian partnerships, may elect exchangeable shares for any or all of their Dolly Varden common shares and Contango common shares for the balance. The exchangeable-share choice requires a timely completed Letter of Transmittal and Election Form with any share certificates, or another election method reasonably acceptable to Contango and Dolly Varden. Other holders receive Contango common shares.
default_option: A holder who does not make a timely, valid exchangeable-share election, or otherwise fails to comply with the election requirements, is deemed to elect only Contango common shares. A timely deposited election form is irrevocable and cannot be withdrawn.
election_deadline: A specific date and time are not stated. Contango and Dolly Varden will agree on a deadline before the Effective Date. Dolly Varden must announce it by news release at least two Business Days in advance; an extension to another pre-Effective-Date deadline must be announced with at least one Business Day of advance notice.

closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted waiver: Ryvyl and RTB stockholder approvals; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an effective SEC stop order or pending proceeding seeking one; Nasdaq approval to list the merger shares and continued listing of Ryvyl common stock; applicable antitrust waiting periods and required regulatory approvals or clearances, with alternative compliance mechanisms permitted for specified digital-asset approvals; and absence of orders or laws preventing or prohibiting the merger. effective_date: Not specified. The merger will become legally effective when the certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later date or time agreed in writing and specified in that certificate.
available_options: No holder election; eligible RTB common stock is converted into the right to receive Ryvyl common stock, subject to the stated exceptions for excluded and dissenting shares.

acquirer: Bakkt, Inc. (parent), through its wholly owned subsidiary Bakkt Opco Holdings, LLC (buyer).
consideration_type: Stock; the DTR holders are to receive Bakkt Class A Common Stock, subject to the consideration-share adjustment for DTR indebtedness and transaction expenses above $1,500,000 and potential additional shares tied to exercises of specified Bakkt warrants.
cash_consideration: No cash consideration is payable to DTR holders for their shares; the acquisition consideration consists solely of Bakkt equity.
stock_exchange_ratio: A variable number of shares of Bakkt, Inc. Class A Common Stock per 1 ordinary share of Distributed Technologies Research Global Ltd.: the Exchange Ratio equals the Consideration Shares divided by the Company Share Number. Consideration Shares equal 31.5% of the Parent Share Number, less the Adjustment Share Number for closing indebtedness and transaction expenses above $1,500,000. The Parent Share Number includes outstanding Bakkt Class A shares and specified shares issuable on exercise or conversion, excluding Bakkt warrants. Additional consideration equal to 31.5% of shares issued upon exercise of Bakkt warrants outstanding on the agreement date may be issued. Shares delivered to the seller at a particular time are rounded to the nearest whole share, without payment for that rounding.
shareholder_vote_date: Bakkt, Inc. stockholders are scheduled to vote on the share-issuance proposal at a virtual special meeting on 3/24/2026 at 1:00 p.m. Eastern Time.
closing_conditions: Closing is subject to satisfaction or permissible waiver of the applicable conditions: required Bakkt stockholder approval; expiration or termination of any applicable HSR Act waiting period and receipt of requisite HSR consents, approvals or clearances; specified financial-regulatory authorizations; and no continuing law or order prohibiting or restraining the transaction. Each side's additional conditions include the other side's representations and warranties meeting the agreement's specified accuracy standards, material compliance with pre-closing covenants, and no continuing material adverse effect on the other side. Conditions also include the specified transaction agreements remaining in effect, required closing deliverables, and authorization for NYSE listing of the Bakkt Class A shares, subject to official notice of issuance.
event_status: Pending; the share purchase agreement has been signed, and Bakkt stockholder approval is being sought for the proposed acquisition.
security_description: Ordinary shares of Distributed Technologies Research Global Ltd., with a nominal value of EUR 0.10 each.
available_options: No holder election; DTR holders are to receive stock consideration under the agreement.

consideration_type: Stock; eligible Hadron Energy, Inc. common shares are converted into the right to receive Domesticated GigCapital7 Common Stock. Excluded shares and dissenting shares receive different treatment, and restricted share awards and options are assumed and converted separately.
stock_exchange_ratio: A number of shares of Domesticated GigCapital7 Common Stock equal to the Exchange Ratio per 1 eligible share of Hadron Energy, Inc. common stock. The Exchange Ratio is Aggregate Merger Consideration divided by Hadron Fully Diluted Capital. Aggregate Merger Consideration equals $1,200,200,000 divided by $10.59 per share, less 13,333,333 shares; if Hadron Energy has indebtedness outstanding at closing, it is further reduced by the indebtedness divided by $10.59, rounded down to the nearest whole share. Hadron Fully Diluted Capital includes outstanding common shares after SAFE conversion, restricted shares, and shares issuable upon full exercise of outstanding options using the treasury method on a cashless-exercise basis. No fractional shares will be issued; fractional interests are rounded up to the nearest whole share.
shareholder_vote_date: GigCapital7 Corp. shareholders: extraordinary general meeting scheduled for 3/20/2026 at 1:00 p.m., Eastern Time. Hadron Energy, Inc. stockholder approval is contemplated by written consent after the registration statement becomes effective; no consent date is stated.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permissible waiver by the applicable parties. Conditions for each party include GigCapital7 shareholder approval of the Condition Precedent Proposals and Hadron Energy stockholder approval; no effective law or order making the transactions illegal or preventing or prohibiting them; SEC effectiveness of the registration statement through Closing, without an effective stop order or an unwithdrawn proceeding for one; conditional Nasdaq listing approval for the Domesticated GigCapital7 Common Stock issued in the transaction, subject to the round-lot-holder requirement and a stated exception involving publicly held securities subject to lock-up; expiration or termination of the HSR Act and other antitrust waiting periods and receipt of other required antitrust approvals; and Hadron Energy having no outstanding borrowed-money indebtedness at Closing, except ordinary-course trade payables and accrued expenses or amounts GigCapital7 agrees to in writing. Hadron Energy's additional conditions include GigCapital7 and Merger Sub representations and warranties being true and correct subject to stated date and material-adverse-effect exceptions, material performance of covenants, no continuing GigCapital7 material adverse effect, completed Domestication, availability at Closing of net trust-account proceeds after redemptions, at least $5,000,001 in GigCapital7 net tangible assets immediately after the Effective Time, at least $20,000,000 in Available Closing SPAC Cash at Closing, and the contemplated post-closing board composition. GigCapital7 and Merger Sub's additional conditions include Hadron Energy representations and warranties being true and correct subject to stated date and material-adverse-effect exceptions, material covenant performance except the specified financial-statement delivery deadlines, no continuing Hadron Energy material adverse effect, no formal NRC written communication materially adversely affecting Hadron Energy's ability to complete the Merger or preventing continued NRC engagement, and amendment and conversion of all outstanding SAFEs before the Effective Time. The agreement also specifies closing certificates and documents to be delivered. The filing states that the HSR filing was made on 10/27/2025 and its waiting period expired on 11/26/2025; it does not state that all closing conditions have been satisfied.
event_status: Pending; the Business Combination Agreement was amended on 12/12/2025 to expand the proposed post-closing board from seven to eight directors. Shareholder approval and other closing conditions remain contemplated.
security_description: Issued and outstanding Hadron Energy, Inc. common stock, other than excluded shares, shares held by stockholders who have properly exercised and not withdrawn appraisal rights, and Hadron Restricted Shares. Hadron common shares issued upon conversion of SAFEs are treated as common stock for merger consideration.
effective_date: The Merger's Effective Time is the filing time of the Certificate of Merger with the Delaware Secretary of State, or a later time agreed in writing by the parties and specified in that certificate. No actual date or time is stated. The Closing is to occur no later than the third Business Day after satisfaction or waiver of the applicable closing conditions, unless GigCapital7 and Hadron Energy agree otherwise.
available_options: No holder election for the merger consideration payable on eligible Hadron Energy, Inc. common shares; the shares are cancelled and converted into the right to receive stock. The separate SPAC public-share redemption right is not a merger consideration option for Hadron Energy stockholders.

acquirer: McCarthy Finney, Inc. (Holdco), through its wholly owned subsidiary Thramann Merger Sub LLC
consideration_type: Holdco Special Preferred Stock and $3,500,000 aggregate principal amount of non-convertible, exchangeable Holdco Notes; no holder election stated.
stock_exchange_ratio: Each Thramann Membership Interest receives Holdco Special Preferred Stock at the Thramann Preferred Stock Exchange Ratio: Thramann Preferred Merger Shares divided by Thramann Outstanding Membership Interests, rounded to four decimal places. Thramann Preferred Merger Shares equal Thramann Preferred Share Value divided by $1,000; that value equals Thramann As-Converted Merger Shares multiplied by the Auddia Closing Market Price, less $3,500,000 of Holdco Notes consideration. The formula adjusts for Auddia net cash above $20,000,000 or below $12,000,000; no ownership adjustment applies between those amounts. Fractional preferred shares are rounded down without payment.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or written waiver, where permitted by law: effectiveness of the registration statement without a stop order or proceeding seeking one; no effective legal restraint or law making the transactions illegal; Auddia stockholder approval; Auddia net cash of at least $12,000,000 at the cash determination time; lock-up agreements remaining effective immediately after the applicable merger effective time; any Holdco charter amendment determined necessary by the parties; and approval of the combined company’s listing. Thramann’s additional conditions include the specified accuracy of Auddia, Holdco and merger-sub representations, material covenant compliance, no Auddia Material Adverse Effect, Auddia market capitalization of at least $6,000,000 immediately before closing, and an officer’s certificate. Auddia’s additional conditions include the specified accuracy of Thramann’s representations, material covenant compliance, no Thramann Material Adverse Effect, and a closing certificate.
event_status: Pending; definitive merger agreement entered into on 2/17/2026, subject to closing conditions.
security_description: Issued and outstanding membership interests of Thramann Holdings, LLC, other than excluded interests or dissenting interests.
available_options: No holder election

acquirer: ReserveOne Holdings, Inc. (Pubco), through its wholly-owned subsidiary R1 SPAC Merger Sub, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock; non-redeemed Class A-1 common shares are exchanged for Pubco Class A common shares. Public shareholders may separately exercise redemption rights for cash before the merger.
stock_exchange_ratio: 1 share of ReserveOne Holdings, Inc. Class A common stock per 1 share of M3-Brigade Class A-1 common stock, into which each outstanding M3-Brigade Class A ordinary share converts in the Domestication.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permissible waiver of the Business Combination Agreement's closing conditions: M3-Brigade and ReserveOne shareholder approvals; expiration or termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period; no effective legal restraint preventing the transaction; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an effective SEC stop order or pending proceeding seeking one; amendment and restatement of Pubco's certificate of incorporation; at least $500 million in aggregate proceeds from the Trust Account after redemptions and the Equity PIPE, net of unpaid expenses; and approval of Pubco's Nasdaq initial listing and listing of the shares and public warrants to be issued in the mergers. Additional party-specific conditions include the applicable representations and warranties being true and correct, material compliance with covenants, required closing deliverables and ancillary documents, and no ongoing applicable material adverse effect. ReserveOne's additional conditions include completion of the Domestication, arrangements to release available Trust Account funds, a specified tax opinion, and approval to list Pubco Class A common stock. The Business Combination Proposal and Merger Proposal are interdependent; the advisory organizational documents votes are not closing conditions.
event_status: Pending; the Business Combination Agreement was entered into on July 7, 2025, and the filing seeks M3-Brigade shareholder approval.
security_description: M3-Brigade Class A ordinary shares, par value $0.0001 per share, that are not redeemed; these convert into M3-Brigade Class A-1 common stock in the Domestication before the M3-Brigade Merger.
effective_date: Pending; the M3-Brigade Merger becomes effective when its certificate of merger is accepted for filing by the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later date and time agreed by M3-Brigade, R1 SPAC Merger Sub, Inc. and ReserveOne, Inc. and specified in that certificate. No calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: Public shareholders may retain their shares and receive the fixed stock consideration or separately elect redemption of all or a portion of their Public Shares for cash if the Business Combination is consummated. Redemption is available regardless of how they vote, subject to the stated procedures and the restriction on redeeming more than 15% of Public Shares without prior M3-Brigade Board consent. The redemption right is not an elective form of merger consideration.
default_option: A holder who takes no action and whose Public Shares are not redeemed receives Pubco Class A common stock upon completion of the Business Combination.

acquirer: ReserveOne Holdings, Inc. (Pubco), through its wholly-owned subsidiary R1 Company Merger Sub, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock; ReserveOne common shares, other than dissenting shares, convert into the right to receive Pubco Class A common shares.
stock_exchange_ratio: Each issued and outstanding share of ReserveOne common stock, other than dissenting shares, converts into the right to receive a number of ReserveOne Holdings, Inc. Class A common shares determined under an Allocation Schedule delivered before closing. The aggregate common-share consideration equals the Equity Value divided by the parties' agreed $10-per-Pubco-common-share value; Equity Value is $25,000,000 plus Equity PIPE proceeds, minus Group Company indebtedness immediately before closing, excluding proceeds and indebtedness attributable to the Convertible Notes PIPE. The aggregate shares allocated to each ReserveOne stockholder are rounded down to the nearest whole share. A fixed per-target-share ratio is not stated.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permissible waiver of the Business Combination Agreement's closing conditions: M3-Brigade and ReserveOne shareholder approvals; expiration or termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period; no effective legal restraint preventing the transaction; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an effective SEC stop order or pending proceeding seeking one; amendment and restatement of Pubco's certificate of incorporation; at least $500 million in aggregate proceeds from the Trust Account after redemptions and the Equity PIPE, net of unpaid expenses; and approval of Pubco's Nasdaq initial listing and listing of the shares and public warrants to be issued in the mergers. Additional party-specific conditions include the applicable representations and warranties being true and correct, material compliance with covenants, required closing deliverables and ancillary documents, and no ongoing applicable material adverse effect. ReserveOne's additional conditions include completion of the Domestication, arrangements to release available Trust Account funds, a specified tax opinion, and approval to list Pubco Class A common stock. The Business Combination Proposal and Merger Proposal are interdependent; the advisory organizational documents votes are not closing conditions.
event_status: Pending; the Business Combination Agreement was entered into on July 7, 2025, and the filing seeks M3-Brigade shareholder approval.
security_description: Issued and outstanding ReserveOne, Inc. common stock, par value $0.0001 per share, including shares issued to Equity PIPE investors if applicable; dissenting shares and treasury shares are treated separately.
effective_date: Pending; the Company Merger is to occur promptly following the M3-Brigade Merger on the Closing Date. It becomes legally effective when its certificate of merger is accepted for filing by the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later date and time agreed by M3-Brigade, R1 Company Merger Sub, Inc. and ReserveOne, Inc. and specified in that certificate. No calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: No holder election for the merger consideration is stated. ReserveOne stockholders who properly demand and retain appraisal rights are treated as dissenting stockholders rather than receiving merger consideration for those shares.

consideration_type: Stock for TLGY Class A Ordinary Shares not redeemed or held as dissenting shares; properly redeemed Public Shares instead receive cash under the separate redemption right.
cash_consideration: No regular cash merger consideration is stated for non-redeemed TLGY Class A Ordinary Shares. Public Shares properly redeemed before the SPAC Merger receive a cash price per Public Share equal to a pro rata portion of the Trust Account, calculated as of two business days before consummation of the Business Combination; approximately $13.05 per Public Share as of the 2/4/2026 record date, for illustration only.
stock_exchange_ratio: 1 share of StablecoinX Class A Common Stock per 1 TLGY Class A Ordinary Share not redeemed. Before the SPAC Merger, each outstanding TLGY Class B Ordinary Share converts into 1 TLGY Class A Ordinary Share. No fractional shares of StablecoinX stock will be issued; otherwise fractional entitlements are rounded down to the nearest whole share.
shareholder_vote_date: TLGY shareholders: extraordinary general meeting scheduled for 3/10/2026 at 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time, in person and virtually. TLGY shareholders will vote on the Business Combination Proposal and SPAC Merger Proposal.

Additional party-specific conditions include the applicable representations and warranties being sufficiently accurate, material covenant compliance, absence of a continuing material adverse effect, and performance and continued effectiveness of the Sponsor Support Agreement for the obligations of SC Assets and the merger subsidiaries.
event_status: Pending; the Business Combination Agreement was amended on 1/21/2026 to extend its outside date to 4/21/2026, and the TLGY shareholder vote was scheduled.
security_description: TLGY Acquisition Corporation Class A ordinary shares, par value $0.0001 per share, including Public Shares not redeemed and Class A shares resulting from conversion of TLGY Class B ordinary shares. Properly redeemed Public Shares and dissenting shares have separate treatment; founder shares are subject to a separate sponsor securities exchange.
effective_date: Not stated as a calendar date. The SPAC Merger is to become effective on the Closing Date when the SPAC Plan of Merger is registered by the Cayman Islands Registrar of Companies, or at another time specified in the plan.
available_options: Public Shareholders may retain their Public Shares and receive the fixed stock exchange consideration if the Business Combination closes, or request cash redemption of all or part of their Public Shares regardless of how or whether they vote. Redemption requires a written request identifying the beneficial holder and delivery of the Public Shares and applicable forms to Continental. A shareholder acting alone or with affiliates or a group cannot redeem more than 15% of Public Shares without TLGY’s prior consent. This redemption right is separate from the fixed merger consideration.
default_option: If a Public Shareholder takes no action and the Business Combination is approved and consummated, the holder becomes a StablecoinX stockholder; Public Shares are not redeemed without the required redemption election and delivery.
election_deadline: For the separate Public Share redemption right, 3/6/2026 at 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time. No election among alternative forms of merger consideration is described.

consideration_type: Stock

closing_conditions: The Business Combination and Company Merger are subject to satisfaction or permitted waiver of closing conditions, including TLGY shareholder approval of both the Business Combination Proposal and SPAC Merger Proposal; no applicable law or order prohibiting consummation; an effective registration statement; conditional approval of StablecoinX Class A Common Stock for listing on Nasdaq or another acceptable national exchange, subject only to notice of issuance; full funding of the PIPE; completion of Ethena’s ENA Contribution and Ethena OpCo’s locked-ENA sale with the applicable tokens placed in custodial accounts; the Collaboration Agreement and Token Purchase Agreements remaining in force; expiration of applicable antitrust waiting periods and receipt of necessary governmental consents. Additional party-specific conditions include the applicable representations and warranties being sufficiently accurate, material covenant compliance, absence of a continuing material adverse effect, and performance and continued effectiveness of the Sponsor Support Agreement for the obligations of SC Assets and the merger subsidiaries. SC Assets must seek written consent from holders of a majority of its outstanding stock after the registration statement becomes effective; no date for that consent is stated.
event_status: Pending; the Business Combination Agreement was amended on 1/21/2026 to extend its outside date to 4/21/2026.
security_description: Class A common stock of StablecoinX Assets Inc., par value $0.0001 per share.
effective_date: Not stated as a calendar date. The Company Merger is to become effective on the Closing Date when its certificate of merger is accepted for filing by the Delaware Secretary of State, or at another time specified in the certificate, immediately after the SPAC Merger becomes effective.
available_options: No holder election

acquirer: OceanFirst Financial Corp.; its wholly-owned subsidiary, Apollo Merger Sub Corp., will merge into Flushing Financial Corporation in the first-step merger.
consideration_type: Stock, with cash paid only in lieu of fractional shares of OceanFirst common stock.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration per share of Flushing Financial Corporation common stock. Cash is payable only in lieu of fractional shares of OceanFirst Financial Corp. common stock, rounded to the nearest cent. The amount equals the fractional share, rounded to the nearest thousandth after aggregating the holder’s Flushing shares, multiplied by the volume-weighted average trading price of OceanFirst common stock for the 15 consecutive full trading days ending on the last trading day before the merger closing date.
stock_exchange_ratio: 0.85 shares of OceanFirst Financial Corp. common stock, par value $0.01 per share, per 1 share of Flushing Financial Corporation common stock, par value $0.01 per share. No fractional OceanFirst shares will be issued; cash is payable instead. The ratio is subject to appropriate, proportionate adjustment for specified changes in capitalization or extraordinary dividends or distributions before the first-step merger becomes effective, excluding the Warburg equity financing.
shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled virtual special meetings on 4/2/2026: Flushing Financial Corporation stockholders at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time to vote on adoption of the merger agreement; OceanFirst Financial Corp. stockholders at 4:00 p.m. Eastern Time to vote on the share issuance required for the merger and investment.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where legally permitted, waiver of applicable conditions: required OceanFirst stockholder approval of the issuance and Flushing stockholder adoption of the merger agreement; Nasdaq authorization for listing the OceanFirst shares issued under the merger agreement; required regulatory approvals remaining effective and expiration or termination of applicable statutory waiting periods, without a materially burdensome regulatory condition; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an outstanding stop order or unresolved SEC proceeding; absence of specified legal restraints or laws prohibiting the transactions; consummation of the Warburg equity investment before or concurrently with the merger closing; accuracy of the parties’ representations and warranties under the agreement’s applicable standards; performance of their covenants under the applicable standards, including the specified cybersecurity-remediation standard; and receipt by each party of a satisfactory legal opinion that the mergers together will qualify as a reorganization under Section 368(a) of the Internal Revenue Code.
event_status: Pending as described in Amendment No. 1 to the preliminary Form S-4 registration statement filed 2/23/2026; regulatory applications were pending, and the mergers remained subject to closing conditions.
security_description: Flushing Financial Corporation common stock, par value $0.01 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the effective time of the first-step merger, excluding specified treasury and intercompany-owned shares, subject to exceptions for certain benefit-plan, fiduciary, agency and previously contracted debt holdings.
effective_date: No calendar effective date is stated. The first-step merger will become effective when its certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later mutually agreed time specified in that certificate. The second-step merger will become effective when its separate certificate is filed, or at a later mutually agreed time specified in that certificate; it is to follow the first-step merger immediately.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Flushing common stockholders receive the stated stock consideration, with cash only in lieu of fractional shares.

consideration_type: Stock; cash is payable only in lieu of fractional shares of Coursera common stock.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration per share of Udemy common stock. stock_exchange_ratio: 0.800 shares of Coursera, Inc. common stock, par value $0.00001 per share, per 1 eligible share of Udemy, Inc. common stock, par value $0.00001 per share. No fractional Coursera shares will be issued; cash will be paid in lieu.
closing_conditions: Completion is subject to satisfaction or permissible waiver of the applicable conditions. Mutual conditions include approval of Coursera’s share issuance and charter amendment by its stockholders and adoption of the merger agreement by Udemy stockholders; authorization for NYSE listing of the Coursera shares issuable to Udemy stockholders, subject to official notice of issuance; expiration or termination of the applicable HSR waiting period and any applicable timing commitment, plus specified other regulatory approvals and waiting periods; absence of an effective legal restraint or law prohibiting or making the merger illegal; and effectiveness of the Form S-4 without an effective stop order or pending SEC stop-order proceedings. The FTC granted early termination of the HSR waiting period on February 9, 2026; the filing does not state that all regulatory approvals have been obtained. Each party’s additional conditions include the other party’s representations and warranties meeting the agreement’s applicable accuracy standards, material performance of obligations and covenants, absence of a material adverse effect on the other party since December 17, 2025, and receipt of the other party’s officer certificate. Udemy must also receive the specified closing-date tax opinion that the merger, or an effective two-step restructuring, will qualify as a reorganization under Section 368(a) of the Internal Revenue Code.

effective_date: Upon filing and acceptance of the certificate of merger by the Delaware Secretary of State on the closing date, or at a later time agreed in writing by Coursera and Udemy and specified in that certificate. No calendar date or clock time for legal effectiveness is stated.

acquirer: ProCap Financial, Inc. (parent acquirer); Silvia Merger Sub, Inc. is its wholly owned merger subsidiary.
consideration_type: Stock: ProCap Financial, Inc. common stock, including contingent earnout shares if the trading-price condition is met. A portion of the closing shares is withheld in escrow.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each outstanding share of CFO Silvia, Inc. common stock, the right to receive ProCap Financial, Inc. common stock equals the per-share merger consideration, plus per-share earnout consideration if earned and per-share escrow consideration if released. Each component is calculated under the formulas in Appendix A using the fully diluted number of CFO Silvia shares and the applicable allocations to SAFE holders. The aggregate shares issued to a holder in respect of a certificate are rounded down to the nearest whole share. The earnout consists of 9,000,000 ProCap shares and is triggered if the specified ProCap trading price reaches $9.00 during the five-year earnout period, subject to adjustment for stock dividends, splits, combinations or similar recapitalizations. The exact number of ProCap shares per CFO Silvia share cannot be determined from the filing because the SAFE-holder allocations are to be set out in a spreadsheet delivered before closing.
shareholder_vote_date: ProCap Financial, Inc. stockholders are scheduled to vote on the merger-related share issuance at the annual meeting on 3/27/2026 at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time, unless postponed or adjourned. CFO Silvia, Inc. stockholders approved the merger on 2/9/2026.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver of applicable conditions: required stockholder approvals, including ProCap stockholder approval of the merger-related share issuance (CFO Silvia stockholder approval is reported as obtained); required governmental and regulatory approvals and filings, including HSR filings if applicable, and expiration or termination of any applicable antitrust waiting period; no legal restraint making or preventing the merger illegal; the parties’ applicable representations and warranties being accurate and covenants being performed to the stated standards; no CFO Silvia material adverse effect; no specified litigation or burdensome regulatory condition; and delivery of required closing documents and ancillary agreements, including debt payoff documents, the escrow agreement, a fairness opinion, and the Noor employment, lock-up, SAFE termination, registration-rights and noncompetition agreements. The agreement also requires payment of transaction expenses and specified CFO Silvia director resignations. The filing states that listing approval for the ProCap shares to be issued is a condition.
event_status: Pending as described in the 3/2/2026 proxy statement; the merger agreement was signed on 2/9/2026, CFO Silvia stockholders approved the merger, and ProCap stockholder approval and other closing conditions remained outstanding.
security_description: Issued and outstanding common stock of CFO Silvia, Inc., par value $0.001 per share, other than dissenting shares and treasury shares. CFO Silvia SAFE holders are entitled to separate allocations of merger consideration and any earnout shares; preferred shares are stated not to be outstanding.
effective_date: No calendar effective date is stated. Conditionally, the merger becomes effective when Delaware’s Secretary of State accepts the certificate of merger filed at closing, or at a later time agreed in writing by ProCap Financial, Inc. and CFO Silvia, Inc. and specified in that certificate.
available_options: No holder election; the merger agreement provides automatic conversion of eligible CFO Silvia common shares into the specified rights to ProCap stock consideration.

acquirer: Black Hawk Acquisition Corporation, through its wholly-owned merger subsidiary BH Merger Sub, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock
cash_consideration: No cash merger consideration for Vesicor shareholders; no cash will be paid instead of fractional shares, which will be rounded to the nearest whole share.
stock_exchange_ratio: A variable number of shares of PubCo Common Stock per 1 share of Vesicor Common Stock, equal to the Consideration Ratio: Aggregate Merger Consideration divided by Aggregate Fully Diluted Company Shares. Aggregate Merger Consideration equals $70,000,000 divided by the Redemption Price. The filing also uses an illustrative consideration exchange ratio of 0.627213 shares of PubCo Common Stock per 1 share of Vesicor Common Stock, based on a $10.00 Redemption Price; it does not establish that illustrative ratio as the final ratio. Fractional shares will be rounded to the nearest whole share.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver, where permitted, of the stated conditions: no law or order prohibiting the Business Combination; SEC effectiveness of the registration statement without a stop order or specified SEC proceedings; Black Hawk and Vesicor shareholder approvals, including approval of the required Black Hawk proposals; the specified PubCo board size and composition; Nasdaq listing approval for PubCo Common Stock; and receipt by Black Hawk of a fairness opinion, which the filing says it obtained. Black Hawk and Merger Sub also require Vesicor’s material covenant compliance, accuracy of representations and warranties subject to customary standards, no continuing Material Adverse Effect, specified officer and FIRPTA certificates, termination of certain Vesicor shareholder agreements, required third-party consents, and specified non-competition, lock-up and other ancillary agreements. Vesicor also requires Black Hawk’s and Merger Sub’s material covenant compliance and representation-and-warranty accuracy, a Black Hawk officer certificate, an effective Delaware certificate of incorporation for PubCo, and specified ancillary agreements. Vesicor must procure at least $10,000,000 of PPM Investment financing before Closing, unless Black Hawk and Vesicor waive that condition. The Nasdaq listing condition may be waived only to the extent permitted by law and with the written waiver of all three merger parties. As of the proxy statement/prospectus date, no PPM Investment commitments or funding had been received, and Nasdaq had not yet made its listing determination.
event_status: Pending; the Business Combination Agreement was signed on 4/26/2025, and the filing states that the transaction had not closed.
security_description: Vesicor Therapeutics, Inc. common stock, no par value per share. Outstanding, unexercised Vesicor warrants are treated separately: PubCo will assume and convert them into warrants to purchase PubCo Common Stock. PubCo treasury shares will be canceled.
available_options: No holder election; Vesicor shareholders receive stock consideration, with fractional shares rounded to the nearest whole share.

Fractional VICI shares are paid in cash.

closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permissible waiver, the mutual conditions include Golden shareholder approval; specified gaming and liquor approvals remaining in effect; completion of the pre-closing restructuring; no applicable governmental order prohibiting, or later-enacted law making illegal, the OpCo Sale or Merger; NYSE listing approval for the VICI shares; and effectiveness of the registration statement without an outstanding SEC stop order or proceeding. New HoldCo additionally requires the specified accuracy of OpCo Buyer’s, VICI’s and the merger subsidiary’s representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, no continuing material adverse effect, officer certificates and a tax opinion that the Merger qualifies as a reorganization. VICI and its merger subsidiary additionally require the specified accuracy of Golden’s and OpCo Buyer’s representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, no continuing material adverse effect, officer certificates, title to the subject properties and title policies, a reorganization tax opinion, no qualifying casualty or condemnation meeting the $174,000,000 threshold at closing, payment by OpCo Buyer of any Excess Debt Amount, and an updated study estimating Golden’s specified earnings and profits do not exceed $460,000,000. OpCo Buyer’s conditions to the OpCo Sale include specified representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, no continuing material adverse effect, officer certificates and VICI’s payment of the $426,000,000 Target Debt Amount. Financing is not a closing condition.
event_status: Pending as described in the proxy statement dated 3/6/2026; the Master Transaction Agreement was executed on 11/6/2025, and shareholder approval and closing remained prospective.
security_description: New HoldCo common stock, par value $0.01 per share, issued one-for-one to holders of Golden Entertainment, Inc. common stock, par value $0.01 per share, in the pre-closing F Reorganization. effective_date: Conditional: on the Closing Date, after the OpCo Sale and cash Distribution, when the articles of merger and certificate of merger have been filed with the Minnesota and Delaware secretaries of state, respectively, or at a later date and time agreed by the parties and specified in both filings. available_options: No holder election; the stated consideration is fixed.

acquirer: Calisa Acquisition Corp, the acquiring parent; its wholly owned subsidiary, Calisa Merger Sub, will merge into Goodvision AI Inc.
consideration_type: Stock: Calisa Acquisition Corp ordinary shares for eligible Goodvision AI Inc. ordinary shares, subject to a 10% escrow for indemnification. Goodvision shareholders are also entitled to contingent earnout shares if specified revenue and share-price conditions are met.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each eligible Goodvision AI Inc. ordinary share, the right to receive a number of Calisa Acquisition Corp ordinary shares equal to 18,000,000 divided by the number of fully diluted Goodvision shares outstanding immediately before the merger becomes effective, subject to a 10% escrow. Each holder’s Goodvision shares are aggregated before applying the ratio, and the resulting number of Calisa shares is rounded to the nearest whole share. Treasury shares receive no consideration; dissenting shares are excluded unless appraisal rights are withdrawn or lost. Goodvision shareholders are also entitled to 3,600,000 contingent earnout shares in aggregate: 1,800,000 if FY 2026 net revenue exceeds $19.9 million and the specified $12.00 share-price condition is met, and 1,800,000 if FY 2027 net revenue exceeds $106.0 million and the specified $15.00 share-price condition is met.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where permitted by law, written waiver of the applicable conditions: expiration or termination of applicable antitrust waiting periods and receipt of applicable antitrust approvals; no legal restraint prohibiting the merger; effectiveness of the registration statement/proxy statement without an effective SEC stop order or pending SEC proceeding seeking one; Goodvision and required Calisa shareholder approvals; satisfaction or waiver of all conditions to a financing with $5,000,000 in aggregate gross proceeds, to be consummated substantially concurrently with closing; and, if required by Calisa’s charter, at least $5,000,001 in net tangible assets immediately before or upon consummation. Additional party-specific conditions include the applicable accuracy of representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, absence of a Goodvision material adverse effect, absence of specified proceedings, execution and effectiveness of required ancillary documents, required closing deliverables, and approval of the Calisa share listing and satisfaction of applicable exchange listing requirements.
event_status: Announced; pending. The business combination agreement was executed on March 6, 2026, and closing remains subject to approvals and other conditions.
security_description: Goodvision AI Inc. ordinary shares, par value $5.00 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the merger becomes effective, excluding treasury shares and dissenting shares.
effective_date: Conditional: the merger becomes effective when the Cayman Islands Registrar accepts the plan of merger for filing, or at a later date or time agreed by Calisa Acquisition Corp and Goodvision AI Inc. and specified in the plan. The transaction was expected to close in the second half of 2026; no specific legal effective date or time is stated.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Goodvision shareholders receive stock consideration, subject to escrow and the contingent earnout conditions.

acquirer: Coursera, Inc., through Chess Merger Sub, Inc., its direct wholly owned merger subsidiary.
consideration_type: Stock; eligible Udemy common shares will be converted into the right to receive Coursera common stock, with cash paid only in lieu of fractional shares.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration per share of Udemy common stock is specified. Cash will be paid only in lieu of a fractional share of Coursera common stock: the fractional share, rounded to the nearest one-thousandth after taking into account all Udemy shares held by the holder immediately before the effective time, multiplied by the average closing-sale price of Coursera common stock on the NYSE for the five full trading days ending on the day before the closing date; the payment is rounded to the nearest cent.
stock_exchange_ratio: A fixed 0.800 shares of Coursera, Inc. common stock, par value $0.00001 per share, per 1 eligible share of Udemy, Inc. common stock, par value $0.00001 per share. The ratio is subject to appropriate, proportionate adjustment for specified reorganizations, recapitalizations, reclassifications, stock dividends, stock splits, reverse stock splits, and extraordinary dividends or distributions. No fractional Coursera shares will be issued; cash will be paid in lieu.
shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled virtual special meetings of both Coursera stockholders and Udemy stockholders: 4/9/2026 at 8:00 a.m. Pacific Time. Coursera stockholders will vote on the share issuance and charter amendment; Udemy stockholders will vote on adoption of the merger agreement.
closing_conditions: Mutual conditions include approval of Coursera’s share issuance and charter amendment proposals by Coursera stockholders and adoption of the merger agreement by Udemy stockholders; authorization for NYSE listing of the Coursera shares issuable to Udemy stockholders, subject to official notice of issuance; expiration or termination of applicable HSR waiting periods and any applicable timing-agreement commitment, plus receipt of specified other regulatory approvals and expiration or termination of their waiting periods; absence of an effective legal restraint or law prohibiting or making the merger illegal; and effectiveness of the Form S-4 without an SEC stop order or pending, unwithdrawn proceedings seeking one. The FTC granted early termination of the HSR waiting period on 2/9/2026; other required foreign regulatory approvals are not stated to have been obtained. Coursera’s and Merger Sub’s obligations also depend on Udemy’s representations and warranties meeting the merger agreement’s applicable accuracy standards, Udemy’s material covenant compliance, no material adverse effect on Udemy since 12/17/2025, and an Udemy officer’s certificate. Udemy’s obligations have corresponding conditions concerning Coursera, plus receipt of a closing-date counsel opinion that the merger, or an effective two-step restructuring, qualifies as a reorganization under Section 368(a) of the Internal Revenue Code. The agreement provides for waiver of conditions to the extent permitted by law.
event_status: Announced and pending as of the joint proxy statement/prospectus dated 3/10/2026; completion remained subject to closing conditions.
security_description: Issued and outstanding common stock of Udemy, Inc., par value $0.00001 per share, immediately before the merger’s effective time, excluding shares owned directly by Coursera, Udemy or Chess Merger Sub, Inc. (other than specified fiduciary or agency holdings beneficially owned by third parties). Excluded shares will be cancelled without consideration. Udemy equity awards have separate treatment.
effective_date: No calendar effective date is specified. Subject to closing, the merger will become effective when the certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed in writing by Coursera and Udemy and specified in that certificate. Closing is separately set for 8:00 a.m. New York City time no later than five business days after satisfaction or permitted waiver of the closing conditions, unless the parties agree otherwise in writing.
available_options: No holder election; each eligible Udemy common share will be converted into the right to receive the fixed stock consideration, with cash instead of any fractional Coursera share.

acquirer: GigCapital7 Corp., through its direct wholly owned subsidiary MMR Merger Sub, Inc., which will merge with and into Hadron Energy, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock; eligible holders of Hadron Energy, Inc. common stock will receive Domesticated GigCapital7 Common Stock. Excluded Shares, Dissenting Shares and Hadron Restricted Shares have different treatment.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each 1 share of Hadron Energy, Inc. common stock eligible for merger consideration, a number of shares of Domesticated GigCapital7 Common Stock equal to the Exchange Ratio. The Exchange Ratio is Aggregate Merger Consideration divided by Hadron Fully Diluted Capital. Aggregate Merger Consideration is ($1,200,200,000 divided by the $10.59 Per Share Price) minus 13,333,333 shares, further reduced, if Hadron Energy has indebtedness outstanding at closing, by the amount of that indebtedness divided by $10.59, rounded down to the nearest whole share. Hadron Fully Diluted Capital includes outstanding Hadron common shares after SAFE conversion, Hadron Restricted Shares and shares issuable on full exercise of outstanding Hadron Options calculated using the treasury method on a cashless-exercise basis. Fractional shares resulting from conversion of Company Securities in the Merger will be rounded up to the nearest whole share.
shareholder_vote_date: GigCapital7 Corp. shareholders’ extraordinary general meeting is scheduled for March [ ], 2026, at 1:00 p.m. Eastern Time; the day is not specified. Hadron Energy, Inc. stockholder approval is required, but no vote or written-consent date is stated.
closing_conditions: The Business Combination is subject to satisfaction or written waiver where permissible. Conditions for each party include GigCapital7 shareholder approval of the Condition Precedent Proposals and Hadron Energy stockholder approval; no effective law or order making the transactions illegal or preventing or prohibiting them; SEC effectiveness of the registration statement at closing without an effective stop order or unresolved SEC proceedings; conditional Nasdaq listing approval for the Domesticated GigCapital7 Common Stock, subject to the stated round-lot-holder requirement and lock-up-related exception; expiration or termination of the HSR Act and other applicable antitrust waiting periods and receipt of required antitrust approvals; and Hadron Energy having no outstanding indebtedness for borrowed money at closing, except ordinary-course trade payables and accrued expenses or amounts otherwise agreed in writing by GigCapital7. Conditions for Hadron Energy include GigCapital7 and Merger Sub representations and warranties being true and correct subject to the stated material-adverse-effect qualification, material compliance with their obligations and covenants, no continuing GigCapital7 material adverse effect, completion of the Domestication, arrangements making trust proceeds net of redemptions available at closing, at least $5,000,001 of GigCapital7 net tangible assets immediately after the Effective Time, at least $20,000,000 of Available Closing SPAC Cash at closing, constitution of the agreed post-closing board, and specified closing certificates and documents. Conditions for GigCapital7 and Merger Sub include Hadron Energy representations and warranties being true and correct subject to the stated material-adverse-effect qualification, material compliance with its obligations and covenants except the specified financial-statement delivery deadlines, no continuing Hadron Energy material adverse effect, no formal written NRC communication materially and adversely affecting Hadron Energy’s ability to consummate the Merger or preventing continued NRC engagement, amendment and conversion of all outstanding SAFEs before the Effective Time, and specified closing certificates and documents. The filing states that the HSR waiting period expired on November 26, 2025.
event_status: Pending; the Business Combination Agreement was amended on December 12, 2025, to expand the post-closing board to eight directors. The filing states that shareholder approvals and other closing conditions remain requirements.
security_description: Issued and outstanding Hadron Energy, Inc. common stock, excluding shares held by GigCapital7, Merger Sub or GigCapital7 subsidiaries, Hadron Energy treasury shares, Dissenting Shares and Hadron Restricted Shares. Outstanding SAFEs are to convert into Hadron common stock immediately before the Effective Time, and those shares receive the common-stock merger consideration. Excluded Shares are cancelled for no consideration; qualifying Dissenting Shares are subject to appraisal treatment; restricted-share awards and options are assumed and converted separately.
effective_date: Not specified. The Merger becomes effective when the Certificate of Merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed in writing by Hadron Energy, MMR Merger Sub, Inc. and GigCapital7 Corp. and specified in that certificate. Closing is to occur no later than the third business day after satisfaction or waiver of the applicable closing conditions, unless GigCapital7 and Hadron Energy agree otherwise.
available_options: No holder election for eligible Hadron Energy common shares: they convert into the right to receive the stock-based Per Share Merger Consideration. Holders of qualifying Dissenting Shares who properly exercise appraisal rights are treated separately.
default_option: Eligible issued and outstanding Hadron Energy common shares are cancelled and converted into the right to receive the stock-based Per Share Merger Consideration at the Effective Time, without holder action. The filing does not state a separate default for a missing or invalid consideration election.

acquirer: Beacon Topco, Inc. (Topco), the acquiring parent. Its wholly owned subsidiary, Cdog Merger Sub, Inc., will merge with and into Clywedog Therapeutics, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock; cash is payable only in lieu of fractional shares.
cash_consideration: Cash in lieu of fractional shares of Beacon Topco, Inc. common stock; no cash price per Clywedog share is stated.
stock_exchange_ratio: Between 0.000305 and 0.000508 shares of Beacon Topco, Inc. common stock per 1 share of Clywedog Therapeutics, Inc. common stock or Series Seed Preferred Stock, as finally determined by Clywedog and Barinthus Bio. The ratio will be adjusted proportionately to reflect Topco shares held by former Barinthus shareholders immediately before the merger, giving effect to the self-tender offer if elected. Whole shares are rounded down, with cash paid in lieu of fractional shares.
shareholder_vote_date: Clywedog stockholder approval is to be obtained by written consent no later than 24 hours after the registration statement becomes effective; no calendar consent date is stated.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where permitted by law, waiver of the applicable conditions: effectiveness of the registration statement without an outstanding stop order or related SEC proceeding; no effective order or law preventing or prohibiting the transactions; Barinthus shareholder approval of the Scheme of Arrangement and Scheme Implementation Proposal and court sanction of the Scheme, including the capital reduction; Clywedog stockholder approval; Nasdaq approval for listing Topco common stock, subject to official notice of issuance; specified UK National Security and Investment Act clearance; and expiration, termination or receipt of applicable antitrust waiting periods or consents. Additional conditions include the applicable accuracy of the parties’ representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, no material adverse effect, delivery of required certificates, continued effectiveness of specified lock-up agreements, termination of Clywedog investor agreements, completion of the self-tender offer if elected, and applicable minimum net cash requirements for both companies, subject to the stated collars. Under the February 2026 amendment, Clywedog’s minimum net cash is $1,000,000 for an assumed closing on either May 31 or June 30, 2026; Barinthus Bio’s is $22,850,000 or $20,470,000, respectively.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was amended on February 22, 2026. Completion remains subject to closing conditions.
security_description: Clywedog Therapeutics, Inc. common stock, $0.0001 par value per share, and Series Seed Preferred Stock, $0.0001 par value per share. Treasury shares and shares owned by Topco or Merger Sub immediately before the merger are excluded; shares with properly exercised appraisal rights receive separate treatment.
effective_date: Not stated as a calendar date. The merger becomes effective when the certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time specified in that certificate with Barinthus Bio’s and Clywedog’s consent. The Scheme Transaction is to occur before the merger.
available_options: No holder election; eligible holders receive the specified stock consideration and cash in lieu of fractional shares.

consideration_type: Stock; Vine Hill Class A shareholders receive Holdco ordinary shares. Public warrants are separately assumed as Holdco warrants. Public shareholders may instead request cash redemption if the Business Combination is consummated.
cash_consideration: No fixed cash merger consideration per Vine Hill Class A Share. Eligible Vine Hill Public Shareholders who properly elect redemption receive cash per redeemed share equal to its pro rata portion of the Trust Account, calculated two business days before Closing, including interest not previously released to Vine Hill and net of applicable taxes. The illustrative amount was approximately $10.68 per Vine Hill Public Share as of the 3/2/2026 record date; the actual Redemption Price is not fixed.
stock_exchange_ratio: 1 no-par-value Holdco Ordinary Share per 1 Vine Hill Class A Share, including a Class A Share issued upon conversion of a remaining Sponsor-held Vine Hill Class B Share. Redeemed public shares, dissenting shares and cancelled shares are excluded. Each outstanding Vine Hill Public Warrant converts into a warrant to purchase 1 Holdco Ordinary Share.
shareholder_vote_date: Vine Hill shareholder extraordinary general meeting scheduled for 3/27/2026 at 10:00 a.m., Eastern Time.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or written waiver where permissible: approval of the Business Combination, SPAC Merger and Organizational Document proposals by Vine Hill shareholders; CoinShares shareholder approval of the Scheme of Arrangement; specified regulatory approvals, including expiration or termination of any Hart-Scott-Rodino Act waiting period; no applicable legal prohibition or injunction; no secured creditors of Vine Hill; approval of Holdco Ordinary Shares for listing on Nasdaq or another agreed U.S. exchange, subject to official notice of issuance; effectiveness of the registration statement without an effective SEC stop order; and sanction of the Scheme by the Royal Court of Jersey and submission of its order for registration. Vine Hill's additional conditions include specified accuracy of CoinShares, Holdco and SPAC Merger Sub representations and warranties, material pre-Closing covenant compliance, no continuing CoinShares Material Adverse Effect, and material compliance with the Shareholder Support Agreement. CoinShares' additional conditions include specified accuracy and completeness of Vine Hill's disclosures, absence of a specified materially adverse effect on Vine Hill, no action or omission by Vine Hill or the Sponsor likely to impair Closing prerequisites, cancellation of the Sponsor's private warrants, and compliance with the Sponsor Support Agreement. The filing states the NTA Proposal is not a condition precedent to Closing.
event_status: Pending; the Business Combination Agreement has been executed, and Vine Hill shareholder approval is being sought.
security_description: Vine Hill Class A ordinary shares, par value $0.0001 per share, including public shares and Class A shares issued upon conversion of remaining Sponsor-held Class B ordinary shares. Outstanding Vine Hill Public Warrants receive separate warrant treatment.
effective_date: The SPAC Merger becomes effective when the Cayman Registrar registers the SPAC Plan of Merger, or at a later date or time agreed by CoinShares and Vine Hill and specified in that plan. No calendar date or time is stated. The Scheme of Arrangement is to become effective at least one day after the SPAC Merger and on the Closing Date.
available_options: Eligible Vine Hill Public Shareholders may retain their shares and receive 1 Holdco Ordinary Share per Vine Hill Class A Share, or request cash redemption of all or part of their public shares if the Business Combination is consummated. acquirer: Odysseus Holdings Limited (Holdco), through Odysseus (Cayman) Limited (SPAC Merger Sub), which directly acquires CoinShares under the Scheme of Arrangement
consideration_type: Stock for outstanding CoinShares ordinary shares: Holdco ordinary shares at a variable exchange ratio, except that PIPE Shares exchange one-for-one. Vested CoinShares options are cancelled for formula-based cash payments; unvested options become options to purchase Holdco ordinary shares.
cash_consideration: No cash consideration per outstanding CoinShares ordinary share is stated. Each vested CoinShares Option is instead cancelled for cash equal to the excess, if any, of Equity Value Per Share over that option's per-share exercise price, multiplied by the number of underlying CoinShares Shares, less applicable withholding. No consideration is delivered for CoinShares treasury shares. The agreement provides an additional Holdco Ordinary Share, rather than cash, where fractional-share consideration remains after aggregation.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each outstanding CoinShares ordinary share other than a PIPE Share or treasury share: Holdco Ordinary Shares equal to the Equity Exchange Ratio, calculated as Equity Value Per Share divided by $10.00. Equity Value Per Share equals Equity Value divided by Fully Diluted Company Equity Securities; the agreement defines Equity Value as $1,200,000,000 plus aggregate Company Filing Fees, and fully diluted securities as outstanding CoinShares Shares other than PIPE Shares plus shares that would be issued if vested and unvested CoinShares Options were net settled. Each PIPE Share exchanges for 1 Holdco Ordinary Share. For each unvested CoinShares Option, the underlying number of Holdco Ordinary Shares equals its underlying CoinShares Shares multiplied by the Equity Exchange Ratio, rounded down to a whole share; the per-share exercise price is divided by that ratio and rounded up to the nearest cent. After aggregating fractional Holdco shares otherwise due to a shareholder under the Scheme, one Holdco Ordinary Share is issued in lieu of a remaining fractional share. The agreement also provides for adjustment following specified changes in Holdco Ordinary Shares before Closing.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or written waiver where permissible: approval of the Condition Precedent Proposals by Vine Hill shareholders and approval of the Scheme of Arrangement by CoinShares shareholders, including approval at the court-ordered meeting by a majority in number representing three-fourths of the voting rights of shareholders or the relevant class present and voting; specified regulatory approvals, including expiration or termination of any Hart-Scott-Rodino Act waiting period; no applicable legal prohibition or injunction; no secured creditors of Vine Hill; approval of Holdco Ordinary Shares for listing on Nasdaq or another agreed U.S. exchange, subject to official notice of issuance; effectiveness of the registration statement without an effective SEC stop order; and the Royal Court of Jersey's sanction of the Scheme and delivery of the court order for registration. Vine Hill's additional conditions include specified accuracy of CoinShares, Holdco and SPAC Merger Sub representations and warranties, material pre-Closing covenant compliance, no continuing CoinShares Material Adverse Effect, and material compliance with the Shareholder Support Agreement. CoinShares' additional conditions include specified accuracy and completeness of Vine Hill's disclosures, absence of a specified materially adverse effect on Vine Hill, no action or omission by Vine Hill or the Sponsor likely to impair Closing prerequisites, cancellation of the Sponsor's private warrants, and compliance with the Sponsor Support Agreement.
event_status: Pending; the Business Combination Agreement has been executed, and the Scheme of Arrangement remains subject to shareholder and court approval and other closing conditions.
security_description: CoinShares International Limited ordinary shares, par value £0.000495 per share. Outstanding ordinary shares other than PIPE Shares receive variable-ratio stock consideration; PIPE Shares receive one-for-one stock consideration; treasury shares receive no consideration. CoinShares Options have separate vested and unvested treatment.
effective_date: The Scheme of Arrangement becomes effective upon delivery of the Royal Court of Jersey's sanctioning order to the Jersey Registrar. It is to take effect at least one day after the SPAC Merger effective time and on the Closing Date. No calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: No holder election for the consideration assigned to each security category: ordinary CoinShares Shares other than PIPE Shares receive the variable-ratio Holdco stock consideration; PIPE Shares receive one Holdco Ordinary Share each; vested and unvested CoinShares Options receive their specified, different treatments.
default_option: No alternative default treatment for an ordinary CoinShares Share is stated: the agreement provides its exchange for Holdco Ordinary Shares, subject to the separate PIPE Share and treasury-share treatments.
