acquirer: New Providence Acquisition Corp. III (parent); Aether Merger Sub I Corp. is its wholly-owned merger subsidiary.
consideration_type: Stock; each outstanding share of Abra Financial Holdings, Inc. common stock, other than excluded securities, is exchanged for SPAC common stock at the Exchange Ratio.
stock_exchange_ratio: A number of shares of New Providence Acquisition Corp. III common stock per 1 share of Abra Financial Holdings, Inc. common stock equal to the Exchange Ratio: Merger Consideration divided by Fully-Diluted Company Shares. Merger Consideration is $750,000,000 divided by the Redemption Price, which is the price at which each SPAC public share is redeemed under SPAC’s organizational documents and IPO prospectus. Fully-Diluted Company Shares includes outstanding Abra common stock plus shares issuable upon exercise of outstanding Abra options, calculated using the treasury stock method. The ratio is not stated as a fixed number.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or written waiver where permissible: requisite approvals of New Providence shareholders and Abra stockholders; expiration or termination of applicable antitrust waiting periods; required governmental consents; no law or order prohibiting the transactions; appointment of the post-closing SPAC board; an effective Form S-4 registration statement with no stop order; an amended SPAC charter; Nasdaq approval to list SPAC common stock; and adoption of an incentive plan. Abra’s additional conditions include specified SPAC representations and warranties being accurate, material compliance with SPAC covenants, and Net Cash Proceeds of at least $40 million. SPAC’s additional conditions include specified Abra representations and warranties being accurate, material compliance with Abra covenants, no Material Adverse Effect on Abra since the agreement date, specified ancillary agreements being effective, repayment or cancellation of specified related-party loans, and specified employment agreement, consents, trademark-assignment, Plutus-securities, FIRPTA and F Reorganization deliveries. The agreement also specifies customary closing certificates and good-standing certificates.
event_status: Pending; the parties entered into a definitive business combination agreement on March 16, 2026, and closing remains subject to approvals and other conditions.
security_description: Issued and outstanding common stock of Abra Financial Holdings, Inc., par value $0.0001 per share, other than excluded securities. Outstanding Abra options are assumed and converted into options for SPAC common stock rather than exchanged as common shares.
effective_date: Upon filing the Certificate of Merger with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time specified in that certificate; no calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: No holder election

Outstanding units separate into one Class A ordinary share and one right before the merger. The SPAC's obligation is also subject to specified accuracy of the other parties' representations and warranties, their material covenant compliance, no material adverse effect on the Company or Pubco since the agreement date, and completion of the Dragonfly Contribution and Foundation Transaction under their agreements.

consideration_type: Stock
stock_exchange_ratio: 1 share of Avalanche Treasury Corporation Class A common stock per 1 Avalanche Treasury Company LLC unit held by a Company Member other than a Seller Related Party. Treasury units are cancelled without conversion or payment. No fractional Pubco shares will be issued; aggregate fractional entitlements are rounded down to the nearest whole share.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permissible written waiver by the Seller and Mountain Lake Acquisition Corp. of: requisite Mountain Lake Acquisition Corp. shareholder approval; no effective law making the transactions illegal or preventing or prohibiting them; SEC effectiveness of the registration statement continuing through closing; and approval of Pubco Class A stock for DTC clearing and listing on an acceptable national exchange, subject only to notice of issuance. Additional conditions include specified accuracy of Mountain Lake Acquisition Corp.'s representations and warranties, material compliance with its obligations and covenants, no continuing and uncured material adverse effect on Mountain Lake Acquisition Corp. since the agreement date, and material performance of the Sponsor's covenants under the Sponsor Support Agreement. The SPAC's obligation is also subject to specified accuracy of the Company, Pubco, their subsidiaries, the Seller Related Parties and Astral's representations and warranties; their material covenant compliance; no material adverse effect on the Company or Pubco since the agreement date; and completion of the Dragonfly Contribution and Foundation Transaction under their agreements.
event_status: Pending; business combination agreement amended on March 17, 2026, including postponement of the issuance of 2,000,000 Astral Post-Closing Shares until the 30th calendar day after the Closing Date
security_description: Avalanche Treasury Company LLC units held by Company Members other than the Seller Related Parties
effective_date: Proposed to take effect on the Closing Date when the Company Certificate of Merger is accepted for filing by the Delaware Secretary of State, or at another time specified in that certificate. No calendar date or clock time is stated.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Company Members other than the Seller Related Parties receive the fixed Class A stock consideration.

consideration_type: Cash
cash_consideration: $47.00 in cash per share of Tri Pointe Homes, Inc. common stock, without interest and subject to required tax withholding. Treasury shares and shares held by Parent or Merger Sub or their wholly owned subsidiaries receive no payment; shares held by wholly owned subsidiaries of Tri Pointe Homes, Inc. are converted into surviving-corporation stock; dissenting shares are subject to appraisal rights instead.
stock_exchange_ratio: No stock consideration is payable for outstanding Tri Pointe Homes, Inc. common stock converted into the right to receive merger consideration; shares held by wholly owned subsidiaries of Tri Pointe Homes, Inc. receive different treatment.
shareholder_vote_date: Tri Pointe Homes, Inc. stockholders’ special meeting scheduled for 4/16/2026 at 10:00 a.m. Pacific Time.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver where permitted by law: Tri Pointe Homes, Inc. stockholder approval; expiration or termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period, including extensions; and no post-agreement law, order or injunction restraining, enjoining or otherwise prohibiting the merger. Parent’s and Merger Sub’s additional conditions include the specified accuracy of the Company’s representations and warranties, the Company’s material compliance with its obligations and covenants, no Company Material Adverse Effect since the agreement date, and a Company officer’s certificate. The Company’s additional conditions include the specified accuracy of Parent’s and Merger Sub’s representations and warranties, their material compliance with their obligations and covenants, and a Parent officer’s certificate. Obtaining financing is not a closing condition.
event_status: Pending as described in the proxy statement dated 3/17/2026; the merger agreement was executed, and stockholder approval and other closing conditions remained required.
security_description: Tri Pointe Homes, Inc. common stock, par value $0.01 per share; treasury, specified affiliate-held and dissenting shares have different treatment.
effective_date: Conditional: the merger becomes effective when the certificate of merger is filed with and accepted by the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later date and time agreed by the parties and specified in the certificate. No specific effective date is stated.
available_options: No holder election; eligible common shares are converted into the right to receive fixed cash consideration, subject to the stated exclusions and appraisal rights.
